seg.6a61d0d1cb9e.src: Chimmili for Nagula Chavithi ⟦1⟧(Sesame Jaggery Balls)⟦/1⟧

seg.4fea7db714b7.src: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet of roasted sesame and jaggery, ground coarsely and rolled into balls. It is one of the offerings made on Nagula Chavithi in Karthika masam, along with chalimidi and the milk poured at the snake anthill (putta). Sesame and jaggery sweets like it are made again at Sankranti.
seg.4fea7db714b7.t: चिम्मिली ही एक छोटी तेलुगु मिठाई आहे: भाजलेले तीळ आणि गूळ जाडसर वाटून त्याचे गोळे वळले जातात. कार्तिक मासात नागुला चविथीला दाखवल्या जाणाऱ्या नैवेद्यांपैकी ही एक, सोबत चलिमिडी आणि नागाच्या वारुळावर (पुट्टा) घातलेले दूध. अशा तिळगुळाच्या मिठाया पुन्हा संक्रांतीला केल्या जातात.
seg.4fea7db714b7.back: Chimmili is a small Telugu sweet: roasted sesame and jaggery are coarsely ground and rolled into balls. In the month of Karthika it is one of the naivedyams offered on Nagula Chavithi, along with chalimidi and the milk poured at the snake anthill (putta). Such sesame-jaggery sweets are made again at Sankranti.

seg.6e104d560e56.src: Roasted sesame gives it a nutty, toasty taste, and cane jaggery a caramel sweetness. The texture is soft and a little crumbly, and each ball is gone in two bites. This recipe makes about 12.
seg.6e104d560e56.t: भाजलेल्या तिळामुळे याला खमंग, सुक्या मेव्यासारखी चव येते, आणि उसाच्या गुळामुळे कॅरमेलसारखा गोडवा. लाडू मऊ आणि थोडे भुसभुशीत असतात, आणि प्रत्येक लाडू दोन घासांत संपतो. या पाककृतीने सुमारे 12 लाडू होतात.
seg.6e104d560e56.back: Because of the roasted sesame it gets a toasty, dry-fruit-like taste, and because of the sugarcane jaggery a caramel-like sweetness. The laddus are soft and slightly crumbly, and each laddu is finished in two mouthfuls. This recipe makes about 12 laddus.

seg.9e72f273d4f2.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the roasted sesame to cool.
seg.9e72f273d4f2.t: एकूण वेळेत भाजलेले तीळ थंड होण्याची 5 मिनिटेही धरली आहेत.
seg.9e72f273d4f2.back: The total time also counts the 5 minutes for the roasted sesame to cool.

seg.df9373d040ca.src: ⟦1⟧The recipe card⟦/1⟧Save it or send it to family. ⟦2⟧Open full size⟦/2⟧
seg.df9373d040ca.t: ⟦1⟧पाककृती कार्ड⟦/1⟧सेव्ह करा किंवा घरच्यांना पाठवा. ⟦2⟧पूर्ण आकारात उघडा⟦/2⟧
seg.df9373d040ca.back: ⟦1⟧Recipe card⟦/1⟧Save it or send it to family. ⟦2⟧Open in full size⟦/2⟧

seg.2097a0e593c6.src: Make chimmili at home: roast sesame till it crackles, grind coarsely, pulse with grated cane jaggery and cardamom, shape into balls.
seg.2097a0e593c6.t: घरी चिम्मिली करा: तीळ तडतडेपर्यंत भाजा, जाडसर वाटा, किसलेला उसाचा गूळ आणि वेलची घालून मिक्सर थांबून थांबून फिरवा, आणि लाडू वळा.
seg.2097a0e593c6.back: Make chimmili at home: roast the sesame until it crackles, grind coarsely, add grated sugarcane jaggery and cardamom and run the mixer stopping and starting, and roll laddus.

seg.ac56800c5ad4.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; soft jaggery binds best⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.t: ¾ कप किसलेला उसाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧हलका दाबून भरलेला; मऊ गुळाने मिश्रण सर्वात छान बांधले जाते⟦/1⟧
seg.ac56800c5ad4.back: ¾ cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧filled lightly pressed; with soft jaggery the mixture binds best⟦/1⟧

seg.39c46fb56757.src: 1 tsp ghee, for greasing your palms
seg.39c46fb56757.back: 1 small spoon (teaspoon) ghee, for applying to the palms

seg.ed775cba4fcf.src: Grate the jaggery and measure out the sesame before you start; once the sesame is roasted, the rest moves quickly.
seg.ed775cba4fcf.t: सुरू करण्याआधी गूळ किसून घ्या आणि तीळ मोजून ठेवा; तीळ भाजले की पुढचे काम पटपट होते.
seg.ed775cba4fcf.back: Before starting, grate the jaggery and keep the sesame measured; once the sesame is roasted the next work goes quickly.

seg.cfb9d281b47f.src: Heat a heavy kadai or pan on low heat for a minute. Add the sesame; no oil or ghee is needed.
seg.cfb9d281b47f.t: जाड बुडाची कढई किंवा पॅन मंद आचेवर एक मिनिट गरम करा. तीळ घाला; तेल किंवा तूप लागत नाही.
seg.cfb9d281b47f.back: Heat a heavy-bottomed kadai or pan on low flame for a minute. Add the sesame; oil or ghee is not needed.

seg.89a51ce5355c.src: Dry-roast the sesame on a low flame till it crackles and turns light golden. Stir all the time; the seeds start to pop and smell nutty after 4–6 minutes. Do not let them turn brown.
seg.89a51ce5355c.t: तीळ मंद आचेवर कोरडेच भाजा, ते तडतडेपर्यंत आणि हलके सोनेरी होईपर्यंत. सतत हलवत राहा; 4–6 मिनिटांनंतर दाणे फुटू लागतात आणि खमंग वास येतो. ते तपकिरी होऊ देऊ नका.
seg.89a51ce5355c.back: Roast the sesame dry on low flame, until they crackle and become light golden. Keep stirring continuously; after 4–6 minutes the seeds start to pop and a toasty smell comes. Do not let them become brown.

seg.999792547560.src: Tip the sesame onto a wide plate straight away so it stops browning. Cool it for about 5 minutes, until it is just warm to the touch.
seg.999792547560.t: तीळ लगेच एका रुंद ताटात काढा, म्हणजे ते आणखी तपकिरी होणार नाहीत. सुमारे 5 मिनिटे थंड होऊ द्या, हात लावल्यावर फक्त कोमट लागेपर्यंत.
seg.999792547560.back: Immediately take the sesame out onto a wide plate, so that they will not get more brown. Let them cool about 5 minutes, until they feel just lukewarm when touched by hand.

seg.77b614ea2f92.src: Grind the sesame coarsely in short pulses. Use the small jar of the mixer and pulse 3–4 times, a second or two at a time; stop while you can still see broken seeds.
seg.77b614ea2f92.t: तीळ थोडा थोडा वेळ मिक्सर फिरवत जाडसर वाटा. मिक्सरचे लहान भांडे वापरा आणि 3–4 वेळा, दर वेळी एक-दोन सेकंद फिरवा; तुटलेले दाणे अजून दिसत असतानाच थांबा.
seg.77b614ea2f92.back: Grind the sesame coarsely running the mixer a little at a time. Use the small jar of the mixer and run it 3–4 times, each time a second or two; stop while the broken seeds are still visible.

seg.175aeced5810.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom; pulse till it comes together. This takes 4–6 more short pulses; scrape down the sides once. A pinch pressed between your fingers should hold its shape.
seg.175aeced5810.t: गूळ आणि वेलची घाला; मिश्रण एकजीव होईपर्यंत थांबून थांबून फिरवा. यासाठी आणखी 4–6 छोटे फेरे लागतात; एकदा कडेचे मिश्रण खरवडून खाली करा. बोटांमध्ये दाबलेले चिमूटभर मिश्रण आकार धरून राहिले, की झाले.
seg.175aeced5810.back: Add the jaggery and cardamom; run stopping and starting until the mixture comes together. This needs 4–6 more small rounds; once scrape down the mixture from the sides. If a pinch of mixture pressed between the fingers holds its shape, it is done.

seg.6f94cb46b9ab.src: If the mixture is too dry to hold, add 1–2 tsp more grated jaggery and pulse once or twice again.
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.t: मिश्रण इतके कोरडे असेल की बांधले जात नसेल, तर आणखी 1–2 छोटे चमचे किसलेला गूळ घाला आणि एक-दोनदा पुन्हा फिरवा.
seg.6f94cb46b9ab.back: If the mixture is so dry that it is not binding, add 1–2 more small spoons (teaspoons) of grated jaggery and run once or twice again.

seg.226f137c9449.src: Tip the mixture into a bowl and grease your palms lightly with ghee.
seg.226f137c9449.t: मिश्रण एका वाडग्यात काढा आणि तळहातांना थोडे तूप लावा.
seg.226f137c9449.back: Take the mixture out into a bowl and apply a little ghee to the palms.

seg.ff3eb71729c2.src: Shape into small balls. Take a heaped tablespoon at a time, press it firmly in your fist, then roll it smooth. Work quickly while the mixture is still warm, as it turns crumbly when it cools.
seg.ff3eb71729c2.t: छोटे लाडू वळा. एका वेळी एक भरलेला मोठा चमचा मिश्रण घ्या, मुठीत घट्ट दाबा, मग गोल आणि गुळगुळीत वळा. मिश्रण गरम असतानाच पटपट वळा, कारण थंड झाल्यावर ते भुसभुशीत होते.
seg.ff3eb71729c2.back: Roll small laddus. Take one heaped big spoon (tablespoon) of mixture at a time, press tightly in the fist, then roll round and smooth. Roll quickly while the mixture is still warm, because after cooling it becomes crumbly.

seg.ee9e027268aa.src: Leave the balls on a plate until they cool completely, about 15 minutes, then store them in an airtight jar.
seg.ee9e027268aa.t: लाडू ताटात पूर्ण थंड होऊ द्या, सुमारे 15 मिनिटे, मग हवाबंद डब्यात ठेवा.
seg.ee9e027268aa.back: Let the laddus cool completely on the plate, about 15 minutes, then keep them in an airtight box.

seg.7fe633314020.src: Roast on a low flame and keep stirring; sesame goes from golden to burnt quickly, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.
seg.7fe633314020.t: मंद आचेवर भाजा आणि हलवत राहा; तीळ सोनेरीवरून करपायला वेळ लागत नाही, आणि करपलेले तीळ कडू लागतात.
seg.7fe633314020.back: Roast on low flame and keep stirring; sesame takes no time to go from golden to burnt, and burnt sesame tastes bitter.

seg.d50b37351252.src: Grind in short pulses only; long runs turn sesame into an oily paste.
seg.d50b37351252.t: फक्त थोड्या थोड्या फेऱ्यांतच वाटा; जास्त वेळ फिरवल्यास तिळाची तेलकट पेस्ट होते.
seg.d50b37351252.back: Grind only in short rounds; running for too long makes an oily paste of the sesame.

seg.75f5428655c4.src: Shape while the mixture is warm. If it turns crumbly, pulse it once more with a teaspoon of grated jaggery.
seg.75f5428655c4.t: मिश्रण गरम असतानाच लाडू वळा. ते भुसभुशीत झाले तर एक छोटा चमचा किसलेला गूळ घालून आणखी एकदा फिरवा.
seg.75f5428655c4.back: Roll the laddus while the mixture is still warm. If it becomes crumbly, add a small spoon (teaspoon) of grated jaggery and run once more.

seg.1d42a24453d2.src: Soft jaggery binds best. If yours is hard, grate it finely so it blends in evenly.
seg.1d42a24453d2.t: मऊ गुळाने मिश्रण सर्वात छान बांधले जाते. तुमचा गूळ कडक असेल तर तो बारीक किसा, म्हणजे सगळीकडे सारखा मिसळेल.
seg.1d42a24453d2.back: With soft jaggery the mixture binds best. If your jaggery is hard, grate it finely, so that it mixes evenly everywhere.

seg.5a7ed16f4810.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker chimmili with a smoky sweetness.
seg.5a7ed16f4810.t: ताडाचा गूळ: तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ वापरा; चिम्मिली गडद रंगाची होईल आणि गोडव्याला हलकी धुरकट चव येईल.
seg.5a7ed16f4810.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the chimmili will be dark in colour and the sweetness will get a slight smoky taste.

seg.569a63f3cd17.src: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind it the same way for darker, stronger-tasting balls.
seg.569a63f3cd17.t: काळे तीळ (नल्ला नुव्वुलु): तसेच भाजून वाटा; लाडू गडद रंगाचे आणि जास्त ठसठशीत चवीचे होतील.
seg.569a63f3cd17.back: Black sesame (nalla nuvvulu): roast and grind the same way; the laddus will be dark in colour and with a bolder taste.

seg.da0d1a9b6378.src: Peanut or coconut: pulse in 2 tbsp roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut with the jaggery.
seg.da0d1a9b6378.t: शेंगदाणे किंवा खोबरे: गुळासोबत 2 मोठे चमचे भाजलेले शेंगदाणे किंवा किसलेले सुके खोबरे घालून फिरवा.
seg.da0d1a9b6378.back: Peanuts or coconut: along with the jaggery add 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of roasted peanuts or grated dry coconut and run.

seg.32d41fc0994e.src: Without a mixer: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar (rolu) until the mixture holds, then shape.
seg.32d41fc0994e.t: मिक्सर नसेल तर: गरम तीळ आणि गूळ दगडी खलबत्त्यात (रोलु) एकत्र कुटा, मिश्रण बांधले जाईपर्यंत, मग लाडू वळा.
seg.32d41fc0994e.back: If there is no mixer: pound the warm sesame and jaggery together in a stone mortar-pestle (rolu), until the mixture binds, then roll laddus.

seg.2fa9aaef4425.src: On Nagula Chavithi morning, offer chimmili with milk at the snake anthill (putta) or in your puja, then share them as prasadam. They also go well with evening tea.
seg.2fa9aaef4425.t: नागुला चविथीच्या सकाळी चिम्मिली दुधासोबत नागाच्या वारुळावर (पुट्टा) किंवा तुमच्या पूजेत दाखवा, मग प्रसाद म्हणून वाटा. संध्याकाळच्या चहासोबतही ते छान लागतात.
seg.2fa9aaef4425.back: On the morning of Nagula Chavithi offer the chimmili with milk at the snake anthill (putta) or in your puja, then distribute as prasad. They also taste nice with evening tea.

seg.bd50831bbb3f.src: Keeps a week in an airtight jar. Store the jar at room temperature, in a dry place.
seg.bd50831bbb3f.t: हवाबंद डब्यात एक आठवडा टिकतात. डबा खोलीच्या तापमानाला, कोरड्या जागी ठेवा.
seg.bd50831bbb3f.back: They keep for one week in an airtight box. Keep the box at room temperature, in a dry place.

seg.4023b0de08bd.src: Why is my chimmili not holding together?
seg.4023b0de08bd.t: माझी चिम्मिली बांधली का जात नाही?
seg.4023b0de08bd.back: Why is my chimmili not binding?

seg.7fed90d1ebe0.src: The sesame may be under-ground, or the mixture may have cooled. Pulse it once more with 1–2 tsp extra grated jaggery and shape it while it is still warm.
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.t: तीळ नीट वाटले गेले नसतील, किंवा मिश्रण थंड झाले असेल. 1–2 छोटे चमचे जास्तीचा किसलेला गूळ घालून आणखी एकदा फिरवा आणि गरम असतानाच लाडू वळा.
seg.7fed90d1ebe0.back: The sesame may not have been ground properly, or the mixture may have cooled. Add 1–2 small spoons (teaspoons) of extra grated jaggery and run once more and roll the laddus while still warm.

seg.694d2b416f39.src: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?
seg.694d2b416f39.back: Why does my chimmili taste bitter?

seg.d0ee77d0957e.src: The sesame was roasted too dark. Roast it on a low flame only until it crackles and turns light golden, then tip it onto a plate at once so it stops browning.
seg.d0ee77d0957e.t: तीळ जास्त गडद भाजले गेले. मंद आचेवर फक्त तडतडेपर्यंत आणि हलके सोनेरी होईपर्यंत भाजा, मग लगेच ताटात काढा, म्हणजे ते आणखी तपकिरी होणार नाहीत.
seg.d0ee77d0957e.back: The sesame was roasted too dark. On low flame roast only until they crackle and become light golden, then immediately take out onto a plate, so that they will not get more brown.

seg.30d31a37acfa.src: Can I use palm jaggery instead of cane jaggery?
seg.30d31a37acfa.t: उसाच्या गुळाऐवजी ताडाचा गूळ वापरू शकतो का?
seg.30d31a37acfa.back: Can palm jaggery be used instead of sugarcane jaggery?

seg.77afe99f558c.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The chimmili will be darker, with a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.77afe99f558c.t: हो. तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) वापरा. चिम्मिली गडद होईल, आणि गोडवा जास्त गहिरा, किंचित धुरकट असेल.
seg.77afe99f558c.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The chimmili will be darker, and the sweetness more deep, slightly smoky.

seg.bae4fc214e74.src: Nagula Chavithi falls on Friday, 13 November 2026, in Karthika masam, a few days after Deepavali. Chimmili, chalimidi and milk are among the offerings made at the snake anthill (putta) that morning.
seg.bae4fc214e74.t: नागुला चविथी शुक्रवार, 13 नोव्हेंबर 2026 रोजी आहे, कार्तिक मासात, दीपावलीनंतर काही दिवसांनी. त्या सकाळी नागाच्या वारुळावर (पुट्टा) दाखवल्या जाणाऱ्या नैवेद्यांमध्ये चिम्मिली, चलिमिडी आणि दूध असते.
seg.bae4fc214e74.back: Nagula Chavithi is on Friday, 13 November 2026, in the month of Karthika, a few days after Deepavali. The naivedyams offered at the snake anthill (putta) that morning include chimmili, chalimidi and milk.

seg.4b090c2ce3d3.src: Filter coffee is how many Telugu homes start the day: a strong decoction dripped through a steel filter, topped up with hot milk and frothed between a tumbler and davara. This version is sweetened with grated palm jaggery (thati bellam) in place of sugar.
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.t: अनेक तेलुगु घरांत दिवसाची सुरुवात फिल्टर कॉफीने होते: स्टीलच्या फिल्टरमधून ठिबकलेले कडक डिकॉक्शन, वरून गरम दूध, आणि टंबलर व दवरा यांच्यात ओतून आणलेला फेस. या प्रकारात साखरेऐवजी किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) घातला जातो.
seg.4b090c2ce3d3.back: In many Telugu homes the day starts with filter coffee: strong decoction dripped through a steel filter, hot milk on top, and froth brought up by pouring between the tumbler and dabara. In this variation grated palm jaggery (tati bellam) is added instead of sugar.

seg.cff6d2079da1.src: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky caramel sweetness that sits well with the bitterness of the decoction. Once the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it suits a slow morning as much as an evening break.
seg.cff6d2079da1.t: ताडाच्या गुळाने कपाला गहिरा, किंचित धुरकट, कॅरमेलसारखा गोडवा येतो, जो डिकॉक्शनच्या कडवटपणासोबत छान जुळतो. डिकॉक्शन तयार असेल तर सुमारे 5 मिनिटे लागतात, आणि निवांत सकाळीही ती तितकीच छान वाटते जितकी संध्याकाळच्या ब्रेकमध्ये.
seg.cff6d2079da1.back: Palm jaggery gives the cup a deep, slightly smoky, caramel-like sweetness, which matches nicely with the bitterness of the decoction. If the decoction is ready it takes about 5 minutes, and it feels just as nice on a leisurely morning as in an evening break.

seg.814efc526088.src: 5 minutes if your decoction is already made.
seg.814efc526088.t: डिकॉक्शन आधीच तयार असेल तर 5 मिनिटे.
seg.814efc526088.back: If the decoction is already ready, 5 minutes.

seg.9ad0a1e24d76.src: Boil the milk, add it to the decoction, then stir in grated palm jaggery off the heat. Froth it between tumbler and davara.
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.t: दूध उकळा, ते डिकॉक्शनमध्ये घाला, मग आचेवरून उतरवून किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ ढवळून मिसळा. टंबलर आणि दवरा यांच्यात ओतून फेस आणा.
seg.9ad0a1e24d76.back: Boil the milk, add it to the decoction, then taking it off the flame stir in grated palm jaggery. Bring up froth by pouring between the tumbler and dabara.

seg.927b924ff51d.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧enough decoction for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.t: 2 मोठे चमचे फिल्टर कॉफी पावडर ⟦1⟧2–3 कपांसाठी पुरेसे डिकॉक्शन⟦/1⟧
seg.927b924ff51d.back: 2 big spoons (tablespoons) filter coffee powder ⟦1⟧enough decoction for 2–3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.8aa60818ccf8.src: ½ cup water, just off the boil
seg.8aa60818ccf8.t: ½ कप पाणी, नुकतेच उकळीवरून उतरवलेले
seg.8aa60818ccf8.back: ½ cup water, just taken off the boil

seg.95409b9d346e.src: 2 tbsp filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧from above; 3 tbsp for a stronger cup⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.t: 2 मोठे चमचे फिल्टर कॉफी डिकॉक्शन ⟦1⟧वर केलेले; कडक कपासाठी 3 मोठे चमचे⟦/1⟧
seg.95409b9d346e.back: 2 big spoons (tablespoons) filter coffee decoction ⟦1⟧made above; 3 big spoons for a strong cup⟦/1⟧

seg.7b8c0f7e922a.back: 1–2 small spoons (teaspoons) grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.95d91fecafcb.src: Make the decoction: put 2 tbsp filter coffee powder in the top chamber of a South Indian coffee filter, set the perforated press on it and pour in ½ cup water just off the boil. Cover and leave it to drip for 10–15 minutes.
seg.95d91fecafcb.t: डिकॉक्शन करा: दक्षिण भारतीय कॉफी फिल्टरच्या वरच्या भागात 2 मोठे चमचे फिल्टर कॉफी पावडर घाला, त्यावर छिद्रांचा प्रेस ठेवा आणि नुकतेच उकळीवरून उतरवलेले ½ कप पाणी ओता. झाकून 10–15 मिनिटे ठिबकू द्या.
seg.95d91fecafcb.back: Make the decoction: put 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of filter coffee powder in the upper part of a South Indian coffee filter, place the perforated press on it and pour ½ cup of water just taken off the boil. Cover and let it drip 10–15 minutes.

seg.9024c8716b54.src: While it drips, grate the palm jaggery finely so it dissolves in seconds.
seg.9024c8716b54.t: ते ठिबकत असताना ताडाचा गूळ बारीक किसून घ्या, म्हणजे तो काही सेकंदांत विरघळेल.
seg.9024c8716b54.back: While it is dripping grate the palm jaggery finely, so that it will dissolve in a few seconds.

seg.24689e3dd311.src: Pour the milk into a small saucepan and set it on medium heat.
seg.24689e3dd311.t: दूध एका लहान पातेल्यात ओता आणि मध्यम आचेवर ठेवा.
seg.24689e3dd311.back: Pour the milk into a small pot and keep on medium flame.

seg.4d8e3042dc81.src: Bring the milk to a boil. As soon as it froths up the sides of the pan, switch off the heat.
seg.4d8e3042dc81.t: दुधाला उकळी येऊ द्या. फेस पातेल्याच्या कडेपर्यंत वर येताच आच बंद करा.
seg.4d8e3042dc81.back: Let the milk come to a boil. As soon as the froth rises up to the edge of the pot, turn off the flame.

seg.a124a0d34983.src: Pour the decoction into a tumbler and add the hot milk. Use 2 tbsp decoction for a mild cup and 3 tbsp for a strong one.
seg.a124a0d34983.t: डिकॉक्शन टंबलरमध्ये ओता आणि गरम दूध घाला. सौम्य कपासाठी 2 मोठे चमचे डिकॉक्शन आणि कडक कपासाठी 3 मोठे चमचे वापरा.
seg.a124a0d34983.back: Pour the decoction into the tumbler and add the hot milk. For a mild cup use 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of decoction and for a strong cup 3 big spoons.

seg.85570720618b.src: Let it stand for about a minute, so the milk is just off the boil.
seg.85570720618b.t: सुमारे एक मिनिट तसेच राहू द्या, म्हणजे दुधाची उकळी नुकतीच खाली बसेल.
seg.85570720618b.back: Let it stay like that for about a minute, so that the boil of the milk just settles down.

seg.eacea0d7cf43.src: Stir in the palm jaggery off the heat. Keep stirring for 20–30 seconds, until no grains are left at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.eacea0d7cf43.t: आचेपासून दूर ताडाचा गूळ ढवळून मिसळा. टंबलरच्या तळाशी एकही कण उरत नाही तोपर्यंत 20–30 सेकंद ढवळत राहा.
seg.eacea0d7cf43.back: Away from the flame stir in the palm jaggery. Keep stirring 20–30 seconds until not a single particle remains at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.08b600da2ef8.src: Taste, and add a little more jaggery if you like it sweeter.
seg.08b600da2ef8.t: चव पाहा, आणि जास्त गोड आवडत असेल तर थोडा आणखी गूळ घाला.
seg.08b600da2ef8.back: Taste, and if you like it sweeter add a little more jaggery.

seg.878b0d8d7eeb.src: Pour between tumbler and davara to froth. Hold the tumbler high and pour into the davara, then back again, 3–4 times, until a light foam sits on top.
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.t: फेस येण्यासाठी टंबलर आणि दवरा यांच्यात ओता. टंबलर उंच धरून दवऱ्यात ओता, मग परत टंबलरमध्ये, 3–4 वेळा, वर हलका फेस येईपर्यंत.
seg.878b0d8d7eeb.back: To bring froth pour between the tumbler and dabara. Holding the tumbler high pour into the dabara, then back into the tumbler, 3–4 times, until light froth comes on top.

seg.653390b95f57.src: Serve straight away, in the tumbler set inside the davara.
seg.653390b95f57.back: Serve immediately, in the tumbler placed in the dabara.

seg.33aca43ebf99.src: Add jaggery after the milk is off the boil so it does not split.
seg.33aca43ebf99.t: दुधाची उकळी उतरल्यावरच गूळ घाला, म्हणजे दूध फाटणार नाही.
seg.33aca43ebf99.back: Add jaggery only after the milk's boil has subsided, so that the milk will not split.

seg.60404da43771.src: Grate the jaggery finely: fine shreds dissolve in seconds, while lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.
seg.60404da43771.t: गूळ बारीक किसा: बारीक कीस काही सेकंदांत विरघळतो, तर खडे बुडून टंबलरच्या तळाशीच राहतात.
seg.60404da43771.back: Grate the jaggery finely: fine gratings dissolve in a few seconds, while lumps sink and stay at the bottom of the tumbler.

seg.ca883342300e.src: Palm jaggery has a deep, slightly smoky sweetness, so start with 1 tsp and add more to taste.
seg.ca883342300e.t: ताडाच्या गुळाचा गोडवा गहिरा, किंचित धुरकट असतो, म्हणून 1 छोट्या चमच्याने सुरुवात करा आणि चवीनुसार आणखी घाला.
seg.ca883342300e.back: The sweetness of palm jaggery is deep, slightly smoky, so start with 1 small spoon (teaspoon) and add more to taste.

seg.d7c0084f5cc6.src: A steel tumbler and davara keep the coffee hot and make frothing easy; a mug and a jug work too.
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.t: स्टीलचा टंबलर आणि दवरा कॉफी गरम ठेवतात आणि फेस आणणे सोपे करतात; मग आणि जगही चालतो.
seg.d7c0084f5cc6.back: A steel tumbler and dabara keep the coffee hot and make bringing froth easy; a mug and jug also work.

seg.1b917ac5fc8c.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.t: उसाचा गूळ: तेवढाच किसलेला उसाचा गूळ वापरा; गोडवा हलका, कॅरमेलसारखा येईल.
seg.1b917ac5fc8c.back: Sugarcane jaggery: use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery; the sweetness will come light, caramel-like.

seg.0ada954bebfe.src: Palm jaggery tea: make your usual milk tea, switch off the heat, wait a minute, then stir in the palm jaggery the same way.
seg.0ada954bebfe.t: ताडाच्या गुळाचा चहा: नेहमीसारखा दुधाचा चहा करा, आच बंद करा, एक मिनिट थांबा, मग त्याच पद्धतीने ताडाचा गूळ ढवळून मिसळा.
seg.0ada954bebfe.back: Palm jaggery tea: make milk tea as usual, turn off the flame, wait a minute, then stir in palm jaggery the same way.

seg.6512d133d4c0.src: No coffee filter: dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water and use it in place of the decoction.
seg.6512d133d4c0.t: कॉफी फिल्टर नसेल तर: 1 छोटा चमचा इन्स्टंट कॉफी 2 मोठे चमचे गरम पाण्यात विरघळवा आणि डिकॉक्शनऐवजी वापरा.
seg.6512d133d4c0.back: If there is no coffee filter: dissolve 1 small spoon (teaspoon) of instant coffee in 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of hot water and use instead of the decoction.

seg.e9e80ce83cf6.src: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.t: इडली, डोसा किंवा उपमाच्या नाश्त्यानंतर गरम वाढा, किंवा संध्याकाळी बिस्किटे किंवा मुरुकुलुसोबत.
seg.e9e80ce83cf6.back: Serve hot after a breakfast of idli, dosa or upma, or in the evening with biscuits or murukulu.

seg.97817ad1f29f.src: Make each cup as you need it; coffee reheated after the jaggery goes in can split. Keep extra decoction covered at room temperature and use it within the day.
seg.97817ad1f29f.t: प्रत्येक कप हवा तेव्हाच करा; गूळ घातल्यानंतर पुन्हा गरम केलेली कॉफी फाटू शकते. उरलेले डिकॉक्शन झाकून खोलीच्या तापमानाला ठेवा आणि त्याच दिवशी वापरा.
seg.97817ad1f29f.back: Make each cup only when wanted; coffee reheated after adding jaggery can split. Keep leftover decoction covered at room temperature and use it the same day.

seg.ea4f4072538a.src: Why did my coffee curdle when I added palm jaggery?
seg.ea4f4072538a.t: ताडाचा गूळ घातल्यावर माझी कॉफी का फाटली?
seg.ea4f4072538a.back: Why did my coffee split after adding palm jaggery?

seg.180a2670ead3.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Take the milk off the heat, let it stand for about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.180a2670ead3.t: अजून उकळत असलेल्या दुधात गूळ ढवळल्यास दूध फाटू शकते. दूध आचेवरून उतरवा, सुमारे एक मिनिट तसेच राहू द्या, मग किसलेला गूळ ढवळून मिसळा.
seg.180a2670ead3.back: If jaggery is stirred into milk that is still boiling, the milk can split. Take the milk off the flame, let it stay like that about a minute, then stir in grated jaggery.

seg.2b9449407096.src: Can I use cane jaggery instead of palm jaggery?
seg.2b9449407096.t: ताडाच्या गुळाऐवजी उसाचा गूळ वापरू शकतो का?
seg.2b9449407096.back: Can sugarcane jaggery be used instead of palm jaggery?

seg.890ae3e15593.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery. The coffee tastes lighter and more like caramel, while palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky cup.
seg.890ae3e15593.t: हो. तेवढाच किसलेला उसाचा गूळ वापरा. कॉफीची चव हलकी आणि जास्त कॅरमेलसारखी लागते, तर ताडाच्या गुळाने कप गहिरा, किंचित धुरकट होतो.
seg.890ae3e15593.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery. The taste of the coffee comes out lighter and more caramel-like, whereas with palm jaggery the cup becomes deep, slightly smoky.

seg.e4c92d1c8a42.src: How much palm jaggery should I add to one cup of coffee?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.t: एका कप कॉफीत किती ताडाचा गूळ घालावा?
seg.e4c92d1c8a42.back: How much palm jaggery should be added to one cup of coffee?

seg.43a5dfb10340.src: 1 to 2 tsp of grated palm jaggery for 1 cup of milk and 2 tbsp of decoction. Start with 1 tsp, taste, and add more if you like.
seg.43a5dfb10340.t: 1 कप दूध आणि 2 मोठे चमचे डिकॉक्शनसाठी 1 ते 2 छोटे चमचे किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ. 1 छोट्या चमच्याने सुरुवात करा, चव पाहा, आणि आवडत असेल तर आणखी घाला.
seg.43a5dfb10340.back: For 1 cup of milk and 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of decoction, 1 to 2 small spoons (teaspoons) of grated palm jaggery. Start with 1 small spoon, taste, and if you like add more.

seg.2ba4fb9452bb.src: Can I make palm jaggery coffee without a coffee filter?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.t: कॉफी फिल्टरशिवाय ताडाच्या गुळाची कॉफी करता येते का?
seg.2ba4fb9452bb.back: Can palm jaggery coffee be made without a coffee filter?

seg.23f63da2d908.src: Yes. Dissolve 1 tsp instant coffee in 2 tbsp hot water, use it in place of the decoction and follow the same steps.
seg.23f63da2d908.t: हो. 1 छोटा चमचा इन्स्टंट कॉफी 2 मोठे चमचे गरम पाण्यात विरघळवा, डिकॉक्शनऐवजी ती वापरा आणि त्याच पायऱ्या पाळा.
seg.23f63da2d908.back: Yes. Dissolve 1 small spoon (teaspoon) of instant coffee in 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of hot water, use it instead of the decoction and follow the same steps.

seg.4fce579abe5f.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ · Palm Jaggery Coffee Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.t: ताटि बेल्लम कॉफी · ताडाच्या गुळाच्या कॉफीची पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.4fce579abe5f.back: Tati Bellam coffee · palm jaggery coffee recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.08ada9e6791e.src: తాటి బెల్లం కాఫీ. Palm jaggery coffee (thati bellam coffee), the Andhra way: filter decoction, hot milk and grated palm jaggery stirred in off the heat. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.08ada9e6791e.t: ताटि बेल्लम कॉफी. आंध्र पद्धतीची ताडाच्या गुळाची कॉफी (ताटि बेल्लम कॉफी): फिल्टर डिकॉक्शन, गरम दूध आणि आचेवरून उतरवून ढवळलेला किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरे.
seg.08ada9e6791e.back: Tati Bellam coffee. Andhra-style palm jaggery coffee (Tati Bellam coffee): filter decoction, hot milk and grated palm jaggery stirred in off the flame. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.0fc7db27d3fc.src: Palm Jaggery Coffee: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.t: ताडाच्या गुळाची कॉफी: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.0fc7db27d3fc.back: Palm jaggery coffee: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.1143d51ba236.src: Paramannam is the rice-and-milk sweet that Telugu homes cook for festivals and pujas: rice simmered slowly in milk until soft and creamy, then sweetened. Bellam paramannam, made with jaggery, is a common naivedyam at Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratham, offered at the puja and then shared at the festive meal.
seg.1143d51ba236.t: परमान्नम ही तांदूळ आणि दुधाची गोड डिश आहे, जी तेलुगु घरांत सण आणि पूजेसाठी केली जाते: तांदूळ दुधात हळूहळू मऊ आणि मलईदार होईपर्यंत शिजवून मग गोड केला जातो. गुळाने केलेले बेल्लम परमान्नम दिवाळी, संक्रांत आणि वरलक्ष्मी व्रतम यांना नेहमीचा नैवेद्य असतो, जो पूजेत दाखवून मग सणाच्या जेवणात वाटला जातो.
seg.1143d51ba236.back: Paramannam is a sweet dish of rice and milk, which is made in Telugu homes for festivals and puja: rice is cooked slowly in milk until soft and creamy and then sweetened. Bellam Paramannam made with jaggery is the usual naivedyam for Diwali, Sankranti and Varalakshmi Vratam, which is offered in the puja and then shared in the festival meal.

seg.360051f42785.src: Cane jaggery turns it a light caramel colour and gives a rounder, toffee-like sweetness. Ghee-fried cashews and a little cardamom finish it. This recipe serves 4.
seg.360051f42785.t: उसाच्या गुळामुळे याला हलका कॅरमेल रंग आणि भरीव, टॉफीसारखा गोडवा येतो. वरून तुपात तळलेले काजू आणि थोडी वेलची. ही पाककृती 4 जणांसाठी आहे.
seg.360051f42785.back: Because of the sugarcane jaggery it gets a light caramel colour and a rich, toffee-like sweetness. On top, cashews fried in ghee and a little cardamom. This recipe is for 4 people.

seg.04a51f6c83e4.src: Total includes the 5-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.04a51f6c83e4.t: एकूण वेळेत गूळ घालण्याआधी 5 मिनिटे थांबण्याचा वेळही धरला आहे.
seg.04a51f6c83e4.back: The total time also counts the time of waiting 5 minutes before adding the jaggery.

seg.fd8f49fce13b.src: Cook rice in milk till creamy, rest it 5 minutes, then stir in grated cane jaggery. Finish with ghee-fried cashews and cardamom.
seg.fd8f49fce13b.t: तांदूळ दुधात मलईदार होईपर्यंत शिजवा, 5 मिनिटे तसेच राहू द्या, मग किसलेला उसाचा गूळ ढवळून मिसळा. वरून तुपात तळलेले काजू आणि वेलची घाला.
seg.fd8f49fce13b.back: Cook the rice in milk until creamy, let it stay 5 minutes, then stir in grated sugarcane jaggery. On top add cashews fried in ghee and cardamom.

seg.1c0f194a4451.src: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori or another short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.t: ½ कप तांदूळ ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी किंवा दुसरा कोणताही आखूड दाण्याचा तांदूळ, सुमारे 100 g⟦/1⟧
seg.1c0f194a4451.back: ½ cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masuri or any other short-grain rice, about 100 g⟦/1⟧

seg.8f34922ee281.src: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; whole milk gives the creamiest result⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.t: 4 कप दूध ⟦1⟧सुमारे 1 लिटर; फुल क्रीम दुधाने सर्वात मलईदार होते⟦/1⟧
seg.8f34922ee281.back: 4 cups milk ⟦1⟧about 1 litre; with full cream milk it becomes creamiest⟦/1⟧

seg.ee0c3b96837f.src: ¾ cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed; up to 2 tbsp more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.t: ¾ कप किसलेला उसाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧हलका दाबून भरलेला; जास्त गोड आवडत असेल तर आणखी 2 मोठे चमचेपर्यंत⟦/1⟧
seg.ee0c3b96837f.back: ¾ cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧filled lightly pressed; if you like it sweeter, up to 2 more big spoons (tablespoons)⟦/1⟧

seg.fa014766d2bf.src: ½ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 4–5 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.t: ½ छोटा चमचा वेलची पूड ⟦1⟧किंवा 4–5 वेलच्यांचे कुटलेले दाणे⟦/1⟧
seg.fa014766d2bf.back: ½ small spoon (teaspoon) cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 4–5 cardamoms⟦/1⟧

seg.480e0a7d227f.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water until the water runs almost clear, then drain it well.
seg.480e0a7d227f.t: तांदूळ 2–3 वेळा पाणी बदलून धुवा, पाणी जवळजवळ नितळ येईपर्यंत, मग पाणी पूर्ण निथळून घ्या.
seg.480e0a7d227f.back: Wash the rice changing the water 2–3 times, until the water comes almost clear, then drain off the water completely.

seg.d5b0fc46818a.src: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed pan and bring it to a boil on medium heat, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.d5b0fc46818a.t: दूध जाड बुडाच्या पातेल्यात ओता आणि मध्यम आचेवर उकळी आणा, सुमारे 8–10 मिनिटे. मधूनमधून ढवळा, म्हणजे दूध तळाला लागणार नाही.
seg.d5b0fc46818a.back: Pour the milk into a heavy-bottomed pot and bring to a boil on medium flame, about 8–10 minutes. Stir now and then, so that the milk will not stick to the bottom.

seg.b8f9c8c6758b.src: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and turn the heat to low.
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.t: निथळलेले तांदूळ उकळत्या दुधात घाला आणि आच मंद करा.
seg.b8f9c8c6758b.back: Add the drained rice to the boiling milk and lower the flame.

seg.9ae9baab76d7.src: Cook the washed rice in the milk on a low flame till soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Stir often, scraping the bottom and sides of the pan each time.
seg.9ae9baab76d7.t: धुतलेले तांदूळ दुधात मंद आचेवर मऊ आणि मलईदार होईपर्यंत शिजवा, सुमारे 30 मिनिटे. वारंवार ढवळा, आणि दर वेळी पातेल्याचा तळ आणि कडा खरवडा.
seg.9ae9baab76d7.back: Cook the washed rice in the milk on low flame until soft and creamy, about 30 minutes. Stir frequently, and each time scrape the bottom and sides of the pot.

seg.ec1509a08b4c.src: Check the rice: a grain should mash easily between your fingers, and the milk should have thickened slightly. For a creamier paramannam, lightly mash a few grains against the side of the pan.
seg.ec1509a08b4c.t: तांदूळ तपासा: एक दाणा बोटांमध्ये सहज चिरडला गेला पाहिजे, आणि दूध थोडे घट्ट झाले पाहिजे. जास्त मलईदार परमान्नमसाठी काही दाणे पातेल्याच्या कडेला हलकेच चिरडा.
seg.ec1509a08b4c.back: Check the rice: a grain should crush easily between the fingers, and the milk should have become slightly thick. For a creamier paramannam lightly crush some grains against the side of the pot.

seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.src: Switch off and let it rest 5 minutes. This brings the milk below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.t: आच बंद करा आणि 5 मिनिटे तसेच राहू द्या. यामुळे दूध उकळीच्या खाली येते, म्हणजे गुळाने ते फाटणार नाही.
seg.d8ba0a82f4ec.back: Turn off the flame and let it stay 5 minutes. Because of this the milk comes below the boil, so it will not split with the jaggery.

seg.ca16c98d9b18.src: Stir in the jaggery till it melts, about 1–2 minutes, keeping the pan off the heat.
seg.ca16c98d9b18.t: पातेले आचेपासून दूर ठेवून गूळ घाला आणि वितळेपर्यंत ढवळा, सुमारे 1–2 मिनिटे.
seg.ca16c98d9b18.back: Keeping the pot away from the flame add the jaggery and stir until melted, about 1–2 minutes.

seg.74412a8cc141.src: Taste, and stir in a little more grated jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.74412a8cc141.t: चव पाहा, आणि जास्त गोड हवे असेल तर थोडा आणखी किसलेला गूळ ढवळून घाला.
seg.74412a8cc141.back: Taste, and if you want it sweeter stir in a little more grated jaggery.

seg.92b56df40ea6.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat.
seg.92b56df40ea6.t: एका लहान पॅनमध्ये मध्यम-मंद आचेवर तूप गरम करा.
seg.92b56df40ea6.back: Heat ghee in a small pan on medium-low flame.

seg.1bb1f411e4d0.src: Fry the cashews in ghee; add with the cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up. Pour the nuts and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and stir.
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.t: काजू तुपात तळा; वेलचीसोबत घाला. काजू सोनेरी होईपर्यंत हलवा, सुमारे 1 मिनिट, आणि शेवटच्या काही सेकंदांत बेदाणे घाला, ते फुगेपर्यंत. काजू-बेदाणे आणि तूप परमान्नममध्ये ओता, वेलची पूड भुरभुरा आणि ढवळा.
seg.1bb1f411e4d0.back: Fry the cashews in ghee; add along with the cardamom. Stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, and in the last few seconds add the raisins, until they puff up. Pour the cashew-raisins and ghee into the paramannam, sprinkle cardamom powder and stir.

seg.e10b7192c157.src: Serve warm. Paramannam thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, if needed.
seg.e10b7192c157.t: गरम वाढा. ठेवल्यावर परमान्नम घट्ट होते; गरज असेल तर आचेपासून दूर, काही चमचे कोमट दूध घालून सैल करा.
seg.e10b7192c157.back: Serve hot. On keeping, paramannam becomes thick; if needed, away from the flame, loosen it by adding a few spoons of warm milk.

seg.d30196cf6b28.src: Jaggery goes in off the heat so the milk does not split.
seg.d30196cf6b28.t: गूळ आचेवरून उतरवल्यावर घाला, म्हणजे दूध फाटणार नाही.
seg.d30196cf6b28.back: Add the jaggery after taking off the flame, so that the milk will not split.

seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and scrape the bottom each time you stir; milk catches easily during the long simmer.
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.t: जाड बुडाचे पातेले वापरा आणि प्रत्येक वेळी ढवळताना तळ खरवडा; बराच वेळ मंद उकळताना दूध सहज तळाला लागते.
seg.d4a9c2ee09bf.back: Use a heavy-bottomed pot and scrape the bottom every time while stirring; while simmering for a long time the milk easily sticks to the bottom.

seg.a01441abc0b6.src: Cook the rice until fully soft before the jaggery goes in; the grains do not soften further once it is sweetened.
seg.a01441abc0b6.t: गूळ घालण्याआधी तांदूळ पूर्ण मऊ शिजवा; गोड केल्यावर दाणे आणखी मऊ होत नाहीत.
seg.a01441abc0b6.back: Before adding jaggery cook the rice fully soft; after sweetening the grains do not become any softer.

seg.688b80a32383.src: Grate the jaggery finely so it melts in the hot milk without going back on the stove.
seg.688b80a32383.t: गूळ बारीक किसा, म्हणजे पुन्हा चुलीवर न ठेवता तो गरम दुधात वितळेल.
seg.688b80a32383.back: Grate the jaggery finely, so that it will melt in the hot milk without putting it back on the stove.

seg.7bf8faca62b8.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker colour and a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.7bf8faca62b8.t: ताडाचा गूळ: तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ वापरा; रंग गडद आणि गोडवा गहिरा, धुरकट येईल.
seg.7bf8faca62b8.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the colour will come dark and the sweetness deep, smoky.

seg.6672d2210281.src: Pesarapappu paramannam: dry-roast 2 tbsp split moong dal until light golden, wash it and cook it with the rice.
seg.6672d2210281.t: पेसरपप्पु परमान्नम: 2 मोठे चमचे मुगाची डाळ कोरडीच हलकी सोनेरी होईपर्यंत भाजा, धुवा आणि तांदळासोबत शिजवा.
seg.6672d2210281.back: Pesarapappu paramannam: roast 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of moong dal dry until light golden, wash and cook with the rice.

seg.cd25d9fb2a56.src: Coconut: fry 2 tbsp thin slivers of dry coconut in the ghee along with the cashews.
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.t: खोबरे: सुक्या खोबऱ्याचे 2 मोठे चमचे पातळ काप काजूसोबत तुपात तळा.
seg.cd25d9fb2a56.back: Coconut: fry 2 big spoons (tablespoons) of thin slices of dry coconut in ghee with the cashews.

seg.988ab75b5ccb.src: Serve warm as naivedyam at the Diwali or Lakshmi puja, then as the sweet at the festive meal. Some like it chilled the next day.
seg.988ab75b5ccb.t: दिवाळीच्या किंवा लक्ष्मीपूजेच्या वेळी नैवेद्य म्हणून गरम दाखवा, मग सणाच्या जेवणात गोड पदार्थ म्हणून वाढा. काहींना ते दुसऱ्या दिवशी थंड आवडते.
seg.988ab75b5ccb.back: At Diwali or Lakshmi Puja offer it hot as naivedya, then serve as the sweet dish in the festival meal. Some like it cold the next day.

seg.4a60d211f14d.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. It sets thick when chilled; stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, before serving.
seg.4a60d211f14d.t: उरलेले परमान्नम झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. थंड झाल्यावर ते घट्ट होते; वाढण्याआधी, आचेपासून दूर, थोडे कोमट दूध ढवळून घाला.
seg.4a60d211f14d.back: Keep leftover paramannam covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. After cooling it becomes thick; before serving, away from the flame, stir in a little warm milk.

seg.2949774c7efb.src: Why did my paramannam curdle after adding jaggery?
seg.2949774c7efb.t: गूळ घातल्यावर माझे परमान्नम का फाटले?
seg.2949774c7efb.back: Why did my paramannam split after adding jaggery?

seg.283626ae50fc.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still on the heat or boiling can make it split. Switch off, let the paramannam rest for about 5 minutes, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.283626ae50fc.t: अजून आचेवर असलेल्या किंवा उकळत्या दुधात गूळ ढवळल्यास दूध फाटू शकते. आच बंद करा, परमान्नम सुमारे 5 मिनिटे तसेच राहू द्या, मग किसलेला गूळ ढवळून मिसळा.
seg.283626ae50fc.back: If jaggery is stirred into milk still on the flame or boiling, the milk can split. Turn off the flame, let the paramannam stay about 5 minutes, then stir in grated jaggery.

seg.7df6976d1e83.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The paramannam turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7df6976d1e83.t: हो. तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) वापरा. परमान्नम गडद होते आणि चव गहिरी, किंचित धुरकट लागते.
seg.7df6976d1e83.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The paramannam becomes dark and the taste comes deep, slightly smoky.

seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.src: Which rice is best for paramannam?
seg.6ac2cfc26fb7.back: Which rice is best for paramannam?

seg.ead18bc39c32.src: A short-grain rice such as sona masoori cooks soft and creamy in milk. Long-grain basmati keeps its grains separate and gives a thinner paramannam.
seg.ead18bc39c32.t: सोना मसूरीसारखा आखूड दाण्याचा तांदूळ दुधात मऊ आणि मलईदार शिजतो. लांब दाण्याच्या बासमतीचे दाणे सुटे राहतात आणि परमान्नम पातळ होते.
seg.ead18bc39c32.back: Short-grain rice like Sona Masuri cooks soft and creamy in milk. The grains of long-grain basmati stay separate and the paramannam becomes thin.

seg.2baf5cc4ec36.src: How do I fix paramannam that has become too thick?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.t: खूप घट्ट झालेले परमान्नम कसे सुधारावे?
seg.2baf5cc4ec36.back: How to fix paramannam that has become too thick?

seg.9ffeabf346fa.src: Stir in a few spoons of warm milk, off the heat, until it loosens. It thickens as it cools, so stop when it is a little thinner than you want.
seg.9ffeabf346fa.t: आचेपासून दूर, सैल होईपर्यंत काही चमचे कोमट दूध ढवळून घाला. थंड होताना ते घट्ट होते, म्हणून हवे त्यापेक्षा थोडे पातळ असतानाच थांबा.
seg.9ffeabf346fa.back: Away from the flame, stir in a few spoons of warm milk until loose. While cooling it becomes thick, so stop while it is a little thinner than wanted.

seg.8b09026bfd65.src: బెల్లం పరమాన్నం. Bellam paramannam for Diwali: rice slow-cooked in milk and sweetened with cane jaggery off the heat, finished with ghee-fried cashews. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 4.
seg.8b09026bfd65.t: बेल्लम परमान्नम. दिवाळीसाठी बेल्लम परमान्नम: दुधात हळूहळू शिजवलेला तांदूळ, आचेवरून उतरवून उसाच्या गुळाने गोड केलेला, वरून तुपात तळलेले काजू. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरे. 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.8b09026bfd65.back: Bellam Paramannam. Bellam Paramannam for Diwali: rice cooked slowly in milk, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery off the flame, cashews fried in ghee on top. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers. For 4 people.

seg.cf8cab3618d9.src: Bellam Paramannam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.cf8cab3618d9.t: बेल्लम परमान्नम: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.cf8cab3618d9.back: Bellam Paramannam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.5fbc274b0656.src: Pasupu paalu is warm milk simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. It is an everyday cup in many Telugu homes, made on cool evenings and often through Karthika masam, the month of Somavaram (Monday) pujas and evening lamps.
seg.5fbc274b0656.t: पसुपु पालु म्हणजे थोडी हळद आणि चिमूटभर काळी मिरी घालून मंद उकळलेले, मग गुळाने गोड केलेले गरम दूध. अनेक तेलुगु घरांत हा रोजचा कप आहे; गार संध्याकाळी केला जातो, आणि अनेकदा संपूर्ण कार्तिक मासात, जो सोमवारच्या पूजांचा आणि संध्याकाळच्या दिव्यांचा महिना आहे.
seg.5fbc274b0656.back: Pasupu Palu means hot milk simmered with a little turmeric and a pinch of black pepper, then sweetened with jaggery. In many Telugu homes this is the daily cup; it is made on cold evenings, and often through the whole month of Karthika, which is the month of Monday pujas and evening lamps.

seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.src: The turmeric turns the milk golden and gives it an earthy, slightly bitter edge, the pepper adds a little heat, and the jaggery rounds it off with a caramel sweetness. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.t: हळदीमुळे दूध सोनेरी होते आणि त्याला मातीसारखी, किंचित कडवट चव येते, मिरीमुळे थोडा तिखटपणा येतो, आणि गूळ कॅरमेलसारख्या गोडव्याने चव पूर्ण करतो. या पाककृतीने सुमारे 5 मिनिटांत एक कप होतो.
seg.7d5fe2bc79e0.back: Because of turmeric the milk becomes golden and gets an earthy, slightly bitter taste, because of pepper a little pungency comes, and jaggery completes the taste with caramel-like sweetness. This recipe makes one cup in about 5 minutes.

seg.8e4df121a859.src: Simmer milk with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, switch off, then stir in a spoon of jaggery.
seg.8e4df121a859.t: दूध हळद आणि चिमूटभर मिरीसोबत मंद उकळा, आच बंद करा, मग एक चमचा गूळ ढवळून मिसळा.
seg.8e4df121a859.back: Simmer the milk with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, turn off the flame, then stir in a spoon of jaggery.

seg.33cd5776caaf.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Turmeric Powder or Hill Turmeric Powder⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.t: ¼ छोटा चमचा हळद पावडर ⟦1⟧हळद पावडर किंवा डोंगरी हळद पावडर⟦/1⟧
seg.33cd5776caaf.back: ¼ small spoon (teaspoon) turmeric powder ⟦1⟧turmeric powder or hill turmeric powder⟦/1⟧

seg.f1056c625241.src: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or crushed⟦/1⟧
seg.f1056c625241.t: चिमूटभर काळी मिरी ⟦1⟧पूड केलेली किंवा कुटलेली⟦/1⟧
seg.f1056c625241.back: A pinch of black pepper ⟦1⟧powdered or crushed⟦/1⟧

seg.bc417c4b3691.src: 1 tsp grated palm or cane jaggery ⟦1⟧or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.t: 1 छोटा चमचा किसलेला ताडाचा किंवा उसाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧किंवा चवीनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.bc417c4b3691.back: 1 small spoon (teaspoon) grated palm or sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.12c1bae1db56.back: A pinch of cardamom powder (if wanted)

seg.1a51e1f06af0.src: Sweeten it with ⟦1⟧Palm Jaggery⟦/1⟧ or ⟦2⟧Cane Jaggery⟦/2⟧.
seg.1a51e1f06af0.back: Sweeten by adding ⟦1⟧palm jaggery⟦/1⟧ or ⟦2⟧sugarcane jaggery⟦/2⟧.

seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.src: Pour the milk into a small steel saucepan.
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.t: दूध एका लहान स्टीलच्या पातेल्यात ओता.
seg.b0b3cf3b3c0d.back: Pour the milk into a small steel pot.

seg.94d57531a741.src: Add the turmeric and pepper (and the cardamom, if using) and stir until no specks of turmeric float on top. They mix in more evenly before the milk is heated.
seg.94d57531a741.t: हळद आणि मिरी घाला (आणि वेलची, वापरत असाल तर) आणि वर हळदीचे कण तरंगत नाहीत तोपर्यंत ढवळा. दूध गरम करण्याआधी ते जास्त एकसारखे मिसळतात.
seg.94d57531a741.back: Add the turmeric and pepper (and cardamom, if using) and stir until turmeric particles are not floating on top. Before heating the milk they mix more evenly.

seg.9da3932c6508.src: Set the pan on medium-low heat. Warm the milk with the turmeric and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. Once small bubbles appear around the edge, turn the heat to low and let it bubble gently.
seg.9da3932c6508.t: पातेले मध्यम-मंद आचेवर ठेवा. दूध हळद आणि मिरीसोबत गरम करा; 2 मिनिटे मंद उकळा. कडेला लहान बुडबुडे दिसू लागताच आच मंद करा आणि हलकेच उकळू द्या.
seg.9da3932c6508.back: Keep the pot on medium-low flame. Heat the milk with turmeric and pepper; simmer 2 minutes. As soon as small bubbles start appearing at the edge, lower the flame and let it simmer gently.

seg.c66cb9336ef5.src: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the pan, as milk rises fast once it boils. If it starts to climb, lift the pan off the heat for a few seconds.
seg.c66cb9336ef5.t: मधूनमधून ढवळा आणि पातेल्यावर लक्ष ठेवा, कारण उकळी आल्यावर दूध पटकन वर येते. ते वर चढू लागले तर पातेले काही सेकंद आचेवरून उचला.
seg.c66cb9336ef5.back: Stir now and then and keep an eye on the pot, because when it boils the milk rises quickly. If it starts to climb up, lift the pot off the flame for a few seconds.

seg.b567bc0c93c9.src: It is ready when the milk is an even golden yellow and the raw smell of turmeric has gone.
seg.b567bc0c93c9.t: दुधाला एकसारखा सोनेरी पिवळा रंग आला आणि हळदीचा कच्चा वास गेला की ते तयार आहे.
seg.b567bc0c93c9.back: When the milk gets an even golden yellow colour and the raw smell of turmeric has gone, it is ready.

seg.6e16c50d7c2a.src: Switch off and wait a minute. The milk drops just below the boil, so the jaggery will not split it.
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.t: आच बंद करा आणि एक मिनिट थांबा. दूध उकळीच्या जरा खाली येते, म्हणजे गुळाने ते फाटणार नाही.
seg.6e16c50d7c2a.back: Turn off the flame and wait a minute. The milk comes slightly below the boil, so it will not split with the jaggery.

seg.aa0d1bcf6802.src: For a smooth cup, pour the milk through a fine sieve into a tumbler or mug.
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.t: गुळगुळीत कपासाठी दूध बारीक गाळणीतून टंबलर किंवा मगमध्ये गाळा.
seg.aa0d1bcf6802.back: For a smooth cup, strain the milk through a fine strainer into a tumbler or mug.

seg.862cac523844.src: Stir in the jaggery and serve warm. Stir for 20–30 seconds, until it dissolves, and taste for sweetness.
seg.862cac523844.t: गूळ ढवळून मिसळा आणि गरम वाढा. विरघळेपर्यंत 20–30 सेकंद ढवळा, आणि गोडवा चाखून पाहा.
seg.862cac523844.back: Stir in the jaggery and serve hot. Stir 20–30 seconds until dissolved, and taste the sweetness.

seg.1d9b9ec736a8.src: Strain through a fine sieve if you like it smooth.
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.t: गुळगुळीत आवडत असेल तर बारीक गाळणीतून गाळा.
seg.1d9b9ec736a8.back: If you like it smooth, strain through a fine strainer.

seg.018366193ef3.src: Add the jaggery only after switching off; jaggery stirred into boiling milk can split it.
seg.018366193ef3.t: गूळ आच बंद केल्यानंतरच घाला; उकळत्या दुधात गूळ ढवळल्यास दूध फाटू शकते.
seg.018366193ef3.back: Add jaggery only after turning off the flame; if jaggery is stirred into boiling milk the milk can split.

seg.0e783ba83473.src: Use a steel pan and spoon; turmeric stains plastic and wood.
seg.0e783ba83473.t: स्टीलचे पातेले आणि चमचा वापरा; हळदीमुळे प्लास्टिक आणि लाकडावर डाग पडतात.
seg.0e783ba83473.back: Use a steel pot and spoon; turmeric causes stains on plastic and wood.

seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.src: Making more? Use the same amounts for each cup of milk.
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.t: जास्त करताय? प्रत्येक कप दुधासाठी हेच प्रमाण वापरा.
seg.dc2a0c79ccd5.back: Making more? Use this same proportion for each cup of milk.

seg.485f68415013.src: Hill turmeric: use Hill Turmeric Powder (konda pasupu) in place of turmeric powder, in the same amount.
seg.485f68415013.t: डोंगरी हळद: हळद पावडरऐवजी तेवढीच डोंगरी हळद पावडर (कोंडा पसुपु) वापरा.
seg.485f68415013.back: Hill turmeric: instead of turmeric powder use the same amount of hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu).

seg.01ec7a142032.src: Palm or cane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deeper, slightly smoky sweetness; cane jaggery a lighter, caramel one.
seg.01ec7a142032.t: ताडाचा किंवा उसाचा गूळ: ताडाच्या गुळाने गहिरा, किंचित धुरकट गोडवा येतो; उसाच्या गुळाने हलका, कॅरमेलसारखा.
seg.01ec7a142032.back: Palm or sugarcane jaggery: palm jaggery gives a deep, slightly smoky sweetness; sugarcane jaggery a light, caramel-like one.

seg.15b67235d087.src: Milder cup: leave out the pepper and add a pinch of cardamom powder instead.
seg.15b67235d087.t: सौम्य कप: मिरी वगळा आणि त्याऐवजी चिमूटभर वेलची पूड घाला.
seg.15b67235d087.back: Mild cup: skip the pepper and instead add a pinch of cardamom powder.

seg.d80219c8a51f.src: Serve warm in a tumbler or mug, on a cool evening or after the Karthika Somavaram puja.
seg.d80219c8a51f.t: टंबलर किंवा मगमध्ये गरम वाढा, गार संध्याकाळी किंवा कार्तिक सोमवारच्या पूजेनंतर.
seg.d80219c8a51f.back: Serve hot in a tumbler or mug, on a cold evening or after the Karthika Monday puja.

seg.ac04ffd1d51a.src: Make it as you need it and drink it warm. Reheating after the jaggery is in can split the milk.
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.t: हवे तेव्हाच करा आणि गरम प्या. गूळ घातल्यानंतर पुन्हा गरम केल्यास दूध फाटू शकते.
seg.ac04ffd1d51a.back: Make only when wanted and drink hot. If reheated after adding jaggery the milk can split.

seg.c758e61dd102.src: Why did my pasupu paalu curdle?
seg.c758e61dd102.back: Why did my Pasupu Palu split?

seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.src: Jaggery stirred into milk that is still boiling can make it split. Switch off the heat, wait about a minute, then stir in the grated jaggery.
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.t: अजून उकळत असलेल्या दुधात गूळ ढवळल्यास दूध फाटू शकते. आच बंद करा, सुमारे एक मिनिट थांबा, मग किसलेला गूळ ढवळून मिसळा.
seg.d5f9c6fb2e27.back: If jaggery is stirred into milk that is still boiling, the milk can split. Turn off the flame, wait about a minute, then stir in grated jaggery.

seg.df4dbdd3102b.src: How much turmeric should I use for one cup of milk?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.t: एका कप दुधासाठी किती हळद वापरावी?
seg.df4dbdd3102b.back: How much turmeric should be used for one cup of milk?

seg.3ec50124bdd7.src: ¼ tsp turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) of milk. More than that makes the taste sharp and earthy.
seg.3ec50124bdd7.t: 1 कप (सुमारे 240 ml) दुधासाठी ¼ छोटा चमचा हळद पावडर. त्यापेक्षा जास्त घातल्यास चव तीव्र आणि मातीसारखी होते.
seg.3ec50124bdd7.back: ¼ small spoon (teaspoon) of turmeric powder for 1 cup (about 240 ml) of milk. If more than that is added the taste becomes sharp and earthy.

seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.src: Can I skip the black pepper?
seg.3dc4d1edd4f9.back: Can the black pepper be skipped?

seg.166b3a44e11d.src: Yes. The pepper adds a little heat to the taste; leave it out, or use a pinch of cardamom instead, for a milder cup.
seg.166b3a44e11d.t: हो. मिरीमुळे चवीला थोडा तिखटपणा येतो; सौम्य कपासाठी ती वगळा, किंवा त्याऐवजी चिमूटभर वेलची वापरा.
seg.166b3a44e11d.back: Yes. Pepper gives the taste a little pungency; for a mild cup skip it, or instead use a pinch of cardamom.

seg.2184adfd31b0.src: Should I use palm jaggery or cane jaggery?
seg.2184adfd31b0.t: ताडाचा गूळ वापरावा की उसाचा गूळ?
seg.2184adfd31b0.back: Should palm jaggery be used or sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ef65c3a9d015.src: Either works, 1 tsp grated per cup. Palm jaggery tastes deeper and slightly smoky; cane jaggery is lighter and more like caramel.
seg.ef65c3a9d015.t: दोन्ही चालतात, प्रत्येक कपाला 1 छोटा चमचा किसलेला. ताडाच्या गुळाची चव गहिरी, किंचित धुरकट असते; उसाचा गूळ हलका आणि जास्त कॅरमेलसारखा.
seg.ef65c3a9d015.back: Both work, 1 small spoon (teaspoon) grated per cup. The taste of palm jaggery is deep, slightly smoky; sugarcane jaggery light and more caramel-like.

seg.0f694f995bf8.src: పసుపు పాలు · Pasupu Paalu (Turmeric Milk) Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.0f694f995bf8.t: पसुपु पालु · पसुपु पालु (हळदीचे दूध) पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.0f694f995bf8.back: Pasupu Palu · Pasupu Palu (turmeric milk) recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.bf09ae159f00.src: పసుపు పాలు. Pasupu paalu (haldi doodh): warm milk simmered with turmeric and a pinch of pepper, sweetened with jaggery off the heat. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.bf09ae159f00.t: पसुपु पालु. पसुपु पालु (हळदीचे दूध): हळद आणि चिमूटभर मिरी घालून मंद उकळलेले गरम दूध, आचेवरून उतरवून गुळाने गोड केलेले. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरे.

seg.5094f960d9a4.src: Bellam in a Telugu kitchen usually means one of two things: cheruku bellam, made from sugarcane juice, or thati bellam, made from the sap of the palmyra palm. FSSAI treats them as two separate products, each with its own standard.
seg.5094f960d9a4.t: तेलुगु स्वयंपाकघरात बेल्लम म्हणजे साधारणपणे दोनपैकी एक: चेरुकु बेल्लम, जो उसाच्या रसापासून बनतो, किंवा ताटि बेल्लम, जो ताडाच्या झाडाच्या रसापासून बनतो. FSSAI त्यांना दोन वेगळी उत्पादने मानते, आणि प्रत्येकाचे स्वतःचे मानक आहे.
seg.5094f960d9a4.back: In the Telugu kitchen bellam usually means one of two: cheruku bellam, which is made from sugarcane juice, or tati bellam, which is made from the sap of the palm tree. FSSAI considers them two separate products, and each has its own standard.

seg.13fd9611c493.src: They can look alike in a lump, but they taste different and suit different dishes. Here is how to tell them apart, which to use where, and how to keep them. There is a full Telugu section further down.

seg.13fd9611c493.back: In block form they can look alike, but their taste is different and they suit different dishes. How to recognise them, which to use where, and how to store them, is given here. Further down below there is also a full Telugu section.

seg.70c115199d4c.src: Cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) is boiled-down sugarcane juice with a mellow, caramel sweetness: the one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (thati bellam) is boiled-down palmyra sap, darker and deeper in taste: a favourite in filter coffee and tea. You can swap one for the other gram for gram; start with a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight jar.
seg.70c115199d4c.t: उसाचा गूळ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) म्हणजे उसाचा रस आटवून केलेला गूळ, सौम्य कॅरमेलसारख्या गोडव्याचा: पायसम, पोंगल आणि चिम्मिलीसाठी हाच. ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) म्हणजे ताडाचा रस आटवून केलेला गूळ, रंगाने गडद आणि चवीने गहिरा: फिल्टर कॉफी आणि चहात आवडीचा. एकाऐवजी दुसरा ग्रॅमला ग्रॅम वापरू शकता; ताडाचा गूळ थोडा कमी घालून सुरुवात करा. दोन्ही हवाबंद डब्यात ठेवा.
seg.70c115199d4c.back: Sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) means jaggery made by boiling down sugarcane juice, of mild caramel-like sweetness: this one for payasam, pongal and chimmili. Palm jaggery (tati bellam) means jaggery made by boiling down palm sap, dark in colour and deep in taste: a favourite in filter coffee and tea. You can use one instead of the other gram for gram; start by adding a little less palm jaggery. Keep both in an airtight box.

seg.db3bddd4a4fc.src: Cane jaggery is made wherever sugarcane grows: the juice is pressed out of the cane and boiled down in open pans. In Andhra Pradesh, Anakapalli has the second largest jaggery market in India.
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.t: जिथे ऊस पिकतो तिथे उसाचा गूळ बनतो: उसातून रस काढून तो उघड्या कढयांमध्ये आटवला जातो. आंध्र प्रदेशात, अनकापल्ली येथे भारतातील दुसरी सर्वात मोठी गुळाची बाजारपेठ आहे.
seg.db3bddd4a4fc.back: Where sugarcane grows, there sugarcane jaggery is made: juice is extracted from the sugarcane and boiled down in open kadais (pans). In Andhra Pradesh, Anakapalli has India's second largest jaggery market.

seg.31988f9e86fc.src: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palmyra palm, thati chettu in Telugu. The sap is called neera, or thati neera, and it is boiled down until it sets.
seg.31988f9e86fc.t: ताडाचा गूळ ताडाच्या झाडाच्या (तेलुगुमध्ये ताटि चेट्टु) रसापासून बनतो. या रसाला नीरा, किंवा ताटि नीरा, म्हणतात, आणि तो घट्ट होईपर्यंत आटवला जातो.
seg.31988f9e86fc.back: Palm jaggery is made from the sap of the palm tree (tati chettu in Telugu). This sap is called neera, or tati neera, and it is boiled down until it becomes thick.

seg.7231a4f0bd69.src: Payasam, sweet pongal and ⟦1⟧bellam paramannam⟦/1⟧: cane jaggery.
seg.7231a4f0bd69.t: पायसम, गोड पोंगल आणि ⟦1⟧बेल्लम परमान्नम⟦/1⟧: उसाचा गूळ.
seg.7231a4f0bd69.back: Payasam, sweet pongal and ⟦1⟧Bellam Paramannam⟦/1⟧: sugarcane jaggery.

seg.2b10b5036017.src: Filter coffee and tea: palm jaggery. Its deeper taste stands up to the decoction; try our ⟦1⟧palm jaggery coffee⟦/1⟧.
seg.2b10b5036017.t: फिल्टर कॉफी आणि चहा: ताडाचा गूळ. त्याची गहिरी चव डिकॉक्शनसमोर टिकून राहते; आमची ⟦1⟧ताडाच्या गुळाची कॉफी⟦/1⟧ करून पाहा.
seg.2b10b5036017.back: Filter coffee and tea: palm jaggery. Its deep taste holds up in front of the decoction; try making our ⟦1⟧palm jaggery coffee⟦/1⟧.

seg.39f0609ee4de.back: ⟦1⟧Pasupu Palu⟦/1⟧: any one, as you like.

seg.46fffb385af6.src: Use the same weight. Palm jaggery tastes stronger, so start with a little less and add more to taste.
seg.46fffb385af6.t: वजन तेवढेच ठेवा. ताडाच्या गुळाची चव जास्त तीव्र असते, म्हणून थोडा कमी घालून सुरुवात करा आणि चवीनुसार आणखी घाला.
seg.46fffb385af6.back: Keep the weight the same. The taste of palm jaggery is more intense, so start by adding a little less and add more to taste.

seg.8a98e07b6f1e.src: In milk, coffee or tea, add either jaggery after the milk is off the boil, so the milk does not split.
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.t: दूध, कॉफी किंवा चहात, कोणताही गूळ दुधाची उकळी उतरल्यानंतर घाला, म्हणजे दूध फाटणार नाही.
seg.8a98e07b6f1e.back: In milk, coffee or tea, add any jaggery after the milk's boil has subsided, so that the milk will not split.

seg.6788faade30c.src: Keep jaggery in an airtight jar in a cool, dry place.
seg.6788faade30c.t: गूळ हवाबंद डब्यात थंड, कोरड्या जागी ठेवा.
seg.6788faade30c.back: Keep jaggery in an airtight box in a cool, dry place.

seg.5ea00ae441ac.src: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery takes in moisture from the air and turns sticky.
seg.5ea00ae441ac.t: कोरडा चमचा किंवा सुरी वापरा. गूळ हवेतील ओलावा शोषून घेतो आणि चिकट होतो.
seg.5ea00ae441ac.back: Use a dry spoon or knife. Jaggery absorbs moisture from the air and becomes sticky.

seg.1d7ae0c59b87.src: If it sets hard, grate it.
seg.1d7ae0c59b87.t: तो कडक झाला तर किसून घ्या.
seg.1d7ae0c59b87.back: If it becomes hard, grate it.

seg.8be6c65e90d5.src: Use it within the best-before date on the pack.

seg.8be6c65e90d5.back: Use within the best-before date given on the pack.

seg.cc5783126657.src: Is palm jaggery the same as karupatti?
seg.cc5783126657.t: ताडाचा गूळ आणि करुपट्टी एकच आहेत का?
seg.cc5783126657.back: Are palm jaggery and karupatti the same?

seg.f7071649dddd.src: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name for jaggery made from palmyra sap. In Telugu it is thati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.
seg.f7071649dddd.t: हो. करुपट्टी हे ताडाच्या रसापासून बनलेल्या गुळाचे तमिळ नाव आहे. तेलुगुमध्ये त्याला ताटि बेल्लम, आणि हिंदीत ताड़ का गुड़ म्हणतात.
seg.f7071649dddd.back: Yes. Karupatti is the Tamil name of jaggery made from palm sap. In Telugu it is called tati bellam, and in Hindi taad ka gud.

seg.a591ce90fac8.src: Is gud the same as jaggery?
seg.a591ce90fac8.back: Does gud mean the same as gul (jaggery)?

seg.9e04d6270c92.src: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery, and bellam is the Telugu one. On its own it usually means cane jaggery.
seg.9e04d6270c92.t: हो. गुड़, किंवा गुर, हा गुळासाठीचा हिंदी शब्द आहे, आणि बेल्लम हा तेलुगु शब्द. नुसता “गुड़” म्हटले तर साधारणपणे उसाचा गूळ असा अर्थ होतो.
seg.9e04d6270c92.back: Yes. Gud, or gur, is the Hindi word for jaggery (gul), and bellam the Telugu word. If just “gud” is said, it usually means sugarcane jaggery.

seg.e531a25812a8.src: Why has my jaggery gone sticky?
seg.e531a25812a8.back: Why did my jaggery become sticky?

seg.cc79285bfadd.src: It has taken in moisture from the air, which happens faster in humid weather. Move it to an airtight jar and use a dry spoon.
seg.cc79285bfadd.t: त्याने हवेतील ओलावा शोषला आहे, जे दमट हवामानात लवकर होते. तो हवाबंद डब्यात ठेवा आणि कोरडा चमचा वापरा.
seg.cc79285bfadd.back: It has absorbed moisture from the air, which happens quickly in humid weather. Keep it in an airtight box and use a dry spoon.

seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.src: Can I use palm jaggery in payasam?
seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.t: पायसममध्ये ताडाचा गूळ वापरू शकतो का?
seg.1bdcd09c5ca0.back: Can palm jaggery be used in payasam?

seg.8ba95d799ac9.src: Yes. It gives a darker colour and a deeper taste. Add it off the heat, as you would cane jaggery.
seg.8ba95d799ac9.t: हो. त्याने रंग गडद आणि चव गहिरी होते. उसाच्या गुळाप्रमाणेच तो आचेवरून उतरवून घाला.
seg.8ba95d799ac9.back: Yes. With it the colour becomes dark and the taste deep. Just like sugarcane jaggery, add it after taking off the flame.
