seg.2b6b229e651e.src: FSSAI's standard says turmeric powder must be free from added colouring matter, including lead chromate, and from foreign starch. Its testing manual lists what inspectors check turmeric for: added dyes such as metanil yellow, lead salts, and chalk powder.
seg.2b6b229e651e.t: FSSAI च्या मानकानुसार हळद पावडरमध्ये वरून मिसळलेला कोणताही रंग नसावा, लेड क्रोमेटही नाही, आणि बाहेरचा स्टार्चही नाही. त्याच्या तपासणी मॅन्युअलमध्ये निरीक्षक हळदीत काय तपासतात ते दिले आहे: मेटानिल यलोसारखे मिसळलेले रंग, लेडचे क्षार, आणि खडूची पावडर.
seg.2b6b229e651e.back: According to the FSSAI standard, turmeric powder should not have any colour mixed in from outside, not lead chromate either, and not outside starch either. Its testing manual gives what inspectors check in turmeric: mixed-in colours like metanil yellow, salts of lead, and chalk powder.

seg.b27088069a9d.src: Some of this you can check in your kitchen, and some only a lab can find. This guide covers both, plus two popular tests that do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, ours included.
seg.b27088069a9d.t: यापैकी काही तुम्ही स्वयंपाकघरात तपासू शकता, आणि काही फक्त लॅबच शोधू शकते. हे मार्गदर्शक दोन्ही सांगते, सोबत दोन लोकप्रिय चाचण्याही, ज्या हळदीसाठी काम करत नाहीत. तुम्ही घेता त्या कोणत्याही हळदीवर त्या करून पाहा, आमच्या हळदीवरही.
seg.b27088069a9d.back: Some of these you can check in the kitchen, and some only a lab can detect. This guide tells both, along with two popular tests too, which do not work for turmeric. Try them on any turmeric you buy, on our turmeric too.

seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.src: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water with the powder settled at the bottom. Right: strong yellow water with yellow trails running down from the powder.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.t: हळदीच्या तपासणीनंतर पाण्याचे दोन ग्लास. डावीकडे: फिकट पिवळे पाणी, पावडर तळाशी बसलेली. उजवीकडे: गडद पिवळे पाणी, पावडरमधून खाली उतरणाऱ्या पिवळ्या रेषा.
seg.b74ab3f9bb3e.back: Two glasses of water after the turmeric check. Left: pale yellow water, powder settled at the bottom. Right: dark yellow water, yellow streaks descending from the powder.

seg.c8b6eb5f9530.src: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled and the water is pale yellow. Right: strong yellow trails ran from the powder as it sank, and the water turned deep yellow. That one is worth a lab test.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.t: ⟦1⟧पाण्याची तपासणी⟦/1⟧डावीकडे: पावडर खाली बसली आहे आणि पाणी फिकट पिवळे आहे. उजवीकडे: पावडर बुडताना तिच्यातून गडद पिवळ्या रेषा उतरल्या, आणि पाणी गडद पिवळे झाले. त्याची लॅब चाचणी करून घेणे योग्य ठरेल.
seg.c8b6eb5f9530.back: ⟦1⟧The water check⟦/1⟧Left: the powder has settled down and the water is pale yellow. Right: while the powder was sinking dark yellow streaks descended from it, and the water became dark yellow. It would be proper to get a lab test done on it.

seg.a7363cc3fa37.src: Sprinkle a teaspoon of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle without stirring. Turmeric sinks and leaves the water pale yellow; water that turns strong yellow straight away points to added colour. This check cannot find lead chromate or chalk, so for a sure answer, use a food testing lab. Skip the iodine test: turmeric is starchy to begin with.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.t: एका ग्लास पाण्यावर एक छोटा चमचा हळद भुरभुरा आणि न ढवळता खाली बसू द्या. हळद बुडते आणि पाणी फिकट पिवळे राहते; पाणी लगेच गडद पिवळे झाले तर ते वरून मिसळलेल्या रंगाकडे बोट दाखवते. या तपासणीत लेड क्रोमेट किंवा खडू सापडत नाही, म्हणून खात्रीच्या उत्तरासाठी फूड टेस्टिंग लॅबकडून चाचणी करून घ्या. आयोडीन चाचणी करू नका: हळदीत मुळातच स्टार्च असतो.
seg.a7363cc3fa37.back: Sprinkle a small spoon (teaspoon) of turmeric on a glass of water and let it settle down without stirring. Turmeric sinks and the water stays pale yellow; if the water immediately became dark yellow, it points a finger towards colour mixed in from outside. In this check lead chromate or chalk are not found, so for a sure answer get a test done by a food testing lab. Do not do the iodine test: turmeric has starch at its root.

seg.34d6f989bfaf.src: Such as metanil yellow, which can make dull turmeric look brighter. FSSAI does not allow added colour in turmeric.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.t: उदा. मेटानिल यलो, ज्यामुळे फिकट हळद जास्त चमकदार दिसू शकते. FSSAI हळदीत वरून रंग मिसळायला परवानगी देत नाही.
seg.34d6f989bfaf.back: E.g. metanil yellow, because of which pale turmeric can look brighter. FSSAI does not give permission to mix colour into turmeric from outside.

seg.042cabe54b01.src: Lead chromate and other lead salts
seg.042cabe54b01.t: लेड क्रोमेट आणि लेडचे इतर क्षार
seg.042cabe54b01.back: Lead chromate and other salts of lead

seg.8310b11eab8b.src: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024 found it in turmeric from parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not allow it in turmeric at all.
seg.8310b11eab8b.t: लेड क्रोमेट हे पेंटमध्ये वापरले जाणारे पिवळे रंगद्रव्य आहे. 2019 आणि 2024 मध्ये प्रसिद्ध झालेल्या, स्टॅनफर्डच्या नेतृत्वाखालील अभ्यासांत ते दक्षिण आशियाच्या काही भागांतील हळदीत आढळले. FSSAI हळदीत त्याला अजिबात परवानगी देत नाही.
seg.8310b11eab8b.back: Lead chromate is a yellow pigment used in paint. In Stanford-led studies published in 2019 and 2024, it was found in turmeric from some parts of South Asia. FSSAI does not permit it in turmeric at all.

seg.4278e7c5416c.src: A cheap white powder that adds weight.
seg.4278e7c5416c.t: वजन वाढवणारी एक स्वस्त पांढरी पावडर.
seg.4278e7c5416c.back: A cheap white powder that increases weight.

seg.5a8b446bbce0.src: Flour or starch from other crops. FSSAI's standard rules it out too.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.t: इतर पिकांचे पीठ किंवा स्टार्च. FSSAI च्या मानकात यालाही मनाई आहे.
seg.5a8b446bbce0.back: Flour or starch of other crops. In the FSSAI standard this too is prohibited.

seg.1b1af7f63ffd.src: Fill a clear glass with water at room temperature.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.t: एक पारदर्शक ग्लास खोलीच्या तापमानाच्या पाण्याने भरा.
seg.1b1af7f63ffd.back: Fill a transparent glass with room-temperature water.

seg.653731f2ed6f.src: Sprinkle one level teaspoon of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.
seg.653731f2ed6f.t: वरून एक सपाट छोटा चमचा हळद पावडर भुरभुरा. ढवळू नका.
seg.653731f2ed6f.back: Sprinkle a level small spoon (teaspoon) of turmeric powder on top. Do not stir.

seg.ea5b43cf8436.src: Watch the first minute as the powder sinks. Look for coloured trails running down from it.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.t: पावडर बुडत असताना पहिला एक मिनिट लक्ष देऊन पाहा. तिच्यातून खाली उतरणाऱ्या रंगीत रेषा दिसतात का ते पाहा.
seg.ea5b43cf8436.back: While the powder is sinking, watch attentively for the first one minute. See whether coloured streaks descending from it are visible.

seg.e37698aaa3fb.src: Leave it for 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass against a white wall or a sheet of paper and look at the water above the settled powder.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.t: 15 ते 20 मिनिटे तसेच ठेवा. मग ग्लास पांढऱ्या भिंतीसमोर किंवा कागदासमोर धरा आणि खाली बसलेल्या पावडरच्या वरचे पाणी पाहा.
seg.e37698aaa3fb.back: Leave it like that 15 to 20 minutes. Then hold the glass in front of a white wall or paper and look at the water above the settled powder.

seg.e8937cebf136.src: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom
seg.e8937cebf136.back: Pale yellow water, powder at the bottom

seg.256ce5cf303d.src: Strong yellow trails, or deep yellow water within minutes
seg.256ce5cf303d.t: गडद पिवळ्या रेषा, किंवा काही मिनिटांत गडद पिवळे पाणी
seg.256ce5cf303d.back: Dark yellow streaks, or dark yellow water within a few minutes

seg.ce06c8148072.src: Possible added colour. Stop using that batch and get it tested.
seg.ce06c8148072.t: रंग मिसळलेला असू शकतो. ती बॅच वापरणे थांबवा आणि तिची चाचणी करून घ्या.
seg.ce06c8148072.back: Colour may have been mixed in. Stop using that batch and get it tested.

seg.53d9c5db264d.src: ⟦1⟧Why it works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow, curcumin, hardly dissolves in water, so the powder sinks and only tints the water. Dyes such as metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water fast.
seg.53d9c5db264d.t: ⟦1⟧हे का काम करते.⟦/1⟧ हळदीचा स्वतःचा पिवळा रंग, करक्युमिन, पाण्यात फारसा विरघळत नाही, म्हणून पावडर बुडते आणि पाण्याला फक्त हलकी छटा देते. मेटानिल यलोसारखे रंग सहज विरघळतात आणि पाणी पटकन रंगवतात.
seg.53d9c5db264d.back: ⟦1⟧Why this works.⟦/1⟧ Turmeric's own yellow colour, curcumin, does not dissolve much in water, so the powder sinks and gives the water only a light tint. Colours like metanil yellow dissolve easily and colour the water quickly.

seg.af4442c6e910.src: ⟦1⟧What it misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk do not dissolve in water either, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can rule them out.
seg.af4442c6e910.t: ⟦1⟧यात काय सुटते.⟦/1⟧ लेड क्रोमेट आणि खडूही पाण्यात विरघळत नाहीत, म्हणून ते मिसळलेली हळद या तपासणीत पास होऊ शकते. ते नाहीत हे फक्त लॅब चाचणीच सांगू शकते.
seg.af4442c6e910.back: ⟦1⟧What this misses.⟦/1⟧ Lead chromate and chalk also do not dissolve in water, so turmeric mixed with them can pass this check. Only a lab test can tell that they are not there.

seg.a8b61850b87d.src: Very fine powder can keep the water cloudy for a while. Cloudy is fine; a clear, strong yellow is what to look for.
seg.a8b61850b87d.t: खूप बारीक पावडरमुळे पाणी काही वेळ गढूळ राहू शकते. गढूळ असणे ठीक आहे; पाहायचा आहे तो नितळ, गडद पिवळा रंग.
seg.a8b61850b87d.back: Because of very fine powder the water may stay cloudy for some time. Being cloudy is fine; what to look for is a clear, dark yellow colour.

seg.c3455d1f4c96.src: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric
seg.c3455d1f4c96.t: तपासणी 2: तुम्ही अख्खी हळद घेत असाल तर
seg.c3455d1f4c96.back: Check 2: if you buy whole turmeric

seg.3d4e366bb488.src: Snap a finger of dried turmeric in half. Turmeric is yellow-orange right through, so the inside should look much like the outside. A bright yellow skin over a pale or dull core can mean colour was added to the surface. Ask the seller about it, or get it tested.
seg.3d4e366bb488.t: वाळलेल्या हळदीचे एक हळकुंड मधोमध मोडा. हळद आतपर्यंत पिवळसर-नारिंगी असते, म्हणून आतला भाग साधारण बाहेरच्या भागासारखाच दिसायला हवा. आतला भाग फिकट किंवा निस्तेज आणि वरचे साल चमकदार पिवळे असेल, तर पृष्ठभागावर रंग लावलेला असू शकतो. याबद्दल विक्रेत्याला विचारा, किंवा चाचणी करून घ्या.
seg.3d4e366bb488.back: Break a dried turmeric finger (halkund) in the middle. Turmeric is yellowish-orange right to the inside, so the inner part should look roughly like the outer part. If the inner part is pale or dull and the outer skin bright yellow, colour may have been applied on the surface. Ask the seller about this, or get it tested.

seg.4c4dc95561d2.src: Iodine turns blue-black when it meets starch, and it is often suggested for spotting flour in turmeric. But turmeric is starchy itself, so it turns blue-black either way. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for powdered spices other than turmeric.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.t: आयोडीन स्टार्चच्या संपर्कात आल्यावर निळसर-काळे होते, आणि हळदीतील पीठ ओळखण्यासाठी ही चाचणी अनेकदा सुचवली जाते. पण हळदीत स्वतःच स्टार्च असतो, म्हणून ती दोन्ही बाबतीत निळसर-काळी होते. म्हणूनच FSSAI चे स्वतःचे मॅन्युअल आयोडीन चाचणी हळदीव्यतिरिक्त इतर मसाल्यांच्या पावडरसाठी वापरते.
seg.4c4dc95561d2.back: Iodine becomes bluish-black on contact with starch, and this test is often suggested for detecting flour in turmeric. But turmeric itself has starch, so it turns bluish-black in both cases. That is why FSSAI's own manual uses the iodine test for spice powders other than turmeric.

seg.fc16ff8016e3.src: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use concentrated hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. They belong in a lab, not a kitchen.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.t: हळदीतील लेड, मेटानिल यलो आणि खडूसाठी FSSAI च्या चाचण्यांमध्ये तीव्र हायड्रोक्लोरिक किंवा सल्फ्युरिक आम्ल वापरले जाते. ही आम्ले त्वचा आणि डोळे भाजतात. त्यांची जागा लॅबमध्ये आहे, स्वयंपाकघरात नाही.
seg.fc16ff8016e3.back: FSSAI's tests for lead, metanil yellow and chalk in turmeric use strong hydrochloric or sulphuric acid. These acids burn skin and eyes. Their place is in the lab, not in the kitchen.

seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.src: For a sure answer: a food testing lab
seg.1dd87aa7bdc7.back: For a sure answer: a food testing lab

seg.1883beca4d73.src: A NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and for added colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or a clean sealed bag, and note the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.
seg.1883beca4d73.t: NABL मान्यताप्राप्त फूड टेस्टिंग लॅब हळदीतील लेड आणि मिसळलेल्या रंगांची चाचणी करू शकते. लॅबला किती नमुना लागतो ते विचारा, पावडर तिच्या सीलबंद पॅकमध्ये किंवा एका स्वच्छ सीलबंद पिशवीत ठेवा, आणि पॅकवर छापलेला बॅच नंबर लिहून ठेवा. FSSAI आपल्या वेबसाइटवर अधिसूचित फूड टेस्टिंग लॅबची यादी प्रसिद्ध करते.
seg.1883beca4d73.back: An NABL-accredited food testing lab can test turmeric for lead and mixed-in colours. Ask the lab how much sample it needs, keep the powder in its sealed pack or in a clean sealed bag, and write down the batch number printed on the pack. FSSAI publishes a list of notified food testing labs on its website.

seg.456379c75c24.src: Read the pack before you buy

seg.ff7951e2f36b.src: An FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.t: FSSAI परवाना किंवा नोंदणी क्रमांक. तो तुम्ही FSSAI च्या FoSCoS वेबसाइटवर शोधू शकता.
seg.ff7951e2f36b.back: FSSAI licence or registration number. You can look it up on FSSAI's FoSCoS website.

seg.476e4849c1d8.src: The name and address of whoever made or packed it.
seg.476e4849c1d8.t: ज्याने ते बनवले किंवा पॅक केले त्याचे नाव आणि पत्ता.
seg.476e4849c1d8.back: Name and address of the one who made or packed it.

seg.beee8eda6466.src: Net quantity, MRP, a batch or lot number, and a best-before date.
seg.beee8eda6466.t: निव्वळ प्रमाण, MRP, बॅच किंवा लॉट नंबर, आणि बेस्ट-बिफोर तारीख.
seg.beee8eda6466.back: Net quantity, MRP, batch or lot number, and best-before date.

seg.f9270fd96202.src: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions differs in colour, so a named region helps you compare like with like.
seg.f9270fd96202.t: ती कुठे पिकली. वेगवेगळ्या प्रदेशांतील हळदीचा रंग वेगळा असतो, म्हणून प्रदेशाचे नाव असल्यास एकसारख्या हळदीची एकमेकांशी तुलना करता येते.
seg.f9270fd96202.back: Where it was grown. Turmeric from different regions has different colour, so if the region's name is there, similar turmeric can be compared with each other.

seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.src: Keep the pack zipped shut, or move the powder to a dry, airtight jar.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.t: पॅकची झिप बंद ठेवा, किंवा पावडर कोरड्या, हवाबंद डब्यात काढून ठेवा.
seg.7cdc58c0c7e8.back: Keep the pack's zip closed, or transfer the powder into a dry, airtight box.

seg.bb4d61f86b55.src: Use a dry spoon. A damp spoon is what makes turmeric lumpy.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.t: कोरडा चमचा वापरा. ओल्या चमच्यामुळेच हळदीत गुठळ्या होतात.
seg.bb4d61f86b55.back: Use a dry spoon. It is because of a wet spoon that lumps form in turmeric.

seg.a92c022ff52e.src: Keep it out of direct sunlight, which fades the colour.
seg.a92c022ff52e.t: थेट उन्हापासून दूर ठेवा, उन्हामुळे रंग फिका पडतो.
seg.a92c022ff52e.back: Keep away from direct sun, because of sun the colour fades.

seg.6911ce63edde.src: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?
seg.6911ce63edde.t: खूप चमकदार पिवळी हळद हे वाईट लक्षण आहे का?
seg.6911ce63edde.back: Is very bright yellow turmeric a bad sign?

seg.a0ce62cee740.src: Not by itself. Colour changes with the variety, where it was grown and how it was dried and ground, so turmerics differ a lot. What matters is colour that leaves the powder too easily, as in the water check.
seg.a0ce62cee740.t: फक्त तेवढ्यावरून नाही. रंग जात, पिकवण्याची जागा आणि वाळवण्याची व दळण्याची पद्धत यानुसार बदलतो, म्हणून हळदी-हळदीत बराच फरक असतो. पाहायचं ते हे की रंग पावडरमधून फार सहज सुटतो का, जसा पाण्याच्या तपासणीत दिसतो.
seg.a0ce62cee740.back: Not from that alone. The colour changes according to variety, place of growing and method of drying and grinding, so there is a lot of difference from turmeric to turmeric. What to see is whether the colour comes loose from the powder very easily, as seen in the water check.

seg.e8cc5edbb092.src: Can the water check show that turmeric has no lead?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.t: हळदीत लेड नाही हे पाण्याच्या तपासणीतून कळू शकते का?
seg.e8cc5edbb092.back: Can it be known from the water check that turmeric has no lead?

seg.37eb38df9ce8.src: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so the water check cannot see it. Only a lab test can.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.t: नाही. लेड क्रोमेट पाण्यात विरघळत नाही, म्हणून पाण्याच्या तपासणीत ते दिसत नाही. ते फक्त लॅब चाचणीतच कळते.
seg.37eb38df9ce8.back: No. Lead chromate does not dissolve in water, so it is not visible in the water check. It is known only in a lab test.

seg.4c0bb3e9657c.back: Why do lumps form in turmeric?

seg.2b76cd3e665b.src: Moisture. A wet spoon or an open pack lets the powder take in water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack sealed.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.t: ओलाव्यामुळे. ओल्या चमच्यामुळे किंवा उघड्या पॅकमुळे पावडर पाणी शोषते. गुठळ्या कोरड्या चमच्याने फोडा आणि पॅक बंद ठेवा.
seg.2b76cd3e665b.back: Because of moisture. Because of a wet spoon or an open pack, the powder absorbs water. Break the lumps with a dry spoon and keep the pack closed.

seg.87fe2929801d.src: What should I do if a check looks wrong?
seg.87fe2929801d.t: एखादी तपासणी चुकीची वाटली तर काय करावे?
seg.87fe2929801d.back: What to do if some check seems wrong?

seg.e83aba6cc6df.src: Stop using that batch, keep the pack, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also report it to FSSAI through its Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.t: ती बॅच वापरणे थांबवा, पॅक जपून ठेवा, आणि बॅच नंबरसह विक्रेत्याशी संपर्क साधा. FSSAI च्या Food Safety Connect ॲपवर तुम्ही तक्रारही करू शकता. ती आमची असेल, तर पॅक आणि ग्लासचा फोटो आम्हाला WhatsApp करा.
seg.e83aba6cc6df.back: Stop using that batch, keep the pack carefully, and contact the seller with the batch number. You can also complain on FSSAI's Food Safety Connect app. If it is ours, WhatsApp us a photo of the pack and the glass.

seg.1dd4194330b1.src: Try these checks on ours too. If anything looks off, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number from the pack.
seg.1dd4194330b1.t: या तपासण्या आमच्या हळदीवरही करा. काही वेगळे वाटले, तर पॅकवरील बॅच नंबरसह एक फोटो ⟦1⟧आम्हाला WhatsApp करा⟦/1⟧.
seg.1dd4194330b1.back: Do these checks on our turmeric too. If something seemed different, ⟦1⟧WhatsApp us⟦/1⟧ a photo with the batch number on the pack.

seg.d25dae4babde.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Andhra Kodi Kura · Andhra Chicken Curry
seg.d25dae4babde.t: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · आंध्र कोडी कूरा · आंध्र चिकन करी
seg.d25dae4babde.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Andhra Kodi Koora · Andhra chicken curry

seg.91bce9460ade.src: Kodi kura is the chicken curry that fills Andhra homes on a Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken marinated in chilli and turmeric, cooked down in a gravy of deep-golden onions and tomatoes, and finished with garam masala. It goes to the table with hot rice, and the leftovers with dosa or chapati at night.
seg.91bce9460ade.t: कोडी कूरा म्हणजे रविवारी दुपारी आंध्रातल्या घरोघरी होणारी चिकन करी: हाडासकट चिकन तिखट आणि हळदीत मुरवून, गडद सोनेरी कांदा आणि टोमॅटोच्या ग्रेव्हीत शिजवले जाते, आणि शेवटी गरम मसाला घातला जातो. ती गरम भातासोबत ताटात येते, आणि उरलेली रात्री डोसा किंवा चपातीसोबत.
seg.91bce9460ade.back: Kodi koora is the chicken curry made in home after home in Andhra on Sunday afternoon: bone-in chicken is marinated in chilli powder and turmeric, cooked in a gravy of deep golden onion and tomato, and garam masala is added at the end. It comes to the plate with hot rice, and the leftover at night with dosa or chapati.

seg.2422ebb922bc.src: The heat here comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli that gives Andhra curries their bite and bright red colour, with our turmeric powder in the marinade. This recipe serves 4 and is properly fiery; the tips say how to scale it down.
seg.2422ebb922bc.t: यातला तिखटपणा आमच्या तेजा मिरची पावडरचा आहे, गुंटूरची ही खूप तिखट मिरची आंध्र करींना त्यांचा झणका आणि चमकदार लाल रंग देते; मॅरिनेडमध्ये आमची हळद पावडरही आहे. या पाककृतीत 4 जणांसाठी करी होते आणि ती चांगलीच झणझणीत असते; तिखटपणा कसा कमी करायचा ते टिप्समध्ये दिले आहे.
seg.2422ebb922bc.back: The heat in it is from our Teja chilli powder; this very hot chilli of Guntur gives Andhra curries their kick and bright red colour; our turmeric powder is also in the marinade. This recipe makes curry for 4 people and it is quite fiery; how to reduce the heat is given in the tips.

seg.6037465ed8d2.src: Total includes 30 minutes for the marinade.
seg.6037465ed8d2.t: एकूण वेळेत मॅरिनेडची 30 मिनिटेही धरली आहेत.
seg.6037465ed8d2.back: The total time also counts the 30 minutes of marinade.

seg.9cb820880217.src: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook it in a deep-golden onion and tomato gravy. Finish with garam masala and coriander leaves.
seg.9cb820880217.t: चिकन दही, तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर आणि मिठात मुरवा, मग गडद सोनेरी कांदा-टोमॅटोच्या ग्रेव्हीत शिजवा. शेवटी गरम मसाला आणि कोथिंबीर घाला.
seg.9cb820880217.back: Marinate chicken in curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, then cook in a deep golden onion-tomato gravy. At the end add garam masala and coriander leaves.

seg.d35e8cdc661c.src: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, curry-cut pieces, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.t: 750 g चिकन ⟦1⟧हाडासकट, करीसाठी कापलेले तुकडे, धुऊन नीट निथळलेले⟦/1⟧
seg.d35e8cdc661c.back: 750 g chicken ⟦1⟧bone-in, pieces cut for curry, washed and well drained⟦/1⟧

seg.c84970cf7b6f.t: ½ कप दही ⟦1⟧घट्ट, फेटून गुळगुळीत केलेले⟦/1⟧

seg.9e9cb51b1458.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.t: 2 छोटे चमचे तेजा मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧खूप तिखट; मध्यम तिखटपणासाठी 1 छोटा चमचा वापरा⟦/1⟧
seg.9e9cb51b1458.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.9654088d205e.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧plus more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.t: 1 छोटा चमचा मीठ ⟦1⟧आणि शेवटी चवीनुसार आणखी⟦/1⟧
seg.9654088d205e.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧and more to taste at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.fff6117cc0f5.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual Andhra choice⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.t: 3 मोठे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧आंध्रात सहसा शेंगदाणा तेल वापरतात⟦/1⟧
seg.fff6117cc0f5.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧in Andhra groundnut oil is usually used⟦/1⟧

seg.de3654151f5d.t: 3 लवंगा, 2 हिरव्या वेलच्या, 1 इंच दालचिनीचा तुकडा ⟦1⟧अख्खे⟦/1⟧
seg.de3654151f5d.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1-inch piece of cinnamon ⟦1⟧whole⟦/1⟧

seg.3347559a7b17.src: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for a thinner gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.t: 1 कप गरम पाणी ⟦1⟧पातळ ग्रेव्हीसाठी थोडे जास्त⟦/1⟧
seg.3347559a7b17.back: 1 cup hot water ⟦1⟧a little more for thin gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.cf5fbb1e5375.back: Also turns out nice with ⟦1⟧Sannam chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge if your kitchen is hot.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.t: चिकनला दही, तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर आणि मीठ चोळून लावा. 30 मिनिटे तसेच ठेवा. स्वयंपाकघर गरम असेल तर भांडे झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा.
seg.b4fe3cc46ec4.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt onto the chicken. Keep it like that 30 minutes. If the kitchen is hot, cover the vessel and keep it in the fridge.

seg.217eb90c7dac.src: Heat the oil in a heavy pan or kadai on medium heat. Add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them sizzle for a few seconds.
seg.217eb90c7dac.t: जाड बुडाच्या पॅनमध्ये किंवा कढईत मध्यम आचेवर तेल गरम करा. लवंगा, वेलच्या आणि दालचिनी घाला आणि काही सेकंद तडतडू द्या.
seg.217eb90c7dac.back: Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed pan or kadhai on medium heat. Add cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon and let them crackle a few seconds.

seg.41164e7a534a.src: Add the onions, green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.41164e7a534a.t: कांदा, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता घाला.
seg.41164e7a534a.back: Add onion, green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.127dbd26bc4d.src: Fry the onions in oil till deep golden. This takes 12–15 minutes on medium heat; stir often so they brown evenly without burning.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.t: कांदा तेलात गडद सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता. मध्यम आचेवर यासाठी 12–15 मिनिटे लागतात; कांदा न करपता सगळीकडे सारखा तपकिरी व्हावा म्हणून वारंवार ढवळा.
seg.127dbd26bc4d.back: Fry the onion in oil until deep golden. On medium heat this takes 12–15 minutes; stir often so the onion browns evenly everywhere without burning.

seg.3fa3e9f33095.src: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomatoes, and cook till soft. Fry the paste for 1 minute until the raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes for 5–6 minutes, mashing them, until they break down and oil shows at the edges.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.t: आलं-लसूण पेस्ट घाला, मग टोमॅटो, आणि मऊ होईपर्यंत शिजवा. पेस्टचा कच्चा वास जाईपर्यंत 1 मिनिट परता, मग टोमॅटो 5–6 मिनिटे शिजवा, ते मोडून एकजीव होईपर्यंत आणि कडेने तेल सुटेपर्यंत चेचत राहा.
seg.3fa3e9f33095.back: Add ginger-garlic paste, then tomato, and cook until soft. Fry the paste 1 minute until its raw smell goes, then cook the tomatoes 5–6 minutes, mashing until they break down and blend and oil separates at the edges.

seg.24dbd7dfd784.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.t: धणे पूड ढवळून घाला आणि 30 सेकंद परता.
seg.24dbd7dfd784.back: Stir in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds.

seg.461e7a0a9c22.src: Add the chicken and cook covered on medium heat till no pink remains near the bone. Fry it uncovered for the first 5 minutes until the pieces turn opaque, then pour in the hot water, cover and cook for about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.t: चिकन घाला आणि हाडाजवळ अजिबात गुलाबी रंग उरत नाही तोपर्यंत मध्यम आचेवर झाकून शिजवा. पहिली 5 मिनिटे तुकडे अपारदर्शक होईपर्यंत झाकण न ठेवता परता, मग गरम पाणी ओता, झाकून सुमारे 20 मिनिटे शिजवा, मधूनमधून ढवळत राहा.
seg.461e7a0a9c22.back: Add chicken and cook covered on medium heat until no pink colour at all remains near the bone. For the first 5 minutes fry without a lid until the pieces become opaque, then pour hot water, cover and cook about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.

seg.22f96ed1f76e.src: Check a thick piece: the chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.t: एक जाड तुकडा तपासा: हाडाजवळ अजिबात गुलाबी रंग उरला नसेल आणि रस पारदर्शक येत असेल, तर चिकन शिजले आहे. ग्रेव्ही चाखून पाहा आणि लागल्यास मीठ घाला.
seg.22f96ed1f76e.back: Check a thick piece: if no pink colour at all remains near the bone and the juice runs clear, the chicken is cooked. Taste the gravy and add salt if needed.

seg.f10b1f5ae914.src: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer 3 minutes, uncovered, until the gravy is as thick as you like and a red film of oil floats on top.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.t: गरम मसाला आणि कोथिंबीर ढवळून घाला. झाकण न ठेवता 3 मिनिटे मंद उकळा, ग्रेव्ही तुम्हाला हवी तितकी घट्ट होईपर्यंत आणि वर तेलाचा लाल तवंग येईपर्यंत.
seg.f10b1f5ae914.back: Stir in garam masala and coriander leaves. Simmer gently 3 minutes without a lid, until the gravy is as thick as you want and a red film of oil comes on top.

seg.a7c73631b2ca.src: Switch off and rest the curry for 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour comes together.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.t: आच बंद करा आणि वाढण्याआधी करी 10 मिनिटे तशीच राहू द्या; ग्रेव्ही स्थिरावते आणि चव एकत्र मुरते.
seg.a7c73631b2ca.back: Turn off the heat and let the curry stay like that 10 minutes before serving; the gravy settles and the flavour soaks together.

seg.0b948e3072fa.src: Brown the onions deep golden; the gravy's colour and body come from them.
seg.0b948e3072fa.t: कांदा गडद सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता; ग्रेव्हीचा रंग आणि दाटपणा त्यातूनच येतो.
seg.0b948e3072fa.back: Fry the onion until deep golden; the gravy's colour and thickness come from that itself.

seg.e0365adcf1bf.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium curry use 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder for red colour with gentler heat.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.t: तेजा मिरची पावडर खूप तिखट असते. मध्यम तिखट करीसाठी 1 छोटा चमचा वापरा, किंवा कमी तिखटपणासह लाल रंगासाठी सन्नम मिरची पावडर वापरा.
seg.e0365adcf1bf.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a medium-hot curry use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour with less heat use Sannam chilli powder.

seg.57940a63282d.src: Use bone-in pieces; the bones give the gravy its depth.
seg.57940a63282d.t: हाडासकट तुकडे वापरा; हाडांमुळे ग्रेव्हीला गहिरी चव येते.
seg.57940a63282d.back: Use bone-in pieces; because of the bones the gravy gets a deep flavour.

seg.4f9718c3bc6f.src: Let the oil separate from the tomato masala before the chicken goes in, or the gravy tastes raw.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.t: चिकन घालण्याआधी टोमॅटो मसाल्यातून तेल सुटू द्या, नाहीतर ग्रेव्हीला कच्ची चव लागते.
seg.4f9718c3bc6f.back: Let oil separate from the tomato masala before adding the chicken, otherwise the gravy tastes raw.

seg.164627c386b7.src: Kobbari kodi kura: grind 3 tbsp grated coconut with 1 tbsp poppy seeds and a little water, and stir the paste in with the garam masala for a richer gravy.
seg.164627c386b7.t: कोब्बरी कोडी कूरा: 3 मोठे चमचे किसलेले खोबरे 1 मोठा चमचा खसखस आणि थोड्या पाण्यासोबत वाटा, आणि जास्त दाट ग्रेव्हीसाठी ही पेस्ट गरम मसाल्यासोबत ढवळून घाला.
seg.164627c386b7.back: Kobbari kodi koora: grind 3 tablespoons grated coconut with 1 tablespoon poppy seeds and a little water, and for a thicker gravy stir this paste in with the garam masala.

seg.7d79f857440a.src: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tbsp coriander seeds, 1 tsp fennel seeds, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of the coriander powder and garam masala.
seg.7d79f857440a.t: वाटलेला मसाला: 1 मोठा चमचा धणे, 1 छोटा चमचा बडीशेप, 3 लवंगा आणि दालचिनीचा छोटा तुकडा कोरडे भाजा, वाटा, आणि धणे पूड व गरम मसाल्याऐवजी वापरा.
seg.7d79f857440a.back: Ground masala: dry-roast 1 tablespoon coriander seeds, 1 teaspoon fennel, 3 cloves and a small piece of cinnamon, grind, and use instead of coriander powder and garam masala.

seg.ea1fd7a2c573.src: Pressure cooker: after adding the chicken and water, cook for 2 whistles and let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.t: प्रेशर कुकर: चिकन आणि पाणी घातल्यानंतर 2 शिट्ट्या करा आणि प्रेशर आपोआप उतरू द्या.
seg.ea1fd7a2c573.back: Pressure cooker: after adding chicken and water, do 2 whistles and let the pressure release by itself.

seg.8b4376996905.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, the Sunday way. It also goes well with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.
seg.8b4376996905.t: रविवारच्या पद्धतीने वाफवलेला भात आणि एक चमचा तुपासोबत गरम वाढा. चपाती, डोसा किंवा रागी संगटीसोबतही छान लागते.
seg.8b4376996905.back: In the Sunday way, serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee. It also tastes nice with chapati, dosa or ragi sangati.

seg.45cb0a9558e6.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. The curry tastes deeper the next day.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.t: झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये 2 दिवसांपर्यंत ठेवा; आतपर्यंत चांगली वाफाळती गरम होईपर्यंत पुन्हा गरम करा. दुसऱ्या दिवशी करीची चव अधिक गहिरी लागते.
seg.45cb0a9558e6.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days; reheat until well steaming hot all the way through. The next day the curry's flavour tastes deeper.

seg.bc11ae48bfcf.src: How do I make Andhra chicken curry less spicy?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.t: आंध्र चिकन करी कमी तिखट कशी करावी?
seg.bc11ae48bfcf.back: How to make Andhra chicken curry less hot?

seg.aaa9ea580a50.src: Cut the Teja chilli powder to 1 tsp, or use Sannam chilli powder, which gives the same red colour with gentler heat. A spoon of curd stirred in at the end also softens the bite.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.t: तेजा मिरची पावडर कमी करून 1 छोटा चमचा घाला, किंवा सन्नम मिरची पावडर वापरा, तिने तसाच लाल रंग येतो पण तिखटपणा कमी असतो. शेवटी एक चमचा दही ढवळून घातल्यानेही झणका कमी होतो.
seg.aaa9ea580a50.back: Reduce Teja chilli powder and add 1 teaspoon, or use Sannam chilli powder; it gives the same red colour but the heat is less. Stirring in a spoon of curd at the end also reduces the kick.

seg.fe399a2a853e.src: Why is Andhra chicken curry so spicy?
seg.fe399a2a853e.t: आंध्र चिकन करी इतकी तिखट का असते?
seg.fe399a2a853e.back: Why is Andhra chicken curry so hot?

seg.ada87f188506.src: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies such as Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in most other regional curries. The heat is part of the dish.
seg.ada87f188506.t: आंध्रातल्या स्वयंपाकात तेजासारख्या गुंटूर मिरच्या वापरतात, ज्या इतर बहुतेक प्रदेशांच्या करींमध्ये वापरल्या जाणाऱ्या मिरची पावडरपेक्षा खूपच तिखट असतात. तिखटपणा हा या पदार्थाचाच भाग आहे.
seg.ada87f188506.back: Andhra cooking uses Guntur chillies like Teja, which are much hotter than the chilli powder used in curries of most other regions. Heat is part of this dish itself.

seg.fc940ab96cce.src: How do I know the chicken is cooked through?
seg.fc940ab96cce.t: चिकन आतपर्यंत शिजले आहे हे कसे ओळखावे?
seg.fc940ab96cce.back: How to know the chicken is cooked all the way through?

seg.1445f73d2fc1.src: Cut into the thickest piece near the bone. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains near the bone and the juices run clear.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.t: सर्वात जाड तुकडा हाडाजवळ कापून पाहा. हाडाजवळ अजिबात गुलाबी रंग उरला नसेल आणि रस पारदर्शक येत असेल, तर चिकन शिजले आहे.
seg.1445f73d2fc1.back: Cut and look at the thickest piece near the bone. If no pink colour at all remains near the bone and the juice runs clear, the chicken is cooked.

seg.736c9b09bcd3.src: Can I make kodi kura without curd?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.t: दह्याशिवाय कोडी कूरा करता येईल का?
seg.736c9b09bcd3.back: Can kodi koora be made without curd?

seg.f9ab2afc44b4.src: Yes. Marinate the chicken with the chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tbsp lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.t: हो. चिकन मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर, मीठ आणि 1 मोठा चमचा लिंबाच्या रसात मुरवा, आणि ग्रेव्हीत आणखी एक टोमॅटो घाला.
seg.f9ab2afc44b4.back: Yes. Marinate the chicken in chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and 1 tablespoon lemon juice, and add one more tomato to the gravy.

seg.49c9832aa59a.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర · Andhra Kodi Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.t: आंध्रा कोडी कूरा · आंध्र कोडी कूरा पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.49c9832aa59a.back: Andhra Kodi Koora · Andhra Kodi Koora recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.dcb6c98b640e.src: ఆంధ్రా కోడి కూర. The Andhra Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.t: आंध्रा कोडी कूरा. आंध्रातली रविवारची चिकन करी: तेजा मिरची पावडर आणि हळद पावडरमध्ये मुरवलेले चिकन, गरम मसाल्यासह गडद कांदा-टोमॅटो ग्रेव्हीत शिजवलेले.
seg.dcb6c98b640e.back: Andhra Kodi Koora. Andhra's Sunday chicken curry: chicken marinated in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, cooked in a deep onion-tomato gravy with garam masala.

seg.979d83e76a0e.src: Andhra Kodi Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.979d83e76a0e.t: आंध्र कोडी कूरा: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.979d83e76a0e.back: Andhra Kodi Koora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.dd8d5de6151e.t: 3 लवंगा, 2 हिरव्या वेलच्या, 1 इंच दालचिनीचा तुकडा
seg.dd8d5de6151e.back: 3 cloves, 2 green cardamoms, 1-inch piece of cinnamon

seg.d04209f30de4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Gud Wala Meetha Pongal
seg.d04209f30de4.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Bellam Pongali · Sweet pongal of jaggery

seg.b79702dac541.src: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal that Telugu homes cook on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and enriched with ghee. It is offered as naivedyam before the festive meal, and it is also the prasadam at many temples and Friday pujas.
seg.b79702dac541.t: बेल्लम पोंगली म्हणजे तेलुगु घरांमध्ये संक्रांतीच्या सकाळी होणारा गोड पोंगल: तांदूळ आणि भाजलेली मूग डाळ अगदी मऊ शिजवून, मग गुळाने गोड करून आणि तूप घालून खमंग केलेला. सणाच्या जेवणाआधी तो नैवेद्य म्हणून दाखवला जातो, आणि अनेक मंदिरांमध्ये आणि शुक्रवारच्या पूजांमध्ये तो प्रसादही असतो.
seg.b79702dac541.back: Bellam pongali is the sweet pongal made in Telugu homes on Sankranti morning: rice and roasted moong dal cooked very soft, then sweetened with jaggery and made rich with ghee. Before the festival meal it is offered as naivedya, and in many temples and Friday pujas it is also the prasad.

seg.17053455adbb.src: Cane jaggery gives it a light brown colour and a round, toffee-like sweetness, and ghee-fried whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack add the crunch. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17053455adbb.t: उसाच्या गुळामुळे याला हलका तपकिरी रंग आणि टॉफीसारखा भरीव गोडवा येतो, आणि आमच्या जीडिपप्पु पॅकमधले तुपात तळलेले अख्खे काजू कुरकुरीतपणा आणतात. या पाककृतीत 4 जणांसाठी होते.
seg.17053455adbb.back: Because of sugarcane jaggery it gets a light brown colour and a full toffee-like sweetness, and the whole cashews fried in ghee from our Jeedipappu pack bring crunch. This recipe makes enough for 4 people.

seg.50377f017e4e.src: Cook time is for a pressure cooker; allow about 15 minutes more in a pot.
seg.50377f017e4e.t: शिजवण्याचा वेळ प्रेशर कुकरसाठी आहे; पातेल्यात सुमारे 15 मिनिटे जास्त धरा.
seg.50377f017e4e.back: The cooking time is for a pressure cooker; in a pot allow about 15 minutes more.

seg.b323962ddab1.src: Cook roasted moong dal and rice till very soft, stir in melted cane jaggery and simmer till glossy. Finish with ghee-fried cashews, raisins and cardamom.
seg.b323962ddab1.t: भाजलेली मूग डाळ आणि तांदूळ अगदी मऊ शिजवा, वितळवलेला उसाचा गूळ ढवळून घाला आणि चकाकी येईपर्यंत मंद उकळा. शेवटी तुपात तळलेले काजू, बेदाणे आणि वेलची घाला.
seg.b323962ddab1.back: Cook roasted moong dal and rice very soft, stir in melted sugarcane jaggery and simmer until glossy. At the end add cashews fried in ghee, raisins and cardamom.

seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.src: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧split yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.t: ¼ कप मूग डाळ ⟦1⟧पिवळी मूग डाळ (पेसरपप्पु), सुमारे 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.15ea2f1a2cd2.back: ¼ cup moong dal ⟦1⟧yellow moong dal (pesarapappu), about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.9f8bf29ce704.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly packed, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.t: 1 कप किसलेला उसाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧हलका दाबून भरलेला, सुमारे 150 g; जास्त गोड आवडत असेल तर थोडा जास्त⟦/1⟧
seg.9f8bf29ce704.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧lightly pressed and filled, about 150 g; a little more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.8dff8f977372.src: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧to melt the jaggery⟦/1⟧
seg.8dff8f977372.back: ¼ cup water ⟦1⟧for melting the jaggery⟦/1⟧

seg.c9f89d999d7a.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram) ⟦1⟧optional; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.t: चिमूटभर खाण्याचा कापूर (पच्चा कर्पूरम) ⟦1⟧हवा असल्यास; अगदी लहान चिमूट⟦/1⟧
seg.c9f89d999d7a.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpooram) ⟦1⟧if wanted; a very small pinch⟦/1⟧

seg.a6184e3e789c.src: Roast the moong dal till light golden, then cook it with the rice till very soft and mushy. Start by dry-roasting the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat, stirring, until it smells nutty and turns light golden, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.a6184e3e789c.t: मूग डाळ हलकी सोनेरी होईपर्यंत भाजा, मग तांदळासोबत अगदी मऊ, गिजगिजीत होईपर्यंत शिजवा. सुरुवातीला डाळ प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये किंवा जाड बुडाच्या पातेल्यात मंद आचेवर ढवळत कोरडी भाजा, खमंग वास येईपर्यंत आणि हलकी सोनेरी होईपर्यंत, सुमारे 3–4 मिनिटे.
seg.a6184e3e789c.back: Roast moong dal until light golden, then cook with rice until very soft and mushy. At the start dry-roast the dal in a pressure cooker or heavy-bottomed pot on low heat while stirring, until a toasty smell comes and it is light golden, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.03597768c72a.src: Add the rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 changes of water, and drain.
seg.03597768c72a.t: भाजलेल्या डाळीत तांदूळ घाला, दोन्ही एकत्र 2–3 पाण्यांत धुवा आणि निथळा.
seg.03597768c72a.back: Add rice to the roasted dal, wash both together in 2–3 waters and drain.

seg.1c139f802ab6.src: Add the 3 cups water. Pressure cook for 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure drop on its own, or simmer covered in a pot for 25–30 minutes, adding a splash of hot water if it dries out.
seg.1c139f802ab6.t: 3 कप पाणी घाला. मध्यम आचेवर 4–5 शिट्ट्या करा आणि प्रेशर आपोआप उतरू द्या, किंवा पातेल्यात झाकून 25–30 मिनिटे मंद शिजवा, कोरडे वाटले तर थोडे गरम पाणी घाला.
seg.1c139f802ab6.back: Add 3 cups water. Do 4–5 whistles on medium heat and let the pressure release by itself, or cook covered in a pot 25–30 minutes on low, adding a little hot water if it seems dry.

seg.5c9fcb8182ea.src: Open and mash the rice and dal lightly with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.t: झाकण उघडा आणि डावाच्या पाठीने तांदूळ-डाळ हलकेच घोटा. ते मऊ आणि लापशीसारखे असावे, कोरडे नाही.
seg.5c9fcb8182ea.back: Open the lid and lightly mash the rice-dal with the back of a ladle. It should be soft and porridge-like, not dry.

seg.41870045e57c.src: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour it into the rice. Warm the jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat, stirring, just until it dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; it does not need to boil.
seg.41870045e57c.t: गूळ ¼ कप पाण्यात वितळवा आणि भातात ओता. गूळ आणि पाणी छोट्या पॅनमध्ये मंद आचेवर ढवळत, गूळ विरघळेपर्यंतच गरम करा, सुमारे 2–3 मिनिटे; उकळण्याची गरज नाही.
seg.41870045e57c.back: Melt the jaggery in ¼ cup water and pour into the rice. Heat jaggery and water in a small pan on low heat while stirring, only until the jaggery dissolves, about 2–3 minutes; no need to boil.

seg.ca9ed938d301.src: Simmer, stirring, till thick and glossy, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tbsp ghee. Keep the heat low and stir all the way to the bottom, as the pongali catches easily once the jaggery is in.
seg.ca9ed938d301.t: घट्ट आणि चकचकीत होईपर्यंत ढवळत मंद उकळा, 5–7 मिनिटे; 2 मोठे चमचे तूप ढवळून घाला. आच मंद ठेवा आणि तळापर्यंत ढवळत राहा, कारण गूळ घातल्यावर पोंगली पटकन बुडाला लागते.
seg.ca9ed938d301.back: Simmer while stirring until thick and shiny, 5–7 minutes; stir in 2 tablespoons ghee. Keep the heat low and keep stirring to the bottom, because after adding jaggery the pongali quickly sticks to the bottom.

seg.58e11747230d.src: Taste, and stir in a little more melted jaggery if you want it sweeter.
seg.58e11747230d.t: चाखून पाहा, आणि जास्त गोड हवी असेल तर आणखी थोडा वितळवलेला गूळ ढवळून घाला.
seg.58e11747230d.back: Taste, and if you want it sweeter stir in a little more melted jaggery.

seg.9eabfb77c3db.src: Fry the cashews in the rest of the ghee; add with the cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding the raisins for the last few seconds until they puff up.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.t: उरलेल्या तुपात काजू तळा; वेलचीसोबत घाला. उरलेले 2 मोठे चमचे तूप छोट्या पॅनमध्ये मध्यम-मंद आचेवर गरम करा आणि काजू सोनेरी होईपर्यंत ढवळा, सुमारे 1 मिनिट, शेवटच्या काही सेकंदांत बेदाणे घाला, ते फुगेपर्यंत.
seg.9eabfb77c3db.back: Fry cashews in the remaining ghee; add with cardamom. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons ghee in a small pan on medium-low heat and stir the cashews until golden, about 1 minute, adding raisins in the last few seconds, until they puff up.

seg.4f12a8dd8723.src: Pour the cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle in the cardamom powder and the camphor, if using, and stir well.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.t: काजू, बेदाणे आणि तूप पोंगलीवर ओता, वेलची पूड आणि वापरत असाल तर कापूर भुरभुरा, आणि नीट ढवळा.
seg.4f12a8dd8723.back: Pour cashews, raisins and ghee over the pongali, sprinkle cardamom powder and camphor if using, and stir well.

seg.25eb1725b7f2.src: Switch off and serve warm. Pongali thickens as it stands; loosen it with a few spoons of hot water if needed.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.t: आच बंद करा आणि कोमट वाढा. पोंगली ठेवल्यावर घट्ट होते; लागल्यास काही चमचे गरम पाणी घालून सैल करा.
seg.25eb1725b7f2.back: Turn off the heat and serve lukewarm. On keeping the pongali thickens; if needed loosen with a few spoons of hot water.

seg.d8d20508ad3b.src: Cook the rice and dal fully soft; they stop softening once the jaggery goes in.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.t: तांदूळ आणि डाळ पूर्ण मऊ शिजवा; गूळ घातल्यानंतर ते आणखी मऊ होत नाहीत.
seg.d8d20508ad3b.back: Cook rice and dal fully soft; after adding jaggery they do not get softer.

seg.c5408f916731.src: Roasting the moong dal gives pongali its nutty smell; keep the heat low so it turns golden, not brown.
seg.c5408f916731.t: मूग डाळ भाजल्यामुळे पोंगलीला खमंग वास येतो; आच मंद ठेवा म्हणजे डाळ सोनेरी होईल, तपकिरी नाही.
seg.c5408f916731.back: Because of roasting the moong dal the pongali gets a toasty smell; keep the heat low so the dal turns golden, not brown.

seg.5ed9375ff107.src: Use a heavy-bottomed pan and keep stirring once the jaggery is in; it catches and burns quickly.
seg.5ed9375ff107.t: जाड बुडाचे पातेले वापरा आणि गूळ घातल्यावर ढवळत राहा; ते पटकन बुडाला लागते आणि करपते.
seg.5ed9375ff107.back: Use a heavy-bottomed pot and keep stirring after adding jaggery; it quickly sticks to the bottom and burns.

seg.92b31a616baa.src: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still a little loose; it sets as it cools.
seg.92b31a616baa.t: पोंगली थोडी सैल असतानाच आचेवरून उतरवा; थंड होताना ती घट्ट होते.
seg.92b31a616baa.back: Take the pongali off the heat while it is still slightly loose; as it cools it thickens.

seg.1c14403a599f.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for a darker pongali with a deeper, smoky sweetness.
seg.1c14403a599f.t: ताडाचा गूळ: तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ वापरा; पोंगली गडद रंगाची होईल आणि गोडवा जास्त गहिरा, धुरकट असेल.
seg.1c14403a599f.back: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery; the pongali will be darker in colour and the sweetness deeper, smoky.

seg.d1a4e19c923c.src: Chakkera pongali: use ¾ cup sugar in place of the jaggery for a pale, sugar-sweet version.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.t: चक्केरा पोंगली: फिकट रंगाच्या, साखरेच्या गोडव्याच्या प्रकारासाठी गुळाऐवजी ¾ कप साखर वापरा.
seg.d1a4e19c923c.back: Chakkera pongali: for a pale-coloured, sugar-sweet version use ¾ cup sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.44acc6e45d4b.src: Offer it as naivedyam on Sankranti morning, then serve it warm with the festive meal, alongside pulihora and garelu.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.t: संक्रांतीच्या सकाळी नैवेद्य म्हणून दाखवा, मग सणाच्या जेवणात पुलिहोरा आणि गारेलुसोबत कोमट वाढा.
seg.44acc6e45d4b.back: Offer as naivedya on Sankranti morning, then serve lukewarm in the festival meal with pulihora and garelu.

seg.b4e15a70f8c8.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm with a splash of hot water and a little ghee, stirring, before serving.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.t: उरलेली पोंगली झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. वाढण्याआधी थोडे गरम पाणी आणि थोडे तूप घालून ढवळत गरम करा.
seg.b4e15a70f8c8.back: Keep leftover pongali covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Before serving heat while stirring with a little hot water and a little ghee.

seg.70c91f153ba8.src: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?
seg.70c91f153ba8.t: पोंगली आणि चक्केरा पोंगली यात काय फरक आहे?
seg.70c91f153ba8.back: What is the difference between pongali and chakkera pongali?

seg.75f25d8f552a.src: Pongali on its own often means the savoury version made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are the sweet versions, made with sugar or jaggery.
seg.75f25d8f552a.t: नुसती पोंगली म्हटले की बहुतेक वेळा मिरी आणि जिरे घालून केलेला खारा प्रकार असतो. चक्केरा पोंगली आणि बेल्लम पोंगली हे गोड प्रकार आहेत, साखर किंवा गूळ घालून केलेले.
seg.75f25d8f552a.back: When just "pongali" is said it is mostly the salty kind made with pepper and cumin. Chakkera pongali and bellam pongali are sweet kinds, made with sugar or jaggery.

seg.94d3b2adcbef.src: Can I make bellam pongali in a pressure cooker?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.t: बेल्लम पोंगली प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये करता येईल का?
seg.94d3b2adcbef.back: Can bellam pongali be made in a pressure cooker?

seg.269aace6e2a8.src: Yes. Cook the roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure drop on its own, then add the melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.
seg.269aace6e2a8.t: हो. भाजलेली डाळ आणि तांदूळ 3 कप पाण्यासोबत 4–5 शिट्ट्या करून शिजवा, प्रेशर आपोआप उतरू द्या, मग वितळवलेला गूळ घाला आणि उघड्या कुकरमध्ये मंद उकळा.
seg.269aace6e2a8.back: Yes. Cook roasted dal and rice with 3 cups water for 4–5 whistles, let the pressure release by itself, then add melted jaggery and simmer in the open cooker.

seg.cd439685b7b5.src: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?
seg.cd439685b7b5.t: थंड झाल्यावर माझी पोंगली कडक का झाली?
seg.cd439685b7b5.back: Why did my pongali turn hard after cooling?

seg.696811a7ce7d.src: Pongali sets as it cools, and simmering too long after the jaggery goes in makes it firmer. Take it off while it is still a little loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.
seg.696811a7ce7d.t: थंड होताना पोंगली घट्ट होते, आणि गूळ घातल्यानंतर जास्त वेळ उकळल्याने ती आणखी कडक होते. ती थोडी सैल असतानाच उतरवा, आणि उरलेली गरम पाणी घालून सैल करा.
seg.696811a7ce7d.back: As it cools pongali thickens, and boiling a long time after adding jaggery makes it harder. Take it off while still slightly loose, and loosen leftovers with hot water.

seg.b0499dbc1bd0.src: Can I use palm jaggery for pongali?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.t: पोंगलीसाठी ताडाचा गूळ वापरू शकतो का?
seg.b0499dbc1bd0.back: Can palm jaggery be used for pongali?

seg.7ee832015d30.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The pongali turns darker and tastes deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7ee832015d30.t: हो. तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) वापरा. पोंगली गडद होते आणि तिची चव जास्त गहिरी, किंचित धुरकट लागते.
seg.7ee832015d30.back: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The pongali becomes darker and its taste deeper, slightly smoky.

seg.978f1b90a63e.src: బెల్లం పొంగలి. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with cane jaggery and finished with ghee-fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.978f1b90a63e.t: बेल्लम पोंगली. संक्रांतीसाठी बेल्लम पोंगली: तांदूळ आणि भाजलेली मूग डाळ मऊ शिजवून, उसाच्या गुळाने गोड करून, शेवटी तुपात तळलेले काजू घालून. 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.978f1b90a63e.back: Bellam Pongali. Bellam pongali for Sankranti: rice and roasted moong dal cooked soft, sweetened with sugarcane jaggery, with cashews fried in ghee added at the end. For 4 people.

seg.ad0644e2314c.src: Bellam Pongali: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.ad0644e2314c.t: बेल्लम पोंगली: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.ad0644e2314c.back: Bellam Pongali: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.src: a pinch of edible camphor (pacha karpooram)
seg.c5dbb15b1ab8.back: A pinch of edible camphor (pachcha karpooram)

seg.79401823a930.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(आंध्र चिंचेची फिश करी)⟦/1⟧
seg.79401823a930.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra tamarind fish curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.0fff539adaed.src: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick fish steaks simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onions, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and many homes cook it in a clay pot and keep it for the next day, when the gravy has soaked into the fish.
seg.0fff539adaed.t: चेपला पुलुसु म्हणजे किनारी आंध्रातली चिंचेची फिश करी, गोदावरी जिल्ह्यांत ती खास काळजीने केली जाते: माशांचे जाड तुकडे कांदा, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्त्यासह आंबट, लाल चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हीत मंद उकळले जातात. हा रविवारच्या दुपारच्या जेवणाचा पदार्थ आहे, आणि अनेक घरांत तो मातीच्या भांड्यात करून दुसऱ्या दिवसासाठी ठेवला जातो, तोपर्यंत ग्रेव्ही माशांत चांगली मुरलेली असते.
seg.0fff539adaed.back: Chepala pulusu is the tamarind fish curry of coastal Andhra, made with special care in the Godavari districts: thick pieces of fish are simmered in a sour, red tamarind gravy with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. It is a Sunday lunch dish, and in many homes it is made in a clay pot and kept for the next day, by which time the gravy has soaked well into the fish.

seg.17fc336d9c12.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its deep red colour and a steady heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe serves 4.
seg.17fc336d9c12.t: आमची हळद पावडर मॅरिनेडमध्ये आणि ग्रेव्हीत जाते. सन्नम मिरची पावडरमुळे पुलुसुला गडद लाल रंग आणि चिंचेला तोल देणारा एकसारखा तिखटपणा येतो. या पाककृतीत 4 जणांसाठी होते.
seg.17fc336d9c12.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the marinade and the gravy. Because of Sannam chilli powder the pulusu gets a deep red colour and an even heat that balances the tamarind. This recipe makes enough for 4 people.

seg.4ba98eee496a.src: Prep includes the 15-minute marinade. The curry tastes even better after resting a few hours.
seg.4ba98eee496a.t: तयारीत मॅरिनेडची 15 मिनिटे धरली आहेत. काही तास ठेवल्यावर करी आणखी छान लागते.
seg.4ba98eee496a.back: The preparation counts 15 minutes of marinade. After keeping a few hours the curry tastes even nicer.

seg.aed84f9a20f5.src: Marinate fish with salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onions and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish gently in the gravy without stirring.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.t: मासे मीठ, हळद आणि मिरची पावडरमध्ये मुरवा, कांदा आणि मसाले परता, ते चिंचेच्या पाण्यात उकळा, मग मासे ग्रेव्हीत न ढवळता हलक्या आचेवर मंद शिजवा.
seg.aed84f9a20f5.back: Marinate the fish in salt, turmeric and chilli powder, fry onion and spices, boil them in tamarind water, then simmer the fish in the gravy on gentle heat without stirring.

seg.5ce3c9cccf94.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.t: 500 g माशांचे तुकडे ⟦1⟧घट्ट मासा, जाड तुकड्यांत कापलेला: रोहू (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (मरळ) किंवा सुरमई (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.5ce3c9cccf94.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish, cut in thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.23a800982a03.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.t: 40 g चिंच ⟦1⟧लिंबाएवढा गोळा, 2 कप कोमट पाण्यात 15 मिनिटे भिजवलेला⟦/1⟧
seg.23a800982a03.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-sized ball, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.f8dec19a56f9.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ tsp for the marinade, ¼ tsp for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.t: ½ छोटा चमचा हळद पावडर ⟦1⟧¼ छोटा चमचा मॅरिनेडसाठी, ¼ छोटा चमचा ग्रेव्हीसाठी⟦/1⟧
seg.f8dec19a56f9.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧¼ teaspoon for the marinade, ¼ teaspoon for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.c78341163232.src: 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 tsp for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.t: 2 मोठे चमचे सन्नम मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧1 छोटा चमचा मॅरिनेडसाठी, उरलेली ग्रेव्हीसाठी⟦/1⟧
seg.c78341163232.back: 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon for the marinade, the rest for the gravy⟦/1⟧

seg.bcbd97cd906a.src: 1 tsp salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.bcbd97cd906a.back: 1 teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧for the gravy, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.ba6dcf57651d.back: Also turns out nice with ⟦1⟧Teja chilli powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.2fafef6b8781.src: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain them well.
seg.2fafef6b8781.t: माशांचे तुकडे पाण्यात हलक्या हाताने दोन-तीनदा धुवा आणि नीट निथळा.
seg.2fafef6b8781.back: Wash the fish pieces gently in water two or three times and drain well.

seg.cf370c2b1459.src: Rub the fish with salt, turmeric and 1 tsp chilli powder; rest 15 minutes. Use 1 tsp salt and ¼ tsp of the turmeric powder for the marinade.
seg.cf370c2b1459.t: माशांना मीठ, हळद आणि 1 छोटा चमचा मिरची पावडर चोळा; 15 मिनिटे ठेवा. मॅरिनेडसाठी 1 छोटा चमचा मीठ आणि ¼ छोटा चमचा हळद पावडर वापरा.
seg.cf370c2b1459.back: Rub salt, turmeric and 1 teaspoon chilli powder on the fish; keep 15 minutes. For the marinade use 1 teaspoon salt and ¼ teaspoon turmeric powder.

seg.0c7defd6c85a.src: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its water and strain it. You should have about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.t: भिजवलेली चिंच तिच्याच पाण्यात चांगली कुस्करा आणि गाळून घ्या. सुमारे 2 कप पातळ चिंचेचे पाणी व्हायला हवे.
seg.0c7defd6c85a.back: Squeeze the soaked tamarind well in its own water and strain. There should be about 2 cups of thin tamarind water.

seg.a8777ed4c461.src: Heat the oil in a wide pan or clay pot on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds, mustard seeds and cumin seeds and let them splutter, taking care that the fenugreek does not turn dark.
seg.a8777ed4c461.t: रुंद पॅनमध्ये किंवा मातीच्या भांड्यात मध्यम आचेवर तेल गरम करा. मेथी दाणे, मोहरी आणि जिरे घाला आणि तडतडू द्या, मेथी काळी पडणार नाही याची काळजी घ्या.
seg.a8777ed4c461.back: Heat oil on medium heat in a wide pan or clay pot. Add fenugreek seeds, mustard and cumin and let them crackle, taking care the fenugreek does not turn black.

seg.e87b5c1bcc02.src: Fry the onions, chillies and curry leaves in oil till soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onions about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add the ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, the remaining Sannam chilli powder and the coriander powder and stir for 30 seconds.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.t: कांदा, मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता तेलात मऊ होईपर्यंत परता; मसाल्याच्या पूडी घाला. कांदा मऊ आणि हलका सोनेरी होईपर्यंत सुमारे 6–8 मिनिटे परता, आलं-लसूण पेस्ट आणि टोमॅटो घालून 2 मिनिटे शिजवा, मग उरलेली हळद पावडर, उरलेली सन्नम मिरची पावडर आणि धणे पूड घालून 30 सेकंद ढवळा.
seg.e87b5c1bcc02.back: Fry onion, chillies and curry leaves in oil until soft; add the spice powders. Fry the onion about 6–8 minutes until soft and light golden, add ginger-garlic paste and tomato and cook 2 minutes, then add the remaining turmeric powder, remaining Sannam chilli powder and coriander powder and stir 30 seconds.

seg.61e849535fa9.src: Pour in the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes till the oil rises. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy slightly thick.
seg.61e849535fa9.t: चिंचेचे पाणी ओता आणि तेल वर येईपर्यंत 10 मिनिटे उकळा. ग्रेव्हीसाठीचे मीठ घाला; चिंचेचा कच्चा वास गेलेला असावा आणि ग्रेव्ही किंचित घट्ट झालेली असावी.
seg.61e849535fa9.back: Pour the tamarind water and boil 10 minutes until oil comes up. Add the salt for the gravy; the raw smell of tamarind should have gone and the gravy should have thickened slightly.

seg.65cb3d6833cd.src: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, as the fish will take in some of it.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.t: ग्रेव्ही चाखून पाहा. ती स्पष्टपणे आंबट, खारट आणि तिखट असावी, कारण मासे त्यातले काही शोषून घेतील.
seg.65cb3d6833cd.back: Taste the gravy. It should be clearly sour, salty and hot, because the fish will absorb some of it.

seg.fc6f288cacf9.src: Slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl, do not stir. Lay the pieces in one layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.t: मासे हळूच सोडा आणि झाकून 10–12 मिनिटे मंद उकळा; भांडे गोल फिरवा, ढवळू नका. तुकडे एकाच थरात ठेवा, त्यांच्यावर चमच्याने ग्रेव्ही घाला आणि आच मंद ठेवा.
seg.fc6f288cacf9.back: Gently slide in the fish and simmer covered 10–12 minutes; swirl the vessel round, do not stir. Keep the pieces in a single layer, spoon gravy over them and keep the heat low.

seg.9fed4db6e81b.src: Check one piece at the thickest part: the fish is cooked when the flesh is white or opaque right through and comes away from the bone easily.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.t: एक तुकडा सर्वात जाड भागात तपासा: मांस आतपर्यंत पांढरे किंवा अपारदर्शक झाले असेल आणि हाडापासून सहज सुटत असेल, तर मासा शिजला आहे.
seg.9fed4db6e81b.back: Check a piece at the thickest part: if the flesh has become white or opaque all the way inside and comes away easily from the bone, the fish is cooked.

seg.8a5166c34dc3.src: Sprinkle the coriander leaves, switch off and let the pulusu rest at least 30 minutes, covered, before serving.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.t: कोथिंबीर भुरभुरा, आच बंद करा आणि वाढण्याआधी पुलुसु झाकून किमान 30 मिनिटे तसेच ठेवा.
seg.8a5166c34dc3.back: Sprinkle coriander leaves, turn off the heat and keep the pulusu covered at least 30 minutes before serving.

seg.c6819a9980cc.src: Swirl the pan instead of stirring so the fish stays whole.
seg.c6819a9980cc.t: ढवळण्याऐवजी भांडे गोल फिरवा, म्हणजे मासे अख्खे राहतील.
seg.c6819a9980cc.back: Swirl the vessel instead of stirring, so the fish stays whole.

seg.1333bb67a0a8.src: Pick a firm fish with thick steaks; thin fillets break up in the long simmer.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.t: जाड तुकड्यांचा घट्ट मासा निवडा; पातळ फिले दीर्घ वेळ उकळताना तुटतात.
seg.1333bb67a0a8.back: Choose firm fish in thick pieces; thin fillets break during long simmering.

seg.dd6f5d867621.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat. Use 1½ tbsp for a milder pulusu, or the full 2 tbsp for the usual Andhra heat.
seg.dd6f5d867621.t: सन्नम मिरची पावडरने मध्यम तिखटपणा येतो. कमी तिखट पुलुसुसाठी 1½ मोठा चमचा वापरा, किंवा नेहमीच्या आंध्र तिखटपणासाठी पूर्ण 2 मोठे चमचे.
seg.dd6f5d867621.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. For a less hot pulusu use 1½ tablespoons, or for the usual Andhra heat the full 2 tablespoons.

seg.6196c7ae078f.src: Boil the tamarind gravy well before the fish goes in; once the fish is in, you cannot cook it much longer without it breaking.
seg.6196c7ae078f.t: मासे घालण्याआधी चिंचेची ग्रेव्ही चांगली उकळा; मासे घातल्यावर ते न तुटता जास्त वेळ शिजवता येत नाहीत.
seg.6196c7ae078f.back: Boil the tamarind gravy well before adding fish; after adding fish it cannot be cooked long without breaking.

seg.cadf91d0b4a1.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu, use 1 tbsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam in the gravy. Teja is very hot; start with 2 tsp if unsure.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.t: तेजा मिरची पावडर: जास्त तिखट पुलुसुसाठी ग्रेव्हीत सन्नमऐवजी 1 मोठा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर वापरा. तेजा खूप तिखट असते; खात्री नसेल तर 2 छोट्या चमच्यांपासून सुरुवात करा.
seg.cadf91d0b4a1.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pulusu use 1 tablespoon Teja chilli powder in the gravy instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot; if not sure, start from 2 teaspoons.

seg.1639b09f9df2.src: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.
seg.1639b09f9df2.t: रोय्याला पुलुसु: 400 g साफ केलेली कोळंबी वापरा आणि फक्त 5–6 मिनिटे मंद उकळा, ती गुलाबी होऊन वळेपर्यंत.
seg.1639b09f9df2.back: Royyala pulusu: use 400 g cleaned prawns and simmer only 5–6 minutes, until they turn pink and curl.

seg.f5f2c78097e7.src: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer, Godavari homes add slices of raw mango and use less tamarind.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.t: मामिडिकाया पुलुसु: उन्हाळ्यात गोदावरीकडची घरे कैरीच्या फोडी घालतात आणि चिंच कमी वापरतात.
seg.f5f2c78097e7.back: Mamidikaya pulusu: in summer Godavari-side homes add raw mango pieces and use less tamarind.

seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.src: Serve with hot steamed rice and sliced onions. Many Godavari homes serve it the next day, when the flavours have settled.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.t: गरम वाफवलेला भात आणि चिरलेल्या कांद्यासोबत वाढा. गोदावरीकडची अनेक घरे तो दुसऱ्या दिवशी वाढतात, तोपर्यंत चवी स्थिरावलेल्या असतात.
seg.4bb7dd4c2c98.back: Serve with hot steamed rice and chopped onion. Many Godavari-side homes serve it the next day, by which time the flavours have settled.

seg.ec67fc31e8d9.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.t: उरलेले झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. पॅनमध्ये न ढवळता हलक्या आचेवर पुन्हा गरम करा.
seg.ec67fc31e8d9.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat in a pan on gentle heat without stirring.

seg.3fb4609a3953.src: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?
seg.3fb4609a3953.t: चेपला पुलुसुसाठी कोणता मासा सर्वात चांगला?
seg.3fb4609a3953.back: Which fish is best for chepala pulusu?

seg.81c757cf9b6b.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu (bocha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.t: जाड तुकड्यांत कापलेला घट्ट नदीतला किंवा समुद्रातला मासा: रोहू (बोच्चा), मरळ (कोरमीनु), कटला किंवा सुरमई. काटेरी लहान मासेही चालतात, पण ते हलक्या हाताने हाताळावे लागतात.
seg.81c757cf9b6b.back: Firm river or sea fish cut in thick pieces: rohu (bochcha), murrel (korameenu), catla or seer fish. Bony small fish also work, but they have to be handled gently.

seg.1d2170a88905.src: Why does chepala pulusu taste better the next day?
seg.1d2170a88905.t: चेपला पुलुसु दुसऱ्या दिवशी जास्त छान का लागतो?
seg.1d2170a88905.back: Why does chepala pulusu taste nicer the next day?

seg.566bd302c316.src: Resting gives the fish time to soak up the tamarind and chilli gravy, and the sourness and heat even out. That is why many homes cook it in the morning for dinner or the next day.
seg.566bd302c316.t: ठेवल्यामुळे माशांना चिंच-मिरचीची ग्रेव्ही शोषायला वेळ मिळतो, आणि आंबटपणा व तिखटपणा एकसारखा होतो. म्हणूनच अनेक घरे तो सकाळी रात्रीच्या जेवणासाठी किंवा दुसऱ्या दिवसासाठी करतात.
seg.566bd302c316.back: Because of keeping, the fish gets time to absorb the tamarind-chilli gravy, and sourness and heat become even. That is why many homes make it in the morning for dinner or for the next day.

seg.53fa2d1b73d6.src: How do I stop the fish from breaking in the curry?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.t: करीत मासे तुटू नयेत म्हणून काय करावे?
seg.53fa2d1b73d6.back: What to do so the fish does not break in the curry?

seg.adc2b712af00.src: Use thick steaks, add them only after the gravy has boiled, keep the heat low and swirl the pan instead of stirring with a spoon.
seg.adc2b712af00.t: जाड तुकडे वापरा, ग्रेव्ही उकळल्यानंतरच ते घाला, आच मंद ठेवा आणि चमच्याने ढवळण्याऐवजी भांडे गोल फिरवा.
seg.adc2b712af00.back: Use thick pieces, add them only after the gravy boils, keep the heat low and swirl the vessel instead of stirring with a spoon.

seg.9f483b378e98.src: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?
seg.9f483b378e98.back: How much tamarind for 500 g fish?

seg.f77f33d6b7c5.src: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups of warm water. Use a little less if you add tomato or raw mango.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.t: सुमारे 40 g, लिंबाएवढा गोळा, 2 कप कोमट पाण्यात भिजवलेला. टोमॅटो किंवा कैरी घालत असाल तर थोडी कमी वापरा.
seg.f77f33d6b7c5.back: About 40 g, a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 2 cups lukewarm water. If adding tomato or raw mango use a little less.

seg.d9010e0c2ca6.src: చేపల పులుసు · Andhra Fish Curry Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.t: चेपला पुलुसु · आंध्र फिश करी पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.d9010e0c2ca6.back: Chepala Pulusu · Andhra fish curry recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.03c44db05afe.src: చేపల పులుసు. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onions, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. Serves 4, with tips and FAQs.
seg.03c44db05afe.t: चेपला पुलुसु. गोदावरी पद्धतीची फिश करी: कांदा, आमची हळद आणि सन्नम मिरची पावडर घालून चटपटीत चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हीत मंद उकळलेले मासे. 4 जणांसाठी, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरांसह.
seg.03c44db05afe.back: Chepala Pulusu. Godavari-style fish curry: fish simmered in a tangy tamarind gravy with onion, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder. For 4 people, with tips and questions-answers.

seg.d8b8fe1085c2.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra Tamarind Fish Curry) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु (आंध्र चिंचेची फिश करी) · 1acrefarms
seg.d8b8fe1085c2.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu (Andhra tamarind fish curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.244c08d4fc5c.src: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.244c08d4fc5c.t: आंध्र चेपला पुलुसु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.244c08d4fc5c.back: Andhra Chepala Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.fabe2a976262.src: Gongura mamsam is mutton cooked with gongura, the sour sorrel leaf that Andhra, and Guntur above all, treats as its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been sauteed down to a dark, tangy paste, until the curry is thick and the oil rises to the top.
seg.fabe2a976262.t: गोंगुरा मांसम म्हणजे गोंगुरा घालून केलेले मटण; गोंगुरा म्हणजे आंबट अंबाडीची पाने, जी आंध्र, आणि त्यातही खास करून गुंटूर, आपलीच मानतो. मटण मिरची आणि हळदीसोबत मऊ शिजवले जाते, मग परतून गडद, आंबट पेस्ट झालेल्या गोंगुरासोबत मंद उकळले जाते, करी घट्ट होईपर्यंत आणि तेल वर येईपर्यंत.
seg.fabe2a976262.back: Gongura mamsam is mutton made with gongura; gongura is the sour ambadi leaves, which Andhra, and especially Guntur, considers its own. The mutton is cooked soft with chilli and turmeric, then simmered with gongura that has been fried into a dark, sour paste, until the curry thickens and oil comes up.

seg.a26e996a46c7.src: Gongura's sharp sourness needs strong heat to stand up to it, and that comes from our Teja chilli powder, the extra-hot Guntur chilli, with our turmeric powder alongside. Serves 4 with rice.
seg.a26e996a46c7.t: गोंगुराच्या तीव्र आंबटपणाला तोडीस तोड तिखटपणा लागतो, आणि तो येतो आमच्या तेजा मिरची पावडरमधून, गुंटूरची ही खूप तिखट मिरची; सोबत आमची हळद पावडरही. भातासोबत 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.a26e996a46c7.back: Gongura's sharp sourness needs a match-for-match heat, and it comes from our Teja chilli powder, this very hot chilli of Guntur; along with our turmeric powder too. For 4 people with rice.

seg.18985156497a.src: Pressure-cook mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer it with an onion masala and sauteed gongura leaves till thick and the oil floats on top.
seg.18985156497a.t: मटण तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर आणि आलं-लसूण पेस्टसोबत प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये शिजवा, मग कांद्याचा मसाला आणि परतलेल्या गोंगुराच्या पानांसोबत घट्ट होईपर्यंत आणि वर तेल तरंगेपर्यंत मंद उकळा.
seg.18985156497a.back: Cook the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and ginger-garlic paste, then simmer with onion masala and fried gongura leaves until thick and oil floats on top.

seg.b4cc59b185d3.src: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.t: 750 g मटण ⟦1⟧हाडासकट करी कट, धुऊन निथळलेले⟦/1⟧
seg.b4cc59b185d3.back: 750 g mutton ⟦1⟧bone-in curry cut, washed and drained⟦/1⟧

seg.b66b468c45f7.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), picked from the stems, washed and drained well⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.t: 4 कप गोंगुराची (अंबाडीची) पाने ⟦1⟧सुमारे 2 जुड्या (150 g), देठांपासून खुडलेली, धुऊन नीट निथळलेली⟦/1⟧
seg.b66b468c45f7.back: 4 cups gongura (ambadi) leaves ⟦1⟧about 2 bunches (150 g), plucked from stems, washed and well drained⟦/1⟧

seg.9d6372d75a2f.src: 4 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.t: 4 मोठे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧सहसा शेंगदाणा तेल वापरतात⟦/1⟧
seg.9d6372d75a2f.back: 4 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.c89b5d92359a.src: Put the mutton in a pressure cooker with the Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and leave for 15 minutes.
seg.c89b5d92359a.t: मटण प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये घाला, त्यात तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर, आलं-लसूण पेस्ट आणि मीठ घाला, नीट मिसळा आणि 15 मिनिटे ठेवा.
seg.c89b5d92359a.back: Put the mutton in the pressure cooker, add Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and salt, mix well and keep 15 minutes.

seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.src: Pressure-cook the mutton with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add the 1½ cups water and cook for 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.t: मटण तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद, आलं-लसूण पेस्ट, मीठ आणि पाण्यासोबत प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये शिजवा. 1½ कप पाणी घाला आणि मध्यम आचेवर 5–6 शिट्ट्या करा, मग प्रेशर आपोआप उतरू द्या.
seg.d7a27bd7d1d5.back: Cook the mutton in a pressure cooker with Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, salt and water. Add 1½ cups water and do 5–6 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure release by itself.

seg.c084351b01db.src: Open the cooker and check a piece: the mutton is done when it is tender and pulls away from the bone easily with a spoon. If not, cook for 1–2 more whistles.
seg.c084351b01db.t: कुकर उघडा आणि एक तुकडा तपासा: मटण मऊ झाले असेल आणि चमच्याने हाडापासून सहज सुटत असेल, तर शिजले आहे. नसेल तर आणखी 1–2 शिट्ट्या करा.
seg.c084351b01db.back: Open the cooker and check a piece: if the mutton has become soft and comes away easily from the bone with a spoon, it is cooked. If not, do 1–2 more whistles.

seg.80af0da3b5a1.src: While the mutton cooks, heat the 1 tbsp oil in a pan on medium heat.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.t: मटण शिजत असताना एका पॅनमध्ये मध्यम आचेवर 1 मोठा चमचा तेल गरम करा.
seg.80af0da3b5a1.back: While the mutton cooks, heat 1 tablespoon oil in a pan on medium heat.

seg.c59d6a34def2.src: Saute the gongura with green chillies in a little oil till it melts to a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of the spoon as they wilt.
seg.c59d6a34def2.t: गोंगुरा हिरव्या मिरच्यांसोबत थोड्या तेलात, विरघळून गडद पेस्ट होईपर्यंत परता. यासाठी 8–10 मिनिटे लागतात; वारंवार ढवळा आणि पाने मलूल होतील तशी चमच्याच्या पाठीने चेचा.
seg.c59d6a34def2.back: Fry the gongura with green chillies in a little oil until it melts into a dark paste. This takes 8–10 minutes; stir often and mash the leaves with the back of a spoon as they wilt.

seg.37056d0dd9cf.src: Heat the 4 tbsp oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.t: जाड कढईत मध्यम आचेवर 4 मोठे चमचे तेल गरम करा आणि लवंगा, वेलच्या आणि दालचिनी घाला.
seg.37056d0dd9cf.back: Heat 4 tablespoons oil in a heavy kadhai on medium heat and add cloves, cardamoms and cinnamon.

seg.26a945a9fad3.src: Fry the onions with whole spices till golden. Add the curry leaves with the onions, and give them 10–12 minutes, stirring often.
seg.26a945a9fad3.t: कांदा अख्ख्या मसाल्यांसोबत सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता. कांद्यासोबत कढीपत्ता घाला, आणि 10–12 मिनिटे वारंवार ढवळत परता.
seg.26a945a9fad3.back: Fry the onion with the whole spices until golden. Add curry leaves with the onion, and fry 10–12 minutes stirring often.

seg.4dd72cc1abd0.src: Stir in the coriander powder and fry for 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.t: धणे पूड ढवळून घाला आणि 30 सेकंद परता. मटण आणि त्याचा रस्सा घाला, मग गोंगुरा.
seg.4dd72cc1abd0.back: Stir in coriander powder and fry 30 seconds. Add the mutton and its stock, then the gongura.

seg.46f5f6c735ac.src: Simmer till thick and the oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and allow 12–15 minutes. Taste and adjust the salt now, once the sourness of the gongura is in.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.t: घट्ट होईपर्यंत आणि वर तेल तरंगेपर्यंत मंद उकळा. आच मंद ठेवा, मधूनमधून ढवळा, आणि 12–15 मिनिटे द्या. गोंगुराचा आंबटपणा आल्यावर आता चाखून मीठ बरोबर करा.
seg.46f5f6c735ac.back: Simmer until thick and oil floats on top. Keep the heat low, stir now and then, and give 12–15 minutes. Once the gongura's sourness has come in, now taste and correct the salt.

seg.0abf0f798bd3.src: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then switch off and rest for 10 minutes before serving.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.t: गरम मसाला ढवळून घाला. आणखी 2 मिनिटे शिजवा, मग आच बंद करा आणि वाढण्याआधी 10 मिनिटे तसेच ठेवा.
seg.0abf0f798bd3.back: Stir in garam masala. Cook 2 more minutes, then turn off the heat and keep 10 minutes before serving.

seg.c57eb6bfb001.src: Taste after the gongura goes in; its sourness varies from bunch to bunch.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.t: गोंगुरा घातल्यानंतर चाखून पाहा; त्याचा आंबटपणा जुडीनुसार बदलतो.
seg.c57eb6bfb001.back: Taste after adding gongura; its sourness changes from bunch to bunch.

seg.5544823d42b4.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or Sannam chilli powder; do not cut it out entirely, or the gongura tastes flat and sour.
seg.5544823d42b4.t: तेजा मिरची पावडर खूप तिखट असते. मध्यम तिखटपणासाठी 1 छोटा चमचा वापरा, किंवा सन्नम मिरची पावडर; ती पूर्ण वगळू नका, नाहीतर गोंगुरा फिका आणि नुसताच आंबट लागतो.
seg.5544823d42b4.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or Sannam chilli powder; do not leave it out completely, otherwise the gongura tastes flat and merely sour.

seg.62683a58a9fd.src: Do not use an aluminium pan for the gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and darkens the curry. Use steel or cast iron.
seg.62683a58a9fd.t: गोंगुरासाठी ॲल्युमिनियमचे पॅन वापरू नका; त्याच्या आंबटपणाची धातूशी क्रिया होऊन करी काळपट होते. स्टील किंवा लोखंडी कढई वापरा.
seg.62683a58a9fd.back: Do not use an aluminium pan for gongura; its sourness reacts with the metal and the curry turns blackish. Use steel or an iron kadhai.

seg.d036336075e5.src: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.
seg.d036336075e5.t: गोंगुरा खूप आंबट असेल तर तोल साधण्यासाठी मसाल्यात आणखी 1 कांदा घाला.
seg.d036336075e5.back: If the gongura is very sour, add 1 more onion to the masala to balance it.

seg.8faa3986eaa2.src: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala for 20–25 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone, before the gongura goes in.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.t: गोंगुरा चिकन: 750 g हाडासकट चिकन वापरा, प्रेशर कुकर वगळा आणि गोंगुरा घालण्याआधी ते मसाल्यात झाकून 20–25 मिनिटे शिजवा, हाडाजवळ अजिबात गुलाबी रंग उरत नाही तोपर्यंत.
seg.8faa3986eaa2.back: Gongura chicken: use 750 g bone-in chicken, skip the pressure cooker and cook it covered in the masala 20–25 minutes before adding gongura, until no pink colour at all remains near the bone.

seg.2ebce7872a6e.src: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add them after the onions and cook 5–6 minutes, just until they turn pink and curl, then add the gongura.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: 500 g साफ केलेली कोळंबी वापरा, कांद्यानंतर घाला आणि 5–6 मिनिटे शिजवा, ती गुलाबी होऊन वळेपर्यंतच, मग गोंगुरा घाला.
seg.2ebce7872a6e.back: Gongura royyalu: use 500 g cleaned prawns, add after the onion and cook 5–6 minutes, only until they turn pink and curl, then add gongura.

seg.7f3c45600b1c.src: Red chilli gongura: fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind them together for a darker, sharper curry.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.t: लाल मिरची गोंगुरा: जास्त गडद आणि तिखट-तीव्र करीसाठी 6 सुक्या लाल मिरच्या गोंगुरासोबत परता आणि एकत्र वाटा.
seg.7f3c45600b1c.back: Red chilli gongura: for a darker and sharper-hot curry fry 6 dried red chillies with the gongura and grind together.

seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jonna rotte. A plain raw onion on the side is the Guntur way.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.t: वाफवलेला भात आणि एक चमचा तुपासोबत, किंवा ज्वारीच्या भाकरीसोबत (जोन्ना रोट्टे) गरम वाढा. बाजूला साधा कच्चा कांदा, ही गुंटूरची पद्धत.
seg.6fc7d7ad8ce1.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with jowar bhakri (jonna rotte). Plain raw onion on the side, this is the Guntur way.

seg.a4e072616940.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 3 days; reheat until steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes better the next day.
seg.a4e072616940.t: झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये 3 दिवसांपर्यंत ठेवा; आतपर्यंत चांगले वाफाळते गरम होईपर्यंत पुन्हा गरम करा. बहुतेक आंबट करींप्रमाणे, दुसऱ्या दिवशी ते जास्त छान लागते.
seg.a4e072616940.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 3 days; reheat until well steaming hot all the way through. Like most sour curries, it tastes nicer the next day.

seg.056a57b2c0f8.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.50430ec58f61.src: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). The leaves are sour and cook down to a dark paste.
seg.50430ec58f61.t: गोंगुरा म्हणजे सॉरेलची पाने, ज्यांना रोझेल किंवा रेड सॉरेलही म्हणतात (मराठीत अंबाडी, हिंदीत पितवा). ही पाने आंबट असतात आणि शिजून गडद पेस्ट होतात.
