seg.50430ec58f61.back: Gongura is sorrel leaves, also called roselle or red sorrel (ambadi in Marathi, pitwa in Hindi). These leaves are sour and on cooking become a dark paste.

seg.c813168eb832.src: Can I use gongura pickle instead of gongura leaves?
seg.c813168eb832.t: गोंगुराच्या पानांऐवजी गोंगुराचे लोणचे वापरू शकतो का?
seg.c813168eb832.back: Can gongura pickle be used instead of gongura leaves?

seg.e1453431b91a.src: Yes, in a pinch. Stir in 3–4 tbsp gongura pickle in place of the sauteed leaves and cut down the salt and chilli powder, since the pickle already has both.
seg.e1453431b91a.t: हो, अडचणीच्या वेळी. परतलेल्या पानांऐवजी 3–4 मोठे चमचे गोंगुराचे लोणचे ढवळून घाला आणि मीठ व मिरची पावडर कमी करा, कारण लोणच्यात दोन्ही आधीच असतात.
seg.e1453431b91a.back: Yes, in a pinch. Instead of fried leaves stir in 3–4 tablespoons gongura pickle and reduce salt and chilli powder, because the pickle already has both.

seg.13ee618e3c36.src: How long should I pressure-cook mutton for gongura mamsam?
seg.13ee618e3c36.t: गोंगुरा मांसमसाठी मटण प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये किती वेळ शिजवावे?
seg.13ee618e3c36.back: How long to cook mutton in a pressure cooker for gongura mamsam?

seg.5888ba63831a.src: About 5–6 whistles on medium heat for bone-in curry-cut mutton. It is done when the meat pulls away from the bone easily; older mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.
seg.5888ba63831a.t: हाडासकट करी-कट मटणासाठी मध्यम आचेवर सुमारे 5–6 शिट्ट्या. मांस हाडापासून सहज सुटले की शिजले; जून मटणाला आणखी 1–2 शिट्ट्या लागू शकतात.
seg.5888ba63831a.back: For bone-in curry-cut mutton about 5–6 whistles on medium heat. When the meat comes away easily from the bone it is cooked; mature mutton may need 1–2 more whistles.

seg.5f47c430018f.src: How do I make gongura mutton less spicy?
seg.5f47c430018f.t: गोंगुरा मटण कमी तिखट कसे करावे?
seg.5f47c430018f.back: How to make gongura mutton less hot?

seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and use 2 green chillies. Keep some heat, as it balances the sourness of the gongura.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.t: 1 छोटा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर वापरा किंवा त्याऐवजी सन्नम मिरची पावडर घाला, आणि 2 हिरव्या मिरच्या वापरा. थोडा तिखटपणा ठेवा, कारण तो गोंगुराच्या आंबटपणाला तोल देतो.
seg.e4fe5fb9cf48.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or add Sannam chilli powder instead, and use 2 green chillies. Keep a little heat, because it balances gongura's sourness.

seg.df5186f8f459.src: గోంగూర మాంసం. Gongura mutton, the Guntur way: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour sorrel leaves till thick.
seg.df5186f8f459.t: गोंगूरा मांसम. गुंटूर पद्धतीचे गोंगुरा मटण: तेजा मिरची पावडर आणि हळद पावडरसोबत शिजवलेले मटण, मग आंबट अंबाडीच्या पानांसोबत घट्ट होईपर्यंत मंद उकळलेले.
seg.df5186f8f459.back: Gongura Mamsam. Guntur-style gongura mutton: mutton cooked with Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, then simmered with sour ambadi leaves until thick.

seg.dffa96c4d761.src: Gongura Mamsam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.dffa96c4d761.t: गोंगुरा मांसम: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.dffa96c4d761.back: Gongura Mamsam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a7dd4a4d025c.src: Gongura pachadi is the chutney Andhra is best known for: sour gongura (sorrel) leaves fried down in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. Around Guntur and Palnadu it is on the table almost every day, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, with sliced onion on the side.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी ही आंध्रची सर्वात प्रसिद्ध चटणी: आंबट गोंगुराची (अंबाडीची) पाने तेलात परतून भाजलेले मसाले, लसूण आणि लाल मिरचीसोबत वाटलेली. गुंटूर आणि पलनाडू भागात ती जवळजवळ रोज ताटात असते, गरम भातात एक चमचा तुपासोबत कालवून, बाजूला चिरलेला कांदा.
seg.a7dd4a4d025c.back: Gongura pachadi is Andhra's most famous chutney: sour gongura (ambadi) leaves fried in oil and ground with roasted spices, garlic and red chilli. In the Guntur and Palnadu area it is on the plate almost daily, mixed into hot rice with a spoon of ghee, chopped onion on the side.

seg.73ddd8b1df98.src: Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the sharp heat that stands up to the sourness of the leaves. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.t: तेजा मिरची पावडरमुळे तिला गडद लाल रंग आणि पानांच्या आंबटपणाला तोडीस तोड असा तीव्र तिखटपणा येतो. या पाककृतीने सुमारे 1½ कप होते, 6 जणांना पुरेल इतकी.
seg.73ddd8b1df98.back: Because of Teja chilli powder it gets a deep red colour and a sharp heat that matches the leaves' sourness. This recipe makes about 1½ cups, enough for 6 people.

seg.1689d390a49e.src: Total includes cooling the leaves and spices before grinding.
seg.1689d390a49e.t: एकूण वेळेत वाटण्याआधी पाने आणि मसाले थंड होण्याचा वेळही धरला आहे.
seg.1689d390a49e.back: The total time also counts the time for the leaves and spices to cool before grinding.

seg.b4b21c43d6d9.src: Fry gongura leaves in oil till they turn to a dark mash, then grind them with roasted coriander, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. Finish with a mustard and dal tempering.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.t: गोंगुराची पाने तेलात गडद लगदा होईपर्यंत परता, मग भाजलेले धणे, मेथी, लसूण, तेजा मिरची पावडर आणि मिठासोबत वाटा. शेवटी मोहरी आणि डाळीची फोडणी द्या.
seg.b4b21c43d6d9.back: Fry gongura leaves in oil until they become a dark pulp, then grind with roasted coriander seeds, fenugreek, garlic, Teja chilli powder and salt. At the end give a tempering of mustard and dal.

seg.bc1f3c96e98a.src: 4 cups gongura leaves ⟦1⟧picked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.t: 4 कप गोंगुराची (अंबाडीची) पाने ⟦1⟧2 मोठ्या जुड्यांतून खुडलेली, सुमारे 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.bc1f3c96e98a.back: 4 cups gongura (ambadi) leaves ⟦1⟧plucked from 2 large bunches, about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.e478a092b07c.src: 1 tbsp sesame oil ⟦1⟧gingelly oil, for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧
seg.e478a092b07c.back: 1 tablespoon sesame oil ⟦1⟧for frying the leaves⟦/1⟧

seg.b00132daaabc.src: ¼ tsp fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.t: ¼ छोटा चमचा मेथी दाणे ⟦1⟧मेंतुलु; यापेक्षा जास्त नको, नाहीतर पच्चडी कडू होते⟦/1⟧
seg.b00132daaabc.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧menthulu; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.c1657b10781a.src: 2 tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for a milder pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.t: 2 छोटे चमचे तेजा मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧खूप तिखट; कमी तिखट पच्चडीसाठी 1 छोटा चमचा वापरा⟦/1⟧
seg.c1657b10781a.back: 2 teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for a less hot pachadi use 1 teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.69e8fc35d187.src: Pick the gongura leaves off the stems and wash them in 2–3 changes of water. Spread them on a cloth and pat them completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in the oil and shortens how long the pachadi keeps.
seg.69e8fc35d187.t: गोंगुराची पाने देठांपासून खुडा आणि 2–3 पाण्यांत धुवा. ती कापडावर पसरा आणि पूर्ण कोरडी होईपर्यंत टिपून घ्या; पानांवर राहिलेले पाणी तेलात तडतडते आणि पच्चडी कमी दिवस टिकते.
seg.69e8fc35d187.back: Pluck the gongura leaves from the stems and wash in 2–3 waters. Spread them on a cloth and pat until completely dry; water left on the leaves splutters in oil and the pachadi keeps fewer days.

seg.1b214adb5a9c.src: Roast the coriander, cumin and fenugreek till fragrant; let them cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir all the time: the fenugreek should turn one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.t: धणे, जिरे आणि मेथी खमंग वास येईपर्यंत भाजा; थंड होऊ द्या. मंद आचेवर कोरडे पॅन वापरा आणि सतत ढवळा: मेथी एका छटेने गडद व्हायला हवी, सुमारे 2 मिनिटे, पण तपकिरी नाही.
seg.1b214adb5a9c.back: Roast coriander seeds, cumin and fenugreek until a toasty smell comes; let cool. Use a dry pan on low heat and stir constantly: the fenugreek should get one shade darker, about 2 minutes, but not brown.

seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.src: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tbsp oil till they wilt to a dark mash, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink fast, turn from green to a dull olive-brown, and almost all their water cooks off.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.t: गोंगुराची पाने 1 मोठा चमचा तेलात मलूल होऊन गडद लगदा होईपर्यंत परता, 6–8 मिनिटे. मध्यम आचेवर रुंद पॅन वापरा आणि वारंवार ढवळा; पाने पटकन आकसतात, हिरव्यावरून फिकट ऑलिव्ह-तपकिरी होतात, आणि त्यांचे जवळजवळ सगळे पाणी आटते.
seg.6dd2ecdfbc2f.back: Fry the gongura leaves in 1 tablespoon oil until wilted into a dark pulp, 6–8 minutes. Use a wide pan on medium heat and stir often; the leaves shrink quickly, go from green to pale olive-brown, and almost all their water evaporates.

seg.adc2540067f6.src: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.
seg.adc2540067f6.t: पाने ताटात पसरा आणि पूर्ण थंड होऊ द्या, सुमारे 10 मिनिटे.
seg.adc2540067f6.back: Spread the leaves on a plate and let them cool completely, about 10 minutes.

seg.78d34fa0267e.src: Grind the spices with the garlic, chilli powder and salt, then pulse in the leaves. Grind the roasted spices, the 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder first.
seg.78d34fa0267e.t: मसाले लसूण, मिरची पावडर आणि मिठासोबत वाटा, मग पाने घालून थांबून थांबून फिरवा. आधी भाजलेले मसाले, लसणाच्या 6 पाकळ्या, तेजा मिरची पावडर आणि मीठ जाडसर पूड होईपर्यंत वाटा.
seg.78d34fa0267e.back: Grind the spices with garlic, chilli powder and salt, then add the leaves and pulse. First grind the roasted spices, 6 garlic cloves, Teja chilli powder and salt to a coarse powder.

seg.e84cadbb2f28.src: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times to a coarse paste, without any water. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.t: थंड झालेली पाने घाला आणि पाणी न घालता 3–4 वेळा थांबून थांबून फिरवून जाडसर पेस्ट करा. आंध्रातली अनेक घरे त्याऐवजी ती दगडी खलबत्त्यात (रोलु) कुटतात.
seg.e84cadbb2f28.back: Add the cooled leaves and pulse 3–4 times without adding water to make a coarse paste. Many Andhra homes pound it in a stone mortar (rolu) instead.

seg.c04597c43292.src: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. Add a pinch more salt if the sourness feels too sharp.
seg.c04597c43292.t: चाखून पाहा: ती आंबट, तिखट आणि चांगली खारट असावी. आंबटपणा जास्तच तीव्र वाटला तर आणखी चिमूटभर मीठ घाला.
seg.c04597c43292.back: Taste: it should be sour, hot and well salted. If the sourness feels too sharp, add another pinch of salt.

seg.317793f8bd6d.src: Temper mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the rest of the oil; mix it in. Heat the 2 tbsp sesame oil in a small pan, let the mustard seeds crackle, fry the chana dal and urad dal till golden, then add the red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida for a few seconds. Pour it over the pachadi and stir well.
seg.317793f8bd6d.t: उरलेल्या तेलात मोहरी, डाळी, लाल मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी करा; ती मिसळा. छोट्या पॅनमध्ये 2 मोठे चमचे तिळाचे तेल गरम करा, मोहरी तडतडू द्या, चणा डाळ आणि उडीद डाळ सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता, मग लाल मिरच्या, ठेचलेला लसूण, कढीपत्ता आणि हिंग घालून काही सेकंद परता. ही फोडणी पच्चडीवर ओता आणि नीट ढवळा.
seg.317793f8bd6d.back: Make a tempering of mustard, dals, red chillies and curry leaves in the remaining oil; mix it in. Heat 2 tablespoons sesame oil in a small pan, let mustard crackle, fry chana dal and urad dal until golden, then add red chillies, crushed garlic, curry leaves and asafoetida and fry a few seconds. Pour this tempering on the pachadi and stir well.

seg.bd6dcf672985.src: Let the pachadi sit for 30 minutes if you can, so the flavours come together, then spoon it into a clean, dry glass jar.
seg.bd6dcf672985.t: जमल्यास पच्चडी 30 मिनिटे तशीच ठेवा, म्हणजे चवी एकत्र मुरतील, मग ती स्वच्छ, कोरड्या काचेच्या बरणीत भरा.
seg.bd6dcf672985.back: If possible keep the pachadi 30 minutes so the flavours soak together, then fill it into a clean, dry glass jar.

seg.e0bb74b2a966.src: Dry the leaves fully before frying so the pachadi keeps longer.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.t: परतण्याआधी पाने पूर्ण कोरडी करा, म्हणजे पच्चडी जास्त दिवस टिकते.
seg.e0bb74b2a966.back: Dry the leaves completely before frying, so the pachadi keeps more days.

seg.29688dc9fded.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a milder pachadi use 1 tsp, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.29688dc9fded.t: तेजा मिरची पावडर खूप तिखट असते. कमी तिखट पच्चडीसाठी 1 छोटा चमचा वापरा, किंवा अर्धी तेजा आणि अर्धी सन्नम मिरची पावडर.
seg.29688dc9fded.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For a less hot pachadi use 1 teaspoon, or half Teja and half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.d1fa39431c01.src: Keep the fenugreek to ¼ tsp and roast it only one shade darker; more, or darker, makes the pachadi bitter.
seg.d1fa39431c01.t: मेथी ¼ छोटा चमचाच ठेवा आणि ती फक्त एका छटेने गडद होईपर्यंत भाजा; जास्त घेतली किंवा जास्त गडद भाजली तर पच्चडी कडू होते.
seg.d1fa39431c01.back: Keep fenugreek at ¼ teaspoon only and roast it only until one shade darker; if more is taken or it is roasted too dark the pachadi turns bitter.

seg.00435dc24e2d.src: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with bits of leaf you can see.
seg.00435dc24e2d.t: थांबून थांबून फिरवा, गुळगुळीत वाटू नका: गोंगुरा पच्चडी जाडसर असावी, पानांचे तुकडे दिसतील अशी.
seg.00435dc24e2d.back: Pulse, do not grind smooth: gongura pachadi should be coarse, with pieces of leaf visible.

seg.70ea8f84244b.src: Do not skimp on the oil; the layer of oil on top helps the pachadi keep.
seg.70ea8f84244b.t: तेलात कंजुषी करू नका; वरच्या तेलाच्या थरामुळे पच्चडी टिकायला मदत होते.
seg.70ea8f84244b.back: Do not be stingy with oil; the oil layer on top helps the pachadi keep.

seg.bd2018335c09.src: With onion: stir 1 small onion, finely chopped, into a portion just before serving, and eat it the same day.
seg.bd2018335c09.t: कांद्यासह: वाढण्याच्या अगदी आधी एका भागात 1 छोटा बारीक चिरलेला कांदा मिसळा, आणि तो त्याच दिवशी खा.
seg.bd2018335c09.back: With onion: just before serving mix 1 small finely chopped onion into one portion, and eat that the same day.

seg.77f8d979d9c5.src: Whole red chillies: in place of the chilli powder, fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind them with the spices.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.t: अख्ख्या लाल मिरच्या: मिरची पावडरऐवजी 12–15 सुक्या लाल मिरच्या थोड्या तेलात परता आणि मसाल्यांसोबत वाटा.
seg.77f8d979d9c5.back: Whole red chillies: instead of chilli powder fry 12–15 dried red chillies in a little oil and grind with the spices.

seg.98bf90687f81.src: Green chilli gongura: fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and cut the chilli powder to 1 tsp, for a sharper, greener heat.
seg.98bf90687f81.t: हिरव्या मिरचीचा गोंगुरा: जास्त तीव्र, हिरव्या मिरचीच्या तिखटपणासाठी 6–8 हिरव्या मिरच्या पानांसोबत परता आणि मिरची पावडर कमी करून 1 छोटा चमचा घाला.
seg.98bf90687f81.back: Green chilli gongura: for a sharper, green-chilli heat fry 6–8 green chillies with the leaves and reduce chilli powder to 1 teaspoon.

seg.3ffc938ce36f.src: Mix a spoon into hot rice with ghee and eat with sliced raw onion on the side. It also goes well with dosa, idli and as a side on any Andhra meal plate.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.t: गरम भातात तुपासोबत एक चमचा कालवा आणि बाजूला चिरलेल्या कच्च्या कांद्यासोबत खा. डोसा, इडलीसोबत आणि कोणत्याही आंध्र जेवणाच्या ताटात तोंडीलावणी म्हणूनही छान लागते.
seg.3ffc938ce36f.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with ghee and eat with chopped raw onion on the side. It is also nice with dosa, idli and as a side relish on any Andhra meal plate.

seg.9b58b3a03e55.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge for up to 2 weeks, always using a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.t: स्वच्छ, कोरड्या काचेच्या बरणीत फ्रिजमध्ये 2 आठवड्यांपर्यंत ठेवा, नेहमी कोरडा चमचा वापरा. वर तेलाचा पातळ थर असल्याने ती टिकायला मदत होते.
seg.9b58b3a03e55.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge up to 2 weeks, always use a dry spoon. A thin layer of oil on top helps it keep.

seg.5fb383e7c1ab.src: What is gongura called in English?
seg.5fb383e7c1ab.back: What is gongura called in English?

seg.100f275734bd.src: Gongura is the leaf of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.
seg.100f275734bd.t: गोंगुरा म्हणजे रोझेल वनस्पतीची पाने, ती अनेकदा सॉरेलची पाने किंवा रेड सॉरेल म्हणून विकली जातात. हिंदी आणि मराठी भाषिक भागांत तिला अंबाडी म्हणतात.
seg.100f275734bd.back: Gongura is the leaves of the roselle plant, often sold as sorrel leaves or red sorrel. In Hindi- and Marathi-speaking areas it is called ambadi.

seg.7f27f7848f6b.src: How do I make gongura pachadi less sour?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी कमी आंबट कशी करावी?
seg.7f27f7848f6b.back: How to make gongura pachadi less sour?

seg.a8b5b3cafa35.src: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 tsp grated jaggery. Frying the leaves down well also mellows their sourness.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.t: थोडे जास्त मीठ आणि मिरची घाला, किंवा 1 छोटा चमचा किसलेला गूळ ढवळून घाला. पाने चांगली परतल्यानेही त्यांचा आंबटपणा सौम्य होतो.
seg.a8b5b3cafa35.back: Add a little more salt and chilli, or stir in 1 teaspoon grated jaggery. Frying the leaves well also mellows their sourness.

seg.5bc83cd0bb23.src: Why is my gongura pachadi bitter?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.t: माझी गोंगुरा पच्चडी कडू का झाली?
seg.5bc83cd0bb23.back: Why did my gongura pachadi turn bitter?

seg.bcbd736912c5.src: Usually too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it to ¼ tsp and stop roasting when it is one shade darker.
seg.bcbd736912c5.t: बहुतेक वेळा मेथी जास्त झाल्यामुळे, किंवा मेथी जास्त गडद भाजल्यामुळे. ती ¼ छोटा चमचाच ठेवा आणि एका छटेने गडद झाली की भाजणे थांबवा.
seg.bcbd736912c5.back: Mostly because of too much fenugreek, or fenugreek roasted too dark. Keep it at ¼ teaspoon only and stop roasting once it is one shade darker.

seg.f5ec54c6b341.src: How long does gongura pachadi last?
seg.f5ec54c6b341.back: How many days does gongura pachadi keep?

seg.693b158b80df.src: About 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry glass jar, if the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon. Outside the fridge, eat it within 2–3 days.
seg.693b158b80df.t: पाने नीट कोरडी केली असतील आणि तुम्ही नेहमी कोरडा चमचा वापरत असाल, तर कोरड्या काचेच्या बरणीत फ्रिजमध्ये सुमारे 2 आठवडे. फ्रिजबाहेर, 2–3 दिवसांत खा.
seg.693b158b80df.back: If the leaves were dried well and you always use a dry spoon, about 2 weeks in a dry glass jar in the fridge. Outside the fridge, eat within 2–3 days.

seg.a8b7816171d1.src: గోంగూర పచ్చడి. Gongura pachadi the Guntur way: sorrel leaves fried down, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. Serves 6.
seg.a8b7816171d1.t: गोंगूरा पच्चडी. गुंटूर पद्धतीची गोंगुरा पच्चडी: अंबाडीची पाने परतून, भाजलेले मसाले, लसूण आणि तेजा मिरची पावडरसोबत वाटून, मग फोडणी दिलेली. 6 जणांसाठी.
seg.a8b7816171d1.back: Gongura Pachadi. Guntur-style gongura pachadi: ambadi leaves fried, ground with roasted spices, garlic and Teja chilli powder, then tempered. For 6 people.

seg.de566b9f7c3e.src: Gongura Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.de566b9f7c3e.t: गोंगुरा पच्चडी: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.de566b9f7c3e.back: Gongura Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.70fd98f238a4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु ⟦1⟧(चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हीतली आंध्र अंडा करी)⟦/1⟧
seg.70fd98f238a4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu ⟦1⟧(Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy)⟦/1⟧

seg.dd0da0936d87.src: Kodi guddu pulusu is the Andhra egg curry that many homes make when there is no meat in the house: hard-boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and slow-fried onions. It is thinner and sourer than a North Indian egg curry, made to be mixed into plenty of hot rice.
seg.dd0da0936d87.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु ही आंध्रची अंडा करी, घरात मटण-चिकन नसताना अनेक घरे ती करतात: उकडलेली अंडी चिंच आणि मंद आचेवर परतलेल्या कांद्याच्या चटपटीत ग्रेव्हीत मंद उकळलेली. ती उत्तर भारतीय अंडा करीपेक्षा पातळ आणि जास्त आंबट असते, भरपूर गरम भातात कालवण्यासाठी केलेली.
seg.dd0da0936d87.back: Kodi guddu pulusu is Andhra's egg curry; many homes make it when there is no mutton or chicken in the house: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy gravy of tamarind and onion fried on low heat. It is thinner and more sour than North Indian egg curry, made for mixing into lots of hot rice.

seg.27588d5a0d73.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the pulusu its red colour and a steady medium heat, and our turmeric powder (Pasupu) gives the golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.
seg.27588d5a0d73.t: आमच्या सन्नम मिरची पावडरमुळे पुलुसुला लाल रंग आणि एकसारखा मध्यम तिखटपणा येतो, आणि आमच्या हळद पावडरमुळे (पसुपु) सोनेरी बेस. थोडासा गूळ आंबटपणा गोलसर करतो.
seg.27588d5a0d73.back: Because of our Sannam chilli powder the pulusu gets red colour and an even medium heat, and because of our turmeric powder (pasupu) a golden base. A little jaggery rounds off the sourness.

seg.3c683c3f8074.src: Boil and slit the eggs. Fry onions, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in the gravy till it thickens.
seg.3c683c3f8074.t: अंडी उकडा आणि त्यांवर चिरा द्या. कांदा परता, हळद, सन्नम मिरची पावडर आणि चिंचेचे पाणी घाला, मंद उकळा, मग ग्रेव्ही घट्ट होईपर्यंत अंडी त्यात शिजवा.
seg.3c683c3f8074.back: Boil the eggs and make slits on them. Fry onion, add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and tamarind water, simmer, then cook the eggs in it until the gravy thickens.

seg.8c348975674a.src: a pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (optional)⟦/1⟧
seg.8c348975674a.back: A pinch of turmeric powder ⟦1⟧for frying the eggs (if wanted)⟦/1⟧

seg.3a31dc522e29.src: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧a lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups warm water⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.t: 20 g चिंच ⟦1⟧लिंबाएवढा गोळा, 1½ कप कोमट पाण्यात भिजवलेला⟦/1⟧
seg.3a31dc522e29.back: 20 g tamarind ⟦1⟧lemon-sized ball, soaked in 1½ cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.d56c07ca17af.t: 3 मोठे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧शेंगदाणा किंवा तिळाचे तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.5b3cff6eb38d.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; use 1½ tsp for milder⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.t: 2 छोटे चमचे सन्नम मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧मध्यम तिखट; कमी तिखटपणासाठी 1½ छोटा चमचा वापरा⟦/1⟧
seg.5b3cff6eb38d.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium hot; for less heat use 1½ teaspoons⟦/1⟧

seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.src: Soak the tamarind in the warm water for 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; discard the fibres and seeds.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.t: चिंच कोमट पाण्यात 15 मिनिटे भिजवा. ती चांगली कुस्करा, गाळा आणि चिंचेचे पाणी ठेवा; धागे आणि बिया टाकून द्या.
seg.4b88dbe5eb6d.back: Soak the tamarind in lukewarm water 15 minutes. Squeeze it well, strain and keep the tamarind water; throw away fibres and seeds.

seg.e7eefe0a36b0.src: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel them and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start them in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from the boil, then cool them in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.t: अंडी 10 मिनिटे उकडा, सोला आणि प्रत्येकावर 3–4 उथळ चिरा द्या. अंडी खोलीच्या तापमानाच्या पाण्यात ठेवून सुरुवात करा, उकळी आल्यापासून 10 मिनिटे मोजा, मग सोलण्याआधी पाण्यात थंड करा. पिवळा बलक आतपर्यंत घट्ट आणि फिकट पिवळा असावा.
seg.e7eefe0a36b0.back: Boil the eggs 10 minutes, peel and make 3–4 shallow slits on each. Start with eggs in room-temperature water, count 10 minutes from when it boils, then cool in water before peeling. The yolk should be firm all the way inside and pale yellow.

seg.6747ea35bd7d.src: Optional: heat 1 tsp of the oil with the pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it for 2 minutes until lightly blistered. Keep aside.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.t: हवे असल्यास: 1 छोटा चमचा तेल चिमूटभर हळदीसोबत गरम करा आणि अंडी त्यात 2 मिनिटे घोळवा, त्यांवर हलके फोड येईपर्यंत. बाजूला ठेवा.
seg.6747ea35bd7d.back: If wanted: heat 1 teaspoon oil with a pinch of turmeric and roll the eggs in it 2 minutes, until light blisters come on them. Keep aside.

seg.9d3c50e45f8b.src: Heat the rest of the oil in a kadai on medium heat. Add the fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; they turn bitter if they go dark.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.t: उरलेले तेल कढईत मध्यम आचेवर गरम करा. मेथी दाणे घाला आणि हलके तपकिरी होऊ द्या; ते गडद झाले तर कडू होतात.
seg.9d3c50e45f8b.back: Heat the remaining oil in a kadhai on medium heat. Add fenugreek seeds and let them turn light brown; if they get dark they turn bitter.

seg.c867d4469da7.src: Fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and onions in the oil till soft and golden. Add the mustard seeds first and let them splutter, then the curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then the onions for about 8 minutes.
seg.c867d4469da7.t: मोहरी, कढीपत्ता आणि कांदा तेलात मऊ आणि सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता. आधी मोहरी घाला आणि तडतडू द्या, मग कढीपत्ता, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि हिंग, मग कांदा सुमारे 8 मिनिटे.
seg.c867d4469da7.back: Fry mustard, curry leaves and onion in oil until soft and golden. First add mustard and let it crackle, then curry leaves, green chillies and asafoetida, then onion about 8 minutes.

seg.ae0272dd2475.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then the tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in the coriander powder with the chilli powder so it fries for a few seconds first.
seg.ae0272dd2475.t: आच मंद करा. हळद, सन्नम मिरची पावडर आणि मीठ घाला, मग चिंचेचे पाणी; 10 मिनिटे मंद उकळा. धणे पूड मिरची पावडरसोबतच ढवळून घाला, म्हणजे ती आधी काही सेकंद परतली जाईल.
seg.ae0272dd2475.back: Lower the heat. Add turmeric, Sannam chilli powder and salt, then tamarind water; simmer 10 minutes. Stir in coriander powder along with the chilli powder, so it gets fried a few seconds first.

seg.01aeed8b749f.src: The raw tamarind smell should be gone and the gravy should look glossy. Add ½ cup water if it thickens too fast.
seg.01aeed8b749f.t: चिंचेचा कच्चा वास गेलेला असावा आणि ग्रेव्ही चकचकीत दिसायला हवी. ती फार पटकन घट्ट झाली तर ½ कप पाणी घाला.
seg.01aeed8b749f.back: The raw smell of tamarind should have gone and the gravy should look glossy. If it thickens too quickly add ½ cup water.

seg.74f1a1affff6.src: Slide in the eggs and simmer 5 minutes more till the gravy thickens. Spoon the gravy over the eggs now and then.
seg.74f1a1affff6.t: अंडी हळूच सोडा आणि ग्रेव्ही घट्ट होईपर्यंत आणखी 5 मिनिटे मंद उकळा. मधूनमधून अंड्यांवर चमच्याने ग्रेव्ही घाला.
seg.74f1a1affff6.back: Gently slide in the eggs and simmer 5 more minutes until the gravy thickens. Now and then spoon gravy over the eggs.

seg.299781c49104.src: Stir in the jaggery, taste and adjust the salt or sourness, and scatter the coriander leaves.
seg.299781c49104.t: गूळ ढवळून घाला, चाखून मीठ किंवा आंबटपणा बरोबर करा, आणि कोथिंबीर भुरभुरा.
seg.299781c49104.back: Stir in jaggery, taste and correct salt or sourness, and sprinkle coriander leaves.

seg.d0ce3c2b157a.src: Switch off and let the pulusu rest for 10 minutes before serving so the eggs take on the gravy.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.t: आच बंद करा आणि वाढण्याआधी पुलुसु 10 मिनिटे तसाच ठेवा, म्हणजे अंड्यांत ग्रेव्ही मुरेल.
seg.d0ce3c2b157a.back: Turn off the heat and keep the pulusu like that 10 minutes before serving, so the gravy soaks into the eggs.

seg.feebbb94999b.src: Slits let the tangy gravy into the eggs.
seg.feebbb94999b.t: चिरांमुळे चटपटीत ग्रेव्ही अंड्यांच्या आत जाते.
seg.feebbb94999b.back: Because of the slits the tangy gravy goes inside the eggs.

seg.98394356bb39.src: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off cleanly.
seg.98394356bb39.t: सोलण्याआधी उकडलेली अंडी पाण्यात थंड करा; टरफले सहज निघतात.
seg.98394356bb39.back: Cool the boiled eggs in water before peeling; the shells come off easily.

seg.f4306708f8c5.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ tsp Teja chilli powder along with it.
seg.f4306708f8c5.t: सन्नम मिरची पावडरने मध्यम तिखटपणा येतो; जास्त तिखट पुलुसुसाठी तिच्यासोबत ½ छोटा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर घाला.
seg.f4306708f8c5.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat; for a hotter pulusu add ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder with it.

seg.fc1643db807e.src: Pulusu tastes better after it rests, and even more the next day, as the eggs soak up the tamarind.
seg.fc1643db807e.t: ठेवल्यावर पुलुसु जास्त छान लागतो, आणि दुसऱ्या दिवशी तर आणखीनच, कारण अंडी चिंच शोषून घेतात.
seg.fc1643db807e.back: After keeping the pulusu tastes nicer, and the next day even more so, because the eggs absorb the tamarind.

seg.b19fe3919add.src: Tomato: add 1 chopped tomato after the onions for a softer, less sour gravy.
seg.b19fe3919add.t: टोमॅटो: जास्त सौम्य, कमी आंबट ग्रेव्हीसाठी कांद्यानंतर 1 चिरलेला टोमॅटो घाला.
seg.b19fe3919add.back: Tomato: for a milder, less sour gravy add 1 chopped tomato after the onion.

seg.0d78d434249e.src: Sesame: stir in 1 tbsp roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes for a thicker, nutty gravy.
seg.0d78d434249e.t: तीळ: जास्त दाट, खमंग ग्रेव्हीसाठी शेवटच्या 5 मिनिटांत 1 मोठा चमचा भाजलेल्या तिळाची पूड ढवळून घाला.
seg.0d78d434249e.back: Sesame: for a thicker, nutty gravy stir in 1 tablespoon roasted sesame powder in the last 5 minutes.

seg.e4adab31c02b.src: Mamidikaya: in summer, replace half the tamarind with a few pieces of raw mango cooked in the gravy.
seg.e4adab31c02b.t: मामिडिकाया: उन्हाळ्यात अर्ध्या चिंचेऐवजी कैरीच्या काही फोडी ग्रेव्हीत शिजवा.
seg.e4adab31c02b.back: Mamidikaya: in summer cook a few raw mango pieces in the gravy instead of half the tamarind.

seg.bbf897873153.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, with a crisp fry or appadalu on the side. It also goes with chapati or dosa.
seg.bbf897873153.t: वाफवलेला भात आणि एक चमचा तुपासोबत गरम वाढा, बाजूला कुरकुरीत भाजी किंवा पापड (अप्पडालु). चपाती किंवा डोशासोबतही चालतो.
seg.bbf897873153.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, a crispy vegetable or papad (appadalu) on the side. It also works with chapati or dosa.

seg.7a5a4bbedfff.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu gently in a pan with a splash of water.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.t: उरलेले झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. थोडे पाणी घालून पॅनमध्ये पुलुसु हलक्या आचेवर गरम करा.
seg.7a5a4bbedfff.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat the pulusu in a pan with a little water on gentle heat.

seg.3dae693db30c.src: How long should I boil eggs for egg curry?
seg.3dae693db30c.t: अंडा करीसाठी अंडी किती वेळ उकडावी?
seg.3dae693db30c.back: How long to boil eggs for egg curry?

seg.2d6d1a298a24.src: About 10 minutes from the time the water boils. The yolk should be firm and pale yellow right through, with no runny centre, before the eggs go into the gravy.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.t: पाण्याला उकळी आल्यापासून सुमारे 10 मिनिटे. अंडी ग्रेव्हीत घालण्याआधी पिवळा बलक आतपर्यंत घट्ट आणि फिकट पिवळा असावा, मध्ये पातळ भाग नसावा.
seg.2d6d1a298a24.back: About 10 minutes from when the water comes to a boil. Before adding the eggs to the gravy the yolk should be firm all the way inside and pale yellow, with no runny part in the middle.

seg.4abaae123f39.src: Why do you make slits on eggs for pulusu?
seg.4abaae123f39.back: Why make slits on the eggs for pulusu?

seg.d3f5992ccd6e.src: Shallow slits let the tamarind gravy soak into the egg white. Without them the gravy stays on the surface and the egg tastes plain.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.t: उथळ चिरांमुळे चिंचेची ग्रेव्ही अंड्याच्या पांढऱ्या भागात मुरते. चिरा नसल्या तर ग्रेव्ही वरच राहते आणि अंडे सपक लागते.
seg.d3f5992ccd6e.back: Because of shallow slits the tamarind gravy soaks into the egg white. Without slits the gravy stays on top and the egg tastes bland.

seg.7a591bf728ac.src: How do I reduce the sourness of the pulusu?
seg.7a591bf728ac.back: How to reduce the sourness of pulusu?

seg.0a2bf657f386.src: Simmer it a few minutes longer, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Use a smaller ball of tamarind next time.
seg.0a2bf657f386.t: काही मिनिटे जास्त मंद उकळा, एक छोटा चमचा किसलेला गूळ घाला, किंवा थोडे पाणी ढवळून घाला. पुढच्या वेळी चिंचेचा लहान गोळा वापरा.
seg.0a2bf657f386.back: Simmer a few minutes more, add a teaspoon of grated jaggery, or stir in a little water. Next time use a smaller ball of tamarind.

seg.f9a34864523d.src: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?
seg.f9a34864523d.t: अंडा पुलुसु आणि अंडा करी यात काय फरक आहे?
seg.f9a34864523d.back: What is the difference between egg pulusu and egg curry?

seg.08bcae4f5075.src: Pulusu is a thinner, tangy tamarind gravy made to mix with rice. A regular egg curry is usually built on onion and tomato, with no tamarind and a thicker masala.
seg.08bcae4f5075.t: पुलुसु म्हणजे भातात कालवण्यासाठी केलेली पातळ, चटपटीत चिंचेची ग्रेव्ही. नेहमीची अंडा करी सहसा कांदा-टोमॅटोवर आधारित असते, चिंच नसते आणि मसाला जास्त घट्ट असतो.
seg.08bcae4f5075.back: Pulusu is a thin, tangy tamarind gravy made for mixing into rice. Regular egg curry is usually based on onion-tomato, has no tamarind and the masala is thicker.

seg.6977652a1279.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు · Egg Pulusu Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु · अंडा पुलुसु पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.6977652a1279.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu · Egg pulusu recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.src: కోడి గుడ్డు పులుసు. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. Serves 4.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु. कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु, आंध्र अंडा करी: सन्नम मिरची पावडर आणि हळदीने रंग आलेल्या चटपटीत चिंच-कांद्याच्या ग्रेव्हीत मंद उकळलेली उकडलेली अंडी. 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.4f1d5bbdf5db.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu. Kodi guddu pulusu, Andhra egg curry: boiled eggs simmered in a tangy tamarind-onion gravy coloured by Sannam chilli powder and turmeric. For 4 people.

seg.24e368a0d7e4.src: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra Egg Curry in Tamarind Gravy) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु (चिंचेच्या ग्रेव्हीतली आंध्र अंडा करी) · 1acrefarms
seg.24e368a0d7e4.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu (Andhra egg curry in tamarind gravy) · 1acrefarms

seg.583485fac40c.t: कोडी गुड्डु पुलुसु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.583485fac40c.back: Kodi Guddu Pulusu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.722d155a3c4f.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura ⟦1⟧(Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry)⟦/1⟧

seg.00fde8f92a7e.src: Gutti vankaya kura is the stuffed brinjal curry that Andhra homes make for Sunday lunches, weddings and when guests come over. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, packed with a roasted peanut, sesame and coconut masala, and cooked slowly in oil until they turn soft and the masala clings to them.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.t: गुत्ती वांकाया कूरा म्हणजे भरल्या वांग्याची भाजी, आंध्रातली घरे ती रविवारच्या जेवणाला, लग्नांमध्ये आणि पाहुणे आल्यावर करतात. लहान, गोल जांभळी वांगी चिरून, त्यांत भाजलेले शेंगदाणे, तीळ आणि खोबऱ्याचा मसाला भरला जातो, आणि ती मऊ होईपर्यंत आणि मसाला त्यांना चिकटेपर्यंत तेलात मंद शिजवली जातात.
seg.00fde8f92a7e.back: Gutti vankaya koora is stuffed brinjal curry; Andhra homes make it for Sunday meals, at weddings and when guests come. Small, round purple brinjals are slit, filled with a masala of roasted groundnuts, sesame and coconut, and cooked slowly in oil until soft and until the masala clings to them.

seg.27fd58488499.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives the stuffing its red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder rounds it off. Serve it with hot rice or chapati. This recipe serves 4.
seg.27fd58488499.t: आमच्या सन्नम मिरची पावडरमुळे मसाल्याला लाल रंग आणि मध्यम तिखटपणा येतो, आणि हळद पावडर त्याला पूर्णता देते. गरम भात किंवा चपातीसोबत वाढा. या पाककृतीत 4 जणांसाठी होते.
seg.27fd58488499.back: Because of our Sannam chilli powder the masala gets red colour and medium heat, and turmeric powder gives it completeness. Serve with hot rice or chapati. This recipe makes enough for 4 people.

seg.dea818e2c052.src: Roast peanuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, stuff small brinjals and cook them slowly in oil until soft.
seg.dea818e2c052.t: शेंगदाणे, तीळ, सुके खोबरे आणि धणे भाजा, सन्नम मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर आणि मिठासोबत वाटा, लहान वांग्यांत भरा आणि मऊ होईपर्यंत तेलात मंद शिजवा.
seg.dea818e2c052.back: Roast groundnuts, sesame, dry coconut and coriander seeds, grind with Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt, fill into small brinjals and cook slowly in oil until soft.

seg.1ba4509b5345.src: 3 tbsp peanuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skins⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.t: 3 मोठे चमचे शेंगदाणे ⟦1⟧कच्चे, सालीसकट किंवा सालीशिवाय⟦/1⟧
seg.1ba4509b5345.back: 3 tablespoons groundnuts ⟦1⟧raw, with or without skin⟦/1⟧

seg.b0b877b509dc.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.t: 2 छोटे चमचे सन्नम मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧जास्त तिखट भाजीसाठी 1 मोठ्या चमच्यापर्यंत⟦/1⟧
seg.b0b877b509dc.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter curry⟦/1⟧

seg.df2079b45203.src: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple ones⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.t: 12 लहान वांगी ⟦1⟧सुमारे 500 g, लहान गोल जांभळी⟦/1⟧
seg.df2079b45203.back: 12 small brinjals ⟦1⟧about 500 g, small round purple⟦/1⟧

seg.3994d7458465.back: 2 tablespoons coriander leaves ⟦1⟧chopped, for adding at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.d56e638c12d0.src: Dry-roast the peanuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with the spices. Roast the peanuts first on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes, then add the coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut for the last 30 seconds, until it is light golden. Let it cool.
seg.d56e638c12d0.t: शेंगदाणे, तीळ, खोबरे आणि धणे कोरडे भाजा; मसाल्यांसोबत वाटा. आधी शेंगदाणे मध्यम-मंद आचेवर 3–4 मिनिटे भाजा, मग धणे, जिरे आणि तीळ घालून 1 मिनिट, आणि शेवटच्या 30 सेकंदांत खोबरे, ते हलके सोनेरी होईपर्यंत. थंड होऊ द्या.
seg.d56e638c12d0.back: Dry-roast groundnuts, sesame, coconut and coriander seeds; grind with spices. First roast the groundnuts on medium-low heat 3–4 minutes, then add coriander seeds, cumin and sesame for 1 minute, and the coconut in the last 30 seconds, until light golden. Let cool.

seg.26e4a965b3f7.src: In a mixer, grind the roasted mix with the garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind to a coarse powder without water. It should clump when pressed.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.t: मिक्सरमध्ये भाजलेले मिश्रण लसूण, सन्नम मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर, मीठ आणि चिंचेसोबत पाणी न घालता जाडसर पूड होईपर्यंत वाटा. दाबल्यावर ती गोळा धरायला हवी.
seg.26e4a965b3f7.back: In a mixer grind the roasted mixture with garlic, Sannam chilli powder, turmeric powder, salt and tamarind without adding water to a coarse powder. When pressed it should hold together.

seg.5784e45d4bff.src: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, leaving the stalk on.
seg.5784e45d4bff.t: वांगी धुवा आणि हिरवे टोपण थोडे कापून घ्या, देठ तसाच ठेवा.
seg.5784e45d4bff.back: Wash the brinjals and trim the green cap a little, keeping the stem as is.

seg.02665f13e5af.src: Slit each brinjal in a cross from the bottom, keeping the stem on, and pack in the stuffing. Cut about three-quarters of the way up so the four quarters stay joined at the top. Drop each one into a bowl of salted water as you go, then drain.
seg.02665f13e5af.t: प्रत्येक वांग्याला खालच्या बाजूने अधिक (+) आकाराची चीर द्या, देठ तसाच ठेवा, आणि मसाला भरा. सुमारे तीन-चतुर्थांश उंचीपर्यंतच कापा, म्हणजे चारही भाग वरच्या बाजूला जोडलेले राहतील. कापत जाल तसे प्रत्येक वांगे मिठाच्या पाण्याच्या वाडग्यात टाका, मग निथळा.
seg.02665f13e5af.back: Give each brinjal a plus (+) shaped slit from the bottom, keeping the stem as is, and fill with masala. Cut only about three-quarters of the height, so all four parts stay joined at the top. As you cut, drop each brinjal into a bowl of salt water, then drain.

seg.498fc880430b.src: Press about 1 heaped tsp of stuffing into each brinjal. Keep the leftover stuffing aside.
seg.498fc880430b.t: प्रत्येक वांग्यात सुमारे 1 भरलेला छोटा चमचा मसाला दाबून भरा. उरलेला मसाला बाजूला ठेवा.
seg.498fc880430b.back: Press about 1 heaped teaspoon of masala into each brinjal. Keep the remaining masala aside.

seg.3daa0935ccba.src: Heat the oil in a wide, heavy pan on medium heat. Add the mustard seeds and, when they splutter, the curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.
seg.3daa0935ccba.t: रुंद, जाड बुडाच्या पॅनमध्ये मध्यम आचेवर तेल गरम करा. मोहरी घाला आणि ती तडतडली की कढीपत्ता आणि कांदा, वापरत असाल तर. कांदा मऊ होईपर्यंत परता, सुमारे 3 मिनिटे.
seg.3daa0935ccba.back: Heat oil in a wide, heavy-bottomed pan on medium heat. Add mustard and when it crackles, curry leaves and onion, if using. Fry the onion until soft, about 3 minutes.

seg.3a140b72d6a0.src: Place the stuffed brinjals in a single layer in the pan.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.t: भरलेली वांगी पॅनमध्ये एकाच थरात ठेवा.
seg.3a140b72d6a0.back: Place the stuffed brinjals in the pan in a single layer.

seg.1ae98f10b6ed.src: Cook the brinjals in hot oil, covered, on a low flame, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the stuffing stays in, and cook for 15–18 minutes, until the skins wrinkle.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.t: वांगी गरम तेलात झाकून मंद आचेवर शिजवा, दर 4–5 मिनिटांनी हलक्या हाताने उलटा. मसाला आत राहावा म्हणून चमचा किंवा चिमटा वापरा, आणि साले सुरकुतेपर्यंत 15–18 मिनिटे शिजवा.
seg.1ae98f10b6ed.back: Cook the brinjals covered in hot oil on low heat, turning gently every 4–5 minutes. Use a spoon or tongs so the masala stays inside, and cook 15–18 minutes until the skins wrinkle.

seg.50530663a626.src: Add the leftover stuffing with ½ cup water; simmer till the brinjals are soft. Cover and cook on low for 8–10 minutes more, until the masala thickens and oil shows at the sides.
seg.50530663a626.t: उरलेला मसाला ½ कप पाण्यासोबत घाला; वांगी मऊ होईपर्यंत मंद उकळा. झाकून मंद आचेवर आणखी 8–10 मिनिटे शिजवा, मसाला घट्ट होईपर्यंत आणि कडेने तेल सुटेपर्यंत.
seg.50530663a626.back: Add the remaining masala with ½ cup water; simmer until the brinjals are soft. Cook covered on low heat 8–10 more minutes, until the masala thickens and oil separates at the edges.

seg.2a2726cfebd5.src: Check doneness: a knife should slide through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Sprinkle the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.t: शिजले का ते तपासा: सर्वात जाड वांग्यातून सुरी काहीही अडथळा न येता आरपार जायला हवी. कोथिंबीर भुरभुरा आणि आच बंद करा.
seg.2a2726cfebd5.back: Check if cooked: a knife should go right through the thickest brinjal without any resistance. Sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the heat.

seg.c2e59cef6130.src: Keep the stalks on so the brinjals hold together while they cook and turn.
seg.c2e59cef6130.t: देठ तसेच ठेवा, म्हणजे शिजताना आणि उलटताना वांगी एकसंध राहतील.
seg.c2e59cef6130.back: Keep the stems as they are, so the brinjals stay whole while cooking and turning.

seg.15314c3b05cd.src: Pick small, glossy brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; large ones stay hard in the centre.
seg.15314c3b05cd.t: सारख्या आकाराची लहान, चकचकीत वांगी निवडा, म्हणजे ती सारखी शिजतील; मोठी वांगी मध्ये कडक राहतात.
seg.15314c3b05cd.back: Choose small, shiny brinjals of the same size, so they cook evenly; big brinjals stay hard in the middle.

seg.208cff8b9d46.src: Roast the peanuts and sesame on medium-low heat; burnt sesame makes the whole masala bitter.
seg.208cff8b9d46.t: शेंगदाणे आणि तीळ मध्यम-मंद आचेवर भाजा; करपलेल्या तिळामुळे सगळा मसाला कडू होतो.
seg.208cff8b9d46.back: Roast groundnuts and sesame on medium-low heat; because of burnt sesame the whole masala turns bitter.

seg.7779355bd06d.src: For a milder curry, use 1½ tsp Sannam chilli powder; for more heat, go up to 1 tbsp.
seg.7779355bd06d.t: कमी तिखट भाजीसाठी 1½ छोटा चमचा सन्नम मिरची पावडर वापरा; जास्त तिखटपणासाठी 1 मोठ्या चमच्यापर्यंत वाढवा.
seg.7779355bd06d.back: For a less hot curry use 1½ teaspoons Sannam chilli powder; for more heat increase up to 1 tablespoon.

seg.742d7eb81437.src: With onion masala: grind 1 small onion into the stuffing for a softer, slightly sweet gravy.
seg.742d7eb81437.t: कांद्याच्या मसाल्यासह: जास्त मऊ, किंचित गोडसर ग्रेव्हीसाठी मसाल्यात 1 छोटा कांदा वाटून घाला.
seg.742d7eb81437.back: With onion masala: for a softer, slightly sweet gravy grind 1 small onion and add to the masala.

seg.abde9958c7fa.src: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and use 1 tbsp more peanuts and sesame.
seg.abde9958c7fa.t: खोबऱ्याशिवाय: खोबरे वगळा आणि शेंगदाणे व तीळ 1 मोठा चमचा जास्त घ्या.
seg.abde9958c7fa.back: Without coconut: leave out the coconut and take 1 tablespoon more groundnuts and sesame.

seg.b9a6b34c8c73.src: Gravy style: add 1 cup water in place of ½ cup in the last step for a thinner curry to mix into rice.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.t: रस्सा पद्धत: भातात कालवण्यासाठी पातळ भाजी हवी असेल तर शेवटच्या टप्प्यात ½ कपऐवजी 1 कप पाणी घाला.
seg.b9a6b34c8c73.back: Gravy style: if you want a thin curry to mix into rice, add 1 cup water instead of ½ cup in the last step.

seg.80faf3a5e4b1.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jonna rotte.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.t: वाफवलेला भात आणि एक चमचा तुपासोबत, किंवा चपाती किंवा ज्वारीच्या भाकरीसोबत (जोन्ना रोट्टे) गरम वाढा.
seg.80faf3a5e4b1.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with chapati or jowar bhakri (jonna rotte).

seg.9adac1f51f99.src: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm gently with a splash of water.
seg.9adac1f51f99.t: झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. थोडे पाणी घालून हलक्या आचेवर गरम करा.
seg.9adac1f51f99.back: Keep covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Heat on gentle heat with a little water.

seg.83ffeb71bb2a.src: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.t: गुत्ती वांकायासाठी कोणती वांगी सर्वात चांगली?
seg.83ffeb71bb2a.back: Which brinjals are best for gutti vankaya?

seg.76c81f4beef2.src: Small, round purple brinjals about the size of an egg, with a glossy skin and green stalk. They cook through in the time the masala takes and hold the stuffing well.
seg.76c81f4beef2.t: अंड्याएवढी लहान, गोल जांभळी वांगी, चकचकीत साल आणि हिरव्या देठाची. मसाला शिजायला लागतो तेवढ्या वेळात ती आतपर्यंत शिजतात आणि मसाला नीट धरून ठेवतात.
seg.76c81f4beef2.back: Egg-sized small, round purple brinjals, with shiny skin and green stems. They cook through in the time the masala takes to cook and hold the masala well.

seg.71325f387d2a.src: How do I know the brinjals are cooked?
seg.71325f387d2a.back: How to know the brinjals are cooked?

seg.c65656faa952.src: The skins wrinkle and soften, and a knife slides through the thickest brinjal with no resistance. Undercooked brinjals feel firm and spongy in the centre.
seg.c65656faa952.t: साले सुरकुततात आणि मऊ होतात, आणि सर्वात जाड वांग्यातून सुरी काहीही अडथळा न येता आरपार जाते. कच्ची राहिलेली वांगी मध्ये घट्ट आणि स्पंजसारखी लागतात.
seg.c65656faa952.back: The skins wrinkle and become soft, and a knife goes right through the thickest brinjal without any resistance. Brinjals left raw feel firm and spongy in the middle.

seg.297ebd94e89c.src: Can I make gutti vankaya without coconut?
seg.297ebd94e89c.t: खोबऱ्याशिवाय गुत्ती वांकाया करता येईल का?
seg.297ebd94e89c.back: Can gutti vankaya be made without coconut?

seg.f9ad1045b4c1.src: Yes. Use 1 tbsp more peanuts and 1 tbsp more sesame seeds in place of the coconut; the masala tastes nuttier.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.t: हो. खोबऱ्याऐवजी 1 मोठा चमचा जास्त शेंगदाणे आणि 1 मोठा चमचा जास्त तीळ वापरा; मसाल्याला जास्त खमंग चव येते.
seg.f9ad1045b4c1.back: Yes. Instead of coconut use 1 tablespoon more groundnuts and 1 tablespoon more sesame; the masala gets a nuttier taste.

seg.534e126ba995.src: Why do my brinjals fall apart?
seg.534e126ba995.back: Why do my brinjals break apart?

seg.96bfe0b8ed06.src: The stalk was removed or the cross was cut all the way through. Keep the stalk on, stop the slit about a quarter from the top and turn them gently.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.t: देठ काढला गेला असेल किंवा चीर पूर्ण आरपार कापली गेली असेल. देठ तसाच ठेवा, चीर वरून सुमारे एक-चतुर्थांश अंतरावर थांबवा आणि वांगी हलक्या हाताने उलटा.
seg.96bfe0b8ed06.back: The stem may have been removed or the slit cut fully through. Keep the stem as is, stop the slit about a quarter of the way from the top and turn the brinjals gently.

seg.69e1140e9c6e.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర · Gutti Vankaya Kura Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.t: गुत्ती वंकाया कूरा · गुत्ती वांकाया कूरा पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.69e1140e9c6e.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora · Gutti Vankaya Koora recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.d09cc87e5fde.src: గుత్తి వంకాయ కూర. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted peanut, sesame and coconut, ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then slow-cooked in oil.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.t: गुत्ती वंकाया कूरा. भाजलेले शेंगदाणे, तीळ आणि खोबरे सन्नम मिरची पावडर आणि हळद पावडरसोबत वाटून भरलेली लहान वांगी, मग तेलात मंद आचेवर शिजवलेली.
seg.d09cc87e5fde.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora. Small brinjals stuffed with roasted groundnuts, sesame and coconut ground with Sannam chilli powder and turmeric powder, then cooked in oil on low heat.

seg.e6d2d516a538.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura (Andhra Stuffed Brinjal Curry) · 1acrefarms

seg.edfa611d692c.src: Gutti Vankaya Kura: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.edfa611d692c.t: गुत्ती वांकाया कूरा: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.edfa611d692c.back: Gutti Vankaya Koora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.111c74722b7d.src: Jeedipappu pakodi is the cashew pakoda that Andhra sweet shops and homes fry for tea time, festivals and guests: whole cashews in a thin, spiced coat of besan and rice flour, fried till crisp. Made without onion, it keeps for days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch for Diwali and Sankranti visitors.
seg.111c74722b7d.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडी म्हणजे काजू पकोडा, आंध्रातली मिठाईची दुकाने आणि घरे चहाच्या वेळी, सणांना आणि पाहुण्यांसाठी तो तळतात: अख्खे काजू बेसन आणि तांदळाच्या पिठाच्या पातळ, मसालेदार आवरणात, कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत तळलेले. कांद्याशिवाय केल्यामुळे तो बरणीत कित्येक दिवस टिकतो, म्हणून अनेक घरे दिवाळी आणि संक्रांतीला येणाऱ्या पाहुण्यांसाठी एक घाणा तळून ठेवतात.
seg.111c74722b7d.back: Jeedipappu pakodi is cashew pakoda; Andhra sweet shops and homes fry it at tea time, for festivals and for guests: whole cashews in a thin, spicy coating of gram flour and rice flour, fried until crisp. Because it is made without onion it keeps many days in a jar, so many homes fry a batch and keep it for guests coming at Diwali and Sankranti.

seg.b4f22aebea20.src: Whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe serves 4.
seg.b4f22aebea20.t: आमच्या जीडिपप्पु पॅकमधले अख्खे काजू आवरणाच्या आत कुरकुरीत राहतात, आणि सन्नम मिरची पावडरमुळे मध्यम तिखटपणा आणि उबदार लाल रंग येतो. या पाककृतीत 4 जणांसाठी होते.
seg.b4f22aebea20.back: The whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack stay crunchy inside the coating, and because of Sannam chilli powder there is medium heat and a warm red colour. This recipe makes enough for 4 people.

seg.a21c4d5f661e.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and crisp.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.t: एकूण वेळेत पकोडी थंड होऊन कुरकुरीत होण्याची 5 मिनिटेही धरली आहेत.
seg.a21c4d5f661e.back: The total time also counts the 5 minutes for the pakodi to cool and become crisp.

seg.0f4b2d277930.src: Toss whole cashews with besan, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle in just enough water to coat, and deep fry till golden and crisp.
seg.0f4b2d277930.t: अख्खे काजू बेसन, तांदळाचे पीठ, सन्नम मिरची पावडर, मीठ आणि एक चमचा गरम तेलासोबत घोळवा, आवरण बसेल इतकेच पाणी शिंपडा, आणि सोनेरी व कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत तेलात तळा.
seg.0f4b2d277930.back: Toss whole cashews with gram flour, rice flour, Sannam chilli powder, salt and a spoon of hot oil, sprinkle just enough water for the coating to set, and fry in oil until golden and crisp.

seg.d97defcf6bd2.src: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; split any very large ones in half⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.t: 1 कप अख्खे काजू ⟦1⟧सुमारे 150 g; खूप मोठे काजू असतील तर अर्धे करा⟦/1⟧
seg.d97defcf6bd2.back: 1 cup whole cashews ⟦1⟧about 150 g; if the cashews are very big, halve them⟦/1⟧

seg.0fb432c2000d.src: ½ cup besan ⟦1⟧gram flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.t: ½ कप बेसन ⟦1⟧हरभऱ्याचे पीठ, सुमारे 50 g⟦/1⟧
seg.0fb432c2000d.back: ½ cup gram flour ⟦1⟧chickpea flour, about 50 g⟦/1⟧

seg.4530b28d3c24.src: 2 tbsp rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.t: 2 मोठे चमचे तांदळाचे पीठ ⟦1⟧जास्त कुरकुरीत आवरणासाठी⟦/1⟧
seg.4530b28d3c24.back: 2 tablespoons rice flour ⟦1⟧for a crisper coating⟦/1⟧

seg.069bf214d83d.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium heat; add ½ tsp more for a hotter pakodi⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.t: 1 छोटा चमचा सन्नम मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧मध्यम तिखट; जास्त तिखट पकोडीसाठी ½ छोटा चमचा आणखी घाला⟦/1⟧
seg.069bf214d83d.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧medium hot; for hotter pakodi add ½ teaspoon more⟦/1⟧

seg.c5de5bb5101e.src: 1 tbsp hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.t: 1 मोठा चमचा गरम तेल ⟦1⟧तळण्याच्या तेलातून घेतलेले⟦/1⟧
seg.c5de5bb5101e.back: 1 tablespoon hot oil ⟦1⟧taken from the frying oil⟦/1⟧

seg.a24adfc46507.src: 2–3 tbsp water ⟦1⟧sprinkled in a little at a time⟦/1⟧

seg.9a0fd1249b07.src: oil for deep frying ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.9a0fd1249b07.back: Oil for frying ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.8423a6481648.src: Rinse the cashews and drain them well; a slightly damp surface helps the flour stick.
seg.8423a6481648.t: काजू धुऊन नीट निथळा; पृष्ठभाग थोडा ओलसर असल्याने पीठ चिकटायला मदत होते.
seg.8423a6481648.back: Wash the cashews and drain well; because the surface is a little moist it helps the flour stick.

seg.0d03259dc451.src: Heat the oil for deep frying in a kadai on medium heat.
seg.0d03259dc451.t: तळण्यासाठी कढईत मध्यम आचेवर तेल गरम करा.
seg.0d03259dc451.back: Heat oil for frying in a kadhai on medium heat.

seg.c7fa1a156718.src: Mix the besan, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and add the green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida at the same time.
seg.c7fa1a156718.t: बेसन, तांदळाचे पीठ, मिरची पावडर, मीठ, आलं-लसूण पेस्ट आणि कढीपत्ता मिसळा. रुंद वाडगा वापरा, आणि त्याच वेळी हिरव्या मिरच्या, कोथिंबीर आणि हिंग घाला.
seg.c7fa1a156718.back: Mix gram flour, rice flour, chilli powder, salt, ginger-garlic paste and curry leaves. Use a wide bowl, and at the same time add green chillies, coriander leaves and asafoetida.

seg.346911fb291b.src: Rub in 1 tbsp hot oil, add the cashews and sprinkle water till the flour just coats them. Spoon the hot oil from the kadai with care and rub it into the flour mix with your fingertips first, then add the cashews and sprinkle the water 1 tbsp at a time, tossing, until the flour clings to every cashew. The mix should look like damp crumbs, not a batter.
seg.346911fb291b.t: 1 मोठा चमचा गरम तेल चोळून मिसळा, काजू घाला आणि पीठ त्यांना जेमतेम लागेल इतके पाणी शिंपडा. कढईतले गरम तेल काळजीपूर्वक चमच्याने घ्या आणि आधी बोटांच्या टोकांनी पिठाच्या मिश्रणात चोळा, मग काजू घाला आणि एका वेळी 1 मोठा चमचा पाणी शिंपडत घोळवा, प्रत्येक काजूला पीठ चिकटेपर्यंत. मिश्रण ओलसर चुऱ्यासारखे दिसायला हवे, पिठासारखे पातळ नाही.
seg.346911fb291b.back: Rub in 1 tablespoon hot oil and mix, add cashews and sprinkle just enough water for the flour to barely coat them. Carefully take hot oil from the kadhai in a spoon and first rub it into the flour mix with fingertips, then add cashews and toss while sprinkling 1 tablespoon water at a time, until flour sticks to every cashew. The mixture should look like moist crumbs, not thin like batter.

seg.05a50e3b5ae8.src: Check the oil: a pinch of the mix dropped in should rise to the top in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns at once, the oil is too hot.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.t: तेल तपासा: मिश्रणाची चिमूट टाकली की ती 2–3 सेकंदांत एकसारख्या बुडबुड्यांसह वर यायला हवी. ती लगेच तपकिरी झाली तर तेल जास्त गरम आहे.
seg.05a50e3b5ae8.back: Check the oil: when a pinch of the mixture is dropped in, it should come up in 2–3 seconds with steady bubbles. If it browns immediately the oil is too hot.

seg.f3e77b6c0f73.src: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with your fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, without crowding the kadai.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.t: मध्यम गरम तेलात लहान लहान घोस सोडा. एका वेळी 3–4 पीठ लागलेले काजू बोटांनी उचला आणि ते सुटे सुटे तेलात पडू द्या, कढईत गर्दी करू नका.
seg.f3e77b6c0f73.back: Drop small clusters into medium-hot oil. Pick up 3–4 coated cashews at a time with fingers and let them fall loosely into the oil, do not crowd the kadhai.

seg.5e4bfdad4c05.src: Fry, turning, till golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; drain on paper. The bubbles around the pakodi get smaller and slow down when they are done.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.t: उलटत, सोनेरी आणि कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत तळा, 5–6 मिनिटे; कागदावर काढून तेल निथळू द्या. पकोडी तयार झाली की तिच्याभोवतीचे बुडबुडे लहान होतात आणि मंदावतात.
seg.5e4bfdad4c05.back: Fry while turning until golden and crisp, 5–6 minutes; take out on paper and let the oil drain. When the pakodi is ready the bubbles around it get small and slow down.

seg.eb1a58e02e89.src: Fry the rest in batches the same way, letting the oil come back to heat between batches.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.t: उरलेले काजू याच पद्धतीने घाण्यांमध्ये तळा, दोन घाण्यांच्या मध्ये तेल पुन्हा गरम होऊ द्या.
seg.eb1a58e02e89.back: Fry the remaining cashews the same way in batches, letting the oil heat again between two batches.

seg.8ab193492427.src: Let the pakodi rest for 5 minutes on the paper; they crisp up further as they cool. Sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder over the top, if you like.
seg.8ab193492427.t: पकोडी कागदावर 5 मिनिटे राहू द्या; थंड होताना ती आणखी कुरकुरीत होते. आवडत असल्यास वरून चिमूटभर मीठ किंवा मिरची पावडर भुरभुरा.
seg.8ab193492427.back: Let the pakodi stay on paper 5 minutes; as it cools it gets even crisper. If you like, sprinkle a pinch of salt or chilli powder on top.

seg.c8ded38fad10.src: Keep the batter thick and dry, not runny, or the pakodi turns soft.
seg.c8ded38fad10.t: पीठ घट्ट आणि कोरडे ठेवा, पातळ नको, नाहीतर पकोडी मऊ होते.
seg.c8ded38fad10.back: Keep the flour thick and dry, not thin, otherwise the pakodi turns soft.

seg.9670def7c10b.src: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown fast, and on high heat the coating colours before the cashew inside is toasted.
seg.9670def7c10b.t: मध्यम आचेवर तळा: काजू पटकन तपकिरी होतात, आणि मोठ्या आचेवर आतला काजू भाजला जाण्याआधीच आवरणाचा रंग बदलतो.
seg.9670def7c10b.back: Fry on medium heat: cashews brown quickly, and on high heat the coating changes colour before the cashew inside is roasted.

seg.76602f605fc8.src: The spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour makes the pakodi light and crisp.
seg.76602f605fc8.t: पिठात चोळलेल्या एका चमचा गरम तेलामुळे पकोडी हलकी आणि कुरकुरीत होते.
seg.76602f605fc8.back: Because of one spoon of hot oil rubbed into the flour, the pakodi becomes light and crisp.

seg.2494998e92ed.src: Sannam chilli powder gives a medium heat and a good red colour; use ½ tsp for children.
seg.2494998e92ed.t: सन्नम मिरची पावडरमुळे मध्यम तिखटपणा आणि छान लाल रंग येतो; मुलांसाठी ½ छोटा चमचा वापरा.
seg.2494998e92ed.back: Because of Sannam chilli powder there is medium heat and a nice red colour; for children use ½ teaspoon.

seg.7f70d313349e.src: Hotter: replace half the Sannam chilli powder with Teja chilli powder, which is much hotter.
seg.7f70d313349e.t: जास्त तिखट: अर्ध्या सन्नम मिरची पावडरऐवजी तेजा मिरची पावडर वापरा, ती खूपच जास्त तिखट असते.
seg.7f70d313349e.back: Hotter: use Teja chilli powder instead of half the Sannam chilli powder; it is much hotter.

seg.2b2be3846a1d.src: With onion: add 1 small onion, thinly sliced, with the cashews for a softer, sweeter pakodi, and eat it the same day.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.t: कांद्यासह: जास्त मऊ, गोडसर पकोडीसाठी काजूसोबत 1 छोटा पातळ चिरलेला कांदा घाला, आणि ती त्याच दिवशी खा.
seg.2b2be3846a1d.back: With onion: for a softer, sweetish pakodi add 1 small thinly sliced onion with the cashews, and eat it the same day.

seg.7f852eddc8b5.src: Mint: add 2 tbsp chopped mint leaves along with the coriander leaves.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.t: पुदिना: कोथिंबिरीसोबत 2 मोठे चमचे चिरलेली पुदिन्याची पाने घाला.
seg.7f852eddc8b5.back: Mint: add 2 tablespoons chopped mint leaves with the coriander leaves.

seg.cd47edc05460.src: Serve warm with evening tea or filter coffee. They also go into lunch boxes or onto the side of a rice-and-pappu meal.
seg.cd47edc05460.t: संध्याकाळच्या चहासोबत किंवा फिल्टर कॉफीसोबत कोमट वाढा. डब्यात किंवा भात-पप्पुच्या जेवणासोबत बाजूलाही चालते.
seg.cd47edc05460.back: Serve lukewarm with evening tea or filter coffee. It also works in a lunch box or on the side with a rice-pappu meal.

seg.e2777b4dabb7.src: Once fully cooled, keep them in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If they soften, warm them in a dry pan on low heat for 2–3 minutes.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.t: पूर्ण थंड झाल्यावर हवाबंद बरणीत खोलीच्या तापमानाला ठेवा आणि 4–5 दिवसांत खा. ती मऊ झाली तर कोरड्या पॅनमध्ये मंद आचेवर 2–3 मिनिटे गरम करा.
seg.e2777b4dabb7.back: After cooling completely keep in an airtight jar at room temperature and eat within 4–5 days. If it goes soft, heat it in a dry pan on low heat 2–3 minutes.

seg.f8c9120f7f67.src: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.t: माझी काजू पकोडी मऊ का झाली?
seg.f8c9120f7f67.back: Why did my cashew pakodi turn soft?

seg.346050614d3a.src: Too much water in the flour, or frying on low heat. Keep the mix like damp crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.
seg.346050614d3a.t: पिठात जास्त पाणी झाल्यामुळे, किंवा मंद आचेवर तळल्यामुळे. मिश्रण ओलसर चुऱ्यासारखे ठेवा आणि बुडबुडे मंदावेपर्यंत मध्यम आचेवर तळा.
seg.346050614d3a.back: Because of too much water in the flour, or because of frying on low heat. Keep the mixture like moist crumbs and fry on medium heat until the bubbles slow down.

seg.921421ebf2c6.src: Should I soak cashews before making pakodi?
seg.921421ebf2c6.back: Should cashews be soaked before making pakodi?

seg.e6e487728264.src: No soak is needed. A quick rinse is enough to help the flour stick; cashews soaked for long lose some of their crunch.
seg.e6e487728264.t: भिजवण्याची गरज नाही. पीठ चिकटण्यासाठी पटकन धुणे पुरेसे आहे; जास्त वेळ भिजवलेल्या काजूंचा कुरकुरीतपणा थोडा कमी होतो.
seg.e6e487728264.back: No need to soak. A quick wash is enough for the flour to stick; cashews soaked a long time lose a little crunch.

seg.905443e515e2.src: Can I make cashew pakodi without rice flour?
seg.905443e515e2.t: तांदळाच्या पिठाशिवाय काजू पकोडी करता येईल का?
seg.905443e515e2.back: Can cashew pakodi be made without rice flour?

seg.72a2c55cca9c.src: Yes. Use 2 tbsp more besan, or 1 tbsp cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so the pakodi will be a little softer without it.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.t: हो. 2 मोठे चमचे जास्त बेसन, किंवा 1 मोठा चमचा कॉर्नफ्लोअर वापरा. तांदळाच्या पिठाने सर्वात कुरकुरीत आवरण येते, त्यामुळे त्याशिवाय पकोडी थोडी मऊ होईल.
seg.72a2c55cca9c.back: Yes. Use 2 tablespoons more gram flour, or 1 tablespoon cornflour. Rice flour gives the crispest coating, so without it the pakodi will be a little softer.

seg.f129edc737b1.src: How long does cashew pakodi stay crisp?
seg.f129edc737b1.t: काजू पकोडी किती दिवस कुरकुरीत राहते?
seg.f129edc737b1.back: How many days does cashew pakodi stay crisp?

seg.d73ef4b28b6d.src: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, as long as it cools completely before it goes in.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.t: हवाबंद बरणीत सुमारे 4–5 दिवस, बरणीत भरण्याआधी ती पूर्ण थंड झाली असेल तर.
seg.d73ef4b28b6d.back: About 4–5 days in an airtight jar, if it had cooled completely before filling into the jar.

seg.62c3aa71c55a.src: జీడిపప్పు పకోడీ. Crisp cashew pakodi with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, besan, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडी. आमच्या जीडिपप्पु पॅकमधले अख्खे काजू, बेसन, तांदळाचे पीठ आणि सन्नम मिरची पावडर घालून केलेली कुरकुरीत काजू पकोडी. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरे.
seg.62c3aa71c55a.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi. Crisp cashew pakodi made with whole cashews from our Jeedipappu pack, gram flour, rice flour and Sannam chilli powder. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.f560ff3badb6.src: Jeedipappu Pakodi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.f560ff3badb6.t: जीडिपप्पु पकोडी: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.f560ff3badb6.back: Jeedipappu Pakodi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.a64f3158d8da.src: Upma is the everyday Andhra tiffin: semolina cooked soft in a seasoned water with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is the dressed-up version, with a good handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, the way it is made for guests, for festival mornings and at weddings, often served next to pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.
seg.a64f3158d8da.t: उपमा हा आंध्रातला रोजचा नाश्ता: कांदा, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी दिलेल्या पाण्यात मऊ शिजवलेला रवा. जीडिपप्पु उपमा हा त्याचा खास प्रकार, तुपात सोनेरी तळलेल्या मूठभर काजूंसह, जसा पाहुण्यांसाठी, सणाच्या सकाळी आणि लग्नांमध्ये केला जातो, अनेकदा पेसरट्टूसोबत किंवा एक चमचा साखरेसोबत वाढला जातो.
seg.a64f3158d8da.back: Upma is Andhra's everyday breakfast: rava cooked soft in water tempered with onion, green chillies and curry leaves. Jeedipappu upma is its special version, with a handful of cashews fried golden in ghee, as made for guests, on festival mornings and at weddings, often served with pesarattu or with a spoon of sugar.

seg.f9bc03f64077.src: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy against the soft rava. It is on the table in about 25 minutes. This recipe serves 3.
seg.f9bc03f64077.t: आमचे जीडिपप्पु काजू अख्खे आणि साधे आहेत, त्यामुळे ते सारखे तळले जातात आणि मऊ रव्यात कुरकुरीत राहतात. सुमारे 25 मिनिटांत तो ताटात येतो. या पाककृतीत 3 जणांसाठी होतो.
seg.f9bc03f64077.back: Our Jeedipappu cashews are whole and plain, so they fry evenly and stay crunchy in the soft rava. It comes to the plate in about 25 minutes. This recipe makes enough for 3 people.

seg.5ef4d1713249.src: Roast rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, stir in the rava, cover and finish with the cashews.
seg.5ef4d1713249.t: रवा भाजा, काजू तुपात तळा, मग फोडणी करून कांदा आणि मिरच्या मऊ करा. पाणी मीठ घालून उकळा, रवा ढवळत घाला, झाकून ठेवा आणि शेवटी काजू घाला.
seg.5ef4d1713249.back: Roast the rava, fry cashews in ghee, then temper and soften onion and chillies. Boil water with salt, add rava while stirring, cover and at the end add cashews.

seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.src: 1 cup bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium semolina (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.t: 1 कप बॉम्बे रवा ⟦1⟧मध्यम रवा (सूजी), सुमारे 170 g⟦/1⟧
seg.5f9c9ea52cc5.back: 1 cup Bombay rava ⟦1⟧medium rava (sooji), about 170 g⟦/1⟧

seg.30102cb3f08b.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧use 2 cups for a firmer upma⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.t: 2½ कप पाणी ⟦1⟧जास्त घट्ट उपम्यासाठी 2 कप वापरा⟦/1⟧
seg.30102cb3f08b.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧for a firmer upma use 2 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.src: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halved, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.t: ¼ कप काजू ⟦1⟧अख्खे किंवा अर्धे, सुमारे 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.be0ebf4a6ec1.back: ¼ cup cashews ⟦1⟧whole or halves, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.0e1b40869004.src: 3 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tbsp oil plus 1 tbsp ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.t: 3 मोठे चमचे तूप ⟦1⟧किंवा 2 मोठे चमचे तेल आणि 1 मोठा चमचा तूप⟦/1⟧
seg.0e1b40869004.back: 3 tablespoons ghee ⟦1⟧or 2 tablespoons oil and 1 tablespoon ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.07a870690b21.src: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit; use 3 for a hotter upma⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.t: 2 हिरव्या मिरच्या ⟦1⟧उभ्या चिरलेल्या; जास्त तिखट उपम्यासाठी 3 वापरा⟦/1⟧
seg.07a870690b21.back: 2 green chillies ⟦1⟧slit lengthwise; for a hotter upma use 3⟦/1⟧

seg.5fe03b6066ae.src: Chop the onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit the green chillies, and measure out the water.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.t: कांदा, आलं आणि कोथिंबीर चिरा, हिरव्या मिरच्या उभ्या चिरा, आणि पाणी मोजून ठेवा.
seg.5fe03b6066ae.back: Chop onion, ginger and coriander leaves, slit green chillies lengthwise, and keep the water measured.

seg.015e5d6ef88c.src: Roast the rava in a dry pan till it smells toasty, about 5 minutes. Keep it pale. Stir all the time on medium-low heat, then tip it onto a plate.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.t: रवा कोरड्या पॅनमध्ये खमंग वास येईपर्यंत भाजा, सुमारे 5 मिनिटे. त्याचा रंग फिकटच ठेवा. मध्यम-मंद आचेवर सतत ढवळा, मग ताटात काढा.
seg.015e5d6ef88c.back: Roast the rava in a dry pan until a toasty smell comes, about 5 minutes. Keep its colour pale. Stir constantly on medium-low heat, then take out onto a plate.

seg.2ccb9bbfe373.src: Heat the ghee in a wide, heavy pan on medium-low heat.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.t: रुंद, जाड बुडाच्या पॅनमध्ये मध्यम-मंद आचेवर तूप गरम करा.
seg.2ccb9bbfe373.back: Heat ghee in a wide, heavy-bottomed pan on medium-low heat.

seg.827cce77ebf1.src: Fry the cashews in the ghee till golden; lift them out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.
seg.827cce77ebf1.t: काजू तुपात सोनेरी होईपर्यंत तळा; बाहेर काढा. यासाठी सुमारे 1–2 मिनिटे लागतात; तूप पॅनमध्येच ठेवा.
seg.827cce77ebf1.back: Fry cashews in ghee until golden; take out. This takes about 1–2 minutes; keep the ghee in the pan.

seg.57b61920de4c.src: Temper mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften the onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Let the mustard seeds splutter and the dals turn light golden before the curry leaves go in, then add the ginger with the onion and cook for 3–4 minutes till the onion is soft.
seg.57b61920de4c.t: मोहरी, डाळी आणि कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी करा. कांदा आणि मिरच्या मऊ करा, पाणी आणि मीठ घाला, आणि उकळा. कढीपत्ता घालण्याआधी मोहरी तडतडू द्या आणि डाळी हलक्या सोनेरी होऊ द्या, मग कांद्यासोबत आलं घाला आणि कांदा मऊ होईपर्यंत 3–4 मिनिटे शिजवा.
seg.57b61920de4c.back: Make a tempering of mustard, dals and curry leaves. Soften onion and chillies, add water and salt, and boil. Before adding curry leaves let the mustard crackle and the dals turn light golden, then add ginger with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes until the onion is soft.

seg.be01d433ae80.src: Taste the water once it boils; it should taste a little salty, as the rava will take up the salt.
seg.be01d433ae80.t: पाण्याला उकळी आली की चाखून पाहा; ते थोडे खारट लागायला हवे, कारण रवा मीठ शोषून घेतो.
seg.be01d433ae80.back: When the water comes to a boil taste it; it should taste a little salty, because the rava absorbs salt.

seg.b99b11495ead.src: Turn the heat to low. Pour in the rava in a thin stream, stirring. Cover on low for 3 minutes; top with the cashews.
seg.b99b11495ead.t: आच मंद करा. ढवळत ढवळत रवा बारीक धारेने घाला. मंद आचेवर 3 मिनिटे झाकून ठेवा; वरून काजू घाला.
seg.b99b11495ead.back: Lower the heat. While stirring, add rava in a thin stream. Keep covered on low heat 3 minutes; add cashews on top.

seg.fbf1f55f7751.src: Before adding the cashews, check the upma: the rava should be soft with no hard grains, and the upma should leave the sides of the pan. If it is still grainy, sprinkle in 2 tbsp hot water, cover and cook 1 minute more.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.t: काजू घालण्याआधी उपमा तपासा: रवा मऊ असावा, एकही कडक कण नसावा, आणि उपमा पॅनच्या कडा सोडू लागायला हवा. अजूनही कणकणीत असेल तर 2 मोठे चमचे गरम पाणी शिंपडा, झाकून आणखी 1 मिनिट शिजवा.
seg.fbf1f55f7751.back: Check the upma before adding cashews: the rava should be soft, with not a single hard grain, and the upma should start leaving the sides of the pan. If still grainy, sprinkle 2 tablespoons hot water, cover and cook 1 more minute.

seg.28e90add4ba6.src: Stir in the extra spoon of ghee and the coriander leaves, if using, along with most of the cashews.
seg.28e90add4ba6.t: जास्तीचा एक चमचा तूप आणि वापरत असाल तर कोथिंबीर, बहुतेक काजूंसोबत ढवळून घाला.
seg.28e90add4ba6.back: Stir in an extra spoon of ghee and coriander leaves if using, along with most of the cashews.

seg.351e9512c914.src: Serve hot, with the rest of the cashews on top.
seg.351e9512c914.t: वरून उरलेले काजू घालून गरम वाढा.
seg.351e9512c914.back: Add the remaining cashews on top and serve hot.

seg.4643e12d303d.src: Pour the rava in a thin stream while stirring so no lumps form.
seg.4643e12d303d.t: ढवळत असताना रवा बारीक धारेने घाला, म्हणजे गुठळ्या होणार नाहीत.
seg.4643e12d303d.back: Add rava in a thin stream while stirring, so lumps will not form.

seg.3c98bb62770b.src: Roasting the rava first keeps each grain separate; skip it and the upma turns sticky.
seg.3c98bb62770b.t: आधी रवा भाजल्याने प्रत्येक कण सुटा राहतो; ते वगळले तर उपमा चिकट होतो.
seg.3c98bb62770b.back: Roasting rava first keeps each grain separate; if that is skipped the upma becomes sticky.

seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.src: Fry the cashews on medium-low heat and lift them out as soon as they turn golden; they keep darkening in the hot ghee.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.t: काजू मध्यम-मंद आचेवर तळा आणि सोनेरी होताच बाहेर काढा; गरम तुपात ते गडद होत राहतात.
seg.fc5bc0e0bf4e.back: Fry cashews on medium-low heat and take out as soon as golden; in hot ghee they keep getting darker.

seg.975560a8a158.src: Upma firms up as it stands, so take it off the heat when it is a little softer than you want.
seg.975560a8a158.t: ठेवल्यावर उपमा घट्ट होतो, त्यामुळे तुम्हाला हवा त्यापेक्षा थोडा मऊ असतानाच आचेवरून उतरवा.
seg.975560a8a158.back: On keeping upma firms up, so take it off the heat while it is a little softer than you want.

seg.508f0ab3992d.src: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, beans and green peas with the onion and cook them for 3–4 minutes before the water goes in.
seg.508f0ab3992d.t: भाज्यांचा उपमा: कांद्यासोबत ½ कप चिरलेले गाजर, फरसबी आणि हिरवे वाटाणे घाला आणि पाणी घालण्याआधी 3–4 मिनिटे शिजवा.
seg.508f0ab3992d.back: Vegetable upma: add ½ cup chopped carrot, French beans and green peas with the onion and cook 3–4 minutes before adding water.

seg.1742d7bd0e23.src: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook till soft before adding the water.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.t: टोमॅटो उपमा: कांद्यानंतर 1 चिरलेला टोमॅटो घाला आणि पाणी घालण्याआधी मऊ होईपर्यंत शिजवा.
seg.1742d7bd0e23.back: Tomato upma: add 1 chopped tomato after the onion and cook until soft before adding water.

seg.1981c7f3fc60.src: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook it covered for 5–6 minutes.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.t: गोधुमा रवा उपमा: तेवढाच गव्हाचा रवा 3 कप पाण्यासोबत वापरा आणि झाकून 5–6 मिनिटे शिजवा.
seg.1981c7f3fc60.back: Godhuma rava upma: use the same amount of wheat rava with 3 cups water and cook covered 5–6 minutes.

seg.01300d94ad36.src: Serve hot as a breakfast tiffin with coconut chutney, allam pachadi or a spoon of sugar, or next to pesarattu for pesarattu upma.
seg.01300d94ad36.t: नाश्त्याला नारळाची चटणी, अल्लम पच्चडी (आल्याची चटणी) किंवा एक चमचा साखरेसोबत गरम वाढा, किंवा पेसरट्टू उपमासाठी पेसरट्टूसोबत.
seg.01300d94ad36.back: For breakfast serve hot with coconut chutney, allam pachadi (ginger chutney) or a spoon of sugar, or with pesarattu for pesarattu upma.

seg.3316a3d82f44.src: Upma is best eaten hot, soon after it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and sprinkle with water before reheating.
seg.3316a3d82f44.t: उपमा केल्यानंतर लगेच, गरम खाणे सर्वात छान. उरलेला झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये 1 दिवसापर्यंत ठेवा आणि पुन्हा गरम करण्याआधी त्यावर पाणी शिंपडा.
seg.3316a3d82f44.back: Eating upma right after making it, hot, is best. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge up to 1 day and sprinkle water on it before reheating.

seg.b53646711bf0.src: How do I make upma without lumps?
seg.b53646711bf0.t: गुठळ्या न होता उपमा कसा करावा?
seg.b53646711bf0.back: How to make upma without lumps?

seg.429b54b4ab3a.src: Keep the water at a boil, turn the heat to low and pour in the rava in a thin stream with one hand while you stir with the other.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.t: पाणी उकळत ठेवा, आच मंद करा आणि एका हाताने ढवळत असताना दुसऱ्या हाताने रवा बारीक धारेने घाला.
seg.429b54b4ab3a.back: Keep the water boiling, lower the heat and while stirring with one hand add rava in a thin stream with the other hand.

seg.0c2874233201.src: What is the right rava to water ratio for upma?
seg.0c2874233201.t: उपम्यासाठी रवा आणि पाण्याचे योग्य प्रमाण काय?
seg.0c2874233201.back: What is the right ratio of rava and water for upma?

seg.91a8fe1a38a5.src: For a soft Andhra-style upma, use 2½ cups water to 1 cup bombay rava. Use 2 cups for a firmer, more separate upma.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.t: मऊ आंध्र पद्धतीच्या उपम्यासाठी 1 कप बॉम्बे रव्याला 2½ कप पाणी वापरा. जास्त घट्ट, मोकळ्या उपम्यासाठी 2 कप वापरा.
seg.91a8fe1a38a5.back: For soft Andhra-style upma use 2½ cups water to 1 cup Bombay rava. For a firmer, loose upma use 2 cups.

seg.2cc94b02b5b4.back: Why does my upma become sticky?

seg.bd11a83d27d8.src: The rava was not roasted, or too much water went in. Roast the rava till it smells toasty, and stay close to 2½ cups water per cup.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.t: रवा भाजला नसेल, किंवा जास्त पाणी झाले असेल. रवा खमंग वास येईपर्यंत भाजा, आणि दर कपाला सुमारे 2½ कप पाण्याच्या जवळपास राहा.
seg.bd11a83d27d8.back: The rava may not have been roasted, or there was too much water. Roast the rava until a toasty smell comes, and stay near about 2½ cups water per cup.

seg.247181e411d9.src: When should I add cashews to upma?
seg.247181e411d9.back: When to add cashews to upma?

seg.83f262d9c56e.src: Fry them in the ghee first and lift them out, then stir them in at the end. Added early, they turn soft in the upma.
seg.83f262d9c56e.t: आधी ते तुपात तळा आणि बाहेर काढा, मग शेवटी ढवळून घाला. आधीच घातले तर ते उपम्यात मऊ होतात.
seg.83f262d9c56e.back: First fry them in ghee and take out, then stir in at the end. If added earlier they go soft in the upma.

seg.8b57b24af158.src: జీడిపప్పు ఉప్మా. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning tiffin. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs. Serves 3.
seg.8b57b24af158.t: जीडिपप्पु उप्मा. तुपात सोनेरी तळलेल्या जीडिपप्पु काजूंसह आंध्र रवा उपमा, मऊ आणि पटकन होणारा सकाळचा नाश्ता. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरे. 3 जणांसाठी.
seg.8b57b24af158.back: Jeedipappu Upma. Andhra rava upma with Jeedipappu cashews fried golden in ghee, a soft and quick morning breakfast. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers. For 3 people.

seg.661f01591624.src: Jeedipappu Upma: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.661f01591624.t: जीडिपप्पु उपमा: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.661f01591624.back: Jeedipappu Upma: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.992a8475993f.src: Kodi vepudu is the dry Andhra chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried hard in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and a just-roasted masala until dark and sticky with spice. It is the starter at Andhra weddings and the side that sits next to rasam rice or pappu at home.
seg.992a8475993f.t: कोडी वेपुडु म्हणजे आंध्रचे कोरडे चिकन फ्राय: चिकनचे लहान तुकडे त्यांच्याच रसात शिजवून, मग कढीपत्ता, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि ताबडतोब भाजलेल्या मसाल्यासोबत तेलात खरपूस तळलेले, गडद आणि मसाल्याने चिकट होईपर्यंत. आंध्रातल्या लग्नांमध्ये ते स्टार्टर असते, आणि घरी रसम-भात किंवा पप्पुसोबत बाजूला असते.
seg.992a8475993f.back: Kodi vepudu is Andhra's dry chicken fry: small pieces of chicken cooked in their own juices, then fried crisp in oil with curry leaves, green chillies and freshly roasted masala, until dark and sticky with masala. At Andhra weddings it is the starter, and at home it is on the side with rasam-rice or pappu.

seg.db90598234ea.src: Our Teja chilli powder gives it the deep red colour and the heat Andhra fries are known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashew kernels, fried golden, go in at the end. Serves 4 as a side.
seg.db90598234ea.t: आमच्या तेजा मिरची पावडरमुळे त्याला गडद लाल रंग आणि आंध्र फ्रायसाठी ओळखला जाणारा तिखटपणा येतो, आमची हळद पावडर मॅरिनेडमध्ये जाते, आणि आमचे अख्खे काजू सोनेरी तळून शेवटी घातले जातात. बाजूच्या पदार्थ म्हणून 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.db90598234ea.back: Because of our Teja chilli powder it gets a deep red colour and the heat Andhra fry is known for, our turmeric powder goes into the marinade, and our whole cashews are fried golden and added at the end. For 4 people as a side dish.
