seg.22b3994cc48a.src: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook it in its own juices, then fry it dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and cashews.
seg.22b3994cc48a.t: चिकन तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर, आलं-लसूण पेस्ट आणि लिंबात मुरवा, त्याच्याच रसात शिजवा, मग कढीपत्ता, हिरव्या मिरच्या, भाजलेला मसाला आणि काजूसोबत कोरडे तळा.
seg.22b3994cc48a.back: Marinate chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder, ginger-garlic paste and lemon, cook in its own juices, then dry-fry with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and cashews.

seg.4cb33a348eb8.src: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut into 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.t: 500 g बोनलेस चिकन ⟦1⟧1 इंचाच्या तुकड्यांत कापलेले; किंवा हाडासकट 600 g लहान तुकडे⟦/1⟧
seg.4cb33a348eb8.back: 500 g boneless chicken ⟦1⟧cut in 1-inch pieces; or 600 g small bone-in pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.57789012bc80.src: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashew kernels; halve any large ones⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.t: 15 काजू ⟦1⟧अख्खे काजू; मोठे असतील तर अर्धे करा⟦/1⟧
seg.57789012bc80.back: 15 cashews ⟦1⟧whole cashews; if big, halve them⟦/1⟧

seg.e43b68ea429f.back: 2 sprigs of curry leaves ⟦1⟧leaves plucked, about 30⟦/1⟧

seg.8df3bc4567e3.src: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.t: मॅरिनेड चिकटावे म्हणून चिकन कापडाने टिपून कोरडे करा.
seg.8df3bc4567e3.back: Pat the chicken dry with a cloth so the marinade sticks.

seg.075327f4deca.src: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt, 30 minutes. Mix well with your hands so every piece is coated.
seg.075327f4deca.t: चिकन तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद, आलं-लसूण पेस्ट, लिंबाचा रस आणि मिठात 30 मिनिटे मुरवा. प्रत्येक तुकड्याला लागेल असे हाताने नीट मिसळा.
seg.075327f4deca.back: Marinate the chicken in Teja chilli powder, turmeric, ginger-garlic paste, lemon juice and salt for 30 minutes. Mix well by hand so it coats every piece.

seg.63af904bba96.src: Meanwhile, dry-roast the coriander seeds, cumin seeds, fennel seeds, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until fragrant and a shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and grind to a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.
seg.63af904bba96.t: दरम्यान, धणे, जिरे, बडीशेप, लवंगा आणि दालचिनी छोट्या पॅनमध्ये मंद आचेवर खमंग वास येईपर्यंत आणि एका छटेने गडद होईपर्यंत कोरडे भाजा, सुमारे 2 मिनिटे. थंड करून जाडसर पूड करा. हा फ्राय मसाला.
seg.63af904bba96.back: Meanwhile, dry-roast coriander seeds, cumin, fennel, cloves and cinnamon in a small pan on low heat until a toasty smell comes and they are one shade darker, about 2 minutes. Cool and make a coarse powder. This is the fry masala.

seg.4406ac2e72fe.src: Put the chicken in a heavy kadai with no water, cover and set it on medium heat.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.t: चिकन पाणी न घालता जाड कढईत घाला, झाकून मध्यम आचेवर ठेवा.
seg.4406ac2e72fe.back: Put the chicken in a heavy kadhai without water, cover and keep on medium heat.

seg.93ccca0c5178.src: Cook it covered in its own juices till no pink remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; the chicken releases water as it cooks.
seg.93ccca0c5178.t: अजिबात गुलाबी रंग उरत नाही तोपर्यंत ते त्याच्याच रसात झाकून शिजवा, सुमारे 12 मिनिटे. एक-दोनदा ढवळा; शिजताना चिकनला पाणी सुटते.
seg.93ccca0c5178.back: Cook it covered in its own juices until no pink colour at all remains, about 12 minutes. Stir once or twice; while cooking the chicken releases water.

seg.32f3a3f56679.src: Uncover and cook on high, stirring, until the liquid has almost dried up, 3–4 minutes. Tip the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadai.
seg.32f3a3f56679.t: झाकण काढा आणि मोठ्या आचेवर ढवळत शिजवा, रस जवळजवळ आटेपर्यंत, 3–4 मिनिटे. चिकन ताटात काढा आणि कढई पुसून घ्या.
seg.32f3a3f56679.back: Remove the lid and cook on high heat while stirring, until the juices almost dry up, 3–4 minutes. Take the chicken out onto a plate and wipe the kadhai.

seg.f3e846aa4edd.src: Heat the oil in the kadai on medium heat.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.t: कढईत मध्यम आचेवर तेल गरम करा.
seg.f3e846aa4edd.back: Heat oil in the kadhai on medium heat.

seg.e210c9534a07.src: Fry the cashews in oil till golden; lift out. They take under a minute, so stir them all the time and lift them out with a slotted spoon.
seg.e210c9534a07.t: काजू तेलात सोनेरी होईपर्यंत तळा; बाहेर काढा. त्यांना एका मिनिटापेक्षा कमी वेळ लागतो, म्हणून सतत ढवळा आणि झाऱ्याने बाहेर काढा.
seg.e210c9534a07.back: Fry cashews in oil until golden; take out. They take less than a minute, so stir constantly and take out with a slotted spoon.

seg.09e282d2e36f.src: Add the onion, if using, and fry until golden. Fry the green chillies and curry leaves. Stand back; the leaves crackle and spit.
seg.09e282d2e36f.t: वापरत असाल तर कांदा घाला आणि सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता. हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता परता. थोडे लांब उभे राहा; पाने तडतडतात आणि उडतात.
seg.09e282d2e36f.back: If using, add onion and fry until golden. Fry green chillies and curry leaves. Stand a little away; the leaves crackle and spatter.

seg.1fae224eb27a.src: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high till dry and dark, then toss in the cashews. Keep tossing for 6–8 minutes, until the masala clings to the pieces and the edges turn dark and crisp.
seg.1fae224eb27a.t: चिकन आणि फ्राय मसाला घाला. कोरडे आणि गडद होईपर्यंत मोठ्या आचेवर परता, मग काजू घालून घोळवा. 6–8 मिनिटे परतत राहा, मसाला तुकड्यांना चिकटेपर्यंत आणि कडा गडद व कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत.
seg.1fae224eb27a.back: Add the chicken and fry masala. Fry on high heat until dry and dark, then add cashews and toss. Keep frying 6–8 minutes, until the masala sticks to the pieces and the edges become dark and crisp.

seg.0b62f402945c.src: Taste, add salt if needed, scatter the coriander leaves and serve hot.
seg.0b62f402945c.t: चाखून पाहा, लागल्यास मीठ घाला, कोथिंबीर भुरभुरा आणि गरम वाढा.
seg.0b62f402945c.back: Taste, add salt if needed, sprinkle coriander leaves and serve hot.

seg.349c72ce839a.src: Fry it on high heat at the end so the masala clings to every piece.
seg.349c72ce839a.t: शेवटी मोठ्या आचेवर परता, म्हणजे मसाला प्रत्येक तुकड्याला चिकटेल.
seg.349c72ce839a.back: At the end fry on high heat, so the masala sticks to every piece.

seg.d287ba2c2c11.src: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 tsp, or swap in Sannam chilli powder for the red colour with less fire.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.t: तेजा मिरची पावडर खूप तिखट असते. मध्यम तिखटपणासाठी 1 छोटा चमचा वापरा, किंवा कमी झणक्यासह लाल रंगासाठी त्याऐवजी सन्नम मिरची पावडर घाला.
seg.d287ba2c2c11.back: Teja chilli powder is very hot. For medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for red colour with less kick add Sannam chilli powder instead.

seg.a0ef9b138cd4.src: Cut the pieces small and even so they cook through at the same time and crisp up well in the fry.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.t: तुकडे लहान आणि सारख्या आकाराचे कापा, म्हणजे ते एकाच वेळी आतपर्यंत शिजतील आणि फ्रायमध्ये छान कुरकुरीत होतील.
seg.a0ef9b138cd4.back: Cut the pieces small and of the same size, so they cook through at the same time and become nicely crisp in the fry.

seg.d72b3c1c529a.src: Grind the fry masala just before you cook; the roasted spice smell is the soul of a good vepudu.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.t: फ्राय मसाला शिजवण्याच्या अगदी आधी वाटा; भाजलेल्या मसाल्याचा वास हाच चांगल्या वेपुडुचा आत्मा आहे.
seg.d72b3c1c529a.back: Grind the fry masala just before cooking; the smell of roasted masala is the very soul of good vepudu.

seg.62d6684e446e.src: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their juices for 18–20 minutes, until no pink remains near the bone.
seg.62d6684e446e.t: हाडासकट: हाडासकट 600 g लहान तुकडे वापरा आणि ते त्यांच्याच रसात 18–20 मिनिटे शिजवा, हाडाजवळ अजिबात गुलाबी रंग उरत नाही तोपर्यंत.
seg.62d6684e446e.back: Bone-in: use 600 g small bone-in pieces and cook them in their own juices 18–20 minutes, until no pink colour at all remains near the bone.

seg.6960fe7f3ff8.src: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tbsp grated dry coconut to the fry with the masala and toss until it browns.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.t: कोब्बरी वेपुडु: फ्रायमध्ये मसाल्यासोबत 3 मोठे चमचे किसलेले सुके खोबरे घाला आणि ते तपकिरी होईपर्यंत घोळवा.
seg.6960fe7f3ff8.back: Kobbari vepudu: add 3 tablespoons grated dry coconut with the masala in the fry and toss until it turns brown.

seg.afd92118eb80.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, then fry it the same way.
seg.afd92118eb80.t: मटण वेपुडु: 500 g बोनलेस मटण मॅरिनेड आणि ½ कप पाण्यासोबत प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये 5–6 शिट्ट्या करून शिजवा, मग त्याच पद्धतीने तळा.
seg.afd92118eb80.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles, then fry the same way.

seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.src: Serve hot as a side with rasam rice, pappu and rice or sambar rice, or on its own as a starter with sliced onion and lemon wedges.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.t: रसम-भात, पप्पु-भात किंवा सांबार-भातासोबत बाजूला गरम वाढा, किंवा नुसतेच स्टार्टर म्हणून चिरलेला कांदा आणि लिंबाच्या फोडींसोबत.
seg.2c4ab1a1a5de.back: Serve hot on the side with rasam-rice, pappu-rice or sambar-rice, or just as a starter with chopped onion and lemon wedges.

seg.b7598301bd86.src: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until steaming hot all the way through; it crisps up again.
seg.b7598301bd86.t: झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये 2 दिवसांपर्यंत ठेवा. गरम पॅनमध्ये तेलाचे काही थेंब घालून आतपर्यंत चांगले वाफाळते गरम होईपर्यंत पुन्हा गरम करा; ते परत कुरकुरीत होते.
seg.b7598301bd86.back: Keep covered in the fridge up to 2 days. Reheat in a hot pan with a few drops of oil until well steaming hot all the way through; it becomes crisp again.

seg.551573b4b443.src: What is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry in Andhra?
seg.551573b4b443.t: आंध्रात चिकन फ्राय आणि चिकन करी यात काय फरक आहे?
seg.551573b4b443.back: In Andhra what is the difference between chicken fry and chicken curry?

seg.dbeff7335e31.src: Vepudu is dry: the chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried until the masala coats it with no gravy. Kodi kura is a curry with an onion-tomato gravy for rice.
seg.dbeff7335e31.t: वेपुडु कोरडे असते: चिकन त्याच्याच रसात शिजवून, मग ग्रेव्ही न ठेवता मसाला त्याला लपेटेपर्यंत तळले जाते. कोडी कूरा ही भातासाठी कांदा-टोमॅटो ग्रेव्ही असलेली करी आहे.
seg.dbeff7335e31.back: Vepudu is dry: chicken is cooked in its own juices, then fried without keeping gravy until the masala coats it. Kodi koora is a curry with onion-tomato gravy for rice.

seg.439aacfe8e34.src: Should I use boneless or bone-in chicken for vepudu?
seg.439aacfe8e34.t: वेपुडुसाठी बोनलेस चिकन वापरावे की हाडासकट?
seg.439aacfe8e34.back: Should boneless or bone-in chicken be used for vepudu?

seg.982f470b118d.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need about 8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.982f470b118d.t: दोन्ही चालतात. बोनलेस लवकर शिजते आणि जास्त कुरकुरीत होते; हाडासकट लहान तुकड्यांना जास्त चव असते, पण त्यांना रसात सुमारे 8 मिनिटे जास्त लागतात.
seg.982f470b118d.back: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and gets crisper; small bone-in pieces have more flavour, but they take about 8 minutes more in the juices.

seg.ade697e78f9b.src: Cut open the thickest piece. The chicken is cooked when no pink remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juices run clear.
seg.ade697e78f9b.t: सर्वात जाड तुकडा कापून उघडा. मध्ये (किंवा हाडाजवळ) अजिबात गुलाबी रंग उरला नसेल आणि रस पारदर्शक येत असेल, तर चिकन शिजले आहे.
seg.ade697e78f9b.back: Cut open the thickest piece. If no pink colour at all remains in the middle (or near the bone) and the juice runs clear, the chicken is cooked.

seg.eddd3046275b.src: How do I make kodi vepudu less spicy?
seg.eddd3046275b.t: कोडी वेपुडु कमी तिखट कसे करावे?
seg.eddd3046275b.back: How to make kodi vepudu less hot?

seg.9b5459aec9d6.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder, or swap in Sannam chilli powder, and slit only 2 green chillies. The cashews and curry leaves keep the flavour full.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.t: 1 छोटा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर वापरा, किंवा त्याऐवजी सन्नम मिरची पावडर घाला, आणि फक्त 2 हिरव्या मिरच्या चिरा. काजू आणि कढीपत्त्यामुळे चव भरपूर राहते.
seg.9b5459aec9d6.back: Use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder, or add Sannam chilli powder instead, and slit only 2 green chillies. Because of cashews and curry leaves the flavour stays full.

seg.a00af5cf9954.src: కోడి వేపుడు · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra Chicken Fry) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.t: कोडी वेपुडु · कोडी वेपुडु (आंध्र चिकन फ्राय) | 1acrefarms
seg.a00af5cf9954.back: Kodi Vepudu · Kodi Vepudu (Andhra chicken fry) | 1acrefarms

seg.1af4fbb646e3.src: కోడి వేపుడు. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, fried dry with curry leaves, green chillies, a roasted masala and our cashews.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.t: कोडी वेपुडु. आंध्र चिकन फ्राय: तेजा मिरची पावडर आणि हळद पावडरमधले चिकन, कढीपत्ता, हिरव्या मिरच्या, भाजलेला मसाला आणि आमच्या काजूंसोबत कोरडे तळलेले.
seg.1af4fbb646e3.back: Kodi Vepudu. Andhra chicken fry: chicken in Teja chilli powder and turmeric powder, dry-fried with curry leaves, green chillies, roasted masala and our cashews.

seg.917dba1166ab.src: Kodi Vepudu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.917dba1166ab.t: कोडी वेपुडु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.917dba1166ab.back: Kodi Vepudu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.f9771e2222df.src: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed with a crackling tempering of peanuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard seeds, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. It is the rice packed for train journeys, school tiffin boxes and temple days, and it is made in big batches for festivals and pujas.
seg.f9771e2222df.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा म्हणजे आंध्रातल्या घरांचा चमकदार पिवळा लिंबू भात: शिजलेला भात शेंगदाणे, चणा डाळ, उडीद डाळ, मोहरी, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्त्याच्या तडतडत्या फोडणीत घोळवून, मग लिंबाच्या रसाने आंबट केलेला. रेल्वे प्रवासासाठी, शाळेच्या डब्यासाठी आणि देवळात जायच्या दिवशी हाच भात बांधला जातो, आणि सण आणि पूजांसाठी तो मोठ्या प्रमाणात केला जातो.
seg.f9771e2222df.back: Nimmakaya pulihora is the bright yellow lemon rice of Andhra homes: cooked rice tossed in a crackling tempering of groundnuts, chana dal, urad dal, mustard, green chillies and curry leaves, then soured with lemon juice. This same rice is packed for train journeys, for the school lunch box and for days of going to the temple, and it is made in large quantity for festivals and pujas.

seg.ac569e0882d5.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the hot oil for a few seconds, which turns every grain an even golden yellow and takes away its raw edge. This recipe serves 4.
seg.ac569e0882d5.t: आमची हळद पावडर गरम तेलात काही सेकंद जाते, त्यामुळे प्रत्येक दाणा एकसारखा सोनेरी पिवळा होतो आणि तिचा कच्चेपणा जातो. या पाककृतीत 4 जणांसाठी होतो.
seg.ac569e0882d5.back: Our turmeric powder goes into hot oil for a few seconds, so every grain becomes an even golden yellow and its rawness goes. This recipe makes enough for 4 people.

seg.d194bee0cc5e.src: Total includes cooking the rice and a 15-minute rest so the flavours settle.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.t: एकूण वेळेत भात शिजवणे आणि चवी स्थिरावण्यासाठी 15 मिनिटे ठेवणेही धरले आहे.
seg.d194bee0cc5e.back: The total time also counts cooking the rice and keeping it 15 minutes for the flavours to settle.

seg.1cfa4342f462.src: Fry peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and hing, then toss with cooled rice, salt and lemon juice.
seg.1cfa4342f462.t: शेंगदाणे, डाळी, मोहरी, मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता तेलात परता, हळद पावडर आणि हिंग घाला, मग थंड झालेल्या भातात मीठ आणि लिंबाच्या रसासोबत घोळवा.
seg.1cfa4342f462.back: Fry groundnuts, dals, mustard, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric powder and asafoetida, then toss into cooled rice with salt and lemon juice.

seg.2561142fed2c.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; gives about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.t: 1 कप तांदूळ ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, सुमारे 200 g; शिजल्यावर सुमारे 3 कप होतो⟦/1⟧
seg.2561142fed2c.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; when cooked makes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06ba75699134.src: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little firm, grains separate⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.t: 3 कप शिजलेला भात ⟦1⟧थोडा मोकळा शिजवलेला, दाणे सुटे⟦/1⟧
seg.06ba75699134.back: 3 cups cooked rice ⟦1⟧cooked a little loose, grains separate⟦/1⟧

seg.fbba93c11bc9.src: 3 tbsp lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.t: 3 मोठे चमचे लिंबाचा रस ⟦1⟧सुमारे 2 लिंबांचा; चवीनुसार जास्त घाला⟦/1⟧
seg.fbba93c11bc9.back: 3 tablespoons lemon juice ⟦1⟧from about 2 lemons; add more to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.e254f20f8f14.src: 3 tbsp oil ⟦1⟧groundnut oil is the usual choice⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.t: 3 मोठे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧सहसा शेंगदाणा तेल वापरतात⟦/1⟧
seg.e254f20f8f14.back: 3 tablespoons oil ⟦1⟧usually groundnut oil is used⟦/1⟧

seg.bc63d9715c03.src: Wash the rice and cook it with 2 cups of water until just done, so the grains stay separate. You need about 3 cups of cooked rice.
seg.bc63d9715c03.t: तांदूळ धुवा आणि 2 कप पाण्यात जेमतेम शिजेपर्यंत शिजवा, म्हणजे दाणे सुटे राहतील. सुमारे 3 कप शिजलेला भात लागेल.
seg.bc63d9715c03.back: Wash the rice and cook in 2 cups water until just cooked, so the grains stay separate. You will need about 3 cups cooked rice.

seg.adb2b75edafc.src: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add the salt. Fluff it with a fork and let it sit about 10 minutes until warm, not hot, so the grains do not break when mixed.
seg.adb2b75edafc.t: शिजलेला भात थंड होण्यासाठी ताटात पसरा; मीठ घाला. काट्याने मोकळा करा आणि सुमारे 10 मिनिटे राहू द्या, कोमट होईपर्यंत, गरम नाही, म्हणजे मिसळताना दाणे मोडणार नाहीत.
seg.adb2b75edafc.back: Spread the cooked rice on a plate to cool; add salt. Loosen with a fork and let it stay about 10 minutes, until lukewarm, not hot, so the grains do not break while mixing.

seg.e05322a3ed24.src: Heat the oil; fry the peanuts, dals, mustard seeds, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the peanuts on medium heat and fry them about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.
seg.e05322a3ed24.t: तेल गरम करा; शेंगदाणे, डाळी, मोहरी, मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता परता. सुरुवात मध्यम आचेवर शेंगदाण्यांनी करा आणि ते तडतडेपर्यंत आणि साली गडद होईपर्यंत सुमारे 2 मिनिटे परता.
seg.e05322a3ed24.back: Heat oil; fry groundnuts, dals, mustard, chillies and curry leaves. Start with the groundnuts on medium heat and fry about 2 minutes until they crackle and the skins darken.

seg.542a4fea7b18.src: Add the chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.
seg.542a4fea7b18.t: चणा डाळ आणि उडीद डाळ घाला आणि हलकी सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता, सुमारे 1 मिनिट.
seg.542a4fea7b18.back: Add chana dal and urad dal and fry until light golden, about 1 minute.

seg.502483d7a042.src: Add the mustard seeds and let them splutter, then add the dry red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves turn crisp.
seg.502483d7a042.t: मोहरी घाला आणि तडतडू द्या, मग सुक्या लाल मिरच्या, हिरव्या मिरच्या, आलं आणि कढीपत्ता घाला आणि पाने कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत काही सेकंद परता.
seg.502483d7a042.back: Add mustard and let it crackle, then add dried red chillies, green chillies, ginger and curry leaves and fry a few seconds until the leaves are crisp.

seg.6e856356980b.src: Stir in the turmeric powder and hing; switch off. Stir for 5–10 seconds only so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.
seg.6e856356980b.t: हळद पावडर आणि हिंग ढवळून घाला; आच बंद करा. फक्त 5–10 सेकंद ढवळा, म्हणजे हळद गरम तेलात करपल्याशिवाय शिजेल.
seg.6e856356980b.back: Stir in turmeric powder and asafoetida; turn off the heat. Stir only 5–10 seconds, so the turmeric cooks in the hot oil without burning.

seg.dd6ccaf923d8.src: Pour over the rice, add the lemon juice and mix gently. Use your fingers or a flat spatula and lift the rice from below so every grain turns yellow without turning mushy.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.t: भातावर ओता, लिंबाचा रस घाला आणि हलक्या हाताने मिसळा. बोटांनी किंवा सपाट उलथन्याने भात खालून वर उचलत मिसळा, म्हणजे प्रत्येक दाणा पिवळा होईल पण भात गिचका होणार नाही.
seg.dd6ccaf923d8.back: Pour over the rice, add lemon juice and mix gently. Mix with fingers or a flat spatula lifting the rice from below, so every grain turns yellow but the rice does not become mushy.

seg.1bfc2c04d40e.src: Taste and add more salt or lemon juice if needed. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, as the flavour softens on standing.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.t: चाखून पाहा आणि लागल्यास आणखी मीठ किंवा लिंबाचा रस घाला. भात स्पष्टपणे आंबट आणि खारट लागायला हवा, कारण ठेवल्यावर चव सौम्य होते.
seg.1bfc2c04d40e.back: Taste and if needed add more salt or lemon juice. The rice should taste clearly sour and salty, because on keeping the flavour becomes milder.

seg.8cea6688d0fb.src: Cover and rest the pulihora for 15 minutes before serving so the rice takes in the lemon and tempering.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.t: वाढण्याआधी पुलिहोरा झाकून 15 मिनिटे ठेवा, म्हणजे भातात लिंबू आणि फोडणी मुरेल.
seg.8cea6688d0fb.back: Before serving keep the pulihora covered 15 minutes, so the lemon and tempering soak into the rice.

seg.c1a7043ce357.src: Add the lemon juice off the heat so it stays sharp. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.
seg.c1a7043ce357.t: लिंबाचा रस आचेपासून दूर घाला, म्हणजे तो आंबटपणा टिकेल. शिजवलेला लिंबाचा रस कडू होतो.
seg.c1a7043ce357.back: Add the lemon juice away from the heat, so the sourness stays. Cooked lemon juice turns bitter.

seg.b634a4257b6c.src: Cook the rice slightly firm and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice turns pasty.
seg.b634a4257b6c.t: भात थोडा मोकळा शिजवा आणि मिसळण्याआधी थंड होऊ द्या; गरम, मऊ भात गिचका होतो.
seg.b634a4257b6c.back: Cook the rice a little loose and let it cool before mixing; hot, soft rice becomes mushy.

seg.a1d93274ea3f.src: Keep the turmeric powder in the oil for just a few seconds; burnt turmeric gives a dark colour and a bitter taste.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.t: हळद पावडर तेलात फक्त काही सेकंदच ठेवा; करपलेल्या हळदीमुळे रंग गडद होतो आणि चव कडू लागते.
seg.a1d93274ea3f.back: Keep turmeric powder in the oil only a few seconds; because of burnt turmeric the colour becomes dark and the taste bitter.

seg.747474140bbf.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as the grains are already firm and separate.
seg.747474140bbf.t: सकाळचा उरलेला भात छान चालतो, कारण त्याचे दाणे आधीच घट्ट आणि सुटे असतात.
seg.747474140bbf.back: Leftover morning rice works nicely, because its grains are already firm and separate.

seg.7a379d805448.src: Cashews: fry 10 cashew halves with the peanuts for a festive pulihora.
seg.7a379d805448.t: काजू: सणासाठीच्या पुलिहोरासाठी शेंगदाण्यांसोबत काजूचे 10 अर्धे तुकडे तळा.
seg.7a379d805448.back: Cashews: for festival pulihora fry 10 cashew halves with the groundnuts.

seg.be93899ec308.src: Mamidikaya pulihora: in place of lemon juice, mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.
seg.be93899ec308.t: मामिडिकाया पुलिहोरा: लिंबाच्या रसाऐवजी फोडणीसोबत 1 कप किसलेली कैरी मिसळा.
seg.be93899ec308.back: Mamidikaya pulihora: instead of lemon juice mix in 1 cup grated raw mango with the tempering.

seg.867dba923c04.src: Grated coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the lemon juice for a milder rice.
seg.867dba923c04.t: किसलेले खोबरे: जास्त सौम्य भातासाठी लिंबाच्या रसासोबत 2 मोठे चमचे किसलेले खोबरे घाला.
seg.867dba923c04.back: Grated coconut: for a milder rice add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the lemon juice.

seg.88b87529b506.src: Serve at room temperature with curd, a pickle or appadams. It is a classic tiffin-box and travel rice.
seg.88b87529b506.t: खोलीच्या तापमानाला दही, लोणचे किंवा पापडासोबत वाढा. डब्यासाठी आणि प्रवासासाठी हा नेहमीचा भात आहे.
seg.88b87529b506.back: Serve at room temperature with curd, pickle or papad. This is the usual rice for the lunch box and for travel.

seg.9791f1c7a8e4.src: It keeps well at room temperature for about 6 hours, which is why it travels. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.t: तो खोलीच्या तापमानाला सुमारे 6 तास चांगला राहतो, म्हणूनच प्रवासात नेला जातो. उरलेला झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि एका दिवसात खा.
seg.9791f1c7a8e4.back: It stays good at room temperature about 6 hours, that is why it is taken on travel. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within a day.

seg.c12ab7274709.src: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?
seg.c12ab7274709.t: माझा लिंबू भात कडू का लागतो?
seg.c12ab7274709.back: Why does my lemon rice taste bitter?

seg.44b56d19b9fb.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Switch off the stove before the turmeric goes in, and add the lemon juice only to the rice, off the heat.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.t: एकतर लिंबाचा रस शिजला गेला, किंवा हळद तेलात करपली. हळद घालण्याआधी गॅस बंद करा, आणि लिंबाचा रस फक्त भातातच, आचेपासून दूर घाला.
seg.44b56d19b9fb.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Turn off the gas before adding turmeric, and add lemon juice only into the rice, away from the heat.

seg.69e4bfb93ba8.src: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.t: पुलिहोरा आणि लिंबू भात यात काय फरक आहे?
seg.69e4bfb93ba8.back: What is the difference between pulihora and lemon rice?

seg.f2f993f1b94b.src: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind paste; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon version, quicker to make and lighter in colour.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.t: पुलिहोरा हे आंबट केलेल्या भाताचे तेलुगु नाव आहे. चिंतपंडु पुलिहोरा चिंचेच्या कोळाने आंबट केला जातो; निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा हा लिंबाचा प्रकार, करायला लवकर होणारा आणि रंगाने फिकट.
seg.f2f993f1b94b.back: Pulihora is the Telugu name for soured rice. Chintapandu pulihora is soured with tamarind pulp; nimmakaya pulihora is the lemon kind, quicker to make and paler in colour.

seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.src: How do I stop lemon rice from getting mushy?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.t: लिंबू भात गिचका होऊ नये म्हणून काय करावे?
seg.1ab5dcf1d80a.back: What to do so lemon rice does not get mushy?

seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.src: Cook the rice a little firm with less water, cool it on a plate, and mix gently by lifting from below instead of pressing.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.t: भात कमी पाण्यात थोडा मोकळा शिजवा, ताटात थंड करा, आणि दाबण्याऐवजी खालून वर उचलत हलक्या हाताने मिसळा.
seg.8a0fad2d4bfd.back: Cook the rice a little loose in less water, cool on a plate, and mix gently lifting from below instead of pressing.

seg.dd00224f5f94.src: How much lemon juice for 3 cups of rice?
seg.dd00224f5f94.back: How much lemon juice for 3 cups rice?

seg.50f8efabb87e.src: About 3 tbsp, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add it slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.
seg.50f8efabb87e.t: सुमारे 3 मोठे चमचे, 2 मध्यम लिंबांचा रस. हळूहळू घाला आणि चाखून पाहा, कारण लिंबांचा आंबटपणा कमी-जास्त असतो.
seg.50f8efabb87e.back: About 3 tablespoons, the juice of 2 medium lemons. Add slowly and taste, because lemons vary in sourness.

seg.2d3c4d5f7608.src: నిమ్మకాయ పులిహోర. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed with a peanut and dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा. आंध्रचा लिंबू भात: थंड झालेला भात शेंगदाणे-डाळीची फोडणी, आमची हळद पावडर आणि लिंबाच्या रसात घोळवलेला. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरे.
seg.2d3c4d5f7608.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora. Andhra lemon rice: cooled rice tossed in a groundnut-dal tempering, our turmeric powder and lemon juice. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.5f0282fcd0a8.src: Nimmakaya Pulihora: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.t: निम्मकाया पुलिहोरा: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.5f0282fcd0a8.back: Nimmakaya Pulihora: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.bea68001f34a.back: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Pasupu Annam · Haldi wale chawal [Hindi words]

seg.8922ef1e3767.src: Pasupu annam is plain rice turned bright yellow with turmeric and tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard seeds, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, with fried cashews on top. Andhra homes make it for lunch boxes, for quick weekday meals and as a prasadam on puja days, often with the morning's leftover rice.
seg.8922ef1e3767.t: पसुपु अन्नम म्हणजे हळदीने चमकदार पिवळा केलेला साधा भात, मोहरी, चणा डाळ, कढीपत्ता आणि हिरव्या मिरच्यांच्या तडतडत्या फोडणीत घोळवलेला, वरून तळलेले काजू. आंध्रातली घरे तो डब्यासाठी, रोजच्या दिवशी पटकन जेवणासाठी आणि पूजेच्या दिवशी प्रसाद म्हणून करतात, अनेकदा सकाळच्या उरलेल्या भाताचा.
seg.8922ef1e3767.back: Pasupu annam is plain rice made bright yellow with turmeric, tossed in a crackling tempering of mustard, chana dal, curry leaves and green chillies, topped with fried cashews. Andhra homes make it for the lunch box, for a quick meal on everyday days and as prasad on puja days, often from leftover morning rice.

seg.510252086556.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) gives the rice its deep yellow colour and an earthy turmeric smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4. Whole cashews (Jeedipappu) fried in the same oil add the crunch.
seg.510252086556.t: आमच्या डोंगरी हळद पावडरमुळे (कोंडा पसुपु) भाताला गडद पिवळा रंग आणि हळदीचा मातीसारखा वास येतो, त्यामुळे 4 जणांसाठी अर्धा छोटा चमचा पुरतो. त्याच तेलात तळलेले अख्खे काजू (जीडिपप्पु) कुरकुरीतपणा आणतात.
seg.510252086556.back: Because of our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) the rice gets a deep yellow colour and turmeric's earthy smell, so half a teaspoon is enough for 4 people. Whole cashews (jeedipappu) fried in the same oil bring crunch.

seg.38badedc8d11.src: Total includes about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.
seg.38badedc8d11.t: एकूण वेळेत शिजलेला भात थंड होण्याची सुमारे 15 मिनिटे धरली आहेत.
seg.38badedc8d11.back: The total time counts about 15 minutes for the cooked rice to cool.

seg.8ad70ebff643.src: Cook rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss in the rice.
seg.8ad70ebff643.t: भात शिजवा आणि थंड होऊ द्या. काजू, मोहरी, चणा डाळ, मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता तेलात परता, डोंगरी हळद पावडर घाला आणि त्यात भात घोळवा.
seg.8ad70ebff643.back: Cook the rice and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add hill turmeric powder and toss the rice in it.

seg.bc286f12f1ba.src: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧sona masoori, about 200 g; makes about 3 cups cooked⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.t: 1 कप तांदूळ ⟦1⟧सोना मसूरी, सुमारे 200 g; शिजल्यावर सुमारे 3 कप होतो⟦/1⟧
seg.bc286f12f1ba.back: 1 cup rice ⟦1⟧Sona Masoori, about 200 g; when cooked makes about 3 cups⟦/1⟧

seg.06cd9d581aec.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.t: ½ छोटा चमचा डोंगरी हळद पावडर ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु⟦/1⟧
seg.06cd9d581aec.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu⟦/1⟧

seg.399f19de4e13.src: 1 tbsp ghee (optional) ⟦1⟧stirred in at the end⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.t: 1 मोठा चमचा तूप (हवे असल्यास) ⟦1⟧शेवटी ढवळून घालण्यासाठी⟦/1⟧
seg.399f19de4e13.back: 1 tablespoon ghee (if wanted) ⟦1⟧for stirring in at the end⟦/1⟧

seg.afe3b0737680.back: Also turns out nice with ⟦1⟧turmeric powder⟦/1⟧.

seg.53fcfe53b909.src: Wash the rice in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.53fcfe53b909.back: Wash the rice in 2–3 waters and drain.

seg.cdcf37be99e8.src: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread it on a plate to cool. Use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice in a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles), and fluff it with a fork before spreading it out.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.t: दाणे सुटे राहतील असा भात शिजवा, मग थंड होण्यासाठी ताटात पसरा. पातेल्यात किंवा प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये (2 शिट्ट्या) 1 कप तांदळाला 2 कप पाणी वापरा, आणि पसरण्याआधी काट्याने मोकळा करा.
seg.cdcf37be99e8.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate, then spread on a plate to cool. In a pot or pressure cooker (2 whistles) use 2 cups water to 1 cup rice, and loosen with a fork before spreading.

seg.296995189451.src: Let the rice cool for about 15 minutes until it is just warm. Sprinkle the salt over it.
seg.296995189451.t: भात सुमारे 15 मिनिटे थंड होऊ द्या, जेमतेम कोमट होईपर्यंत. त्यावर मीठ भुरभुरा.
seg.296995189451.back: Let the rice cool about 15 minutes, until just lukewarm. Sprinkle salt over it.

seg.48839bd22983.src: Heat the oil in a wide kadai on medium heat.
seg.48839bd22983.t: रुंद कढईत मध्यम आचेवर तेल गरम करा.
seg.48839bd22983.back: Heat oil in a wide kadhai on medium heat.

seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.src: Fry the cashews in the oil till golden; lift out. Add mustard seeds and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.t: काजू तेलात सोनेरी होईपर्यंत तळा; बाहेर काढा. मोहरी आणि चणा डाळ घाला. काजू ताटात ठेवा; ते सुमारे 1 मिनिटात सोनेरी होतात.
seg.bdc1a0df8ffc.back: Fry cashews in oil until golden; take out. Add mustard and chana dal. Keep the cashews on a plate; they turn golden in about 1 minute.

seg.0729c6efc94a.src: Once the mustard seeds splutter, add the urad dal and the dried red chillies and stir.
seg.0729c6efc94a.t: मोहरी तडतडली की उडीद डाळ आणि सुक्या लाल मिरच्या घालून ढवळा.
seg.0729c6efc94a.back: When the mustard crackles add urad dal and dried red chillies and stir.

seg.2688182af66a.src: When the dal turns golden, add the chillies and curry leaves, then the turmeric on low heat. Add the ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric for only 5–10 seconds.
seg.2688182af66a.t: डाळ सोनेरी झाली की मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता घाला, मग मंद आचेवर हळद. कढीपत्त्यासोबत आलं आणि हिंग घाला, आणि हळद फक्त 5–10 सेकंद ढवळा.
seg.2688182af66a.back: When the dal is golden add chillies and curry leaves, then turmeric on low heat. Add ginger and asafoetida with the curry leaves, and stir the turmeric only 5–10 seconds.

seg.59fd9b87153d.src: Switch off the heat straight away so the turmeric does not burn.
seg.59fd9b87153d.t: हळद करपू नये म्हणून लगेच आच बंद करा.
seg.59fd9b87153d.back: Turn off the heat immediately so the turmeric does not burn.

seg.15dc85e42ca1.src: Tip in the rice, cashews and salt and toss gently till evenly yellow. Use a flat spatula and lift and fold rather than pressing down, so the grains stay whole.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.t: भात, काजू आणि मीठ घाला आणि सगळीकडे सारखा पिवळा होईपर्यंत हलक्या हाताने घोळवा. सपाट उलथने वापरा आणि खाली दाबण्याऐवजी उचलून-उलटून मिसळा, म्हणजे दाणे अख्खे राहतील.
seg.15dc85e42ca1.back: Add rice, cashews and salt and toss gently until evenly yellow everywhere. Use a flat spatula and mix by lifting and turning instead of pressing down, so the grains stay whole.

seg.b005e5771235.src: Taste for salt, stir in the ghee if using, cover and leave for 5 minutes before serving so the rice takes on the tempering.
seg.b005e5771235.t: मीठ चाखून पाहा, वापरत असाल तर तूप ढवळून घाला, झाकून वाढण्याआधी 5 मिनिटे ठेवा, म्हणजे भातात फोडणी मुरेल.
seg.b005e5771235.back: Taste for salt, stir in ghee if using, cover and keep 5 minutes before serving, so the tempering soaks into the rice.

seg.9bce1ed4dbee.src: Spread the rice to cool first so the grains do not break.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.t: आधी भात पसरून थंड करा, म्हणजे दाणे मोडणार नाहीत.
seg.9bce1ed4dbee.back: First spread and cool the rice, so the grains do not break.

seg.1f9a348f8750.src: Add the turmeric on low heat and stir for only a few seconds; burnt turmeric turns the rice bitter.
seg.1f9a348f8750.t: हळद मंद आचेवर घाला आणि फक्त काही सेकंद ढवळा; करपलेल्या हळदीमुळे भात कडू होतो.
seg.1f9a348f8750.back: Add turmeric on low heat and stir only a few seconds; because of burnt turmeric the rice turns bitter.

seg.394d01a50207.src: Hill turmeric powder colours strongly; start with ½ tsp for 1 cup of rice and add a pinch more only if you want a deeper yellow.
seg.394d01a50207.t: डोंगरी हळद पावडरने रंग गडद येतो; 1 कप तांदळासाठी ½ छोट्या चमच्याने सुरुवात करा आणि जास्त गडद पिवळा हवा असेल तरच आणखी चिमूटभर घाला.
seg.394d01a50207.back: Hill turmeric powder gives a deep colour; for 1 cup rice start with ½ teaspoon and add another pinch only if you want a deeper yellow.

seg.505872469eb9.src: Leftover rice from the morning works well, as long as the grains are separate.
seg.505872469eb9.t: सकाळचा उरलेला भात छान चालतो, फक्त दाणे सुटे असायला हवेत.
seg.505872469eb9.back: Leftover morning rice works nicely, only the grains should be separate.

seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.src: Turmeric powder: our everyday Pasupu turmeric powder works the same way; use the same ½ tsp.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.t: हळद पावडर: आमची रोजची पसुपु हळद पावडरही अशीच चालते; तेवढाच ½ छोटा चमचा वापरा.
seg.ab1b24f9cf3d.back: Turmeric powder: our everyday pasupu turmeric powder also works the same way; use the same ½ teaspoon.

seg.302f50dc74c9.src: Peanuts: fry 2 tbsp raw peanuts in the oil before the cashews for extra crunch.
seg.302f50dc74c9.t: शेंगदाणे: जास्त कुरकुरीतपणासाठी काजूआधी 2 मोठे चमचे कच्चे शेंगदाणे तेलात तळा.
seg.302f50dc74c9.back: Groundnuts: for more crunch fry 2 tablespoons raw groundnuts in the oil before the cashews.

seg.551f49339b3d.src: Lemon: squeeze in the juice of half a lemon with the rice for a tangy, pulihora-style rice.
seg.551f49339b3d.t: लिंबू: चटपटीत, पुलिहोरासारख्या भातासाठी भातासोबत अर्ध्या लिंबाचा रस पिळा.
seg.551f49339b3d.back: Lemon: for a tangy, pulihora-like rice squeeze half a lemon's juice with the rice.

seg.6b9e9c07efba.src: Coconut: toss in 2 tbsp grated coconut along with the rice.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.t: खोबरे: भातासोबत 2 मोठे चमचे किसलेले खोबरे घालून घोळवा.
seg.6b9e9c07efba.back: Coconut: add 2 tablespoons grated coconut with the rice and toss.

seg.d541a1d237fc.src: Serve warm or at room temperature with curd, appadalu or a dry potato fry. It also packs well for lunch boxes and travel.
seg.d541a1d237fc.t: कोमट किंवा खोलीच्या तापमानाला दही, पापड (अप्पडालु) किंवा बटाट्याच्या कोरड्या भाजीसोबत वाढा. डब्यासाठी आणि प्रवासासाठीही तो छान बांधता येतो.
seg.d541a1d237fc.back: Serve lukewarm or at room temperature with curd, papad (appadalu) or dry potato vegetable. It also packs nicely for the lunch box and travel.

seg.db97e1ae49fa.src: Best eaten the same day. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and warm them with a sprinkle of water.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.t: त्याच दिवशी खाणे सर्वात छान. उरलेला झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये 1 दिवसापर्यंत ठेवा आणि थोडे पाणी शिंपडून गरम करा.
seg.db97e1ae49fa.back: Eating it the same day is best. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge up to 1 day and heat with a little water sprinkled.

seg.54acb7b11b4c.src: How do you make pasupu annam?

seg.d99d12f26e71.src: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard seeds, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss in the rice with salt.
seg.d99d12f26e71.t: दाणे सुटे राहतील असा भात शिजवा आणि थंड होऊ द्या. काजू, मोहरी, चणा डाळ, मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता तेलात परता, मंद आचेवर काही सेकंद हळद घाला, मग मिठासोबत भात घोळवा.
seg.d99d12f26e71.back: Cook the rice so the grains stay separate and let it cool. Fry cashews, mustard, chana dal, chillies and curry leaves in oil, add turmeric on low heat for a few seconds, then toss the rice with salt.

seg.a4a87b4f7d63.src: How much turmeric powder goes into turmeric rice?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.t: हळदीच्या भातात किती हळद पावडर घालावी?
seg.a4a87b4f7d63.back: How much turmeric powder in turmeric rice?

seg.aa37527cdcfb.src: About ½ tsp for 1 cup of raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder colours strongly, so start with less and add a pinch more if needed.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.t: 1 कप कच्च्या तांदळासाठी (सुमारे 3 कप शिजलेला) सुमारे ½ छोटा चमचा. डोंगरी हळद पावडरने रंग गडद येतो, म्हणून कमीने सुरुवात करा आणि लागल्यास आणखी चिमूटभर घाला.
seg.aa37527cdcfb.back: About ½ teaspoon for 1 cup raw rice (about 3 cups cooked). Hill turmeric powder gives a deep colour, so start with less and add another pinch if needed.

seg.3d200fb0e6fc.src: Why is my turmeric rice bitter?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.t: माझा हळदीचा भात कडू का लागतो?
seg.3d200fb0e6fc.back: Why does my turmeric rice taste bitter?

seg.2c9da3559a42.src: The turmeric burnt in the hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir for only a few seconds and switch off before tipping in the rice.
seg.2c9da3559a42.t: गरम तेलात हळद करपली, किंवा जास्त पडली. ती मंद आचेवर घाला, फक्त काही सेकंद ढवळा आणि भात घालण्याआधी आच बंद करा.
seg.2c9da3559a42.back: The turmeric burnt in hot oil, or too much went in. Add it on low heat, stir only a few seconds and turn off the heat before adding rice.

seg.36ca370ac0d9.src: Can I make pasupu annam with leftover rice?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.t: उरलेल्या भाताचा पसुपु अन्नम करता येईल का?
seg.36ca370ac0d9.back: Can pasupu annam be made from leftover rice?

seg.71df75edcd26.src: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works well. Break up any lumps with your fingers before tossing it in the tempering.
seg.71df75edcd26.t: हो. सुटे दाणे असलेला उरलेला भात छान चालतो. फोडणीत घोळवण्याआधी गुठळ्या बोटांनी मोकळ्या करा.
seg.71df75edcd26.back: Yes. Leftover rice with separate grains works nicely. Loosen lumps with fingers before tossing into the tempering.

seg.720281a9dc26.src: పసుపు అన్నం. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a mustard, chana dal and curry leaf tempering with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. Serves 4.
seg.720281a9dc26.t: पसुपु अन्नम. पसुपु अन्नम, आंध्रचा हळदीचा भात: शिजलेला भात मोहरी, चणा डाळ आणि कढीपत्त्याच्या फोडणीत डोंगरी हळद पावडर आणि तळलेल्या काजूंसोबत घोळवलेला. 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.720281a9dc26.back: Pasupu Annam. Pasupu annam, Andhra turmeric rice: cooked rice tossed in a tempering of mustard, chana dal and curry leaves with hill turmeric powder and fried cashews. For 4 people.

seg.a5bf108c0e27.src: Pasupu Annam: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.a5bf108c0e27.t: पसुपु अन्नम: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.a5bf108c0e27.back: Pasupu Annam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.ed1a4a430aee.t: ½ छोटा चमचा डोंगरी हळद पावडर

seg.cc1333072822.src: Ragi java is a pourable porridge of ragi flour cooked in water, a daily drink in many Andhra and Rayalaseema homes. The salted version is made with buttermilk; this sweet one is loosened with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and it is drunk warm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.
seg.cc1333072822.t: रागी जावा म्हणजे पाण्यात शिजवलेल्या नाचणीच्या पिठाची ओतता येईल अशी पातळ पेज, आंध्र आणि रायलसीमेतल्या अनेक घरांत रोज प्यायली जाते. खारट प्रकार ताकाने करतात; हा गोड प्रकार दुधाने पातळ करून गुळाने गोड केला जातो, आणि न्याहारीला किंवा संध्याकाळी स्टीलच्या टंबलरमधून कोमट प्यायला जातो.
seg.cc1333072822.back: Ragi java is a thin, pourable porridge of nachni flour cooked in water, drunk daily in many homes of Andhra and Rayalaseema. The salty kind is made with buttermilk; this sweet kind is thinned with milk and sweetened with jaggery, and drunk lukewarm from a steel tumbler at breakfast or in the evening.

seg.b29ec96bcd5c.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery suits the earthy taste of ragi and gives the java a toffee-brown colour. It takes about 15 minutes from start to finish. This recipe serves 2.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.t: आमचा ताटि बेल्लम ताडाचा गूळ नाचणीच्या मातीसारख्या चवीला शोभतो आणि जावाला टॉफीसारखा तपकिरी रंग देतो. सुरुवातीपासून शेवटपर्यंत सुमारे 15 मिनिटे लागतात. या पाककृतीत 2 जणांसाठी होते.
seg.b29ec96bcd5c.back: Our tati bellam palm jaggery suits nachni's earthy taste and gives the java a toffee-like brown colour. Start to finish takes about 15 minutes. This recipe makes enough for 2 people.

seg.f65620e4f5c4.src: Total includes the 2-minute rest before the jaggery goes in.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.t: एकूण वेळेत गूळ घालण्याआधी 2 मिनिटे ठेवण्याचा वेळही धरला आहे.
seg.f65620e4f5c4.back: The total time also counts the time of keeping 2 minutes before adding jaggery.

seg.f0a8282433d4.src: Whisk ragi flour into water, cook it in boiling water till thick and glossy, then add milk. Off the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.
seg.f0a8282433d4.t: नाचणीचे पीठ पाण्यात फेटा, उकळत्या पाण्यात घट्ट आणि चकचकीत होईपर्यंत शिजवा, मग दूध घाला. आचेपासून दूर, ताडाचा गूळ आणि वेलची ढवळून घाला.
seg.f0a8282433d4.back: Whisk nachni flour in water, cook in boiling water until thick and glossy, then add milk. Away from the heat, stir in palm jaggery and cardamom.

seg.41bd564147d7.src: ¼ cup ragi flour ⟦1⟧finger millet flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.t: ¼ कप नाचणीचे पीठ ⟦1⟧रागी पीठ, सुमारे 35 g⟦/1⟧
seg.41bd564147d7.back: ¼ cup nachni flour ⟦1⟧ragi flour, about 35 g⟦/1⟧

seg.d9504b3b8592.src: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.t: 2 कप पाणी ⟦1⟧1 कप पीठ मिसळायला, 1 कप उकळायला⟦/1⟧
seg.d9504b3b8592.back: 2 cups water ⟦1⟧1 cup to mix the flour, 1 cup to boil⟦/1⟧

seg.0570314748ee.src: 3 tbsp grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; add a spoon more if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.t: 3 मोठे चमचे किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧सुमारे 30 g; जास्त गोड आवडत असेल तर आणखी एक चमचा⟦/1⟧
seg.0570314748ee.back: 3 tablespoons grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 30 g; one more spoon if you like it sweeter⟦/1⟧

seg.2b7de8d37fd0.src: Put the ragi flour in a bowl.
seg.2b7de8d37fd0.back: Take the nachni flour in a bowl.

seg.fce6db4082ef.src: Whisk the ragi flour into 1 cup water till smooth, with no lumps. Use a whisk or a fork and break up any lumps against the side of the bowl.
seg.fce6db4082ef.t: नाचणीचे पीठ 1 कप पाण्यात गुळगुळीत होईपर्यंत फेटा, गुठळी राहू नये. फेटणी किंवा काटा वापरा आणि गुठळ्या वाडग्याच्या कडेवर दाबून मोडा.
seg.fce6db4082ef.back: Whisk the nachni flour in 1 cup water until smooth, no lumps should remain. Use a whisk or fork and break lumps by pressing them against the side of the bowl.

seg.ac6b0e0e7003.src: Pour the remaining 1 cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan and set it on medium heat.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.t: उरलेले 1 कप पाणी जाड बुडाच्या पातेल्यात ओता आणि मध्यम आचेवर ठेवा.
seg.ac6b0e0e7003.back: Pour the remaining 1 cup water into a heavy-bottomed pot and keep on medium heat.

seg.ec55acf2b96a.src: Boil the other cup of water, pour in the ragi and stir on low heat till thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mix once more before pouring, as the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.t: दुसरा कप पाणी उकळा, त्यात नाचणीचे मिश्रण ओता आणि घट्ट व चकचकीत होईपर्यंत मंद आचेवर ढवळा, 6–8 मिनिटे. ओतण्याआधी मिश्रण पुन्हा एकदा ढवळा, कारण पीठ वाडग्याच्या तळाशी बसते.
seg.ec55acf2b96a.back: Boil the second cup of water, pour the nachni mixture into it and stir on low heat until thick and glossy, 6–8 minutes. Stir the mixture once more before pouring, because the flour settles at the bottom of the bowl.

seg.d0f8efa78d43.src: Keep stirring all the time. The java is cooked when it turns from dull pinkish-brown to a darker, glossy brown and coats the back of the spoon.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.t: सतत ढवळत राहा. जावाचा रंग फिकट गुलाबीसर-तपकिरीवरून गडद, चकचकीत तपकिरी झाला आणि ती चमच्याच्या पाठीला लागू लागली, की शिजली.
seg.d0f8efa78d43.back: Keep stirring constantly. When the java's colour changes from pale pinkish-brown to a deep, glossy brown and it starts coating the back of the spoon, it is cooked.

seg.e7ef07a808c5.src: Add the milk and simmer 2 minutes. Switch off and rest 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while it simmers so it does not catch.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.t: दूध घाला आणि 2 मिनिटे मंद उकळा. आच बंद करा आणि 2 मिनिटे ठेवा. उकळताना एक-दोनदा ढवळा, म्हणजे बुडाला लागणार नाही.
seg.e7ef07a808c5.back: Add milk and simmer 2 minutes. Turn off the heat and keep 2 minutes. Stir once or twice while simmering, so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.8f86db3a6d08.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely while the java rests, so it melts quickly.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.t: जावा थांबलेली असताना ताडाचा गूळ बारीक किसा, म्हणजे तो पटकन वितळेल.
seg.8f86db3a6d08.back: While the java is resting, finely grate the palm jaggery, so it melts quickly.

seg.9cad3a0176bc.src: Stir in the palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve warm. Stir till the jaggery has fully melted, then taste and add a little more if needed.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.t: ताडाचा गूळ आणि वेलची ढवळून घाला. कोमट वाढा. गूळ पूर्ण वितळेपर्यंत ढवळा, मग चाखून लागल्यास थोडा आणखी घाला.
seg.9cad3a0176bc.back: Stir in palm jaggery and cardamom. Serve lukewarm. Stir until the jaggery melts completely, then taste and add a little more if needed.

seg.a8de8fe6382d.src: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it is too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of warm milk.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.t: टंबलरमध्ये किंवा वाट्यांमध्ये ओता. प्यायला खूप घट्ट वाटली तर काही चमचे कोमट दूध ढवळून घाला.
seg.a8de8fe6382d.back: Pour into tumblers or bowls. If it seems too thick to drink, stir in a few spoons of lukewarm milk.

seg.c3916a972329.src: Always mix the ragi flour in water first; flour added straight to boiling water forms lumps that do not break up.
seg.c3916a972329.t: नाचणीचे पीठ नेहमी आधी पाण्यात मिसळा; थेट उकळत्या पाण्यात घातलेल्या पिठाच्या गुठळ्या होतात आणि त्या मोडत नाहीत.
seg.c3916a972329.back: Always mix nachni flour in water first; flour added directly to boiling water forms lumps and they do not break.

seg.966098732312.src: Do not rush the cooking; undercooked ragi tastes raw and floury.
seg.966098732312.t: शिजवण्याची घाई करू नका; कच्ची राहिलेली नाचणी कच्ची आणि पिठूळ लागते.
seg.966098732312.back: Do not hurry the cooking; nachni left undercooked tastes raw and floury.

seg.7c0f350f3691.src: For a thinner java to drink from a tumbler, use 2 tbsp ragi flour; for a spoonable porridge, use ⅓ cup.
seg.7c0f350f3691.t: टंबलरमधून प्यायला पातळ जावा हवी असेल तर 2 मोठे चमचे नाचणीचे पीठ वापरा; चमच्याने खाता येईल अशा पेजेसाठी ⅓ कप वापरा.
seg.7c0f350f3691.back: If you want a thin java to drink from a tumbler use 2 tablespoons nachni flour; for a porridge eaten with a spoon use ⅓ cup.

seg.146636ba6c2e.src: With dry fruit: stir in a few chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins at the end.
seg.146636ba6c2e.t: सुक्या मेव्यासह: शेवटी काही चिरलेले काजू किंवा बदाम आणि एक चमचा बेदाणे ढवळून घाला.
seg.146636ba6c2e.back: With dry fruits: at the end stir in some chopped cashews or almonds and a spoon of raisins.

seg.6fc3ada569ad.src: Without milk: cook the ragi in 2½ cups water and stir in the jaggery once it has stopped bubbling, for a thinner, darker java.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.t: दुधाशिवाय: जास्त पातळ, गडद जावासाठी नाचणी 2½ कप पाण्यात शिजवा आणि उकळी थांबल्यावर गूळ ढवळून घाला.
seg.6fc3ada569ad.back: Without milk: for a thinner, darker java cook the nachni in 2½ cups water and stir in jaggery after the boiling stops.

seg.639ea388ead3.src: Serve warm in a steel tumbler or bowl for breakfast, or as an evening drink with a few biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.
seg.639ea388ead3.t: न्याहारीला स्टीलच्या टंबलरमध्ये किंवा वाटीत कोमट वाढा, किंवा संध्याकाळचे पेय म्हणून काही बिस्किटे किंवा मुरुकुलुसोबत. काहींना उन्हाळ्यात ती थंड करून आवडते.
seg.639ea388ead3.back: Serve lukewarm at breakfast in a steel tumbler or bowl, or as an evening drink with some biscuits or murukulu. Some like it chilled in summer.

seg.e770a9eec01e.src: Best drunk the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge for up to 1 day and stir in a little warm milk, off the heat, when reheating.
seg.e770a9eec01e.t: केल्याच्या दिवशीच पिणे सर्वात छान. उरलेली झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये 1 दिवसापर्यंत ठेवा आणि पुन्हा गरम करताना, आचेपासून दूर, थोडे कोमट दूध ढवळून घाला.
seg.e770a9eec01e.back: Drinking it on the day it is made is best. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge up to 1 day and when reheating, away from the heat, stir in a little lukewarm milk.

seg.a10b6147a5ac.src: How do I make ragi java without lumps?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.t: गुठळ्या न होता रागी जावा कशी करावी?
seg.a10b6147a5ac.back: How to make ragi java without lumps?

seg.ca8628b7e082.src: Whisk the ragi flour into room-temperature water first until smooth, then pour this into boiling water while stirring all the time.
seg.ca8628b7e082.t: आधी नाचणीचे पीठ खोलीच्या तापमानाच्या पाण्यात गुळगुळीत होईपर्यंत फेटा, मग ते सतत ढवळत उकळत्या पाण्यात ओता.
seg.ca8628b7e082.back: First whisk nachni flour in room-temperature water until smooth, then pour it into boiling water while stirring constantly.

seg.8bd78affc52d.src: How do I know ragi java is cooked?
seg.8bd78affc52d.t: रागी जावा शिजली हे कसे ओळखावे?
seg.8bd78affc52d.back: How to know ragi java is cooked?

seg.9b05db7490cb.src: It turns darker and glossy, thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no longer tastes floury. This takes about 6–8 minutes on low heat.
seg.9b05db7490cb.t: ती गडद आणि चकचकीत होते, चमच्याच्या पाठीला लागेल इतकी घट्ट होते, आणि तिला पिठूळ चव राहत नाही. मंद आचेवर यासाठी सुमारे 6–8 मिनिटे लागतात.
seg.9b05db7490cb.back: It becomes dark and glossy, gets thick enough to coat the back of a spoon, and no floury taste remains. On low heat this takes about 6–8 minutes.

seg.6d748d67adfb.src: Can I use palm jaggery in ragi java?
seg.6d748d67adfb.t: रागी जावामध्ये ताडाचा गूळ वापरू शकतो का?
seg.6d748d67adfb.back: Can palm jaggery be used in ragi java?

seg.06e768643767.src: Yes. Grate the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a deeper colour and a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.06e768643767.t: हो. ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) बारीक किसा आणि गॅस बंद केल्यानंतर ढवळून घाला, म्हणजे दूध फाटणार नाही. त्याने रंग जास्त गडद येतो आणि गोडव्याला किंचित धुरकट चव येते.
seg.06e768643767.back: Yes. Finely grate the palm jaggery (tati bellam) and stir in after turning off the gas, so the milk will not curdle. It gives a darker colour and a slightly smoky taste to the sweetness.

seg.9a71713417de.src: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?
seg.9a71713417de.t: रागी जावा आणि रागी माल्ट यात काय फरक आहे?
seg.9a71713417de.back: What is the difference between ragi java and ragi malt?

seg.c2632b6d0b4f.src: They are the same drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; ragi malt is what it is often called in shops and on menus.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.t: वेगवेगळ्या नावांचे हे एकच पेय आहे. रागी जावा हे तेलुगु नाव आहे; दुकानांत आणि मेनूवर त्याला अनेकदा रागी माल्ट म्हणतात.
seg.c2632b6d0b4f.back: This is one drink with different names. Ragi java is the Telugu name; in shops and on menus it is often called ragi malt.

seg.6134777fbfa8.src: రాగి జావ · Sweet Ragi Java Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.t: रागी जावा · गोड रागी जावा पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.6134777fbfa8.back: Ragi Java · Sweet ragi java recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.708e3c523d72.src: రాగి జావ. Sweet ragi java, the Andhra way: ragi flour cooked in water till glossy, loosened with milk and sweetened with Thati Bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.
seg.708e3c523d72.t: रागी जावा. आंध्र पद्धतीची गोड रागी जावा: नाचणीचे पीठ पाण्यात चकचकीत होईपर्यंत शिजवून, दुधाने पातळ करून ताटि बेल्लम ताडाच्या गुळाने गोड केलेली. कृती आणि टिप्स.
seg.708e3c523d72.back: Ragi Java. Andhra-style sweet ragi java: nachni flour cooked in water until glossy, thinned with milk and sweetened with tati bellam palm jaggery. Method and tips.

seg.2889ed2cf93b.src: Ragi Java: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.2889ed2cf93b.t: रागी जावा: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.2889ed2cf93b.back: Ragi Java: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.671d48882eed.src: Iguru is the Andhra way of cooking meat or prawns down in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices cling to every piece. Royyala iguru comes from the coastal districts, from Nellore to Godavari to Srikakulam, where prawns from the backwaters and the sea are a Sunday lunch with rice.
seg.671d48882eed.t: इगुरु म्हणजे मांस किंवा कोळंबी घट्ट कांद्याच्या मसाल्यात जवळजवळ कोरडे होईपर्यंत शिजवण्याची आंध्र पद्धत, म्हणजे मसाले प्रत्येक तुकड्याला चिकटतात. रोय्याला इगुरु किनारी जिल्ह्यांतून आला आहे, नेल्लोरपासून गोदावरी ते श्रीकाकुळमपर्यंत, जिथे खाड्यांतली आणि समुद्रातली कोळंबी हे भातासोबतचे रविवारचे दुपारचे जेवण असते.
seg.671d48882eed.back: Iguru is the Andhra method of cooking meat or prawns in a thick onion masala until almost dry, so the spices stick to every piece. Royyala iguru has come from the coastal districts, from Nellore through Godavari to Srikakulam, where creek and sea prawns are the Sunday lunch with rice.

seg.ff39877dbdbd.src: Our hill turmeric powder (Konda Pasupu) goes on the prawns first and into the masala. Teja chilli powder brings the deep red colour and strong heat coastal homes like, so scale it to your table.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.t: आमची डोंगरी हळद पावडर (कोंडा पसुपु) आधी कोळंबीला लावली जाते आणि मसाल्यातही जाते. तेजा मिरची पावडरमुळे गडद लाल रंग आणि किनारपट्टीवरच्या घरांना आवडणारा जोरदार तिखटपणा येतो, म्हणून तो तुमच्या घरच्यांच्या आवडीनुसार कमी-जास्त करा.
seg.ff39877dbdbd.back: Our hill turmeric powder (konda pasupu) is first applied to the prawns and also goes into the masala. Because of Teja chilli powder there is a deep red colour and the strong heat coastal homes like, so make it more or less as your household likes.

seg.885826f68de3.src: Prep includes cleaning the prawns and the 10-minute rest with turmeric.
seg.885826f68de3.t: तयारीत कोळंबी साफ करणे आणि हळद लावून 10 मिनिटे ठेवणे धरले आहे.
seg.885826f68de3.back: The preparation counts cleaning the prawns and keeping them 10 minutes with turmeric applied.

seg.cff5bbd725a6.src: Rub prawns with turmeric and salt. Fry onions and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala till it coats them.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.t: कोळंबीला हळद आणि मीठ चोळा. कांदा आणि आलं-लसूण पेस्ट परता, तेजा मिरची पावडर आणि धणे पूड घाला, मग मसाला कोळंबीला लपेटेपर्यंत ती मसाल्यात शिजवा.
seg.cff5bbd725a6.back: Rub turmeric and salt on the prawns. Fry onion and ginger-garlic paste, add Teja chilli powder and coriander powder, then cook the prawns in the masala until the masala coats them.

seg.cf489166a3fd.src: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shelled and deveined, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.t: 500 g कोळंबी ⟦1⟧मध्यम आकाराची, साल आणि काळा धागा काढलेली, साफ केल्यानंतर वजन केलेली⟦/1⟧
seg.cf489166a3fd.back: 500 g prawns ⟦1⟧medium size, shell and black thread removed, weighed after cleaning⟦/1⟧

seg.141eb60cb009.src: ¾ tsp salt ⟦1⟧divided, or to taste⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.t: ¾ छोटा चमचा मीठ ⟦1⟧दोन भागांत, किंवा चवीनुसार⟦/1⟧
seg.141eb60cb009.back: ¾ teaspoon salt ⟦1⟧in two parts, or to taste⟦/1⟧

seg.716dc45cf0b3.src: ½ tsp hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧Konda Pasupu; ¼ tsp for the prawns, ¼ tsp for the masala⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.t: ½ छोटा चमचा डोंगरी हळद पावडर ⟦1⟧कोंडा पसुपु; ¼ छोटा चमचा कोळंबीसाठी, ¼ छोटा चमचा मसाल्यासाठी⟦/1⟧
seg.716dc45cf0b3.back: ½ teaspoon hill turmeric powder ⟦1⟧konda pasupu; ¼ teaspoon for the prawns, ¼ teaspoon for the masala⟦/1⟧

seg.f7ec1e72abc0.src: 1½ tsp Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; use 1 tsp for medium heat, ½ tsp for mild⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.t: 1½ छोटा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧खूप तिखट; मध्यम तिखटपणासाठी 1 छोटा चमचा, सौम्यसाठी ½ छोटा चमचा वापरा⟦/1⟧
seg.f7ec1e72abc0.back: 1½ teaspoons Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, for mild ½ teaspoon⟦/1⟧

seg.fce641038ff4.src: Shell and devein the prawns, rinse them well and drain in a colander.
seg.fce641038ff4.t: कोळंबीची साल आणि काळा धागा काढा, नीट धुवा आणि चाळणीत निथळा.
seg.fce641038ff4.back: Remove the shell and black thread of the prawns, wash well and drain in a sieve.

seg.152d1d89f6a5.src: Rub the prawns with half the turmeric and a little salt; set aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ tsp turmeric and ¼ tsp of the salt.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.t: कोळंबीला अर्धी हळद आणि थोडे मीठ चोळा; 10 मिनिटे बाजूला ठेवा. ¼ छोटा चमचा हळद आणि ¼ छोटा चमचा मीठ वापरा.
seg.152d1d89f6a5.back: Rub half the turmeric and a little salt on the prawns; keep aside 10 minutes. Use ¼ teaspoon turmeric and ¼ teaspoon salt.

seg.9e027c56020d.src: Heat the oil in a heavy kadai on medium heat and add the mustard seeds. When they splutter, add the green chillies and curry leaves.
seg.9e027c56020d.t: जाड कढईत मध्यम आचेवर तेल गरम करा आणि मोहरी घाला. ती तडतडली की हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्ता घाला.
seg.9e027c56020d.back: Heat oil in a heavy kadhai on medium heat and add mustard. When it crackles add green chillies and curry leaves.

seg.5d608fabeb97.src: Fry the onions in the oil till golden, then the ginger-garlic paste till it smells cooked. The onions take about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute, until the raw smell goes.
seg.5d608fabeb97.t: कांदा तेलात सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता, मग आलं-लसूण पेस्ट शिजल्याचा वास येईपर्यंत. कांद्याला सुमारे 8–10 मिनिटे लागतात; पेस्टला कच्चा वास जाईपर्यंत सुमारे 1 मिनिट.
seg.5d608fabeb97.back: Fry onion in oil until golden, then ginger-garlic paste until a cooked smell comes. The onion takes about 8–10 minutes; the paste about 1 minute until the raw smell goes.

seg.7677bdc79559.src: If using the tomato, add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.
seg.7677bdc79559.t: टोमॅटो वापरत असाल तर आता घाला आणि मऊ, लगदा होईपर्यंत शिजवा, सुमारे 4 मिनिटे.
seg.7677bdc79559.back: If using tomato add it now and cook until soft and pulpy, about 4 minutes.

seg.5aff56b73c8a.src: Turn the heat to low. Add the rest of the turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not catch.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.t: आच मंद करा. उरलेली हळद, तेजा मिरची पावडर आणि धणे पूड घाला; 1 मिनिट परता. उरलेले मीठ घाला आणि मसाले बुडाला लागू नयेत म्हणून ढवळा.
seg.5aff56b73c8a.back: Lower the heat. Add the remaining turmeric, Teja chilli powder and coriander powder; fry 1 minute. Add the remaining salt and stir so the spices do not stick to the bottom.

seg.ba25fbb9cf98.src: Pour in the water and cook the masala on medium heat until the oil starts to separate at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.t: पाणी ओता आणि मसाला कडेने तेल सुटू लागेपर्यंत मध्यम आचेवर शिजवा, सुमारे 3–4 मिनिटे.
seg.ba25fbb9cf98.back: Pour water and cook the masala on medium heat until oil starts separating at the edges, about 3–4 minutes.

seg.e60a6389cdf2.src: Add the prawns and cook till they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Finish with garam masala. Stir often on medium-high heat so the masala dries and coats the prawns.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.t: कोळंबी घाला आणि ती वळून गुलाबी होईपर्यंत शिजवा, 5–6 मिनिटे. शेवटी गरम मसाला घाला. मध्यम-मोठ्या आचेवर वारंवार ढवळा, म्हणजे मसाला आटून कोळंबीला लपेटेल.
seg.e60a6389cdf2.back: Add the prawns and cook until they curl and turn pink, 5–6 minutes. Add garam masala at the end. Stir often on medium-high heat, so the masala reduces and coats the prawns.

seg.af87e48d1429.src: Check doneness: prawns are cooked when they are pink and opaque all the way through and curled into a loose C. Cut one open if unsure; there should be no grey, see-through centre.
seg.af87e48d1429.t: शिजले का ते तपासा: कोळंबी आतपर्यंत गुलाबी आणि अपारदर्शक झाली असेल आणि सैल C आकारात वळली असेल, तर शिजली आहे. खात्री नसेल तर एक कापून पाहा; मध्ये करडा, आरपार दिसणारा भाग नसावा.
seg.af87e48d1429.back: Check if cooked: if the prawns have become pink and opaque all the way inside and curled into a loose C shape, they are cooked. If not sure cut one and look; there should be no grey, see-through part in the middle.

seg.32e58c09609e.src: Taste for salt, scatter the coriander leaves and switch off. Do not keep cooking once the prawns are done, or they turn rubbery.
seg.32e58c09609e.t: मीठ चाखून पाहा, कोथिंबीर भुरभुरा आणि आच बंद करा. कोळंबी शिजल्यावर शिजवत राहू नका, नाहीतर ती रबरासारखी चिवट होते.
seg.32e58c09609e.back: Taste for salt, sprinkle coriander leaves and turn off the heat. Do not keep cooking after the prawns are cooked, otherwise they become tough like rubber.

seg.89a9cb293875.src: Teja is very hot: 1½ tsp makes a fiery iguru the way coastal homes like it; use 1 tsp for medium heat, or ½ tsp for mild.
seg.89a9cb293875.t: तेजा खूप तिखट असते: 1½ छोट्या चमच्याने किनारपट्टीवरच्या घरांना आवडतो तसा झणझणीत इगुरु होतो; मध्यम तिखटपणासाठी 1 छोटा चमचा, किंवा सौम्यसाठी ½ छोटा चमचा वापरा.
seg.89a9cb293875.back: Teja is very hot: 1½ teaspoons makes a fiery iguru as coastal homes like; for medium heat use 1 teaspoon, or for mild ½ teaspoon.

seg.095c6105ce36.src: Fry the onions until properly golden; the colour and body of an iguru come from well-browned onions.
seg.095c6105ce36.t: कांदा चांगला सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता; इगुरुचा रंग आणि दाटपणा नीट तपकिरी झालेल्या कांद्यातूनच येतो.
seg.095c6105ce36.back: Fry the onion until well golden; the colour and thickness of iguru come only from well-browned onion.

seg.04fb6307d058.src: Prawns cook fast. A loose C shape means done; a tight O means overcooked and chewy.
seg.04fb6307d058.t: कोळंबी पटकन शिजते. सैल C आकार म्हणजे शिजली; घट्ट O आकार म्हणजे जास्त शिजली आणि चिवट झाली.
seg.04fb6307d058.back: Prawns cook quickly. A loose C shape means cooked; a tight O shape means overcooked and tough.

seg.a5e6a832090a.src: Pat the prawns dry after rinsing so they fry in the masala instead of stewing in water.
seg.a5e6a832090a.t: धुतल्यानंतर कोळंबी टिपून कोरडी करा, म्हणजे ती पाण्यात उकडली न जाता मसाल्यात परतली जाईल.
seg.a5e6a832090a.back: After washing pat the prawns dry, so they get fried in the masala instead of boiled in water.

seg.4145e1ca56b5.src: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.t: गोंगुरा रोय्यालु: थोड्या तेलात मलूल करून चेचलेली ½ कप गोंगुराची पाने कोळंबीसोबत ढवळून घाला.
seg.4145e1ca56b5.back: Gongura royyalu: stir in ½ cup gongura leaves, wilted in a little oil and mashed, with the prawns.

seg.e52b316e5c51.src: Coconut: add 2 tbsp grated coconut or 3 tbsp thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes for a softer, richer masala.
seg.e52b316e5c51.t: खोबरे: जास्त सौम्य, दाट मसाल्यासाठी शेवटच्या 2 मिनिटांत 2 मोठे चमचे किसलेले खोबरे किंवा 3 मोठे चमचे घट्ट नारळाचे दूध घाला.
seg.e52b316e5c51.back: Coconut: for a milder, thick masala add 2 tablespoons grated coconut or 3 tablespoons thick coconut milk in the last 2 minutes.

seg.fc55c7b1a788.src: Gravy style: add ¾ cup water after the prawns for a thinner royyala kura to pour over rice.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.t: रस्सा पद्धत: भातावर घालण्यासाठी पातळ रोय्याला कूरा हवा असेल तर कोळंबीनंतर ¾ कप पाणी घाला.
seg.fc55c7b1a788.back: Gravy style: if you want a thin royyala koora to pour over rice, add ¾ cup water after the prawns.

seg.8ccb6d545dd0.src: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam or sambar rice. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.t: वाफवलेला भात आणि एक चमचा तुपासोबत, किंवा रसम-भात किंवा सांबार-भातासोबत गरम वाढा. चपातीसोबतही छान लागते.
seg.8ccb6d545dd0.back: Serve hot with steamed rice and a spoon of ghee, or with rasam-rice or sambar-rice. It also tastes nice with chapati.

seg.d51021b311d0.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Warm gently in a pan; long reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.d51021b311d0.t: उरलेले झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 1 दिवसात खा. पॅनमध्ये हलक्या आचेवर गरम करा; जास्त वेळ गरम केल्याने कोळंबी चिवट होते.
seg.d51021b311d0.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan on gentle heat; heating a long time makes the prawns tough.

seg.8381d6ac4e4f.src: How do I know when prawns are cooked?
seg.8381d6ac4e4f.back: How to know the prawns are cooked?

seg.45cd36ecb77b.src: They turn pink and opaque all the way through and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in the hot masala. A grey, see-through centre means they need a little longer.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.t: ती आतपर्यंत गुलाबी आणि अपारदर्शक होते आणि सैल C आकारात वळते, गरम मसाल्यात साधारणपणे 5–6 मिनिटांत. मध्ये करडा, आरपार दिसणारा भाग असेल तर तिला थोडा आणखी वेळ लागतो.
seg.45cd36ecb77b.back: They become pink and opaque all the way inside and curl into a loose C shape, usually in 5–6 minutes in hot masala. If there is a grey, see-through part in the middle they need a little more time.

seg.2e4c4a4632d7.src: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.t: इगुरु आणि वेपुडु यात काय फरक आहे?
seg.2e4c4a4632d7.back: What is the difference between iguru and vepudu?

seg.1ee73f38a967.src: Iguru is cooked down in an onion masala until thick and almost dry, with the masala clinging to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with less or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns are crisp at the edges.
seg.1ee73f38a967.t: इगुरु कांद्याच्या मसाल्यात घट्ट आणि जवळजवळ कोरडा होईपर्यंत शिजवला जातो, मसाला कोळंबीला चिकटलेला असतो. वेपुडु म्हणजे फ्राय, कांद्याची ग्रेव्ही कमी किंवा अजिबात नाही, कोळंबीच्या कडा कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत शिजवलेले.
seg.1ee73f38a967.back: Iguru is cooked in onion masala until thick and almost dry, the masala stuck to the prawns. Vepudu is a fry, with little or no onion gravy, cooked until the prawns' edges are crisp.

seg.d248a2970455.src: How can I make royyala iguru less spicy?
seg.d248a2970455.t: रोय्याला इगुरु कमी तिखट कसा करावा?
seg.d248a2970455.back: How to make royyala iguru less hot?

seg.8c9c12b68361.src: Use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder for medium heat or ½ tsp for mild, and skip the green chillies. A tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also softens the heat.
seg.8c9c12b68361.t: मध्यम तिखटपणासाठी 1 छोटा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर किंवा सौम्यसाठी ½ छोटा चमचा वापरा, आणि हिरव्या मिरच्या वगळा. शेवटी एक मोठा चमचा दही किंवा नारळाचे दूध घातल्यानेही तिखटपणा कमी होतो.
seg.8c9c12b68361.back: For medium heat use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder or for mild ½ teaspoon, and leave out the green chillies. Adding a tablespoon of curd or coconut milk at the end also reduces the heat.

seg.9cd9740c2604.src: Yes. Thaw them in the fridge, drain them well and pat them dry before rubbing with turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.
seg.9cd9740c2604.t: हो. ती फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवून वितळू द्या, नीट निथळा आणि हळद व मीठ चोळण्याआधी टिपून कोरडी करा. फ्रोझन कोळंबीला जास्त पाणी सुटते, म्हणून मसाला थोडा जास्त वेळ शिजवा.
seg.9cd9740c2604.back: Yes. Let them thaw by keeping in the fridge, drain well and pat dry before rubbing turmeric and salt. Frozen prawns release more water, so cook the masala a little longer.

seg.0484ea984ed7.src: రొయ్యల ఇగురు. Royyala iguru, the coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns cooked down in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. Serves 4.
seg.0484ea984ed7.t: रोय्याला इगुरु. रोय्याला इगुरु, किनारी आंध्रचा कोळंबी रोस्ट: डोंगरी हळद पावडर आणि झणझणीत तेजा मिरची पावडरसह कांद्याच्या मसाल्यात आटवलेली कोळंबी. 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.0484ea984ed7.back: Royyala Iguru. Royyala iguru, coastal Andhra prawn roast: prawns reduced in onion masala with hill turmeric powder and fiery Teja chilli powder. For 4 people.

seg.1b1d6a89c215.src: Royyala Iguru: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.1b1d6a89c215.t: रोय्याला इगुरु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.1b1d6a89c215.back: Royyala Iguru: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.965a1e93fb08.src: Sunnundalu are the urad dal laddus of Andhra: split urad dal roasted till nutty, ground fine with jaggery and pressed together with hot ghee. There is no cooking of syrup, so they come together in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin for Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives travelling abroad, and keep them for an evening sweet with tea.
seg.965a1e93fb08.t: सुन्नुंडलु म्हणजे आंध्रचे उडीद डाळीचे लाडू: उडीद डाळ खमंग होईपर्यंत भाजून, गुळासोबत बारीक वाटून, गरम तुपाने वळलेले. पाक करावा लागत नाही, त्यामुळे सुमारे अर्ध्या तासात होतात. आंध्रातली घरे संक्रांती आणि दिवाळीला एक डबा भरून करतात, परदेशी जाणाऱ्या नातेवाईकांसाठी बांधून देतात, आणि संध्याकाळी चहासोबत गोड म्हणून ठेवतात.
seg.965a1e93fb08.back: Sunnundalu are Andhra's urad dal laddus: urad dal roasted until toasty, ground fine with jaggery, and shaped with hot ghee. No syrup has to be made, so they are done in about half an hour. Andhra homes make a tin full at Sankranti and Diwali, pack them for relatives going abroad, and keep them as a sweet with evening tea.

seg.e564344550cd.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives sunnundalu a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.
seg.e564344550cd.t: आमच्या ताटि बेल्लम ताडाच्या गुळामुळे सुन्नुंडलुला गडद तपकिरी रंग आणि भाजलेल्या डाळीला शोभणारा भरीव, किंचित धुरकट गोडवा येतो. या पाककृतीने सुमारे 15 लाडू होतात.
seg.e564344550cd.back: Because of our tati bellam palm jaggery sunnundalu get a deep brown colour and a full, slightly smoky sweetness that suits the roasted dal. This recipe makes about 15 laddus.

seg.b1400f429b2f.src: Total includes cooling the roasted dal before grinding.
seg.b1400f429b2f.t: एकूण वेळेत वाटण्याआधी भाजलेली डाळ थंड होण्याचा वेळही धरला आहे.
seg.b1400f429b2f.back: The total time also counts the time for the roasted dal to cool before grinding.

seg.6c6369238635.src: Roast urad dal till golden, cool and grind fine, then grind in palm jaggery and cardamom. Mix with hot ghee and shape into laddus.
seg.6c6369238635.t: उडीद डाळ सोनेरी होईपर्यंत भाजा, थंड करून बारीक वाटा, मग ताडाचा गूळ आणि वेलची घालून वाटा. गरम तुपात मिसळा आणि लाडू वळा.
seg.6c6369238635.back: Roast urad dal until golden, cool and grind fine, then add palm jaggery and cardamom and grind. Mix in hot ghee and shape laddus.

seg.890ddaaca185.src: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧split, skinless (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.t: 1 कप पांढरी उडीद डाळ ⟦1⟧सालीशिवायची डाळ (मिनपप्पु), सुमारे 200 g⟦/1⟧
seg.890ddaaca185.back: 1 cup white urad dal ⟦1⟧skinless dal (minapappu), about 200 g⟦/1⟧

seg.06c2723f717d.src: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly packed; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.t: 1 कप किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧सुमारे 180 g, हलका दाबून भरलेला; आधी तुकडे कुटून किंवा किसून घ्या⟦/1⟧
seg.06c2723f717d.back: 1 cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g, lightly pressed and filled; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.25c886ef1375.src: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tbsp extra on hand⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.t: ½ कप तूप ⟦1⟧वितळवलेले आणि गरम; 1–2 मोठे चमचे जास्तीचे हाताशी ठेवा⟦/1⟧
seg.25c886ef1375.back: ½ cup ghee ⟦1⟧melted and hot; keep 1–2 tablespoons extra at hand⟦/1⟧

seg.99983266b588.src: Pick through the urad dal for any small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.
seg.99983266b588.t: उडीद डाळ निवडून बारीक खडे काढा. ती धुऊ नका; भाजण्यासाठी ती कोरडीच राहायला हवी.
seg.99983266b588.back: Sort the urad dal and remove small stones. Do not wash it; it must stay dry for roasting.

seg.2f2807ce216b.src: Put the dal in a heavy pan on a low flame.
seg.2f2807ce216b.t: डाळ जाड पॅनमध्ये मंद आचेवर ठेवा.
seg.2f2807ce216b.back: Keep the dal in a heavy pan on low heat.

seg.65588a76c883.src: Dry-roast the urad dal on a low flame till golden and nutty, about 10 minutes. Stir all the time so every grain colours evenly; it should smell toasty and snap when you bite a grain.
seg.65588a76c883.t: उडीद डाळ मंद आचेवर सोनेरी आणि खमंग होईपर्यंत कोरडी भाजा, सुमारे 10 मिनिटे. प्रत्येक दाण्याला सारखा रंग यावा म्हणून सतत ढवळा; खमंग वास यायला हवा आणि दाणा चावल्यावर कटकन मोडायला हवा.
seg.65588a76c883.back: Dry-roast the urad dal on low heat until golden and toasty, about 10 minutes. Stir constantly so every grain gets the same colour; a toasty smell should come and a grain should snap crisply when bitten.

seg.9e8dc23d38fa.src: Tip the dal onto a plate and spread it out. Cool it, then grind to a fine powder. Grind in short bursts so the mixer does not heat up, and sieve out any coarse bits to grind again.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.t: डाळ ताटात काढून पसरा. थंड करा, मग बारीक पूड करा. मिक्सर गरम होऊ नये म्हणून थोडा थोडा वेळ फिरवा, आणि जाडसर कण चाळून काढून पुन्हा वाटा.
seg.9e8dc23d38fa.back: Take the dal out on a plate and spread it. Cool, then make a fine powder. Run the mixer a little at a time so it does not heat up, and sieve out coarse bits and grind again.

seg.edfa5bb66e59.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.t: ताडाचा गूळ बारीक किसा, किंवा तुकडे खलबत्त्यात कुटा, कडक गुठळ्या मोडून घ्या.
seg.edfa5bb66e59.back: Finely grate the palm jaggery, or pound the pieces in a mortar, breaking hard lumps.

seg.fcf7bce21bc5.src: Add the jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind in the jaggery and cardamom till evenly mixed. A few pulses are enough; tip it all into a wide bowl.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.t: मिक्सरच्या भांड्यातल्या डाळीच्या पुडीत गूळ आणि वेलची पूड घाला. गूळ आणि वेलची सारखे मिसळेपर्यंत वाटा. काही फेरे पुरेसे आहेत; सगळे रुंद वाडग्यात काढा.
seg.fcf7bce21bc5.back: Add jaggery and cardamom powder to the dal powder in the mixer jar. Grind until jaggery and cardamom are evenly mixed. A few rounds are enough; take everything out into a wide bowl.

seg.1cd01dc31b1a.src: Melt the ghee in a small pan until it is hot but not smoking.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.t: छोट्या पॅनमध्ये तूप गरम होईपर्यंत वितळवा, पण धूर येऊ देऊ नका.
seg.1cd01dc31b1a.back: Melt the ghee in a small pan until hot, but do not let smoke come.

seg.0b0ec921a239.src: Pour in the hot ghee, mix well and press into small balls. Start with most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then use your hands once it is cool enough to touch.
seg.0b0ec921a239.t: गरम तूप ओता, नीट मिसळा आणि छोटे लाडू वळा. सुरुवातीला बहुतेक तूप घाला, चमच्याने मिसळा, मग हात लावता येईल इतके कोमट झाल्यावर हाताने मिसळा.
seg.0b0ec921a239.back: Pour the hot ghee, mix well and shape small laddus. At first add most of the ghee, mix with a spoon, then when it is warm enough to touch mix by hand.

seg.0c005163369c.src: Take a small handful and squeeze it firmly in your fist, then roll it round between your palms. If it crumbles, add a spoon more hot ghee to the bowl and mix.
seg.0c005163369c.t: थोडे मिश्रण मुठीत घेऊन घट्ट दाबा, मग तळहातांमध्ये गोल वळा. ते भुरभुरले तर वाडग्यात आणखी एक चमचा गरम तूप घालून मिसळा.
seg.0c005163369c.back: Take a little mixture in your fist and press tightly, then roll round between your palms. If it crumbles, add one more spoon of hot ghee to the bowl and mix.

seg.7ac27bb5fb12.src: Set the laddus on a plate to firm up for 15–20 minutes before storing.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.t: भरून ठेवण्याआधी लाडू ताटात 15–20 मिनिटे घट्ट होऊ द्या.
seg.7ac27bb5fb12.back: Let the laddus firm up on a plate 15–20 minutes before filling away.

seg.591b2b7e4ef4.src: Roast the dal on a low flame so it cooks through without burning.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.t: डाळ मंद आचेवर भाजा, म्हणजे ती न करपता आतपर्यंत भाजली जाईल.
seg.591b2b7e4ef4.back: Roast the dal on low heat, so it roasts through without burning.

seg.07daa833e53a.src: Grind the dal only after it has cooled completely; warm dal turns pasty in the mixer.
seg.07daa833e53a.t: डाळ पूर्ण थंड झाल्यावरच वाटा; कोमट डाळ मिक्सरमध्ये चिकट गोळा होते.
seg.07daa833e53a.back: Grind the dal only after it has fully cooled; warm dal becomes a sticky lump in the mixer.

seg.33701abc66f0.src: Shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm; it binds best with the heat of the ghee.
seg.33701abc66f0.t: मिश्रण कोमट असतानाच लाडू वळा; तुपाच्या उष्णतेने ते सर्वात छान बांधले जाते.
seg.33701abc66f0.back: Shape laddus while the mixture is still warm; with the warmth of the ghee it binds best.

seg.b6fb58b6b287.src: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them small before they go into the mixer.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.t: ताडाच्या गुळाचे तुकडे कमी-जास्त कडक असतात, म्हणून मिक्सरमध्ये घालण्याआधी ते किसून किंवा कुटून बारीक करा.
seg.b6fb58b6b287.back: Palm jaggery pieces vary in hardness, so grate or pound them fine before putting into the mixer.

seg.1797acff16a2.src: Cane jaggery: use the same amount of grated cane jaggery for a lighter colour and a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.1797acff16a2.t: उसाचा गूळ: फिकट रंगासाठी आणि कॅरमेलसारख्या गोडव्यासाठी तेवढाच किसलेला उसाचा गूळ वापरा.
seg.1797acff16a2.back: Sugarcane jaggery: for a paler colour and caramel-like sweetness use the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery.

seg.f95b0650add7.src: With skin: use black split urad dal with its skin for darker, grainier sunnundalu, the way some village homes make them.
seg.f95b0650add7.t: सालीसकट: गडद, जास्त दाणेदार सुन्नुंडलुसाठी सालीसकट काळी उडीद डाळ वापरा, जशी गावाकडची काही घरे करतात.
seg.f95b0650add7.back: With skin: for darker, grainier sunnundalu use black urad dal with skin, as some village homes do.
