seg.07498f6166e4.src: With sugar: use ¾ cup powdered sugar in place of the jaggery for pale, crisp-melting laddus.
seg.07498f6166e4.t: साखरेसह: फिकट, तोंडात विरघळणाऱ्या लाडूंसाठी गुळाऐवजी ¾ कप पिठीसाखर वापरा.
seg.07498f6166e4.back: With sugar: for pale, melt-in-the-mouth laddus use ¾ cup powdered sugar instead of jaggery.

seg.8fea3a4a695f.src: Serve as an evening sweet with tea or coffee, or as part of the Sankranti and Diwali sweet plate.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.t: संध्याकाळी चहा किंवा कॉफीसोबत गोड म्हणून, किंवा संक्रांती आणि दिवाळीच्या फराळाच्या ताटात वाढा.
seg.8fea3a4a695f.back: Serve as a sweet with evening tea or coffee, or on the Sankranti and Diwali faral plate.

seg.83b4edc5c69d.src: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In warm weather they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.t: हवाबंद स्टीलच्या डब्यात खोलीच्या तापमानाला ठेवा आणि 2 आठवड्यांत खा. उकाड्याच्या दिवसांत ते फ्रिजमध्ये जास्त टिकतात; खाण्याआधी ते खोलीच्या तापमानाला येऊ द्या.
seg.83b4edc5c69d.back: Keep in an airtight steel tin at room temperature and eat within 2 weeks. In hot humid days they keep longer in the fridge; let them come to room temperature before eating.

seg.c0ae9315eb0e.src: Why are my sunnundalu not holding shape?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.t: माझे सुन्नुंडलु आकार का धरत नाहीत?
seg.c0ae9315eb0e.back: Why don't my sunnundalu hold shape?

seg.03c64235659e.src: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled down. Warm a spoon or two of ghee, mix it in and shape the laddus while the mixture is still warm.
seg.03c64235659e.t: मिश्रणाला आणखी गरम तूप हवे आहे, किंवा ते थंड झाले आहे. एक-दोन चमचे तूप गरम करा, मिसळा आणि मिश्रण कोमट असतानाच लाडू वळा.
seg.03c64235659e.back: The mixture needs more hot ghee, or it has cooled. Heat a spoon or two of ghee, mix and shape laddus while the mixture is still warm.

seg.c125d749f215.src: Can I make sunnundalu with palm jaggery?
seg.c125d749f215.t: ताडाच्या गुळाने सुन्नुंडलु करता येतील का?
seg.c125d749f215.back: Can sunnundalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.7b13a91f65e1.src: Yes. Grate or pound the palm jaggery (thati bellam) finely and use the same amount as cane jaggery. The laddus turn darker and taste deeper and slightly smoky.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.t: हो. ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) बारीक किसा किंवा कुटा आणि उसाच्या गुळाइतकाच वापरा. लाडू गडद होतात आणि त्यांची चव जास्त गहिरी, किंचित धुरकट लागते.
seg.7b13a91f65e1.back: Yes. Finely grate or pound palm jaggery (tati bellam) and use the same as sugarcane jaggery. The laddus become darker and their taste deeper, slightly smoky.

seg.946f64207639.back: How many days do sunnundalu keep?

seg.b2aed25ebff6.src: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands to take them out.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.t: हवाबंद डब्यात खोलीच्या तापमानाला सुमारे 2 आठवडे, आणि फ्रिजमध्ये त्याहून जास्त. काढताना कोरडा चमचा किंवा कोरडे हात वापरा.
seg.b2aed25ebff6.back: About 2 weeks in an airtight tin at room temperature, and longer than that in the fridge. Use a dry spoon or dry hands when taking them out.

seg.e750875c4912.src: Should I use urad dal with or without skin?
seg.e750875c4912.t: उडीद डाळ सालीसकट वापरावी की सालीशिवाय?
seg.e750875c4912.back: Should urad dal be used with skin or without skin?

seg.b12320430e22.src: Both are made in Andhra. White skinless urad dal gives smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin gives darker, grainier ones.
seg.b12320430e22.t: आंध्रात दोन्ही प्रकारे करतात. सालीशिवायच्या पांढऱ्या उडीद डाळीने गुळगुळीत, हलके तपकिरी लाडू होतात; सालीसकट काळ्या उडीद डाळीने गडद, जास्त दाणेदार.
seg.b12320430e22.back: In Andhra they are made both ways. Skinless white urad dal makes smooth, light brown laddus; black urad dal with skin makes darker, grainier ones.

seg.d8e8e5770555.src: సున్నుండలు. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with Thati Bellam palm jaggery and bound with hot ghee into laddus. Step-by-step method, tips and FAQs.
seg.d8e8e5770555.t: सुन्नुंडलु. आंध्रचे सुन्नुंडलु: भाजलेली उडीद डाळ ताटि बेल्लम ताडाच्या गुळासोबत वाटून गरम तुपाने वळलेले लाडू. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि प्रश्नोत्तरे.
seg.d8e8e5770555.back: Sunnundalu. Andhra sunnundalu: roasted urad dal ground with tati bellam palm jaggery and shaped into laddus with hot ghee. Step-by-step method, tips and questions-answers.

seg.c61b125404d0.src: Sunnundalu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.c61b125404d0.t: सुन्नुंडलु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.c61b125404d0.back: Sunnundalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.02d0a5789a02.src: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of Andhra kitchens: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then ground coarse with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it in the stone roti for a rough, spoonable texture, though a mixer in short pulses does the job. It goes with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.
seg.02d0a5789a02.t: टमाटा पच्चडी ही आंध्रच्या स्वयंपाकघरातली रोजची चटणी: पिकलेले टोमॅटो भाजलेल्या डाळींसोबत तेलात आटवून, मग मिरची, लसूण आणि थोड्या चिंचेसोबत जाडसर वाटलेली. अनेक घरे अजूनही ती दगडी रोटीवर (पाटा-वरवंट्यावर) वाटतात, जाडसर, चमच्याने घेता येईल अशी, पण थांबून थांबून फिरवलेला मिक्सरही काम करतो. ती गरम भात आणि तूप, डोसा, इडली आणि पेसरट्टूसोबत खाल्ली जाते.
seg.02d0a5789a02.back: Tomato pachadi is the everyday chutney of the Andhra kitchen: ripe tomatoes cooked down in oil with roasted dals, then coarsely ground with chilli, garlic and a little tamarind. Many homes still grind it on a stone roti (grinding slab), coarse, so it can be taken with a spoon, but a pulsed mixer also does the job. It is eaten with hot rice and ghee, dosa, idli and pesarattu.

seg.7735dff0ccd2.src: Our Sannam chilli powder gives it a deep red colour and steady, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.t: आमच्या सन्नम मिरची पावडरमुळे तिला गडद लाल रंग आणि एकसारखा, मध्यम तिखटपणा येतो, आणि टोमॅटोसोबत थोडी हळद पावडर जाते. या पाककृतीने सुमारे 1½ कप होते.
seg.7735dff0ccd2.back: Because of our Sannam chilli powder it gets a deep red colour and an even, medium heat, and a little turmeric powder goes in with the tomatoes. This recipe makes about 1½ cups.

seg.44c4d82a4524.src: Total includes 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.
seg.44c4d82a4524.t: एकूण वेळेत वाटण्याआधी टोमॅटो थंड होण्याची 5 मिनिटेही धरली आहेत.
seg.44c4d82a4524.back: The total time also counts 5 minutes for the tomatoes to cool before grinding.

seg.827e4421a48d.src: Fry dals and methi in oil, cook tomatoes down with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.827e4421a48d.t: डाळी आणि मेथी तेलात परता, टोमॅटो हळद आणि मिठासोबत आटवा, मग सन्नम मिरची पावडर, लसूण आणि चिंचेसोबत जाडसर वाटा. शेवटी मोहरी आणि कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी द्या.
seg.827e4421a48d.back: Fry dals and fenugreek in oil, cook down the tomatoes with turmeric and salt, then grind coarsely with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard and curry leaves.

seg.4171dd59d18a.t: 2 मोठे चमचे तेल ⟦1⟧शेंगदाणा किंवा तिळाचे तेल⟦/1⟧

seg.826b52ef9f19.src: ¼ tsp methi seeds ⟦1⟧fenugreek seeds; no more, or the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.t: ¼ छोटा चमचा मेथी दाणे ⟦1⟧मेथी; यापेक्षा जास्त नको, नाहीतर पच्चडी कडू होते⟦/1⟧
seg.826b52ef9f19.back: ¼ teaspoon fenugreek seeds ⟦1⟧methi; not more than this, otherwise the pachadi turns bitter⟦/1⟧

seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.src: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.t: 5 मध्यम टोमॅटो ⟦1⟧सुमारे 500 g, पिकलेले आणि लाल, चिरलेले⟦/1⟧
seg.6cd60f9cc4c2.back: 5 medium tomatoes ⟦1⟧about 500 g, ripe and red, chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.29558a247c61.src: 2 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tbsp for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.t: 2 छोटे चमचे सन्नम मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧जास्त तिखट पच्चडीसाठी 1 मोठ्या चमच्यापर्यंत⟦/1⟧
seg.29558a247c61.back: 2 teaspoons Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧up to 1 tablespoon for a hotter pachadi⟦/1⟧

seg.2f8f5bd3f25f.back: ¼ cup coriander leaves (if wanted) ⟦1⟧roughly chopped⟦/1⟧

seg.2c1074e3a23e.src: Heat 2 tbsp oil in a kadai on medium-low heat.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.t: कढईत मध्यम-मंद आचेवर 2 मोठे चमचे तेल गरम करा.
seg.2c1074e3a23e.back: Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a kadhai on medium-low heat.

seg.9d0674551be0.src: Fry the urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil till golden; lift them out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir all the time, as methi burns fast and turns bitter.
seg.9d0674551be0.t: उडीद डाळ, चणा डाळ आणि मेथी तेलात सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता; बाहेर काढा. यासाठी 2–3 मिनिटे लागतात; सतत ढवळा, कारण मेथी पटकन करपते आणि कडू होते.
seg.9d0674551be0.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil until golden; take out. This takes 2–3 minutes; stir constantly, because fenugreek burns quickly and turns bitter.

seg.4727da6f2a95.src: In the same oil, add the chopped tomatoes and stir for a minute on medium heat.
seg.4727da6f2a95.t: त्याच तेलात चिरलेले टोमॅटो घाला आणि मध्यम आचेवर एक मिनिट ढवळा.
seg.4727da6f2a95.back: In the same oil add chopped tomatoes and stir a minute on medium heat.

seg.8032f2a2778c.src: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt till soft and the juice dries up. Cover for the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulpy and oil shows at the edges.
seg.8032f2a2778c.t: टोमॅटो हळद आणि मिठासोबत मऊ होईपर्यंत आणि रस आटेपर्यंत शिजवा. पहिली 5 मिनिटे झाकून ठेवा, मग झाकण न ठेवता, मधूनमधून ढवळत शिजवा, एकूण सुमारे 12–15 मिनिटे, टोमॅटोचा लगदा होईपर्यंत आणि कडेने तेल सुटेपर्यंत.
seg.8032f2a2778c.back: Cook the tomatoes with turmeric and salt until soft and the juice dries. Keep covered the first 5 minutes, then cook uncovered, stirring now and then, about 12–15 minutes in all, until the tomatoes are pulp and oil separates at the edges.

seg.d606b6ac13a2.src: Switch off, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool for about 5 minutes.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.t: आच बंद करा, चिंच ढवळून घाला म्हणजे ती उष्णतेत मऊ होईल, आणि सगळे सुमारे 5 मिनिटे थंड होऊ द्या.
seg.d606b6ac13a2.back: Turn off the heat, stir in the tamarind so it softens in the heat, and let everything cool about 5 minutes.

seg.c1820dcae462.src: In the stone roti or a mixer jar, first grind the fried dals and methi to a coarse powder.
seg.c1820dcae462.t: दगडी रोटीवर किंवा मिक्सरच्या भांड्यात आधी परतलेल्या डाळी आणि मेथी जाडसर वाटून पूड करा.
seg.c1820dcae462.back: On a stone roti or in a mixer jar first grind the fried dals and fenugreek coarsely into powder.

seg.f07d8b97d1db.src: Grind the dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In a mixer, add the garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while it still has texture. Stir in the coriander leaves, if using.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.t: डाळी, लसूण, चिंच, मिरची पावडर आणि टोमॅटो जाडसर वाटा. मिक्सरमध्ये डाळीच्या पुडीत लसूण, मिरची पावडर आणि शिजलेले टोमॅटो घाला आणि पाणी न घालता 4–5 वेळा थांबून थांबून फिरवा; पोत असतानाच थांबा. वापरत असाल तर कोथिंबीर ढवळून घाला.
seg.f07d8b97d1db.back: Grind dals, garlic, tamarind, chilli powder and tomatoes coarsely. In the mixer add garlic, chilli powder and cooked tomatoes to the dal powder and pulse 4–5 times without water; stop while there is still texture. Stir in coriander leaves if using.

seg.6675d75425f6.src: Taste and adjust: a pinch more salt, or a little more chilli powder pulsed in, if you want it hotter.
seg.6675d75425f6.t: चाखून बरोबर करा: चिमूटभर जास्त मीठ, किंवा जास्त तिखट हवी असेल तर थोडी आणखी मिरची पावडर घालून फिरवा.
seg.6675d75425f6.back: Taste and correct: a pinch more salt, or if you want it hotter add a little more chilli powder and pulse.

seg.27426b7ca3c6.src: Spoon the pachadi into a bowl. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a small pan and add the mustard seeds; when they splutter, add the urad dal and fry until golden.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.t: पच्चडी एका वाडग्यात काढा. छोट्या पॅनमध्ये 1 मोठा चमचा तेल गरम करा आणि मोहरी घाला; ती तडतडली की उडीद डाळ घालून सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता.
seg.27426b7ca3c6.back: Take the pachadi out into a bowl. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a small pan and add mustard; when it crackles add urad dal and fry until golden.

seg.77131f9506c3.src: Add the red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir for a few seconds.
seg.77131f9506c3.t: लाल मिरच्या, हिंग आणि कढीपत्ता घालून काही सेकंद ढवळा.
seg.77131f9506c3.back: Add red chillies, asafoetida and curry leaves and stir a few seconds.

seg.d4a4b9439500.src: Temper with mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour over. Mix it in just before serving.
seg.d4a4b9439500.t: मोहरी, लाल मिरच्या आणि कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी करा; वरून ओता. वाढण्याच्या अगदी आधी मिसळा.
seg.d4a4b9439500.back: Make a tempering of mustard, red chillies and curry leaves; pour on top. Mix just before serving.

seg.0f23e6b9231e.src: Cook the tomatoes till the juice dries up so the pachadi keeps longer and does not taste raw.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.t: टोमॅटोचा रस आटेपर्यंत शिजवा, म्हणजे पच्चडी जास्त दिवस टिकते आणि कच्ची लागत नाही.
seg.0f23e6b9231e.back: Cook until the tomato juice dries, so the pachadi keeps more days and does not taste raw.

seg.bad083b47507.src: Ripe, deep-red tomatoes give the best colour; if yours are sour, cut the tamarind to half.
seg.bad083b47507.t: पिकलेल्या, गडद लाल टोमॅटोंनी सर्वात छान रंग येतो; तुमचे टोमॅटो आंबट असतील तर चिंच अर्धी करा.
seg.bad083b47507.back: Ripe, deep red tomatoes give the nicest colour; if your tomatoes are sour, halve the tamarind.

seg.99bd4830d431.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: a coarse pachadi is how Andhra homes like it, and a smooth paste loses that texture.
seg.99bd4830d431.t: थांबून थांबून फिरवा, मिक्सर सलग चालवू नका: आंध्रातल्या घरांना पच्चडी जाडसरच आवडते, आणि गुळगुळीत पेस्टमध्ये तो पोत हरवतो.
seg.99bd4830d431.back: Pulse, do not run the mixer continuously: Andhra homes like pachadi coarse, and in a smooth paste that texture is lost.

seg.27f2aaa2d25d.src: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start at 2 tsp and add more after tasting; the heat settles a little as the pachadi rests.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.t: सन्नम मिरची पावडरने मध्यम तिखटपणा येतो. 2 छोट्या चमच्यांपासून सुरुवात करा आणि चाखून आणखी घाला; पच्चडी ठेवल्यावर तिखटपणा थोडा स्थिरावतो.
seg.27f2aaa2d25d.back: Sannam chilli powder gives medium heat. Start from 2 teaspoons and taste and add more; on keeping the pachadi's heat settles a little.

seg.5e0bf03c1b36.src: Green chilli: replace the chilli powder with 4–5 green chillies, fried with the dals.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.t: हिरवी मिरची: मिरची पावडरऐवजी 4–5 हिरव्या मिरच्या डाळींसोबत परतून घ्या.
seg.5e0bf03c1b36.back: Green chilli: instead of chilli powder fry 4–5 green chillies with the dals.

seg.d7301a50c407.src: Onion-tomato: fry 1 sliced onion until soft before the tomatoes go in.
seg.d7301a50c407.t: कांदा-टोमॅटो: टोमॅटो घालण्याआधी 1 चिरलेला कांदा मऊ होईपर्यंत परता.
seg.d7301a50c407.back: Onion-tomato: fry 1 chopped onion until soft before adding tomatoes.

seg.bc90e2638112.src: Hotter: use 1 tsp Teja chilli powder in place of 1 tsp of the Sannam; Teja is very hot, so go slowly.
seg.bc90e2638112.t: जास्त तिखट: सन्नमच्या 1 छोट्या चमच्याऐवजी 1 छोटा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर वापरा; तेजा खूप तिखट असते, म्हणून हळूहळू वाढवा.
seg.bc90e2638112.back: Hotter: instead of 1 teaspoon of the Sannam use 1 teaspoon Teja chilli powder; Teja is very hot, so increase slowly.

seg.aab608a427a9.src: Without garlic: leave out the garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida to the tempering.
seg.aab608a427a9.t: लसणाशिवाय: लसूण वगळा आणि फोडणीत चिमूटभर जास्त हिंग घाला.
seg.aab608a427a9.back: Without garlic: leave out garlic and add a pinch more asafoetida in the tempering.

seg.62d9491c4e58.src: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve alongside dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.
seg.62d9491c4e58.t: थोड्या तुपासोबत गरम भातात एक चमचा कालवा, किंवा डोसा, इडली, पेसरट्टू किंवा उपम्यासोबत वाढा.
seg.62d9491c4e58.back: Mix a spoonful into hot rice with a little ghee, or serve with dosa, idli, pesarattu or upma.

seg.3f0b892d2728.src: Keep it in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.3f0b892d2728.t: स्वच्छ, कोरड्या काचेच्या बरणीत फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 4 दिवसांत खा. नेहमी कोरडा चमचा वापरा.
seg.3f0b892d2728.back: Keep in a clean, dry glass jar in the fridge and eat within 4 days. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.20425f76c6e2.src: How do you make Andhra tomato pachadi?
seg.20425f76c6e2.back: How is Andhra tomato pachadi made?

seg.32ae9ac6b03c.src: Fry urad dal, chana dal and methi in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries up, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. Finish with a mustard, red chilli and curry-leaf tempering.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.t: उडीद डाळ, चणा डाळ आणि मेथी तेलात परता, चिरलेले टोमॅटो हळद आणि मिठासोबत रस आटेपर्यंत शिजवा, मग सगळे मिरची पावडर, लसूण आणि चिंचेसोबत जाडसर वाटा. शेवटी मोहरी, लाल मिरची आणि कढीपत्त्याची फोडणी द्या.
seg.32ae9ac6b03c.back: Fry urad dal, chana dal and fenugreek in oil, cook chopped tomatoes with turmeric and salt until the juice dries, then grind everything coarsely with chilli powder, garlic and tamarind. At the end give a tempering of mustard, red chilli and curry leaves.

seg.2e87824684cb.src: Why is my tomato pachadi bitter?
seg.2e87824684cb.t: माझी टमाटा पच्चडी कडू का झाली?
seg.2e87824684cb.back: Why did my tomato pachadi turn bitter?

seg.b367557bedfc.src: Usually the methi seeds burnt or there were too many. Use only ¼ tsp for 500 g tomatoes and fry them on medium-low heat, lifting them out as soon as they turn golden.
seg.b367557bedfc.t: बहुतेक वेळा मेथी करपल्यामुळे किंवा जास्त पडल्यामुळे. 500 g टोमॅटोसाठी फक्त ¼ छोटा चमचा वापरा आणि मध्यम-मंद आचेवर परता, सोनेरी होताच बाहेर काढा.
seg.b367557bedfc.back: Mostly because the fenugreek burnt or too much went in. For 500 g tomatoes use only ¼ teaspoon and fry on medium-low heat, take out as soon as golden.

seg.acdf33e5cc6d.src: Can I make tomato pachadi without tamarind?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.t: चिंचेशिवाय टमाटा पच्चडी करता येईल का?
seg.acdf33e5cc6d.back: Can tomato pachadi be made without tamarind?

seg.53fbd8949e0b.src: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need the small piece of tamarind for balance.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.t: हो, तुमचे टोमॅटो पुरेसे आंबट असतील तर. शिजवल्यानंतर चाखून पाहा; पिकलेल्या, गोड टोमॅटोंना तोल साधण्यासाठी चिंचेचा छोटा तुकडा लागतो.
seg.53fbd8949e0b.back: Yes, if your tomatoes are sour enough. Taste after cooking; ripe, sweet tomatoes need a small piece of tamarind for balance.

seg.2938c7a0249e.src: How long does tomato pachadi last?
seg.2938c7a0249e.back: How many days does tomato pachadi keep?

seg.a35105e3a4af.src: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, as long as the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.
seg.a35105e3a4af.t: स्वच्छ, कोरड्या बरणीत फ्रिजमध्ये सुमारे 4 दिवस, टोमॅटो नीट आटवले असतील आणि तुम्ही कोरडा चमचा वापरत असाल तर.
seg.a35105e3a4af.back: About 4 days in the fridge in a clean, dry jar, if the tomatoes were cooked down well and you use a dry spoon.

seg.de4e2a65c3ae.src: టమాటా పచ్చడి. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, ground coarse with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.t: टमाटा पच्चडी. आंध्रची टमाटा पच्चडी: हळद पावडरसोबत आटवलेले टोमॅटो, सन्नम मिरची पावडर, लसूण आणि चिंचेसोबत जाडसर वाटून, मग फोडणी दिलेली.
seg.de4e2a65c3ae.back: Tomato Pachadi. Andhra tomato pachadi: tomatoes cooked down with turmeric powder, coarsely ground with Sannam chilli powder, garlic and tamarind, then tempered.

seg.03de1ac75259.src: Tomato Pachadi: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.03de1ac75259.t: टमाटा पच्चडी: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.03de1ac75259.back: Tomato Pachadi: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3d323a4b41cc.src: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, mashed smooth and finished with a garlic tempering. It is cooked most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or a pickle on the side.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.t: टमाटा पप्पु म्हणजे आंध्रातल्या घरांची रोजची डाळ: तूर डाळ (कंदि पप्पु) टोमॅटो आणि हिरव्या मिरच्यांसोबत मऊ शिजवून, घोटून गुळगुळीत करून, शेवटी लसणाची फोडणी दिलेली. आठवड्यातले बहुतेक दिवस ती होते आणि गरम भात, एक चमचा तूप आणि बाजूला पापड किंवा लोणच्यासोबत खाल्ली जाते.
seg.3d323a4b41cc.back: Tomato pappu is the everyday dal of Andhra homes: toor dal (kandi pappu) cooked soft with tomato and green chillies, mashed smooth, and finished with a garlic tempering. It is made most days of the week and eaten with hot rice, a spoon of ghee and papad or pickle on the side.

seg.734276af9399.src: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Sannam chilli powder adds a red tinge and a steady, medium heat that sits behind the sour tomato. This recipe serves 4.
seg.734276af9399.t: आमची हळद पावडर डाळीसोबत कुकरमध्ये जाते आणि तिला गडद पिवळा रंग देते. सन्नम मिरची पावडरमुळे लालसर छटा आणि आंबट टोमॅटोच्या मागे राहणारा एकसारखा, मध्यम तिखटपणा येतो. या पाककृतीत 4 जणांसाठी होते.
seg.734276af9399.back: Our turmeric powder goes into the cooker with the dal and gives it a deep yellow colour. Because of Sannam chilli powder there is a reddish tinge and an even, medium heat that stays behind the sour tomato. This recipe makes enough for 4 people.

seg.8c5a5da215b1.src: Total includes letting the cooker release its steam.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.t: एकूण वेळेत कुकरची वाफ आपोआप निघून जाण्याचा वेळही धरला आहे.
seg.8c5a5da215b1.back: The total time also counts the time for the cooker's steam to go out by itself.

seg.2c1a760b1cf8.src: Pressure-cook toor dal with tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder, mash it with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and finish with a garlic and mustard tempering.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.t: तूर डाळ टोमॅटो, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि हळद पावडरसोबत प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये शिजवा, सन्नम मिरची पावडर आणि मिठासोबत घोटा, आणि शेवटी लसूण आणि मोहरीची फोडणी द्या.
seg.2c1a760b1cf8.back: Cook toor dal with tomato, green chillies and turmeric powder in a pressure cooker, mash with Sannam chilli powder and salt, and at the end give a garlic and mustard tempering.

seg.d102a6fa5887.src: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.t: ¾ कप तूर डाळ ⟦1⟧कंदि पप्पु, सुमारे 150 g⟦/1⟧
seg.d102a6fa5887.back: ¾ cup toor dal ⟦1⟧kandi pappu, about 150 g⟦/1⟧

seg.258b0303a820.src: ½ tsp turmeric powder ⟦1⟧goes in the cooker⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.t: ½ छोटा चमचा हळद पावडर ⟦1⟧कुकरमध्ये घालायची⟦/1⟧
seg.258b0303a820.back: ½ teaspoon turmeric powder ⟦1⟧to add in the cooker⟦/1⟧

seg.25c2493b65be.src: 1 tsp Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧goes in after mashing; up to 2 tsp for more heat⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.t: 1 छोटा चमचा सन्नम मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧घोटल्यानंतर घालायची; जास्त तिखटपणासाठी 2 छोट्या चमच्यांपर्यंत⟦/1⟧
seg.25c2493b65be.back: 1 teaspoon Sannam chilli powder ⟦1⟧to add after mashing; up to 2 teaspoons for more heat⟦/1⟧

seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.src: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧plus ½ cup to adjust⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.t: 2½ कप पाणी ⟦1⟧आणि प्रमाण बरोबर करण्यासाठी ½ कप⟦/1⟧
seg.f4f5c6c6e2d3.back: 2½ cups water ⟦1⟧and ½ cup to adjust the consistency⟦/1⟧

seg.5f7d589d9776.src: 1 tbsp tamarind water (optional) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.t: 1 मोठा चमचा चिंचेचे पाणी (हवे असल्यास) ⟦1⟧टोमॅटो फारसे आंबट नसतील तर⟦/1⟧
seg.5f7d589d9776.back: 1 tablespoon tamarind water (if wanted) ⟦1⟧if the tomatoes are not very sour⟦/1⟧

seg.4efa92e0ce99.src: Wash the toor dal in 2–3 changes of water and drain it.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.t: तूर डाळ 2–3 पाण्यांत धुवा आणि निथळा.
seg.4efa92e0ce99.back: Wash toor dal in 2–3 waters and drain.

seg.3f536116a096.src: Put the dal in a pressure cooker with the tomatoes, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups of water.
seg.3f536116a096.t: डाळ प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये टोमॅटो, हिरव्या मिरच्या, कांदा आणि 2½ कप पाण्यासोबत घाला.
seg.3f536116a096.back: Put the dal in the pressure cooker with tomato, green chillies, onion and 2½ cups water.

seg.7d012f63f2a2.src: Pressure-cook the dal with the tomatoes, green chillies and turmeric powder for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before closing the lid, then cook on medium heat.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.t: डाळ टोमॅटो, हिरव्या मिरच्या आणि हळद पावडरसोबत प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये 4 शिट्ट्या करून शिजवा. झाकण लावण्याआधी हळद पावडर पाण्यात ढवळून घ्या, मग मध्यम आचेवर शिजवा.
seg.7d012f63f2a2.back: Cook the dal with tomato, green chillies and turmeric powder in the pressure cooker for 4 whistles. Stir the turmeric powder into the water before putting on the lid, then cook on medium heat.

seg.5dccba018dbc.src: Let the pressure drop on its own, about 10 minutes. The dal is done when a grain mashes completely between two fingers.
seg.5dccba018dbc.t: प्रेशर आपोआप उतरू द्या, सुमारे 10 मिनिटे. डाळीचा दाणा दोन बोटांमध्ये पूर्ण मोडला, की डाळ शिजली.
seg.5dccba018dbc.back: Let the pressure release by itself, about 10 minutes. When a dal grain breaks down fully between two fingers, the dal is cooked.

seg.da76f4c700ad.src: Mash well; add the chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden masher (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash while the dal is still hot, until the tomatoes and dal turn into one smooth mix.
seg.da76f4c700ad.t: नीट घोटा; मिरची पावडर आणि मीठ घाला. लाकडी रवी (पप्पु गुत्ती) किंवा डावाची पाठ वापरा आणि डाळ गरम असतानाच घोटा, टोमॅटो आणि डाळ एकजीव गुळगुळीत होईपर्यंत.
seg.da76f4c700ad.back: Mash well; add chilli powder and salt. Use a wooden churner (pappu gutti) or the back of a ladle and mash the dal while still hot, until tomato and dal become one smooth blend.

seg.c1cb2443fbeb.src: Simmer 5 minutes with a splash of water. Add up to ½ cup water for a pouring consistency, and the tamarind water if using, and keep the heat on low so it does not catch.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.t: थोडे पाणी घालून 5 मिनिटे मंद उकळा. ओतता येईल इतकी पातळ करण्यासाठी ½ कपपर्यंत पाणी घाला, आणि वापरत असाल तर चिंचेचे पाणी, आणि बुडाला लागू नये म्हणून आच मंद ठेवा.
seg.c1cb2443fbeb.back: Add a little water and simmer 5 minutes. To make it thin enough to pour add up to ½ cup water, and tamarind water if using, and keep the heat low so it does not stick to the bottom.

seg.b24472a45a67.src: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in the coriander leaves and switch off.
seg.b24472a45a67.t: मीठ आणि आंबटपणा चाखून पाहा, मग कोथिंबीर ढवळून घाला आणि आच बंद करा.
seg.b24472a45a67.back: Taste for salt and sourness, then stir in coriander leaves and turn off the heat.

seg.6f90b7e4f66a.src: Heat the ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add the mustard seeds; let them splutter.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.t: छोट्या पॅनमध्ये मध्यम आचेवर तूप गरम करा आणि मोहरी घाला; ती तडतडू द्या.
seg.6f90b7e4f66a.back: Heat ghee in a small pan on medium heat and add mustard; let it crackle.

seg.0d1dd3c84a64.src: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in the ghee; pour over. Add the cumin, garlic and dry red chillies after the mustard and fry until the garlic turns golden, then add the curry leaves and hing, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.t: मोहरी, जिरे, लसूण आणि कढीपत्ता तुपात परता; वरून ओता. मोहरीनंतर जिरे, लसूण आणि सुक्या लाल मिरच्या घाला आणि लसूण सोनेरी होईपर्यंत परता, मग कढीपत्ता आणि हिंग घाला, आणि चुरचुरती फोडणी डाळीवर ओता.
seg.0d1dd3c84a64.back: Fry mustard, cumin, garlic and curry leaves in ghee; pour on top. After the mustard add cumin, garlic and dried red chillies and fry until the garlic is golden, then add curry leaves and asafoetida, and pour the sizzling tempering over the dal.

seg.81a1668adc10.src: Cover for 2 minutes so the tempering flavours the dal, then stir and serve hot.
seg.81a1668adc10.t: फोडणीचा स्वाद डाळीत उतरावा म्हणून 2 मिनिटे झाकून ठेवा, मग ढवळून गरम वाढा.
seg.81a1668adc10.back: Keep covered 2 minutes so the tempering's flavour goes into the dal, then stir and serve hot.

seg.f904a5f14a1b.src: Mash the dal while it is hot for a smooth pappu. Once it cools, the grains set and stay lumpy.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.t: गुळगुळीत पप्पुसाठी डाळ गरम असतानाच घोटा. ती थंड झाली की दाणे घट्ट होतात आणि गुठळ्या राहतात.
seg.f904a5f14a1b.back: For smooth pappu mash the dal while it is still hot. Once it cools the grains firm up and lumps remain.

seg.1a8211877e00.src: Sannam chilli powder is medium-hot. Start with 1 tsp; go up to 2 tsp for a spicier pappu.
seg.1a8211877e00.t: सन्नम मिरची पावडर मध्यम तिखट असते. 1 छोट्या चमच्याने सुरुवात करा; जास्त तिखट पप्पुसाठी 2 छोट्या चमच्यांपर्यंत वाढवा.
seg.1a8211877e00.back: Sannam chilli powder is medium hot. Start with 1 teaspoon; for a hotter pappu increase up to 2 teaspoons.

seg.d85da2ea2cf7.src: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the best flavour; with mild hybrid tomatoes add the tamarind water.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.t: पिकलेल्या, आंबट गावठी टोमॅटोंनी (नाटु टोमॅटो) सर्वात छान चव येते; सौम्य हायब्रीड टोमॅटो असतील तर चिंचेचे पाणी घाला.
seg.d85da2ea2cf7.back: Ripe, sour country tomatoes (natu tomatoes) give the nicest flavour; if they are mild hybrid tomatoes add tamarind water.

seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.src: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before the curry leaves go in; pale garlic tastes raw.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.t: कढीपत्ता घालण्याआधी फोडणीत लसूण सोनेरी होऊ द्या; फिकट राहिलेला लसूण कच्चा लागतो.
seg.37f3ad1bf7b9.back: Let the garlic turn golden in the tempering before adding curry leaves; garlic left pale tastes raw.

seg.dfd3706fe457.src: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu, use ½ tsp Teja chilli powder in place of the Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not go over 1 tsp.
seg.dfd3706fe457.t: तेजा मिरची पावडर: जास्त तिखट पप्पुसाठी सन्नमऐवजी ½ छोटा चमचा तेजा मिरची पावडर वापरा. तेजा खूप तिखट असते, म्हणून 1 छोट्या चमच्यापेक्षा जास्त घालू नका.
seg.dfd3706fe457.back: Teja chilli powder: for a hotter pappu use ½ teaspoon Teja chilli powder instead of Sannam. Teja is very hot, so do not add more than 1 teaspoon.

seg.434f1a510bbb.src: Palakura tomato pappu: add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal after mashing and simmer 5 minutes.
seg.434f1a510bbb.t: पालकुरा टमाटा पप्पु: घोटल्यानंतर डाळीत 2 कप चिरलेला पालक घाला आणि 5 मिनिटे मंद उकळा.
seg.434f1a510bbb.back: Palakura tomato pappu: after mashing add 2 cups chopped spinach to the dal and simmer 5 minutes.

seg.8d7a932afdbe.src: Pesarapappu: make it with yellow moong dal and cook for 2 whistles only.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.t: पेसरपप्पु: पिवळ्या मूग डाळीने करा आणि फक्त 2 शिट्ट्या करा.
seg.8d7a932afdbe.back: Pesarapappu: make with yellow moong dal and do only 2 whistles.

seg.94f44314ecbb.src: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and an appadam or avakaya on the side. It also goes well with chapati.
seg.94f44314ecbb.t: वाफवलेला भात, एक चमचा तूप आणि बाजूला पापड किंवा आवकायसोबत गरम वाढा. चपातीसोबतही छान लागते.
seg.94f44314ecbb.back: Serve hot with steamed rice, a spoon of ghee and papad or avakaya on the side. It also tastes nice with chapati.

seg.29a23e2fa864.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. The dal thickens when chilled; add a little hot water and heat through before serving.
seg.29a23e2fa864.t: उरलेली झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. थंड झाल्यावर डाळ घट्ट होते; वाढण्याआधी थोडे गरम पाणी घालून आतपर्यंत गरम करा.
seg.29a23e2fa864.back: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. On cooling the dal thickens; before serving add a little hot water and heat through.

seg.8e56f1d7c871.src: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.t: प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये तूर डाळीला किती शिट्ट्या?
seg.8e56f1d7c871.back: How many whistles for toor dal in a pressure cooker?

seg.562abdd39933.src: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure drop on its own. Older dal or dal that was not washed well may need 5.
seg.562abdd39933.t: मध्यम आचेवर सुमारे 4 शिट्ट्या, मग प्रेशर आपोआप उतरू द्या. जुनी डाळ किंवा नीट न धुतलेल्या डाळीला 5 लागू शकतात.
seg.562abdd39933.back: About 4 whistles on medium heat, then let the pressure release by itself. Old dal or dal not washed well may need 5.

seg.6a800f643cf1.src: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?
seg.6a800f643cf1.t: टमाटा पप्पु आणि सांबार यात काय फरक आहे?
seg.6a800f643cf1.back: What is the difference between tomato pappu and sambar?

seg.05135ac52968.src: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering and no sambar powder or vegetables. Sambar is thinner, uses tamarind, vegetables and a roasted spice powder.
seg.05135ac52968.t: टमाटा पप्पु ही साध्या फोडणीची घट्ट, घोटलेली डाळ आहे, त्यात सांबार मसाला किंवा भाज्या नसतात. सांबार पातळ असते, त्यात चिंच, भाज्या आणि भाजलेल्या मसाल्यांची पूड असते.
seg.05135ac52968.back: Tomato pappu is a thick, mashed dal with a simple tempering; it has no sambar masala or vegetables. Sambar is thin, it has tamarind, vegetables and a powder of roasted spices.

seg.19117f898a31.src: Can I make tomato pappu without a pressure cooker?
seg.19117f898a31.t: प्रेशर कुकरशिवाय टमाटा पप्पु करता येईल का?
seg.19117f898a31.back: Can tomato pappu be made without a pressure cooker?

seg.631df239c7a7.src: Yes. Soak the dal for 30 minutes and cook it in a covered pot with 3½ cups of water for about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it mashes easily.
seg.631df239c7a7.t: हो. डाळ 30 मिनिटे भिजवा आणि झाकलेल्या पातेल्यात 3½ कप पाण्यात सुमारे 40–45 मिनिटे शिजवा, मधूनमधून ढवळत, सहज घोटता येईपर्यंत.
seg.631df239c7a7.back: Yes. Soak the dal 30 minutes and cook in a covered pot in 3½ cups water about 40–45 minutes, stirring now and then, until it can be mashed easily.

seg.b1140d6c02b4.src: Why is my tomato pappu too sour?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.t: माझा टमाटा पप्पु जास्त आंबट का झाला?
seg.b1140d6c02b4.back: Why did my tomato pappu become too sour?

seg.6fb0505bf751.src: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or a spoon of extra mashed dal to balance it.
seg.6fb0505bf751.t: काही टोमॅटो खूप आंबट असतात. डाळ आणखी काही मिनिटे मंद उकळा आणि तोल साधण्यासाठी चिमूटभर गूळ किंवा एक चमचा जास्तीची घोटलेली डाळ ढवळून घाला.
seg.6fb0505bf751.back: Some tomatoes are very sour. Simmer the dal a few more minutes and stir in a pinch of jaggery or an extra spoon of mashed dal to balance.

seg.80a51a64344d.src: టమాటో పప్పు · Andhra Tomato Dal Recipe | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.t: टमाटो पप्पु · आंध्रची टोमॅटो डाळ पाककृती | 1acrefarms
seg.80a51a64344d.back: Tomato Pappu · Andhra tomato dal recipe | 1acrefarms

seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.src: టమాటో పప్పు. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomatoes and green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. Serves 4.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.t: टमाटो पप्पु. आंध्रची टोमॅटो डाळ: टोमॅटो, हिरव्या मिरच्या, आमची हळद आणि सन्नम मिरची पावडरसोबत मऊ शिजवलेली तूर डाळ, आणि लसणाची फोडणी. 4 जणांसाठी.
seg.7b91fd1a3bc3.back: Tomato Pappu. Andhra tomato dal: toor dal cooked soft with tomato, green chillies, our turmeric and Sannam chilli powder, and a garlic tempering. For 4 people.

seg.bf96bcd14023.src: Tomato Pappu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.bf96bcd14023.t: टमाटा पप्पु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.bf96bcd14023.back: Tomato Pappu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.9078b361da10.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Vellulli Kaaram · Lahsun Ki Sookhi Chutney

seg.464f01dcf4e8.src: Vellulli kaaram is the garlic chilli podi kept on Andhra dining tables: red chilli powder pounded with plenty of garlic, roasted coriander and cumin, and salt. Mixed into the first handful of hot rice with ghee, or sprinkled over idli and dosa with a little oil, it is a quick meal on busy days and a staple in tiffin boxes.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम म्हणजे आंध्रच्या जेवणाच्या टेबलावर ठेवली जाणारी लसूण-मिरचीची पोडी: लाल मिरची पावडर भरपूर लसूण, भाजलेले धणे आणि जिरे, आणि मिठासोबत कुटलेली. गरम भाताच्या पहिल्या घासात तुपासोबत कालवून, किंवा इडली-डोशावर थोड्या तेलासोबत भुरभुरून, घाईच्या दिवशी ते पटकन होणारे जेवण आहे, आणि डब्यातही ती नेहमी असते.
seg.464f01dcf4e8.back: Vellulli karam is the garlic-chilli podi kept on the Andhra dining table: red chilli powder pounded with lots of garlic, roasted coriander seeds and cumin, and salt. Mixed with ghee into the first mouthful of hot rice, or sprinkled on idli-dosa with a little oil, it is the quick meal of busy days, and it is always in the lunch box too.

seg.a9654adade5e.src: Our Teja chilli powder makes it deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like it. For less heat, use half Sannam chilli powder.
seg.a9654adade5e.t: आमच्या तेजा मिरची पावडरमुळे ती गडद लाल आणि खूप तिखट होते, गुंटूरच्या घरांना आवडते तशी. कमी तिखटपणासाठी अर्धी सन्नम मिरची पावडर वापरा.
seg.a9654adade5e.back: Because of our Teja chilli powder it becomes deep red and very hot, the way Guntur homes like. For less heat use half Sannam chilli powder.

seg.b43a6fdf4164.src: Total includes cooling the seeds and garlic before grinding.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.t: एकूण वेळेत वाटण्याआधी बिया आणि लसूण थंड होण्याचा वेळही धरला आहे.
seg.b43a6fdf4164.back: The total time also counts the time for the seeds and garlic to cool before grinding.

seg.501bcac1011e.src: Roast coriander and cumin, grind them, then pulse with Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.
seg.501bcac1011e.t: धणे आणि जिरे भाजा, वाटा, मग तेजा मिरची पावडर, मीठ आणि हलका कोमट केलेला लसूण घालून थांबून थांबून फिरवून जाडसर पोडी करा. ती गरम भात आणि तूप, इडली किंवा डोशासोबत खा.
seg.501bcac1011e.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin, grind, then add Teja chilli powder, salt and lightly warmed garlic and pulse into a coarse podi. Eat it with hot rice and ghee, idli or dosa.

seg.e9ce857fe180.src: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; the thin inner skin can stay⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.t: लसणाच्या 25 पाकळ्या ⟦1⟧सुमारे ½ कप, सोललेल्या; आतली पातळ साल राहिली तरी चालेल⟦/1⟧
seg.e9ce857fe180.back: 25 garlic cloves ⟦1⟧about ½ cup, peeled; it is fine if the thin inner skin stays⟦/1⟧

seg.47382aff4c0b.src: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it milder⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.t: ¼ कप तेजा मिरची पावडर ⟦1⟧खूप तिखट; कमी तिखट करण्यासाठी टिप्स पाहा⟦/1⟧
seg.47382aff4c0b.back: ¼ cup Teja chilli powder ⟦1⟧very hot; see the tips to make it less hot⟦/1⟧

seg.33ac26ca8201.t: 1 लहान गोटीएवढी चिंच (हवी असल्यास) ⟦1⟧कोरडी, बिया काढलेली⟦/1⟧
seg.33ac26ca8201.back: 1 small marble-sized tamarind (if wanted) ⟦1⟧dry, seeds removed⟦/1⟧

seg.7bca54595a6a.src: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 tsp per serving⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.t: तूप किंवा तेल ⟦1⟧दर वाढपाला 1 छोटा चमचा⟦/1⟧
seg.7bca54595a6a.back: Ghee or oil ⟦1⟧1 teaspoon per serving⟦/1⟧

seg.074d39a3f8b1.src: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; any water shortens how long the podi keeps.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.t: लसूण सोला आणि पाकळ्या कापडाने पूर्ण कोरड्या टिपून घ्या; थोडेही पाणी राहिले तर पोडी कमी दिवस टिकते.
seg.074d39a3f8b1.back: Peel the garlic and pat the cloves completely dry with a cloth; if even a little water remains the podi keeps fewer days.

seg.33bb0e9eea87.src: Dry-roast the coriander and cumin seeds till fragrant; let them cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander should turn a shade darker, not brown.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.t: धणे आणि जिरे खमंग वास येईपर्यंत कोरडे भाजा; थंड होऊ द्या. छोटे पॅन मध्यम-मंद आचेवर वापरा; यासाठी 1–2 मिनिटे लागतात, आणि धणे एका छटेने गडद व्हायला हवेत, तपकिरी नाही.
seg.33bb0e9eea87.back: Dry-roast coriander seeds and cumin until a toasty smell comes; let cool. Use a small pan on medium-low heat; this takes 1–2 minutes, and the coriander seeds should get one shade darker, not brown.

seg.a2f7a86fc993.src: Warm the garlic in 1 tsp oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should soften slightly at the edges without browning. Let it cool.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.t: लसूण 1 छोटा चमचा तेलात 2 मिनिटे कोमट करा. आच मंद ठेवा आणि ढवळा; पाकळ्या तपकिरी न होता कडेने किंचित मऊ व्हायला हव्यात. थंड होऊ द्या.
seg.a2f7a86fc993.back: Warm the garlic in 1 teaspoon oil for 2 minutes. Keep the heat low and stir; the cloves should get slightly soft at the edges without turning brown. Let cool.

seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.src: Grind the seeds to a powder, then pulse with the chilli powder and salt. Add the tamarind with the seeds, if using, so it breaks down evenly.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.t: बिया वाटून पूड करा, मग मिरची पावडर आणि मीठ घालून थांबून थांबून फिरवा. चिंच वापरत असाल तर ती बियांसोबत घाला, म्हणजे ती सारखी मोडेल.
seg.a4d0f7c87bd5.back: Grind the seeds into powder, then add chilli powder and salt and pulse. If using tamarind add it with the seeds, so it breaks evenly.

seg.c12763cab28c.src: Add the garlic and pulse in short bursts to a coarse, moist powder. Stop and scrape down the jar after every 2–3 pulses, as garlic sticks to the sides.
seg.c12763cab28c.t: लसूण घाला आणि थोडा थोडा वेळ फिरवून जाडसर, ओलसर पूड करा. दर 2–3 फेऱ्यांनंतर थांबून भांड्याच्या कडा खरवडा, कारण लसूण कडेला चिकटतो.
seg.c12763cab28c.back: Add the garlic and pulse a little at a time into a coarse, moist powder. After every 2–3 rounds stop and scrape the sides of the jar, because garlic sticks to the sides.

seg.31358182425b.src: In a stone mortar, pound the seeds first, then the garlic with the salt, and work in the chilli powder last.
seg.31358182425b.t: दगडी खलबत्त्यात आधी बिया कुटा, मग मिठासोबत लसूण, आणि मिरची पावडर सर्वात शेवटी मिसळा.
seg.31358182425b.back: In a stone mortar first pound the seeds, then the garlic with salt, and mix in the chilli powder last of all.

seg.29ac6dd20660.src: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.
seg.29ac6dd20660.t: थोड्या भात आणि तुपासोबत चिमूटभर चाखून पाहा, आणि लागल्यास मीठ घाला.
seg.29ac6dd20660.back: Taste a pinch with a little rice and ghee, and add salt if needed.

seg.b4ccc3b591dd.src: Spread the podi on a plate for 10 minutes so the steam escapes, then pack it into a clean, dry jar.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.t: वाफ निघून जावी म्हणून पोडी 10 मिनिटे ताटात पसरून ठेवा, मग स्वच्छ, कोरड्या बरणीत भरा.
seg.b4ccc3b591dd.back: Keep the podi spread on a plate 10 minutes so the steam goes out, then fill into a clean, dry jar.

seg.23d348ffe051.src: Teja is very hot; use half Sannam for a milder podi, or cut the chilli powder to 3 tbsp for the same garlic.
seg.23d348ffe051.t: तेजा खूप तिखट असते; कमी तिखट पोडीसाठी अर्धी सन्नम वापरा, किंवा तेवढ्याच लसणासाठी मिरची पावडर कमी करून 3 मोठे चमचे घ्या.
seg.23d348ffe051.back: Teja is very hot; for a less hot podi use half Sannam, or for the same garlic reduce the chilli powder and take 3 tablespoons.

seg.948075d5f572.src: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; damp garlic makes the podi go off quickly.
seg.948075d5f572.t: लसूण नीट कोरडा करा आणि तेलात कोमट करा; ओलसर लसणामुळे पोडी लवकर खराब होते.
seg.948075d5f572.back: Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil; because of moist garlic the podi spoils quickly.

seg.1a71c64c8c74.src: Pulse, do not run the mixer: run it long and the garlic turns into a paste.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.t: थांबून थांबून फिरवा, मिक्सर सलग चालवू नका: जास्त वेळ चालवला तर लसणाची पेस्ट होते.
seg.1a71c64c8c74.back: Pulse, do not run the mixer continuously: if run too long the garlic becomes a paste.

seg.d1432fb9a627.src: Mix 1 tsp podi with 1 tsp ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.
seg.d1432fb9a627.t: एक कप गरम भातात 1 छोटा चमचा पोडी आणि 1 छोटा चमचा तूप कालवा; चवीनुसार कमी-जास्त करा.
seg.d1432fb9a627.back: Mix 1 teaspoon podi and 1 teaspoon ghee into a cup of hot rice; adjust to taste.

seg.bdc5e9728b98.src: With dals: dry-roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal with the seeds for a nuttier, slightly milder podi.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.t: डाळींसह: जास्त खमंग, किंचित सौम्य पोडीसाठी बियांसोबत 1 मोठा चमचा चणा डाळ आणि 1 मोठा चमचा उडीद डाळ कोरडी भाजा.
seg.bdc5e9728b98.back: With dals: for a nuttier, slightly milder podi dry-roast 1 tablespoon chana dal and 1 tablespoon urad dal with the seeds.

seg.4d03eacf7428.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste, and eat it within a week.
seg.4d03eacf7428.t: कच्चा लसूण: जास्त तीव्र चवीसाठी लसूण कोमट करणे वगळा, आणि पोडी एका आठवड्यात संपवा.
seg.4d03eacf7428.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper taste skip warming the garlic, and finish the podi within a week.

seg.21139bdcd961.src: Medium heat: use 2 tbsp Teja and 2 tbsp Sannam chilli powder.
seg.21139bdcd961.t: मध्यम तिखटपणा: 2 मोठे चमचे तेजा आणि 2 मोठे चमचे सन्नम मिरची पावडर वापरा.
seg.21139bdcd961.back: Medium heat: use 2 tablespoons Teja and 2 tablespoons Sannam chilli powder.

seg.bceea7c8cb4f.src: Mix with the first handful of hot rice and ghee, or sprinkle over idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.t: गरम भाताच्या पहिल्या घासात तुपासोबत कालवा, किंवा इडली, डोसा किंवा पेसरट्टूवर थोड्या तेल किंवा तुपासोबत भुरभुरा.
seg.bceea7c8cb4f.back: Mix with ghee into the first mouthful of hot rice, or sprinkle on idli, dosa or pesarattu with a little oil or ghee.

seg.5fd9cf1554fd.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar for about 2 weeks at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.t: स्वच्छ, कोरड्या, हवाबंद बरणीत खोलीच्या तापमानाला सुमारे 2 आठवडे, किंवा फ्रिजमध्ये एक महिना ठेवा. नेहमी कोरडा चमचा वापरा.
seg.5fd9cf1554fd.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar at room temperature about 2 weeks, or a month in the fridge. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.c58bc6538b2f.src: How do you make vellulli kaaram?

seg.0ecd3203de93.src: Roast coriander and cumin seeds, grind them, add chilli powder and salt, then pulse in peeled garlic cloves to a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.
seg.0ecd3203de93.t: धणे आणि जिरे भाजा, वाटा, मिरची पावडर आणि मीठ घाला, मग सोललेल्या लसूण पाकळ्या घालून थांबून थांबून फिरवून जाडसर, ओलसर पूड करा. आंध्रातली घरे अनेकदा ती दगडी खलबत्त्यात कुटतात.
seg.0ecd3203de93.back: Roast coriander seeds and cumin, grind, add chilli powder and salt, then add peeled garlic cloves and pulse into a coarse, moist powder. Andhra homes often pound it in a stone mortar.

seg.727d415cb888.src: How do I make garlic podi less spicy?
seg.727d415cb888.t: लसणाची पोडी कमी तिखट कशी करावी?
seg.727d415cb888.back: How to make garlic podi less hot?

seg.e4231ea5cf7a.src: Use half Sannam chilli powder in place of half the Teja, or use 3 tbsp chilli powder in all. Eating it with plenty of ghee also takes the edge off.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.t: अर्ध्या तेजाऐवजी अर्धी सन्नम मिरची पावडर वापरा, किंवा एकूण 3 मोठे चमचे मिरची पावडर वापरा. भरपूर तुपासोबत खाल्ल्यानेही झणका कमी होतो.
seg.e4231ea5cf7a.back: Use half Sannam chilli powder instead of half the Teja, or use 3 tablespoons chilli powder in total. Eating it with lots of ghee also reduces the kick.

seg.982e854e4417.src: How long does vellulli kaaram last?
seg.982e854e4417.back: How many days does vellulli karam keep?

seg.a620f29950c0.src: About 2 weeks at room temperature in a dry, airtight jar, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first so it lasts longer.
seg.a620f29950c0.t: कोरड्या, हवाबंद बरणीत खोलीच्या तापमानाला सुमारे 2 आठवडे, किंवा फ्रिजमध्ये एक महिना. लसूण नीट कोरडा करा आणि आधी तेलात कोमट करा, म्हणजे ते जास्त दिवस टिकते.
seg.a620f29950c0.back: About 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar at room temperature, or a month in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and first warm it in oil, so it keeps more days.

seg.4c626acd1bdd.src: Can I use whole dried red chillies instead of chilli powder?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.t: मिरची पावडरऐवजी अख्ख्या सुक्या लाल मिरच्या वापरू शकतो का?
seg.4c626acd1bdd.back: Can whole dried red chillies be used instead of chilli powder?

seg.c796942589c3.src: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.c796942589c3.t: हो. सुमारे 20 सुक्या लाल मिरच्या तेलाच्या काही थेंबांसोबत कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत कोरड्या भाजा, थंड करा आणि लसूण घालण्याआधी वाटा.
seg.c796942589c3.back: Yes. Dry-roast about 20 dried red chillies with a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.c5afa85ab56d.src: వెల్లుల్లి కారం. Andhra garlic chilli podi: roasted coriander and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or idli and dosa.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम. आंध्रची लसूण-मिरची पोडी: भाजलेले धणे आणि जिरे लसूण, मीठ आणि तेजा मिरची पावडरसोबत कुटलेले. गरम भात आणि तुपासोबत, किंवा इडली आणि डोशासोबत कालवा.
seg.c5afa85ab56d.back: Vellulli Karam. Andhra garlic-chilli podi: roasted coriander seeds and cumin pounded with garlic, salt and Teja chilli powder. Mix with hot rice and ghee, or with idli and dosa.

seg.eff09f5a48ed.src: Vellulli Kaaram: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.eff09f5a48ed.t: वेल्लुल्ली कारम: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.eff09f5a48ed.back: Vellulli Karam: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.3b01a30ec3ce.src: Rub the chicken with curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt. Rest 30 minutes. Cover the bowl and keep it in the fridge while it rests.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.t: चिकनला दही, तेजा मिरची पावडर, हळद पावडर आणि मीठ चोळून लावा. 30 मिनिटे तसेच ठेवा. तेवढा वेळ भांडे झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा.
seg.3b01a30ec3ce.back: Rub curd, Teja chilli powder, turmeric powder and salt onto the chicken. Leave it like that for 30 minutes. For that time keep the vessel covered in the fridge.

seg.6cceb77cd01b.src: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.t: 500 g माशांचे तुकडे ⟦1⟧घट्ट मासा, जाड तुकड्यांत कापलेला: रोहू, कटला (बोच्चा), कोरमीनु (मरळ) किंवा सुरमई (वंजरम)⟦/1⟧
seg.6cceb77cd01b.back: 500 g fish pieces ⟦1⟧firm fish, cut into thick pieces: rohu, catla (boccha), korameenu (murrel) or seer fish (vanjaram)⟦/1⟧

seg.3248f0a2bb4b.src: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked in 2 cups warm water for 15 minutes⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.t: 40 g चिंच ⟦1⟧साधारण दोन लिंबाएवढे गोळे, 2 कप कोमट पाण्यात 15 मिनिटे भिजवलेले⟦/1⟧
seg.3248f0a2bb4b.back: 40 g tamarind ⟦1⟧about two lemon-sized balls, soaked 15 minutes in 2 cups lukewarm water⟦/1⟧

seg.6efbfa504170.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat gently in the pan without stirring, until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.6efbfa504170.t: उरलेले झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. पॅनमध्ये न ढवळता हलक्या आचेवर, आतपर्यंत पूर्ण वाफाळते गरम होईपर्यंत पुन्हा गरम करा.
seg.6efbfa504170.back: Cover the leftovers, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Reheat in a pan on low flame without stirring, until fully steaming hot all the way through to the inside.

seg.379b410c6994.src: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick steaks: rohu, catla (bochcha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Bony small fish also work but need gentle handling.
seg.379b410c6994.t: जाड तुकड्यांत कापलेला घट्ट नदीतला किंवा समुद्रातला मासा: रोहू, कटला (बोच्चा), मरळ (कोरमीनु) किंवा सुरमई. काटेरी लहान मासेही चालतात, पण ते हलक्या हाताने हाताळावे लागतात.
seg.379b410c6994.back: Firm river or sea fish cut into thick pieces: rohu, catla (boccha), murrel (korameenu) or seer fish. Small bony fish also work, but they have to be handled with a light hand.

seg.3af5b68fc2e1.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Warm the pulusu in a pan with a splash of water until steaming hot all the way through.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.t: उरलेले झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 दिवसांत खा. थोडे पाणी घालून पॅनमध्ये पुलुसु आतपर्यंत पूर्ण वाफाळते गरम होईपर्यंत गरम करा.
seg.3af5b68fc2e1.back: Cover the leftovers, keep in the fridge and eat within 2 days. Adding a little water, heat the pulusu in a pan until fully steaming hot all the way through to the inside.

seg.b4d28033bb05.src: Mutton vepudu: pressure-cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water for 5–6 whistles, until tender, then fry it the same way.
seg.b4d28033bb05.t: मटण वेपुडु: 500 g बोनलेस मटण मॅरिनेड आणि ½ कप पाण्यासोबत प्रेशर कुकरमध्ये 5–6 शिट्ट्या करून, मऊ होईपर्यंत शिजवा, मग त्याच पद्धतीने तळा.
seg.b4d28033bb05.back: Mutton vepudu: cook 500 g boneless mutton with the marinade and ½ cup water in a pressure cooker for 5–6 whistles, until soft, then fry the same way.

seg.04112853a660.src: Both work. Boneless cooks faster and crisps more; small bone-in pieces have more flavour but need 6–8 minutes longer in their juices.
seg.04112853a660.t: दोन्ही चालतात. बोनलेस लवकर शिजते आणि जास्त कुरकुरीत होते; हाडासकट लहान तुकड्यांना जास्त चव असते, पण त्यांना रसात 6–8 मिनिटे जास्त लागतात.
seg.04112853a660.back: Both work. Boneless cooks quickly and becomes crispier; small bone-in pieces have more flavour, but they need 6–8 minutes more in the juices.

seg.d20a641bec03.src: Pack it for a lunch box or a short journey and eat it within about 4 hours. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them within a day.
seg.d20a641bec03.t: डब्यात किंवा छोट्या प्रवासासाठी नेत असाल तर साधारण 4 तासांत खा. उरलेला झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि एका दिवसात खा.
seg.d20a641bec03.back: If taking it in a tiffin box or on a short trip, eat within about 4 hours. Cover the leftover, keep in the fridge and eat within one day.

seg.bc9078e02646.src: Either the lemon juice was cooked or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric last, switch off the stove right after and stir for only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, off the heat.
seg.bc9078e02646.t: एकतर लिंबाचा रस शिजला गेला, किंवा हळद तेलात करपली. हळद सगळ्यात शेवटी घाला, लगेच गॅस बंद करा आणि फक्त 5–10 सेकंद ढवळा; लिंबाचा रस आचेपासून दूर, भातात घाला.
seg.bc9078e02646.back: Either the lemon juice got cooked, or the turmeric burnt in the oil. Add the turmeric at the very end, turn off the gas immediately and stir only 5–10 seconds; add the lemon juice to the rice, away from the heat.

seg.c288f67fcabb.src: Pour the other cup of water into a heavy-bottomed pan; a thin pan lets the ragi catch.
seg.c288f67fcabb.t: दुसरा कप पाणी जाड बुडाच्या पातेल्यात ओता; पातळ पातेल्यात रागी खाली लागते.
seg.c288f67fcabb.back: Pour the second cup of water into a heavy-bottomed vessel; in a thin vessel the ragi sticks to the bottom.

seg.e87c26125f87.src: Can I use cane jaggery in ragi java?
seg.e87c26125f87.t: रागी जावामध्ये उसाचा गूळ वापरू शकतो का?
seg.e87c26125f87.back: Can we use sugarcane jaggery in ragi java?

seg.a9a06390a945.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after switching off the stove, so the milk does not split. It gives a lighter colour and a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.a9a06390a945.t: हो. तेवढाच किसलेला उसाचा गूळ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) घ्या आणि गॅस बंद केल्यानंतर ढवळून घाला, म्हणजे दूध फाटणार नाही. त्याने रंग फिकट येतो आणि गोडवा सौम्य, कॅरमेलसारखा लागतो.
seg.a9a06390a945.back: Yes. Take the same amount of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) and stir it in after turning off the gas, so the milk will not split. It gives a lighter colour and a mild, caramel-like sweetness.

seg.e7cb15cc47e2.src: Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Reheat in a pan only until steaming hot all the way through; longer reheating makes the prawns tough.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.t: उरलेले झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 1 दिवसात खा. पॅनमध्ये फक्त आतपर्यंत पूर्ण वाफाळते गरम होईपर्यंतच गरम करा; त्यापेक्षा जास्त वेळ गरम केल्याने कोळंबी चिवट होते.
seg.e7cb15cc47e2.back: Cover the leftovers, keep in the fridge and eat within 1 day. Heat in a pan only until fully steaming hot all the way through to the inside; heating longer than that makes the prawns tough.

seg.ea5408ec0853.src: Can I make sunnundalu with cane jaggery?
seg.ea5408ec0853.t: उसाच्या गुळाने सुन्नुंडलु करता येतील का?
seg.ea5408ec0853.back: Can sunnundalu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.ec48010dffbe.src: Yes. Grate the cane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus turn lighter in colour, with a milder, caramel-like sweetness.
seg.ec48010dffbe.t: हो. उसाचा गूळ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) बारीक किसा आणि ताडाच्या गुळाइतकाच वापरा. लाडूंचा रंग फिकट होतो आणि गोडवा सौम्य, कॅरमेलसारखा लागतो.
seg.ec48010dffbe.back: Yes. Grate sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam) finely and use the same amount as palm jaggery. The laddus' colour becomes lighter and the sweetness tastes mild, caramel-like.

seg.767f9e16fa95.src: Raw garlic: skip warming the garlic for a sharper taste; keep it in the fridge and eat it within 3 days.
seg.767f9e16fa95.t: कच्चा लसूण: जास्त तीव्र चवीसाठी लसूण कोमट करणे वगळा; फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 3 दिवसांत खा.
seg.767f9e16fa95.back: Raw garlic: for a sharper flavour skip warming the garlic; keep in the fridge and eat within 3 days.

seg.8665687f81ce.src: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use it within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.
seg.8665687f81ce.t: स्वच्छ, कोरड्या, हवाबंद बरणीत फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि 2 आठवड्यांत वापरा. नेहमी कोरडा चमचा वापरा.
seg.8665687f81ce.back: Keep in a clean, dry, airtight jar in the fridge and use within 2 weeks. Always use a dry spoon.

seg.367798df40e3.src: Up to 2 weeks in a dry, airtight jar in the fridge. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.
seg.367798df40e3.t: कोरड्या, हवाबंद बरणीत फ्रिजमध्ये 2 आठवड्यांपर्यंत टिकते. लसूण नीट कोरडा करा आणि आधी तेलात कोमट करा, आणि नेहमी कोरडा चमचा वापरा.
seg.367798df40e3.back: Keeps up to 2 weeks in the fridge in a dry, airtight jar. Dry the garlic well and warm it in oil first, and always use a dry spoon.

seg.1d41be2d17f9.src: Yes. Roast about 20 dried red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind them before adding the garlic.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.t: हो. सुमारे 20 सुक्या लाल मिरच्या तेलाच्या काही थेंबांत कुरकुरीत होईपर्यंत भाजा, थंड करा आणि लसूण घालण्याआधी वाटा.
seg.1d41be2d17f9.back: Yes. Roast about 20 dry red chillies in a few drops of oil until crisp, cool and grind before adding the garlic.

seg.7099f7c35107.src: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery)⟦/1⟧
seg.7099f7c35107.back: Bellam Atukulu ⟦1⟧(sweet poha with palm jaggery)⟦/1⟧

seg.c9c11f5b43da.src: Bellam atukulu is the 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. It is the poha offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, recalling Kuchela's gift, and it is also a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only rinsed, never cooked in water, and then tossed in warm jaggery syrup.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु हे तेलुगु घरांतील 10 मिनिटांचे गोड आहे. कृष्णाष्टमीला कृष्णाला अर्पण केले जाणारे हे पोहे आहेत, कुचेलाच्या भेटीची आठवण म्हणून, आणि शाळेनंतर मुलांसाठी झटपट गोड म्हणूनही हे केले जाते. पोहे फक्त धुतले जातात, पाण्यात कधीच शिजवले जात नाहीत, आणि मग कोमट गुळाच्या पाकात परतले जातात.
seg.c9c11f5b43da.back: Bellam Atukulu is a 10-minute sweet of Telugu homes. These are the poha that are offered to Krishna on Krishnashtami, in memory of Kuchela's gift, and it is also made as a quick sweet for children after school. The poha is only washed, never cooked in water, and then tossed (sautéed) in lukewarm jaggery syrup.

seg.8594fedb25dc.src: Our Thati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a deep brown colour and a rich, slightly smoky sweetness. This recipe serves 2.
seg.8594fedb25dc.t: आमचा ताटि बेल्लम ताडाचा गूळ याला गडद तपकिरी रंग आणि भरपूर, हलकी धुरकट गोड चव देतो. ही कृती 2 जणांसाठी आहे.
seg.8594fedb25dc.back: Our Tati Bellam palm jaggery gives it a dark brown colour and a rich, light smoky sweet taste. This recipe is for 2 people.

seg.25e28614accb.src: Prep includes 5 minutes for the rinsed poha to soften.
seg.25e28614accb.t: तयारीत धुतलेले पोहे मऊ होण्यासाठी 5 मिनिटे धरली आहेत.
seg.25e28614accb.back: The preparation includes 5 minutes for the washed poha to soften.

seg.b9dedcd705aa.src: Soften thick poha, toss it in warm palm jaggery syrup with coconut and cardamom, and finish with ghee.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.t: जाड पोहे मऊ करा, खोबरे आणि वेलचीसह कोमट ताडाच्या गुळाच्या पाकात परता, आणि शेवटी तूप घाला.
seg.b9dedcd705aa.back: Soften the thick poha, toss (sauté) it with coconut (khobre) and cardamom in lukewarm palm jaggery syrup, and finally add ghee.

seg.e13864ccb71f.src: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.t: ½ कप किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧सुमारे 90 g⟦/1⟧
seg.e13864ccb71f.back: ½ cup grated palm jaggery ⟦1⟧about 90 g⟦/1⟧

seg.b78c520dca8d.src: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.t: ½ कप किसलेले खोबरे ⟦1⟧फक्त पांढरा भाग⟦/1⟧
seg.b78c520dca8d.back: ½ cup grated coconut ⟦1⟧white part only⟦/1⟧

seg.2d6d2ff14f71.src: ¼ tsp cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or the crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.t: ¼ छोटा चमचा वेलची पूड ⟦1⟧किंवा 2–3 वेलदोड्यांच्या कुटलेल्या बिया⟦/1⟧
seg.2d6d2ff14f71.back: ¼ small spoon cardamom powder ⟦1⟧or crushed seeds of 2–3 pods⟦/1⟧

seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.src: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out any bits of husk.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.t: पोहे गाळणीत ठेवा आणि कोंड्याचे कण निवडून काढा.
seg.fbe7b4b8afbc.back: Put the poha in a sieve and pick out the pieces of husk.

seg.b0f730c0b062.src: Rinse the poha in a sieve under running water for a few seconds, drain, and leave it for 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.
seg.b0f730c0b062.t: पोहे गाळणीत ठेवून वाहत्या पाण्याखाली काही सेकंद धुवा, पाणी निथळू द्या, आणि मऊ होण्यासाठी 5 मिनिटे ठेवा. दाबल्यावर मऊ लागावे, पण ओले नसावे.
seg.b0f730c0b062.back: Keep the poha in a sieve and wash it for a few seconds under running water, drain the water, and leave it 5 minutes to soften. It should feel soft when pressed, but not wet.

seg.0a3e2261d7bc.src: Grate the palm jaggery finely, breaking up any hard lumps.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.t: ताडाचा गूळ बारीक किसा, कडक गुठळ्या असतील तर फोडा.
seg.0a3e2261d7bc.back: Grate the palm jaggery fine, break any hard lumps.

seg.d2b892bf70af.src: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back in.
seg.d2b892bf70af.t: ताडाचा गूळ 2 मोठे चमचे पाण्यासह मंद आचेवर वितळवा, मग गाळून घ्या. पॅन पुसून पाक परत त्यात ओता.
seg.d2b892bf70af.back: Melt the palm jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low heat, then strain. Wipe the pan and pour the syrup back into it.

seg.d073ead78aef.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden.
seg.d073ead78aef.t: काजू वापरत असाल तर थोड्या तुपात सोनेरी होईपर्यंत तळा.
seg.d073ead78aef.back: If adding cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden.

seg.62c17a0f01a5.src: Add the poha, coconut and cardamom to the warm syrup and toss gently on a low flame for 1–2 minutes, until every flake is coated. Use a light hand so the flakes do not break.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.t: कोमट पाकात पोहे, खोबरे आणि वेलची घाला आणि मंद आचेवर 1–2 मिनिटे हलक्या हाताने परता, प्रत्येक पोह्याला पाक लागेपर्यंत. हात हलका ठेवा म्हणजे पोहे मोडणार नाहीत.
seg.62c17a0f01a5.back: Add the poha, coconut (khobre) and cardamom to the lukewarm syrup and toss (sauté) gently on low heat for 1–2 minutes, until syrup has coated every poha piece. Keep a light hand so the poha does not break.

seg.d1abe3d7557d.src: Take the pan off the heat as soon as the flakes are coated; longer cooking makes them chewy.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.t: पोह्यांना पाक लागताच पॅन आचेवरून उतरवा; जास्त वेळ शिजवल्यास ते चिवट होतात.
seg.d1abe3d7557d.back: As soon as the syrup coats the poha, take the pan off the heat; if cooked too long they become tough/chewy.

seg.c91ffab6359d.src: Finish with the ghee and cashews. Serve warm or at room temperature.
seg.c91ffab6359d.t: शेवटी तूप आणि काजू घाला. कोमट किंवा खोलीच्या तापमानाला वाढा.
seg.c91ffab6359d.back: Finally add ghee and cashews. Serve lukewarm or at room temperature.

seg.544ea222a497.src: Use thick poha. Thin poha turns mushy in the syrup.
seg.544ea222a497.t: जाड पोहे वापरा. पातळ पोहे पाकात गिचका होतात.
seg.544ea222a497.back: Use thick poha. Thin poha becomes mush (gichka) in the syrup.

seg.0f56d718ca89.src: Do not soak the poha in a bowl of water; a quick rinse is enough, or it turns soft and sticky.
seg.0f56d718ca89.t: पोहे वाटीभर पाण्यात भिजवू नका; झटकन धुणे पुरेसे आहे, नाहीतर ते मऊ आणि चिकट होतात.
seg.0f56d718ca89.back: Do not soak the poha in a bowlful of water; a quick wash is enough, otherwise it becomes soft and sticky.

seg.972f174730fe.src: Keep the syrup warm, not bubbling, when the poha goes in, so the flakes coat evenly.
seg.972f174730fe.t: पोहे घालताना पाक कोमट ठेवा, उकळणारा नको, म्हणजे पोह्यांना सगळीकडे सारखा लागेल.
seg.972f174730fe.back: Keep the syrup lukewarm, not boiling, when adding the poha, so that it coats the poha evenly.

seg.8496cfe4aa1d.src: With milk: pour 2–3 tbsp warm milk over the finished poha for a softer sweet.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.t: दुधासह: तयार पोह्यांवर 2–3 मोठे चमचे कोमट दूध घाला, म्हणजे गोड अधिक मऊ होईल.
seg.8496cfe4aa1d.back: With milk: pour 2–3 big spoons of lukewarm milk over the prepared poha, the sweet will be softer.

seg.bb5e4ee879e6.src: With sesame: add 1 tbsp roasted sesame seeds along with the coconut.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.t: तिळासह: खोबऱ्यासोबत 1 मोठा चमचा भाजलेले तीळ घाला.
seg.bb5e4ee879e6.back: With sesame: add 1 big spoon of roasted sesame along with the coconut.

seg.25d7247d3c7b.src: Serve it as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.t: कृष्णाष्टमीला नैवेद्य म्हणून वाढा, किंवा शाळेनंतर मुलांसाठी झटपट गोड म्हणून.
seg.25d7247d3c7b.back: Serve as naivedyam on Krishnashtami, or as a quick sweet for children after school.

seg.1170385c1b79.src: Best eaten the day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat them the next day; the poha firms up as it stands.
seg.1170385c1b79.t: बनवलेल्या दिवशीच खाणे उत्तम. उरलेले झाकून फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवा आणि दुसऱ्या दिवशी खा; ठेवल्यावर पोहे घट्ट होतात.
seg.1170385c1b79.back: Best eaten on the very day it is made. Keep leftovers covered in the fridge and eat on the second day; on keeping, the poha become firm.

seg.6acb206e9df4.src: Which poha is best for bellam atukulu?
seg.6acb206e9df4.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलुसाठी कोणते पोहे सर्वात चांगले?
seg.6acb206e9df4.back: Which poha is best for Bellam Atukulu?

seg.7cb97f8423cf.src: Thick poha (atukulu). It holds its shape in the warm syrup; thin poha turns mushy.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.t: जाड पोहे (अटुकुलु). ते कोमट पाकात आकार टिकवतात; पातळ पोहे गिचका होतात.
seg.7cb97f8423cf.back: Thick poha (atukulu). It keeps its shape in lukewarm syrup; thin poha becomes mush.

seg.ba8eb1721096.src: Can I make bellam atukulu with cane jaggery?
seg.ba8eb1721096.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु उसाच्या गुळाने करता येतात का?
seg.ba8eb1721096.back: Can Bellam Atukulu be made with sugarcane jaggery?

seg.2a1aa941db07.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated cane jaggery (cheruku bellam). It turns lighter in colour, with a caramel-like sweetness.
seg.2a1aa941db07.t: हो. तेवढाच किसलेला उसाचा गूळ (चेरुकु बेल्लम) वापरा. रंग हलका होतो, आणि गोडवा कॅरॅमलसारखा.
seg.2a1aa941db07.back: Yes. Take the same quantity of grated sugarcane jaggery (cheruku bellam). The colour is light, and the sweetness is caramel-like.

seg.88008fa2d0e6.src: Why is my bellam atukulu sticky?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.t: माझे बेल्लम अटुकुलु चिकट का झाले?
seg.88008fa2d0e6.back: Why did my Bellam Atukulu become sticky?

seg.a6945e480c9a.src: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Rinse it for only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as every flake is coated.
seg.a6945e480c9a.t: पोहे जास्त वेळ भिजले किंवा शिजले. फक्त काही सेकंद धुवा, आणि प्रत्येक पोह्याला पाक लागताच पॅन आचेवरून उतरवा.
seg.a6945e480c9a.back: The poha was soaked or cooked too long. Wash it only a few seconds, and take the pan off the heat as soon as the syrup coats each poha piece.

seg.d4c0fab65bf7.src: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?
seg.d4c0fab65bf7.back: Why is it made on Krishnashtami?

seg.51ab1914ac8d.src: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought a handful of poha to his friend Krishna as his only gift.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.t: हे कुचेलाच्या कथेची आठवण करून देते, जो आपला मित्र कृष्ण याच्यासाठी भेट म्हणून फक्त मूठभर पोहे घेऊन आला होता.
seg.51ab1914ac8d.back: It recalls the story of Kuchela, who brought just a handful of poha as a gift for his friend Krishna.

seg.5080241b3883.src: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra bellam atukulu: thick poha tossed in warm Thati Bellam palm jaggery syrup with coconut, cardamom and ghee. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and FAQs.
seg.5080241b3883.t: బెల్లం అటుకులు. आंध्रचे बेल्लम अटुकुलु: जाड पोहे खोबरे, वेलची आणि तुपासह कोमट ताटि बेल्लम ताडाच्या गुळाच्या पाकात परतलेले. 10 मिनिटांचे गोड, टिप्स आणि सामान्य प्रश्नांसह.
seg.5080241b3883.back: బెల్లం అటుకులు. Andhra's Bellam Atukulu: thick poha tossed (sautéed) with coconut (khobre), cardamom and ghee in lukewarm Tati Bellam palm jaggery syrup. A 10-minute sweet, with tips and common questions.

seg.4239bed21420.src: Bellam Atukulu (Sweet Poha with Palm Jaggery) · 1acrefarms
seg.4239bed21420.back: Bellam Atukulu (sweet poha with palm jaggery) · 1acrefarms

seg.8dafb14d8ade.src: Bellam Atukulu: the recipe card from 1acrefarms, with ingredients and method
seg.8dafb14d8ade.t: बेल्लम अटुकुलु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.8dafb14d8ade.back: Bellam Atukulu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method

seg.cf5b9ab6ccf1.back: Andhra sweet things · about 14 are made

seg.753ec27036d4.src: ⟦#1⟧ · ⟦#2⟧ · Kobbari Undalu · Nariyal Gud Ke Laddu

seg.de7ddbad7bf0.src: Kobbari undalu are the coconut laddus Andhra homes make for festivals, naivedyam and an everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on a low flame until the mix holds together, and the laddus are rolled by hand while still warm.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.t: कोब्बरि उंडलु हे खोबऱ्याचे लाडू आंध्रच्या घरांत सण, नैवेद्य आणि रोजचे गोड म्हणून बनवतात. त्यासाठी फक्त खोबरे, गूळ, वेलची आणि एक चमचा तूप लागते. गूळ वितळवून गाळला जातो, त्यात खोबरे मंद आचेवर मिश्रण एकत्र धरून राहेपर्यंत शिजवले जाते, आणि लाडू कोमट असतानाच हाताने वळले जातात.
seg.de7ddbad7bf0.back: Kobbari Undalu are the coconut laddus that are made in Andhra homes for festivals, naivedyam and everyday sweet. They need only coconut, jaggery, cardamom and a spoon of ghee. The jaggery is melted and strained, the coconut is cooked in it on low heat until the mixture joins together, and the laddus are shaped by hand while warm.

seg.089fb020d00e.src: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a mellow caramel taste. This recipe makes about 14 laddus.
seg.089fb020d00e.t: आमचा चेरुकु बेल्लम याला हलका सोनेरी रंग आणि मऊ, कॅरॅमलसारखी चव देतो. या कृतीतून सुमारे 14 लाडू होतात.
seg.089fb020d00e.back: Our Cheruku Bellam gives them a light golden colour and a soft, caramel-like taste. About 14 laddus are made from this recipe.

seg.d9e7175cce3e.src: Allow another 15 minutes for the laddus to cool before you store them.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.t: ठेवण्याआधी लाडू थंड होण्यासाठी आणखी 15 मिनिटे द्या.
seg.d9e7175cce3e.back: Before storing (filling away), give the laddus another 15 minutes to cool.

seg.80b59063a128.src: Melt cane jaggery, cook it with grated coconut till it comes together, add cardamom and ghee, and roll into laddus.
seg.80b59063a128.t: उसाचा गूळ वितळवा, किसलेल्या खोबऱ्यासह मिश्रण एकत्र होईपर्यंत शिजवा, वेलची आणि तूप घाला, आणि लाडू वळा.
seg.80b59063a128.back: Melt the sugarcane jaggery, cook it with the grated coconut until the mixture joins together, add cardamom and ghee, and shape the laddus.

seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.src: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.t: 2 कप किसलेले खोबरे ⟦1⟧1 मध्यम नारळ; फक्त पांढरा भाग किसा⟦/1⟧
seg.9dbfabbc7bd0.back: 2 cups grated coconut ⟦1⟧1 medium coconut; grate only the white part⟦/1⟧

seg.fa687abb7dd1.src: 1 cup grated cane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; pound or grate the pieces first⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.t: 1 कप किसलेला उसाचा गूळ ⟦1⟧सुमारे 180 g; आधी तुकडे कुटून किंवा किसून घ्या⟦/1⟧
seg.fa687abb7dd1.back: 1 cup grated sugarcane jaggery ⟦1⟧about 180 g; first pound or grate the pieces⟦/1⟧

seg.1ca2ce946869.src: 1 tbsp ghee ⟦1⟧plus a little for greasing your palms⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.t: 1 मोठा चमचा तूप ⟦1⟧आणि तळहातांना लावण्यासाठी थोडे⟦/1⟧
seg.1ca2ce946869.back: 1 big spoon ghee ⟦1⟧and a little for the palms⟦/1⟧

seg.ccf1a746b971.src: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.t: 10 काजू, ऐच्छिक ⟦1⟧तुकडे करून तुपात सोनेरी तळलेले⟦/1⟧
seg.ccf1a746b971.back: 10 cashews, optional ⟦1⟧broken and fried golden in ghee⟦/1⟧

seg.15ef8686cc9e.src: Grate the coconut, leaving out the brown skin so the laddus stay light in colour.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.t: खोबरे किसा, तपकिरी साल सोडून द्या म्हणजे लाडूंचा रंग हलका राहील.
seg.15ef8686cc9e.back: Grate the coconut, leave the brown skin so that the laddus' colour stays light.

seg.00b442d7f507.src: Pound or grate the cane jaggery into small pieces so it melts evenly.
seg.00b442d7f507.t: उसाचा गूळ कुटून किंवा किसून लहान तुकडे करा म्हणजे तो सारखा वितळेल.
seg.00b442d7f507.back: Pound or grate the sugarcane jaggery into small pieces so that it melts evenly.

seg.c25e0610c714.src: Melt the jaggery with 2 tbsp water on a low flame, then strain it through a fine sieve. This catches any grit or bits of cane from the block.
seg.c25e0610c714.t: गूळ 2 मोठे चमचे पाण्यासह मंद आचेवर वितळवा, मग बारीक गाळणीतून गाळा. यामुळे ढेपेतील खडे आणि उसाचे तुकडे निघून जातात.
seg.c25e0610c714.back: Melt the jaggery with 2 big spoons of water on low heat, then strain through a fine sieve. This strains out the grit and sugarcane pieces in the jaggery lump.

seg.3eb20f2a7136.src: Return it to the pan, add the coconut and cook on medium-low, stirring, until the mix leaves the sides of the pan and holds together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so it does not catch at the bottom.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.t: ते परत पॅनमध्ये घाला, खोबरे घाला आणि मध्यम-मंद आचेवर ढवळत शिजवा, मिश्रण पॅनच्या कडा सोडेपर्यंत आणि एकत्र धरून राहेपर्यंत, 12–15 मिनिटे. ढवळत राहा म्हणजे तळाला लागणार नाही.
seg.3eb20f2a7136.back: Pour it back into the pan, mix in the coconut and cook stirring on medium-low heat, until the mixture leaves the sides of the pan and joins together, 12–15 minutes. Keep stirring so that it does not stick at the bottom.

seg.e1985b8e5f9c.src: If you are using cashews, fry them in a little ghee till golden while the mix cooks.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.t: काजू वापरत असाल तर मिश्रण शिजत असताना ते थोड्या तुपात सोनेरी होईपर्यंत तळा.
seg.e1985b8e5f9c.back: If adding cashews, fry them in a little ghee until golden while the mixture is cooking.

seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.src: Stir in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the heat.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.t: वेलची, तूप आणि काजू ढवळून घाला. पॅन आचेवरून उतरवा.
seg.1dc27e2d9b3e.back: Mix in the cardamom, ghee and cashews. Take the pan off the heat.

seg.d4ee96780aba.src: Let it cool till you can handle it, grease your palms with ghee and roll it into small balls. Press each one firmly so it holds together.
seg.d4ee96780aba.t: हाताळता येईल इतके थंड होऊ द्या, तळहातांना तूप लावा आणि लहान गोळे वळा. प्रत्येक गोळा घट्ट दाबा म्हणजे तो एकत्र राहील.
seg.d4ee96780aba.back: Let it cool enough that you can hold it by hand, put ghee on the palms and shape small balls. Press each one firmly so it stays together.

seg.3753ea8bc7d0.src: Set the laddus on a greased plate and let them cool completely before you store them.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.t: लाडू तूप लावलेल्या ताटात ठेवा आणि भरून ठेवण्याआधी पूर्ण थंड होऊ द्या.
seg.3753ea8bc7d0.back: Put the laddus on a ghee-greased plate and let them cool completely before storing (filling away).

seg.fb3de84de9f6.src: If the mix won't hold a shape, cook it 2 minutes more. If it sets too hard, sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk and press again.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.t: मिश्रण आकार धरत नसेल तर आणखी 2 मिनिटे शिजवा. जर ते खूपच कडक झाले, तर एक चमचा कोमट दूध शिंपडा आणि पुन्हा दाबा.
seg.fb3de84de9f6.back: If the mixture does not hold shape, cook it 2 more minutes. If it sets too hard, sprinkle a spoon of lukewarm milk and press again.

seg.71475e1a7345.src: Keep the flame at medium-low; on a high flame the jaggery darkens and the laddus turn hard.
seg.71475e1a7345.t: आच मध्यम-मंद ठेवा; तीव्र आचेवर गूळ गडद होतो आणि लाडू कडक होतात.
seg.71475e1a7345.back: Keep the heat medium-low; on high heat the jaggery darkens and the laddus turn out hard.

seg.46a2e2b2d323.src: Roll the laddus while the mix is still warm; once it cools completely it will not bind.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.t: मिश्रण कोमट असतानाच लाडू वळा; पूर्ण थंड झाल्यावर ते बांधले जात नाही.
seg.46a2e2b2d323.back: Shape the laddus while the mixture is warm; once completely cool it does not bind.

seg.b277c024adad.src: Palm jaggery: use the same amount of grated palm jaggery for darker laddus with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.b277c024adad.t: ताडाचा गूळ: तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ वापरा; लाडू अधिक गडद होतील, हलक्या धुरकट गोड चवीसह.
seg.b277c024adad.back: Palm jaggery: take the same quantity of grated palm jaggery; the laddus will be dark in colour, with a light smoky sweet taste.

seg.7b597df04222.src: Dry coconut: use the same amount of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mix comes together faster, so watch it closely.
seg.7b597df04222.t: सुके खोबरे: तेवढेच किसलेले सुके खोबरे (कोप्रा) वापरा; मिश्रण लवकर एकत्र येते, म्हणून नीट लक्ष ठेवा.
seg.7b597df04222.back: Dry coconut: take the same quantity of grated dry coconut (kopra); the mixture joins quickly, so keep watching carefully.

seg.676bca051e10.src: Kobbari burfi: spread the cooked mix on a greased plate, let it set a little and cut it into squares instead of rolling laddus.
seg.676bca051e10.t: कोब्बरि बर्फी: शिजवलेले मिश्रण तूप लावलेल्या ताटात पसरा, थोडे सेट होऊ द्या आणि लाडू वळण्याऐवजी चौकोनी तुकडे कापा.
seg.676bca051e10.back: Kobbari barfi: spread the cooked mixture on a ghee-greased plate, let it set a little and cut square pieces instead of shaping laddus.

seg.80538d77ab41.src: Serve as an everyday sweet, offer them as naivedyam, or add them to the festival sweet plate.
seg.80538d77ab41.t: रोजचे गोड म्हणून वाढा, नैवेद्य म्हणून दाखवा, किंवा सणाच्या गोड पदार्थांच्या ताटात ठेवा.
seg.80538d77ab41.back: Serve as an everyday sweet, show (present) as naivedyam, or put on a festival sweets platter.

seg.6f3252f28ef8.src: Keep in an airtight container and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within a week if kept in the fridge.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.t: हवाबंद डब्यात ठेवा आणि खोलीच्या तापमानाला 3 दिवसांत खा, किंवा फ्रिजमध्ये ठेवल्यास आठवड्याभरात.
seg.6f3252f28ef8.back: Keep in an airtight box and eat within 3 days at room temperature, or within a week if kept in the fridge.

seg.f232fb960e89.src: Why are my kobbari undalu not holding shape?
seg.f232fb960e89.t: माझे कोब्बरि उंडलु आकार का धरत नाहीत?
seg.f232fb960e89.back: Why are my Kobbari Undalu not holding shape?

seg.1cf59b528a13.src: The mix needs a little more cooking. Put it back on a low flame for 2 minutes, stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then roll it while it is still warm.
seg.1cf59b528a13.t: मिश्रण थोडे आणखी शिजवायला हवे. ते परत मंद आचेवर 2 मिनिटे ढवळत शिजवा, ते पॅनच्या कडा सोडेपर्यंत, मग कोमट असतानाच लाडू वळा.
seg.1cf59b528a13.back: The mixture needs to be cooked a little more. Cook it again on low heat for 2 minutes, stirring, until it leaves the sides of the pan, then shape while warm.

seg.9371fa8705cd.src: Why did my laddus turn hard?
seg.9371fa8705cd.back: Why did my laddus become hard?

seg.ee988ba3472f.src: The jaggery was cooked too long or on too high a flame. Sprinkle in a spoon of warm milk, mix and press again. Next time, take the pan off the heat as soon as the mix holds together.
seg.ee988ba3472f.t: गूळ जास्त वेळ किंवा खूप तीव्र आचेवर शिजला. एक चमचा कोमट दूध शिंपडा, मिसळा आणि पुन्हा दाबा. पुढच्या वेळी मिश्रण एकत्र धरताच पॅन आचेवरून उतरवा.
seg.ee988ba3472f.back: The jaggery was cooked too long or on too high heat. Sprinkle a spoon of lukewarm milk, mix and press again. Next time, take the pan off the heat as soon as the mixture joins together.

seg.d830316a6adb.src: Can I make kobbari undalu with palm jaggery?
seg.d830316a6adb.t: कोब्बरि उंडलु ताडाच्या गुळाने करता येतात का?
seg.d830316a6adb.back: Can Kobbari Undalu be made with palm jaggery?

seg.813bf680c8a8.src: Yes. Use the same amount of grated palm jaggery (thati bellam). The laddus turn darker, with a slightly smoky sweetness.
seg.813bf680c8a8.t: हो. तेवढाच किसलेला ताडाचा गूळ (ताटि बेल्लम) वापरा. लाडू अधिक गडद होतात, हलक्या धुरकट गोड चवीसह.
seg.813bf680c8a8.back: Yes. Take the same quantity of grated palm jaggery (tati bellam). The laddus come out dark, with a light smoky sweet taste.

seg.ea6121eb3993.src: How long do kobbari undalu keep?
seg.ea6121eb3993.back: How many days do Kobbari Undalu last?

seg.26aba27412dc.src: About 3 days in an airtight container at room temperature, and up to a week in the fridge.
seg.26aba27412dc.t: हवाबंद डब्यात खोलीच्या तापमानाला सुमारे 3 दिवस, आणि फ्रिजमध्ये आठवड्यापर्यंत.
seg.26aba27412dc.back: About 3 days at room temperature in an airtight box, and up to a week in the fridge.

seg.0156a887ba6f.t: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. आंध्रचे कोब्बरि उंडलु: किसलेले खोबरे चेरुकु बेल्लम उसाचा गूळ, वेलची आणि तुपासह शिजवून लाडू वळलेले. टप्प्याटप्प्याने कृती, टिप्स आणि सामान्य प्रश्न.
seg.0156a887ba6f.back: కొబ్బరి ఉండలు. Andhra's Kobbari Undalu: grated coconut (khobre) cooked with Cheruku Bellam sugarcane jaggery, cardamom and ghee, with laddus shaped. Step by step method, tips and common questions.

seg.fc0444bcc4df.t: कोब्बरि उंडलु: 1acrefarms चे पाककृती कार्ड, साहित्य आणि कृतीसह
seg.fc0444bcc4df.back: Kobbari Undalu: 1acrefarms recipe card, with ingredients and method
